name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ActionProof.penalized_action_integral
statement:
lemma penalized_action_integral {σ δ ε l r η : ℝ}
    (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hlr : l ≤ r)
    (k : Fin N → ℝ) (a v : ℝ → Fin N → ℝ)
    (ha : ContinuousOn a (Icc l r)) (hv : ContinuousOn v (Icc l r))
    (had : ∀ t ∈ Ioo l r, ∀ i, HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ a t i) (v t i) t)
    (hal : a l = 0) (har : a r = 0) (X : ℝ → Sym N)
    (hXi : X l = symDiag k) (hXf : X r = -symDiag k)
    (hXd : ∀ t ∈ Icc l r, HasDerivWithinAt X
      (ε⁻¹ • (sourceField σ δ hσ₁ hδ k (X t) - symOuter (a t))) (Icc l r) t)
    (hp : ∀ t ∈ Icc l r, actionDefect σ k (X t,a t) - constraintDefect σ δ k (X t,a t)/ε ≤ η) :
    fieldPrimitive σ δ k (-diagonal k) - fieldPrimitive σ δ k (diagonal k) ≤
      (∫ t in l..r, actionDensity σ k (a t) (v t)) + (r-l)*η

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ConstantProof.betaAction_eq_Gamma
statement:
lemma betaAction_eq_Gamma {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    betaAction σ = Real.sqrt Real.pi * Real.Gamma (σ+1) / Real.Gamma (σ+3/2)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ConstantProof.betaAction_eq_beta
statement:
lemma betaAction_eq_beta {σ : ℝ} (_hσ : 0 < σ) :
    betaAction σ = 2 * (4 : ℝ)^σ * (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t^σ*(1-t)^σ)

statement: lemma betaAction_pos {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) : 0 < betaAction σ

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ConstantProof.boundary_action_scaling
statement:
lemma boundary_action_scaling {σ k : ℝ} (_hσ : 0 < σ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    (∫ s in -k..k, (k^2-s^2)^σ) = k^(1+2*σ)*betaAction σ

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ConstantProof.real_beta_symmetric
statement:
lemma real_beta_symmetric {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t^σ*(1-t)^σ) =
      Real.Gamma (σ+1)^2 / Real.Gamma (2*(σ+1))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ConstantProof.young_over_beta
statement:
lemma young_over_beta {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    (σ^σ/(1+σ)^(1+σ))/betaAction σ =
      (σ/(σ+1))^σ*Real.Gamma (σ+3/2)/(Real.sqrt Real.pi*Real.Gamma (σ+2))

lemma primitive_weak_derivative {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : LocallyIntegrable g volume)
    (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ) :
    (∫ x, (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..x, g t) * deriv φ x) = -(∫ x, g x * φ x)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.SobolevProof.real_eigen_of_weak
statement:
lemma real_eigen_of_weak {W f g : ℝ → ℝ} {k : ℝ}
    (hf : MemLp f 2 volume) (hg : MemLp g 2 volume)
    (hW : LocallyIntegrable W volume)
    (hw : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      (∫ x, f x*deriv φ x) = -(∫ x, g x*φ x))
    (hwe : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      (∫ x, g x*deriv φ x) = -(∫ x, (k^2-W x)*f x*φ x)) :
    ∃ u : RealEigenfunction W k, f =ᵐ[volume] u.val ∧ g =ᵐ[volume] u.grad

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.SobolevProof.weak_derivative_representation
statement:
lemma weak_derivative_representation {f g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : LocallyIntegrable f volume) (hg : LocallyIntegrable g volume)
    (hw : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      (∫ x, f x * deriv φ x) = -(∫ x, g x * φ x)) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, f =ᵐ[volume] fun x ↦ c + ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..x, g t

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.SpectralProof.triangular_action_upper
statement:
lemma triangular_action_upper {σ l r : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hlr : l ≤ r)
    (k : Fin N → ℝ) (a v : ℝ → Fin N → ℝ)
    (ha : ContinuousOn a (Icc l r)) (hv : ContinuousOn v (Icc l r))
    {W : ℝ → ℝ} (hW : IntervalIntegrable W volume l r)
    (hWn : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, 0 ≤ W x)
    (hWp : Integrable (fun x ↦ W x^(1+σ)))
    (he : (∫ t in l..r, (∑ i, v t i^2)+(∑ i, k i^2*a t i^2)) ≤
      ∫ t in l..r, W t*(∑ i, a t i^2)) :
    (∫ t in l..r, actionDensity σ k (a t) (v t)) ≤
      actionYoungConstant σ * ∫ t, W t^(1+σ)

    {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (hfar : ∀ x : E, d ≤ ‖φ-NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E x‖) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ (f : Fin N → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : Fin N → ℕ),
      (∀ j, ‖f j‖ = 1 ∧ d/2 < φ (f j)) ∧
      (∀ i j, j ≤ i → d/4 < f j (u (v i))) ∧
      (∀ i j, i < j → f j (u (v i)) = 0)

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.augmentedEnergy_midpoint
statement:
theorem augmentedEnergy_midpoint (a : MolecularData H) (S : Finset H) (D : ℝ)
    (f g : Smooth H) :
    augmentedEnergy a S D ((1/2:ℝ) • (f+g)) =
      (augmentedEnergy a S D f+augmentedEnergy a S D g)/2-augmentedEnergy a S D (f-g)/4

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.augmentedEnergy_nonneg
statement:
theorem augmentedEnergy_nonneg (a : MolecularData H) (S : Finset H) (D : ℝ) (f : Smooth H) :
    0 ≤ augmentedEnergy a S D f

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.gradEnergy_le_augmentedEnergy
statement:
theorem gradEnergy_le_augmentedEnergy (a : MolecularData H) (S : Finset H) (D : ℝ) (f : Smooth H) :
    gradEnergy a f ≤ augmentedEnergy a S D f

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.gradEnergy_le_cost
statement:
theorem gradEnergy_le_cost (a : MolecularData H) (f : Smooth H)
    (hf : LipschitzWith 1 (f : H → ℝ)) : gradEnergy a f ≤ a.cost

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.gradEnergy_smul
statement:
theorem gradEnergy_smul (a : MolecularData H) (c : ℝ) (f : Smooth H) :
    gradEnergy a (c • f) = c^2*gradEnergy a f

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.gradMass_le_young
statement:
theorem gradMass_le_young (a : MolecularData H) (f : Smooth H) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    gradMass a f ≤ t*a.cost+(4*t)⁻¹*gradEnergy a f

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.grad_integrable
statement:
theorem grad_integrable (f : Smooth H) (p q : H) :

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.grad_sq_integrable

theorem grad_sq_integrable (f : Smooth H) (p q : H) :

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.sq_value_le_augmentedEnergy
statement:
theorem sq_value_le_augmentedEnergy (a : MolecularData H) (S : Finset H) (D : ℝ) (f : Smooth H)

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.smoothPair_apply

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.augmentedEnergy_smul
statement:
theorem augmentedEnergy_smul (a : MolecularData H) (S : Finset H) (D c : ℝ) (f : Smooth H) :

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.dyadicMean_lipschitz
statement:
theorem dyadicMean_lipschitz (u : ℕ → Smooth H) (hu : ∀ i, LipschitzWith 1 (u i).val) (n k : ℕ) :

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.dyadicMean_zero_value

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.halfBlock_zero_value

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.half_sub_lipschitz
statement:
theorem half_sub_lipschitz {f g : H → ℝ} (hf : LipschitzWith 1 f) (hg : LipschitzWith 1 g) :

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.half_sum_lipschitz

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.damping_nonneg
statement:
theorem damping_nonneg {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) (z : ι → Smooth H)
    (hz : ∀ i ∈ s, LipschitzWith 1 (z i).val) (x : H) : 0 ≤ damping s z x

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.product_gradient_error
statement:
theorem product_gradient_error {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) (z : ι → Smooth H)
    (φ f : Smooth H) {x : H} {D ε : ℝ}
    (hf : ‖Smooth.grad x f‖ ≤ 1) (hφ : ‖Smooth.grad x φ‖ ≤ D)
    (happrox : |φ.val x-damping s z x| ≤ ε/2)
    (hsmall : |f.val x| * D ≤ ε/2) :
    ‖Smooth.grad x (φ.mul f)-damping s z x • Smooth.grad x f‖ ≤ ε

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.smoothPair_le_majorant
statement:
theorem smoothPair_le_majorant (a : MolecularData H) (f : Smooth H)
    {Q : Set H} (hQ : Convex ℝ Q) (ha : ∀ i, a.p i ∈ Q ∧ a.q i ∈ Q)
    (b : H → ℝ) (hb : Continuous b) (hbound : ∀ x ∈ Q, ‖Smooth.grad x f‖ ≤ b x) :
    |smoothPair a f| ≤ ∑ i, (|a.coeff i| * dist (a.p i) (a.q i))*
      ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, b (edge (a.p i) (a.q i) t)

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.smoothPair_le_masses
statement:
theorem smoothPair_le_masses {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) (z : ι → Smooth H)
    (a : MolecularData H) (f : Smooth H) {Q : Set H} (hQ : Convex ℝ Q)
    (ha : ∀ i, a.p i ∈ Q ∧ a.q i ∈ Q) (ε : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ x ∈ Q, ‖Smooth.grad x f‖ ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, ‖Smooth.grad x (z i)‖)+ε) :
    |smoothPair a f| ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, gradMass a (z i))+ε*a.cost

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.damping_telescope
statement:
theorem damping_telescope (z : ℕ → Smooth H) (n : ℕ) (x : H) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, damping (Finset.range j) z x * ‖Smooth.grad x (z j)‖) =
      1-damping (Finset.range n) z x

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.halfWeight_le_one
statement: theorem halfWeight_le_one (j : ℕ) : halfWeight j ≤ 1

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.halfWeight_pos
statement: theorem halfWeight_pos (j : ℕ) : 0 < halfWeight j

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.signed_sum_lipschitz
statement:
theorem signed_sum_lipschitz {Q : Set H} (hQ : Convex ℝ Q) (w : ℕ → Smooth H)
    (hgrad : ∀ n x, x ∈ Q → (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ‖Smooth.grad x (w i)‖) ≤ 2)
    (n : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i, |c i| ≤ 1) :
    LipschitzOnWith 2 (fun x => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i*(w i).val x) Q

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.sum_grad_norm_le
statement:
theorem sum_grad_norm_le {Q : Set H} (z w : ℕ → Smooth H) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hz : ∀ i, LipschitzWith 1 (z i).val)
    (hεsum : ∀ n, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ε i) ≤ 1)
    (herr : ∀ i x, x ∈ Q →
      ‖Smooth.grad x (w i)-damping (Finset.range i) z x • Smooth.grad x (z i)‖ ≤ ε i)
    (n : ℕ) {x : H} (hx : x ∈ Q) : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ‖Smooth.grad x (w i)‖) ≤ 2

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.sum_halfWeight
statement: theorem sum_halfWeight (n : ℕ) : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, halfWeight j = 1-(1/2:ℝ)^n

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.sum_halfWeight_le
statement: theorem sum_halfWeight_le (n : ℕ) : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, halfWeight j) ≤ 1

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.WeakSequences.sum_abs_le_of_signed_bound
statement:
theorem sum_abs_le_of_signed_bound (T : ℕ → E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hT : ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ i, |c i| ≤ 1) → ∀ x : E,
      |∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i*T i x| ≤ 2*‖x‖) (n : ℕ) (x : E) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, |T i x|) ≤ 2*‖x‖

name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.WeakSequences.uniform_small_of_wuc
statement:

    {u : ℕ → E} (hu : WeakCauchy u) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N, ∀ j ≥ N, ∀ k, |T j (u k)| < ε

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.arg_negative_imaginary
statement:
theorem arg_negative_imaginary {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    Complex.arg (-Complex.I * (t : ℂ)) = -Real.sign t * Real.pi / 2

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.integrable_schwartz_phase
statement:
theorem integrable_schwartz_phase (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (p : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hp : Continuous p) : Integrable (fun x ↦ f x * realPhase (p x))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.integral_schwartz_inverse_linear
statement:
theorem integral_schwartz_inverse_linear (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ ξ : ℝ, (𝓕⁻ f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) ξ * realPhase (-2 * Real.pi * ξ * x)) = f x

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.integral_schwartz_mul_gaussian
statement:
theorem integral_schwartz_mul_gaussian
    (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) {b : ℂ} (hb : 0 < b.re) (c : ℂ) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, f x * Complex.exp (-Real.pi * b * (x : ℂ) ^ 2 +
      2 * Real.pi * c * (x : ℂ))) =
    1 / b ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∫ ξ : ℝ, (𝓕⁻ f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) ξ *
      Complex.exp (-Real.pi / b * ((ξ : ℂ) + Complex.I * c) ^ 2)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.integral_schwartz_mul_gaussian_boundary
statement:
theorem integral_schwartz_mul_gaussian_boundary
    (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) {b : ℂ} (hb : 0 ≤ b.re) (hb0 : b ≠ 0) (u : ℝ) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, f x * Complex.exp (-Real.pi * b * (x : ℂ) ^ 2 -
      2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * u * x)) =
    1 / b ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∫ ξ : ℝ, (𝓕⁻ f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) ξ *
      Complex.exp (-Real.pi / b * ((ξ : ℂ) + u) ^ 2)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.integral_schwartz_quadratic_exact
statement:
theorem integral_schwartz_quadratic_exact (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ))
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) (u : ℝ) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, f x * realPhase (Real.pi * t * x ^ 2 - 2 * Real.pi * u * x)) =
    1 / (-Complex.I * (t : ℂ)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
      ∫ ξ : ℝ, (𝓕⁻ f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) ξ * realPhase (-Real.pi / t * (ξ + u) ^ 2)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.norm_damped_fourier_le_one
statement:
theorem norm_damped_fourier_le_one {b : ℂ} (hb : 0 ≤ b.re) (y : ℝ) :
    ‖Complex.exp (-Real.pi / b * (y : ℂ) ^ 2)‖ ≤ 1

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.norm_damped_quadratic_le_one
statement:
theorem norm_damped_quadratic_le_one {b : ℂ} (hb : 0 ≤ b.re) (u x : ℝ) :
    ‖Complex.exp (-Real.pi * b * (x : ℂ) ^ 2 -
      2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * u * x)‖ ≤ 1

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.norm_quadratic_multiplier_sub_one
statement:
theorem norm_quadratic_multiplier_sub_one {t : ℝ} (ξ : ℝ) :
    ‖realPhase (-Real.pi / t * ξ ^ 2) - 1‖ ≤ Real.pi / |t| * ξ ^ 2

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.norm_quadratic_prefactor
statement:
theorem norm_quadratic_prefactor (t u : ℝ) :
    ‖1 / (-Complex.I * (t : ℂ)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
        realPhase (-Real.pi / t * u ^ 2)‖ = 1 / Real.sqrt |t|

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.norm_realPhase
statement: @[simp] theorem norm_realPhase (x : ℝ) : ‖realPhase x‖ = 1

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.quadratic_prefactor_eq
statement:
theorem quadratic_prefactor_eq {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) (u : ℝ) :
    (1 / (-Complex.I * (t : ℂ)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)) *
        realPhase (-Real.pi / t * u ^ 2) =
      realPhase (Real.pi * Real.sign t / 4 - Real.pi * u ^ 2 / t) /
        (Real.sqrt |t| : ℂ)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.realPhase_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem realPhase_add (x y : ℝ) :
    realPhase (x + y) = realPhase x * realPhase y

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.uniform_quadratic_error
statement:
theorem uniform_quadratic_error (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) (u : ℝ) :
    ∃ E : ℂ,
      ‖E‖ ≤ Real.pi / |t| * (∫ ξ : ℝ, ξ ^ 2 * ‖(𝓕⁻ f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) ξ‖) ∧
      (∫ x : ℝ, f x * realPhase (Real.pi * t * x ^ 2 - 2 * Real.pi * u * x)) =
        (1 / (-Complex.I * (t : ℂ)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
          realPhase (-Real.pi / t * u ^ 2)) * (f (u / t) + E)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.uniform_quadratic_integration
statement:
theorem uniform_quadratic_integration (g : ℝ → ℂ) (hg : HasCompactSupport g)
    (hgs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) {β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (u : ℝ) :
    ∃ E : ℂ,
      ‖E‖ ≤ (Real.pi / |β| * (∫ ξ : ℝ, ξ ^ 2 *
        ‖(𝓕⁻ (hg.toSchwartzMap hgs) : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) ξ‖)) / T ∧
      (∫ x : ℝ, g x * realPhase (2 * Real.pi * (T * β * x ^ 2 / 2 - u * x))) =
        (realPhase (2 * Real.pi * (Real.sign β / 8 - u ^ 2 / (2 * T * β))) /
          (Real.sqrt (T * |β|) : ℂ)) * (g (u / (T * β)) + E)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.abs_boolSign
statement: @[simp] theorem abs_boolSign (b : Bool) : |boolSign b| = 1

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.bool_exp_sum_le
statement:
theorem bool_exp_sum_le {a : ℝ} (ha : |a| ≤ 1) (t : ℝ) :
    (∑ b : Bool, Real.exp (t * a * boolSign b)) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.card_good_cost
statement:
theorem card_good_cost {γ : Type w} [Fintype γ] [DecidableEq γ]
    (f : γ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (hsum : (∑ x, f x) ≤ (Fintype.card γ : ℝ) * M / 2) :
    (Fintype.card γ : ℝ) / 2 ≤ ((Finset.univ.filter fun x ↦ f x ≤ M).card : ℝ)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.discrepancy_potential_contract
statement:
theorem discrepancy_potential_contract {s u R : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hsR : s ≤ R)
    (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu : u ≤ (15 / 16) * s) :
    Real.sqrt (u * Real.log (16 * R / u)) ≤
      (63 / 64) * Real.sqrt (s * Real.log (16 * R / s))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.dyadic_potential_bound
statement:
theorem dyadic_potential_bound {s μ R : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (hμR : 2 * μ ≤ R)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (j : ℕ) (hsmass : s ≤ 2 ^ j * μ) :
    Real.sqrt (s * Real.log (2 * R / s)) / 2 ^ j ≤
      (3 / 4) ^ j * Real.sqrt (μ * Real.log (2 * R / μ))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.entropy_log_parameters
statement:
theorem entropy_log_parameters {s R : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hsR : s ≤ R) :
    let L := Real.log (16 * R / s)
    1 / 2 ≤ L ∧ Real.exp (-4 * L) ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
      2 * R * Real.exp (-128 * L) ≤ s / (512 * L) ∧
      4 * R * Real.exp (-4 * L) ≤ s / 64

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.exp_small_lt_half_cube
statement:
theorem exp_small_lt_half_cube {n : ℕ} (hn : 32 ≤ n) :
    Real.exp (13 * n / 32) < (2 : ℝ) ^ n / 2

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.grid_dirichlet_square
statement:
theorem grid_dirichlet_square {M n : ℕ} [NeZero M] (hn : n ≤ M)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) :
    (∑ j : ZMod M, ‖∑ a : Fin n, z ^ (a : ℕ) * conj (ZMod.stdAddChar j ^ (a : ℕ))‖ ^ 2) =
      (M : ℝ) * n

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.grid_power_orthogonality
statement:
theorem grid_power_orthogonality {M a b : ℕ} [NeZero M] (ha : a < M) (hb : b < M) :
    (∑ j : ZMod M, ZMod.stdAddChar j ^ a * conj (ZMod.stdAddChar j ^ b)) =
      if a = b then (M : ℂ) else 0

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.grid_reproduce_monomial
statement:
theorem grid_reproduce_monomial {M N : ℕ} [NeZero M] (hNM : 2 * N ≤ M)
    (k : Fin N) {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) :
    (∑ j : ZMod M, ZMod.stdAddChar j ^ (k : ℕ) * gridDirichlet (2 * N) z j *
      conj (gridDirichlet N z j)) = (M : ℂ) * N * z ^ (k : ℕ)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.hamming_exp_sum
statement:
theorem hamming_exp_sum {α : Type u} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (x : α → Bool) (a : ℝ) :
    (∑ y : α → Bool, Real.exp (-a * hammingDist x y)) =
      (1 + Real.exp (-a)) ^ Fintype.card α

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.hamming_small_family_card
statement:
theorem hamming_small_family_card {α : Type u} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (G : Finset (α → Bool)) (x : α → Bool)
    (hG : ∀ y ∈ G, (hammingDist x y : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card α : ℝ) / 16) :
    (G.card : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (3 * Fintype.card α / 8)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.int_exp_sum_le
statement:
theorem int_exp_sum_le (S : Finset ℤ) (a : ℝ) (ha : Real.exp (-a) ≤ 1 / 2) :
    (∑ z ∈ S, Real.exp (-a * |(z : ℝ)|)) ≤ Real.exp (4 * Real.exp (-a))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.int_geometric_sum_le
statement:
theorem int_geometric_sum_le (S : Finset ℤ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq' : q ≤ 1 / 2) :
    (∑ z ∈ S, q ^ z.natAbs) ≤ Real.exp (4 * q)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.polynomial_grid_bound
statement:
theorem polynomial_grid_bound {N M : ℕ} [NeZero M] (hN : 0 < N) (hNM : 2 * N ≤ M)
    (c : Fin N → ℂ) {G : ℝ} (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    (hgrid : ∀ j : ZMod M, ‖∑ k : Fin N, c k * ZMod.stdAddChar j ^ (k : ℕ)‖ ≤ G)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) :
    ‖∑ k : Fin N, c k * z ^ (k : ℕ)‖ ≤ 2 * G

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.round_abs_le_exp_pair
statement:
theorem round_abs_le_exp_pair {x d t : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (htd : 4 ≤ t * d) :
    |(round (x / d) : ℝ)| ≤
      Real.exp (t * x - t * d / 4) + Real.exp (-t * x - t * d / 4)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.binary_cons
statement:
lemma binary_cons (n : ℕ) (u : UnitAddCircle) (y : Fin n → UnitAddCircle) :
    binary (n+1) (Fin.cons u y) = binary n y+(1-binary n y^2)/2*cosine u

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.binary_continuous
statement: @[fun_prop] lemma binary_continuous (n : ℕ) : Continuous (binary n)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.binary_mean_zero
statement: lemma binary_mean_zero (n : ℕ) : (∫ x : Fin n → UnitAddCircle, binary n x) = 0

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.binary_spectrum
statement:
lemma binary_spectrum (n : ℕ) :
    (fun x : Fin n → UnitAddCircle ↦ (binary n x : ℂ)) ∈ spectrumSpan (primitive n)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.binary_support_neg
statement:
lemma binary_support_neg {n : ℕ} (c : (Fin n → ℤ) →₀ ℂ)
    (he : ∀ x, (binary n x : ℂ) = ∑ s ∈ c.support, c s*mFourier s x) (s : Fin n → ℤ) :
    -s ∈ c.support ↔ s ∈ c.support

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.character_cons
statement:
lemma character_cons {n : ℕ} (k : ℤ) (s : Fin n → ℤ) (x : Fin (n+1) → UnitAddCircle) :
    mFourier (Fin.cons k s) x = fourier k (x 0)*mFourier s (Fin.tail x)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.character_mem
statement:
lemma character_mem {n : ℕ} {P : (Fin n → ℤ) → Prop} {s : Fin n → ℤ} (h : P s) :
    (mFourier s : (Fin n → UnitAddCircle) → ℂ) ∈ spectrumSpan P

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.coeff_finite_sum
statement:
lemma coeff_finite_sum {n : ℕ} (c : (Fin n → ℤ) →₀ ℂ) (s : Fin n → ℤ) :
    mFourierCoeff (fun x ↦ ∑ t ∈ c.support, c t*mFourier t x) s = c s

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.coeff_real_neg
statement:
lemma coeff_real_neg {n : ℕ} (f : (Fin n → UnitAddCircle) → ℝ) (s : Fin n → ℤ) :
    mFourierCoeff (fun x ↦ (f x : ℂ)) (-s) = conj (mFourierCoeff (fun x ↦ (f x : ℂ)) s)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.coefficient_support_pairs
statement:
lemma coefficient_support_pairs {n : ℕ} (c : (Fin n → ℤ) →₀ ℂ)
    (hp : ∀ s ∈ c.support, primitive n s)
    (he : ∀ x, (binary n x : ℂ) = ∑ s ∈ c.support, c s*mFourier s x) :
    ∃ S : Finset (Fin n → ℤ), (∀ s ∈ S, positive n s) ∧
      ∀ s, s ∈ c.support ↔ s ∈ S ∨ -s ∈ S

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.cosine_abs_le
statement: lemma cosine_abs_le (x : UnitAddCircle) : |cosine x| ≤ 1

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.cosine_cast
statement:
lemma cosine_cast (x : UnitAddCircle) :

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.cosine_continuous
statement: @[fun_prop] lemma cosine_continuous : Continuous cosine

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.energy_bounds
statement: lemma energy_bounds (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ energy n ∧ energy n ≤ 1

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.energy_increment
statement: lemma energy_increment (n : ℕ) : energy n+(1-energy n)^2/8 ≤ energy (n+1)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.energy_monotone
statement: lemma energy_monotone : Monotone energy

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.energy_succ
statement:
lemma energy_succ (n : ℕ) : energy (n+1) = energy n +
    (1/8)*∫ y : Fin n → UnitAddCircle, (1-binary n y^2)^2

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.exists_binary_coefficients
statement:
lemma exists_binary_coefficients (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : (Fin n → ℤ) →₀ ℂ, (∀ s ∈ c.support, primitive n s) ∧
      ∀ x, (binary n x : ℂ) = ∑ s ∈ c.support, c s*mFourier s x

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.exists_binary_energy
statement:
lemma exists_binary_energy {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.integral_character
statement:
lemma integral_character {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℤ) :
    (∫ x : Fin n → UnitAddCircle, mFourier s x) = if s=0 then 1 else 0

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.integral_circle_fourier
statement:
lemma integral_circle_fourier (n : ℤ) :

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.integral_cosine_linear
statement:
lemma integral_cosine_linear (a b : ℝ) :
    (∫ u : UnitAddCircle, a+b*cosine u) = a

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.integral_cosine_sq
statement: lemma integral_cosine_sq : (∫ x : UnitAddCircle, cosine x ^ 2) = 1/2

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.integral_cosine_square
statement:
lemma integral_cosine_square (a b : ℝ) :

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.integral_pi_cons

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.parseval_continuous

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Curvature.determinant_tuning
statement:
theorem determinant_tuning {I : Type uI} {V : Type uV} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
    (f : I → V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, f i ≠ 0)
    (hpair : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ c : ℝ, f i ≠ c • f j)
    (A : I → ℝ) (hA : ∀ i, 0 < A i) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) :
    ∃ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ ∧ ∃ b : I → V,
      (∀ i j, f i (b j) ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ i, (1-δ)*τ*A i ≤ ∏ j, |f i (b j)| ∧
        (∏ j, |f i (b j)|) ≤ (1+δ)*τ*A i

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Curvature.exists_generic
statement:
lemma exists_generic {I : Type uI} {V : Type uV} [Finite I] [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
    (f : I → V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, f i ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x, ∀ i, f i x ≠ 0

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Curvature.exists_kernel_vectors
statement:
lemma exists_kernel_vectors {I : Type uI} {V : Type uV} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (f : I → V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i, f i ≠ 0) (hpair : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ c : ℝ, f i ≠ c • f j) :
    ∃ b : I → V, (∀ i, f i (b i) = 0) ∧ (∀ i j, i ≠ j → f i (b j) ≠ 0)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Curvature.separating_kernel
statement:
lemma separating_kernel {V : Type uV} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
    (f g : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hf : f ≠ 0) (hfg : ∀ c : ℝ, g ≠ c • f) :
    ∃ x, f x = 0 ∧ g x ≠ 0

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Cutoff.unit_cutoff
statement:
theorem unit_cutoff {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧
      (∃ α : ℝ, 0 < α ∧ α < 1/2 ∧ tsupport g ⊆ Icc (-α) α) ∧
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x ∧ g x ≤ 1) ∧
      1-ε < ∫ x : ℝ, g x ^ 2

OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.QuadraticTail.circleChirp_continuous

statement:
lemma fourier_truncation_error (f : C(UnitAddCircle,ℂ)) (S : Finset ℤ)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.QuadraticTail.latticeWeight_summable
statement: lemma latticeWeight_summable : Summable latticeWeight

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.QuadraticTail.offbox_decay
statement:
theorem offbox_decay {g : ℝ → ℂ} (hg : HasCompactSupport g) (hgs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g)
    {α β : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hα' : α < 1/2) (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    (hsupp : tsupport g ⊆ Set.Icc (-α) α) (l : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ T w : ℝ, 0 < T → T*|β|/2 < |w| →
      (T+|w|)^l * ‖∫ x : ℝ, g x*phase (T*β) w x‖ ≤ C

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.QuadraticTail.osc_bound_zero
statement:
lemma osc_bound_zero {g : ℝ → ℂ} (hg : HasCompactSupport g) (hgs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g)
    {c M : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hM : 0 < M) (t u : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (hsep : ∀ x ∈ tsupport g, c*M ≤ |t*x-u|) :
    M^k * ‖osc g t u k‖ ≤ (∫ x : ℝ, ‖g x‖) / c^k

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.QuadraticTail.osc_integrable
statement:
lemma osc_integrable {g : ℝ → ℂ} (hg : HasCompactSupport g) (hgs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g)
    (t u : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (havoid : ∀ x ∈ tsupport g, t*x-u ≠ 0) :
    Integrable (fun x ↦ amp g t u k x * phase t u x)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.QuadraticTail.osc_parts
statement:
lemma osc_parts {g : ℝ → ℂ} (hg : HasCompactSupport g) (hgs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g)
    (t u : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (havoid : ∀ x ∈ tsupport g, t*x-u ≠ 0) :
    (2*Real.pi*Complex.I)*osc g t u k =
      -(osc (deriv g) t u (k+1) - ((k+1 : ℕ) : ℂ)*(t : ℂ)*osc g t u (k+2))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.QuadraticTail.phase_fourier
statement:
lemma phase_fourier (t x : ℝ) (w : ℤ) :
    fourier (-w) (x : UnitAddCircle) * phase t 0 x = phase t w x

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.QuadraticTail.phase_norm
statement: lemma phase_norm (t u x : ℝ) : ‖phase t u x‖ = 1

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.QuadraticTail.phase_smooth
statement: lemma phase_smooth (t u : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (phase t u)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.QuadraticTail.polynomial_decay
statement:
theorem polynomial_decay (l : ℕ) (c B : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    ∀ (g : ℝ → ℂ), HasCompactSupport g → ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → ∀ k : ℕ,
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (t u M : ℝ), 0 < M → |t| ≤ B*M →
      (∀ x ∈ tsupport g, c*M ≤ |t*x-u|) → M^(k+l)*‖osc g t u k‖ ≤ C

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.QuadraticTail.rowTrunc_error
statement:
theorem rowTrunc_error {g : ℝ → ℂ} (hg : HasCompactSupport g)
    (hgs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0≤α) (hα : α<1/2)
    (hs : tsupport g ⊆ Set.Icc (-α) α) {β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0≤C ∧ ∀ T : ℝ, 1≤T → ∀ z : UnitAddCircle,
      ‖rowTrunc g T β z-circleChirp g (T*β) z‖ ≤ C/T

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.binary_positive_data
statement:
lemma binary_positive_data {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ<1) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ S : Finset (Fin n → ℤ), S.Nonempty ∧
      (∀ s ∈ S, positive n s) ∧ ∃ c : (Fin n → ℤ) → ℂ,
      (∀ s ∈ S, c s≠0) ∧
      (∀ x : Fin n → UnitAddCircle,
        (binary n x : ℂ) = (∑ s ∈ S, c s*mFourier s x) +
          conj (∑ s ∈ S, c s*mFourier s x)) ∧
      1-δ ≤ 2*∑ s ∈ S, ‖c s‖^2 ∧ 2*∑ s ∈ S, ‖c s‖^2 ≤ 1

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.cutoff_power
statement:
lemma cutoff_power {D : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ<1) :
    ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧
      (∃ α : ℝ, 0<α ∧ α<1/2 ∧ tsupport g ⊆ Set.Icc (-α) α) ∧
      (∀ x, 0≤g x ∧ g x≤1) ∧
      1-δ < (∫ x : ℝ, g x^2)^D

statement:
lemma mFourier_add_point {J : Type uJ} [Fintype J] (s : J → ℤ)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.mFourier_norm_apply
statement:
lemma mFourier_norm_apply {J : Type uJ} [Fintype J] (s : J → ℤ)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.mFourier_real
statement:
lemma mFourier_real {J : Type uJ} [Fintype J] (s : J → ℤ) (x : J → ℝ) :
    mFourier s (fun j ↦ (x j : UnitAddCircle)) =
      Complex.exp (Complex.I*(2*Real.pi*(∑ j, (s j : ℝ)*x j) : ℝ))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.mFourier_sum_type
statement:
lemma mFourier_sum_type {J : Type uJ} {K : Type uK} [Fintype J] [Fintype K]
    (s : J → ℤ) (u : K → ℤ) (x : J ⊕ K → UnitAddCircle) :
    mFourier (Sum.elim s u) x = mFourier s (x ∘ Sum.inl)*mFourier u (x ∘ Sum.inr)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.phase_tensor_character
statement:
lemma phase_tensor_character {n : ℕ} {J : Type uJ} [Fintype J]
    (s : Fin n → ℤ) (b : J → Fin n → ℝ) (B : ℝ) (z : J → ℝ) :
    (∏ j, phase (B*rowForm s (b j)) 0 (z j)) =
      mFourier s (fun k ↦ ((B/2*∑ j, b j k*z j^2 : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.positive_rowForm_ne_zero
statement:
lemma positive_rowForm_ne_zero {n : ℕ} {s : Fin n → ℤ} (hs : positive n s) :

OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.rowForm_apply

lemma rowForm_apply {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℤ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.spread_numeric_coefficient
statement:
lemma spread_numeric_coefficient {δ τ P Δ ρ U V : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ<1) (hτ : 0<τ) (hP : 0<P) (hρ : 0<ρ)
    (_hU : 0≤U) (hV : 0≤V)
    (hdet : (1-δ)*τ*U/ρ ≤ Δ) (hdisc : P*Δ*V≤(1+δ)^2) :
    U*V/(1+δ)^2 ≤ ((1+δ)^3/(1-δ))*(ρ/(τ*P*(1+δ)^3))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.spread_numeric_energy
statement:
lemma spread_numeric_energy {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ<1/20) :
    (1-3*δ)^2 ≤ ((1-δ)*(1-2*δ))/(1+δ)^2

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.spread_numeric_width
statement:
lemma spread_numeric_width {δ τ P Δ ρ U L : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0<δ) (hτ : 0<τ) (hP : 0<P) (hρ : 0<ρ)
    (hdet : Δ ≤ (1+δ)*τ*U/ρ) (hcard : L≤(1+δ)*P*Δ) :
    L*(ρ/(τ*P*(1+δ)^3))≤U/(1+δ)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.support_pair_sum
statement:
lemma support_pair_sum {n : ℕ} (c : (Fin n → ℤ) →₀ ℂ)
    (S : Finset (Fin n → ℤ)) (hp : ∀ s ∈ S, positive n s)
    (hc : ∀ s, s ∈ c.support ↔ s ∈ S ∨ -s ∈ S)
    {E : Type uE} [AddCommMonoid E] (f : (Fin n → ℤ) → E) :
    ∑ s ∈ c.support, f s = ∑ s ∈ S, (f s+f (-s))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Auxiliary.tensor_trunc_expand
statement:
lemma tensor_trunc_expand {J : Type uJ} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    (g : ℝ → ℂ) (B : ℝ) (β : J → ℝ) (z : J → UnitAddCircle) :
    (∏ j, rowTrunc g B (β j) (z j)) =
      ∑ u∈multiBox B β, (∏ j, ∫ x : ℝ, g x*phase (B*β j) (u j) x)*mFourier u z

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Spreading.determinant_pos
statement: lemma determinant_pos {β : I → ℝ} (hβ : ∀ i, β i≠0) : 0<determinant β

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Spreading.quadratic_norm_scaled
statement:
lemma quadratic_norm_scaled {g : ℝ → ℂ} (hg : HasCompactSupport g)
    (hgs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) (hg1 : ∀ x, ‖g x‖≤1)
    {β : ℝ} (hβ : β≠0) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0≤C ∧ ∀ T, 0<T → ∀ u : ℝ,
      T*|β| *‖∫ x : ℝ, g x*phase (T*β) u x‖^2 ≤ (1+C/T)^2

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Spreading.tensor_mass_tendsto
statement:
lemma tensor_mass_tendsto {g : ℝ → ℂ} (hg : HasCompactSupport g)
    (hgs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) (hg1 : ∀ x, ‖g x‖≤1) {α : ℝ}
    (hα0 : 0≤α) (hα : α<1/2) (hs : tsupport g ⊆ Set.Icc (-α) α)
    {β : I → ℝ} (hβ : ∀ i, β i≠0) :
    Tendsto (fun B : ℝ ↦ ∑ u ∈ multiBox B β,
      ‖∏ i, (∫ x : ℝ, g x*phase (B*β i) (u i) x)‖^2)
      atTop (𝓝 ((∫ x : ℝ, ‖g x‖^2)^(Fintype.card I)))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.chebyshev_indicator
statement:
lemma chebyshev_indicator {p t : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (f : (E → Bool) → ℝ) :
    t ^ 2 * expectation p (fun s ↦ if t < |f s - expectation p f| then 1 else 0) ≤
      expectation p (fun s ↦ (f s - expectation p f) ^ 2)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.coinWeight_nonneg
statement:
lemma coinWeight_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (s : E → Bool) :
    0 ≤ coinWeight p s

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.coinWeight_sum
statement: lemma coinWeight_sum (p : ℝ) : (∑ s : E → Bool, coinWeight p s) = 1

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.exists_controlled_outcome
statement:
lemma exists_controlled_outcome {I : Type uI} [DecidableEq I] {p : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (U : Finset I)
    (Y : I → (E → Bool) → ℝ) (Z W : (E → Bool) → ℝ)
    {V Vz M t b u c : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hb : 0 < b) (hu : 0 < u) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hY : ∀ i ∈ U, expectation p (fun s ↦ (Y i s - expectation p (Y i))^2) ≤ V)
    (hZ : expectation p (fun s ↦ (Z s - expectation p Z)^2) ≤ Vz)
    (hW0 : ∀ s, 0 ≤ W s) (hW : expectation p W ≤ M)
    (hV : 4 * U.card * V ≤ t^2*b) (hVz : 4*Vz ≤ u^2) (hM : 4*M ≤ c) :
    ∃ s, (((U.filter fun i ↦ t < |Y i s - expectation p (Y i)|).card : ℝ) ≤ b) ∧
      |Z s - expectation p Z| ≤ u ∧ W s ≤ c

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.exists_le_expectation
statement:
lemma exists_le_expectation {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (f : (E → Bool) → ℝ) : ∃ s, f s ≤ expectation p f

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.exists_of_three_bad_bounds
statement:
lemma exists_of_three_bad_bounds {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (P Q R : (E → Bool) → Prop) [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred Q] [DecidablePred R]
    (hP : expectation p (fun s ↦ if P s then 1 else 0) ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hQ : expectation p (fun s ↦ if Q s then 1 else 0) ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hR : expectation p (fun s ↦ if R s then 1 else 0) ≤ 1 / 4) :
    ∃ s, ¬ P s ∧ ¬ Q s ∧ ¬ R s

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.expectation_add
statement:
lemma expectation_add (p : ℝ) (f g : (E → Bool) → ℝ) :
    expectation p (fun s ↦ f s + g s) = expectation p f + expectation p g

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.expectation_const
statement: lemma expectation_const (p c : ℝ) : expectation (E := E) p (fun _ ↦ c) = c

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.expectation_const_mul
statement:
lemma expectation_const_mul (p c : ℝ) (f : (E → Bool) → ℝ) :
    expectation p (fun s ↦ c * f s) = c * expectation p f

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.expectation_mono
statement:
lemma expectation_mono {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    {f g : (E → Bool) → ℝ} (h : ∀ s, f s ≤ g s) : expectation p f ≤ expectation p g

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.expectation_mul_const
statement:
lemma expectation_mul_const (p : ℝ) (f : (E → Bool) → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    expectation p (fun s ↦ f s * c) = expectation p f * c

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.expectation_noHit
statement:
lemma expectation_noHit (p : ℝ) (A : Finset E) :
    expectation p (noHit A) = (1 - p) ^ A.card

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.expectation_nonneg
statement:
lemma expectation_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    {f : (E → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : ∀ s, 0 ≤ f s) : 0 ≤ expectation p f

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.expectation_prod
statement:
lemma expectation_prod (p : ℝ) (g : E → Bool → ℝ) :
    expectation p (fun s ↦ ∏ e, g e (s e)) =
      ∏ e, (p * g e true + (1 - p) * g e false)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.expectation_selected
statement: lemma expectation_selected (p : ℝ) (e : E) : expectation p (selectedIndicator e) = p

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.expectation_selected_mul
statement:
lemma expectation_selected_mul (p : ℝ) (e f : E) (hef : e ≠ f) :
    expectation p (fun s ↦ selectedIndicator e s * selectedIndicator f s) = p^2

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.expectation_sub
statement:
lemma expectation_sub (p : ℝ) (f g : (E → Bool) → ℝ) :
    expectation p (fun s ↦ f s - g s) = expectation p f - expectation p g

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.expectation_sum
statement:
lemma expectation_sum {I : Type uI} (p : ℝ) (S : Finset I) (f : I → (E → Bool) → ℝ) :
    expectation p (fun s ↦ ∑ i ∈ S, f i s) = ∑ i ∈ S, expectation p (f i)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.markov_indicator
statement:
lemma markov_indicator {p t : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (_ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (f : (E → Bool) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ s, 0 ≤ f s) :
    t * expectation p (fun s ↦ if t < f s then 1 else 0) ≤ expectation p f

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.noHit_covariance_le
statement:
lemma noHit_covariance_le {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (A B : Finset E) :
    expectation p (fun s ↦ noHit A s * noHit B s) -
      expectation p (noHit A) * expectation p (noHit B) ≤ p * (A ∩ B).card

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.noHit_eq
statement:
lemma noHit_eq (A : Finset E) (s : E → Bool) :
    noHit A s = if ∀ e ∈ A, s e = false then 1 else 0

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.noHit_le_one
statement: lemma noHit_le_one (A : Finset E) (s : E → Bool) : noHit A s ≤ 1

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.noHit_mean_error
statement:
lemma noHit_mean_error {I : Type uI} {p M B L : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (S : Finset I) (A : I → Finset E)
    (hcard : ∀ i ∈ S, |((A i).card : ℝ) - M| ≤ B)
    (hupper : ∀ i ∈ S, ((A i).card : ℝ) ≤ L) :
    |expectation p (fun s ↦ ∑ i ∈ S, noHit (A i) s) - S.card * (1 - p * M)| ≤
      S.card * (p * B + (p * L)^2 / 2)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.noHit_nonneg
statement: lemma noHit_nonneg (A : Finset E) (s : E → Bool) : 0 ≤ noHit A s

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.noHit_sum_variance
statement:
lemma noHit_sum_variance {I : Type uI} [DecidableEq I] {p : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (S : Finset I) (A : I → Finset E)
    {K L : ℝ} (hK0 : 0 ≤ K) (hL : ∀ i ∈ S, ((A i).card : ℝ) ≤ L)
    (hK : ∀ e, ((S.filter fun i ↦ e ∈ A i).card : ℝ) ≤ K) :
    let Y : (E → Bool) → ℝ := fun s ↦ ∑ i ∈ S, noHit (A i) s
    expectation p (fun s ↦ (Y s - expectation p Y) ^ 2) ≤
      p * S.card * L * K

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.noHit_union
statement:
lemma noHit_union (A B : Finset E) (s : E → Bool) :
    noHit (A ∪ B) s = noHit A s * noHit B s

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.one_sub_pow_le
statement:
lemma one_sub_pow_le {p : ℝ} (_hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) :
    1 - (1 - p) ^ n ≤ n * p

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.pow_bonferroni
statement:
lemma pow_bonferroni {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) :
    (1 - p) ^ n - (1 - n * p) ≤ (n * p) ^ 2 / 2

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.selectedIndicator_eq
statement:
lemma selectedIndicator_eq (e : E) (s : E → Bool) :
    selectedIndicator e s = 1 - noHit {e} s

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.selectedIndicator_nonneg
statement: lemma selectedIndicator_nonneg (e : E) (s : E → Bool) : 0 ≤ selectedIndicator e s

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.PackingState.compose_waste
statement:
lemma compose_waste {U : Finset V} {S : Finset E} {A : E → Finset V}
    (P : PackingState U S A) (Q : PackingState P.vertices P.edges A) :
    ((U \ ((P.compose Q).vertices ∪ (P.compose Q).chosen.biUnion A)).card : ℝ) ≤
      (U \ (P.vertices ∪ P.chosen.biUnion A)).card +
      (P.vertices \ (Q.vertices ∪ Q.chosen.biUnion A)).card

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.almost_perfect_matching
statement:
theorem almost_perfect_matching (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) {K₀ η : ℝ}
    (hK₀ : 0 ≤ K₀) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ e T : ℝ, 0 < e ∧ 0 < T ∧
    ∀ {V E : Type} [DecidableEq V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E],
    ∀ (U : Finset V) (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V) (D C : ℝ),
      T ≤ D → T ≤ (U.card : ℝ) → 0 ≤ C → C ≤ e*D →
      U.card*C ≤ K₀*D →
      (∀ i ∈ S, A i ⊆ U) → (∀ i ∈ S, (A i).card = r) →
      (∀ v ∈ U, |((incident S A v).card : ℝ)-D| ≤ e*D) →
      (∀ v ∈ U, ∀ w ∈ U, v ≠ w →
        ((incident S A v ∩ incident S A w).card : ℝ) ≤ C) →
      ∃ M ⊆ S, (M : Set E).Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (A i) (A j)) ∧
        (1-η)*(U.card : ℝ) ≤ r*(M.card : ℝ)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.card_biUnion_lower
statement:
lemma card_biUnion_lower (S : Finset I) (A : I → Finset E) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hpair : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j ∈ S, i ≠ j → ((A i ∩ A j).card : ℝ) ≤ C) :
    (∑ i ∈ S, ((A i).card : ℝ)) ≤ ((S.biUnion A).card : ℝ) + (S.card : ℝ) ^ 2 * C

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.card_biUnion_upper
OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.colliding_card_le
statement:
lemma colliding_card_le (U : Finset V) (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V)
    (hsub : ∀ e ∈ S, A e ⊆ U) (s : E → Bool) :
    ((colliding S A s).card : ℝ) ≤ collisionCount U S A s

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.collisionCount_mean
statement:
lemma collisionCount_mean (U : Finset V) (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V)
    {p D : ℝ} (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hdeg : ∀ v ∈ U, ((incident S A v).card : ℝ) ≤ D) :
    expectation p (collisionCount U S A) ≤ p^2 * U.card * D^2

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.collisionCount_nonneg
statement:
lemma collisionCount_nonneg (U : Finset V) (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V) (s : E → Bool) :
    0 ≤ collisionCount U S A s

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.degree_loss_deleting
statement:
lemma degree_loss_deleting (U B : Finset V) (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V)
    {C : ℝ} (_hC : 0 ≤ C) (hsub : ∀ e ∈ S, A e ⊆ U)
    (v : V) (hc : ∀ w ∈ B, v ≠ w → ((incident S A v ∩ incident S A w).card : ℝ) ≤ C)
    (hv : v ∉ B) :
    ((incident S A v).card : ℝ) - B.card*C ≤
      ((incident (restrictEdges S A (U \ B)) A v).card : ℝ)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.hits_card_deviation
statement:
lemma hits_card_deviation (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V) (W : Finset V)
    {D e C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hD : ∀ v ∈ W, |((incident S A v).card : ℝ) - D| ≤ e)
    (hpair : ∀ v ∈ W, ∀ w ∈ W, v ≠ w →
      ((incident S A v ∩ incident S A w).card : ℝ) ≤ C) :
    |((hits S A W).card : ℝ) - W.card * D| ≤ W.card * e + (W.card : ℝ) ^ 2 * C

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.hits_card_upper
OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.incident_mono
statement:
lemma incident_mono {S T : Finset E} (h : S ⊆ T) (A : E → Finset V) (v : V) :
    incident S A v ⊆ incident T A v

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.incident_restrict
statement:
lemma incident_restrict (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V) (W : Finset V) (v : V) :
    incident (restrictEdges S A W) A v = (incident S A v).filter fun e ↦ A e ⊆ W

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.incident_restrict_subset
statement:
lemma incident_restrict_subset (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V) (W : Finset V) (v : V) :
    incident (restrictEdges S A W) A v ⊆ incident S A v

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.isolated_pairwise
statement:
lemma isolated_pairwise (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V) (s : E → Bool) :
    (isolated S A s : Set E).Pairwise (fun e f ↦ Disjoint (A e) (A f))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.isolated_untouched_disjoint
statement:
lemma isolated_untouched_disjoint (U : Finset V) (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V)
    (s : E → Bool) : Disjoint ((isolated S A s).biUnion A) (untouched U S A s)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.mem_hits
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_hits (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V) (W : Finset V) (e : E) :
    e ∈ hits S A W ↔ e ∈ S ∧ ∃ v ∈ W, v ∈ A e

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.mem_incident
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_incident (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V) (v : V) (e : E) :
    e ∈ incident S A v ↔ e ∈ S ∧ v ∈ A e

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.nibble_bad_loss
statement:
lemma nibble_bad_loss {n D C a K : ℝ} (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hcode : n*C ≤ K*D) :
    (a^2*n/(K+1))*C ≤ a^2*D

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.nibble_budget_inequalities
statement:
lemma nibble_budget_inequalities {n r D C a K : ℝ}
    (hn : 0 < n) (_hr : 0 ≤ r) (hD : 0 < D) (_hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hcode : n*C ≤ K*D)
    (hsize : 512*r ≤ a*n) (hmany : 16*r^2*(K+1)^2 ≤ a^5*n) :
    4*n*(4*a*r^2*D*C) ≤ (a^2*D)^2 * (a^2*n/(K+1)) ∧
    4*(2*a*n*r) ≤ (a*n/8)^2

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.nibble_iteration
statement:
lemma nibble_iteration (U : Finset V) (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V)
    {r : ℕ} (hr0 : 1 ≤ r) (k : ℕ) {D ε C a K d : ℝ}
    (hD : 0 < D) (he : 0 ≤ ε) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha16 : a ≤ 1/16) (hra : (r : ℝ)*a ≤ 1/4)
    (hK : 0 ≤ K) (_hd : 0 < d)
    (hDmin : 1 ≤ (1-((r-1 : ℕ) : ℝ)*a)^k*D)
    (hecap : (1+2*(r : ℝ)*a)^k*(ε+8*(r : ℝ)^2*a^2*D*k) ≤
      (1-((r-1 : ℕ) : ℝ)*a)^k*D/4)
    (hCmin : C ≤ a*((1-((r-1 : ℕ) : ℝ)*a)^k*D))
    (hcode : U.card*C ≤ K*((1-((r-1 : ℕ) : ℝ)*a)^k*D))
    (hsize : 512*(r : ℝ) ≤ a*d*U.card)
    (hmany : 16*(r : ℝ)^2*(K+1)^2 ≤ a^5*d*U.card)
    (hcontract : (1-a/2)^k ≤ d)
    (hsub : ∀ e ∈ S, A e ⊆ U) (hr : ∀ e ∈ S, (A e).card = r)
    (hdeg : ∀ v ∈ U, |((incident S A v).card : ℝ) - D| ≤ ε)
    (hcodeg : ∀ v ∈ U, ∀ w ∈ U, v ≠ w →
      ((incident S A v ∩ incident S A w).card : ℝ) ≤ C) :
    ∃ P : PackingState U S A,
      ((P.vertices.card : ℝ) ≤ d*U.card) ∧
      (((U \ (P.vertices ∪ P.chosen.biUnion A)).card : ℝ) ≤
        k*(16*(r : ℝ)+1)*a^2*U.card)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.one_round
statement:
lemma one_round (U : Finset V) (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V)
    {r : ℕ} (hr0 : 1 ≤ r) {D ε C a K : ℝ}
    (hD : 1 ≤ D) (he : 0 ≤ ε) (hequarter : ε ≤ D/4) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha16 : a ≤ 1/16) (hra : (r : ℝ)*a ≤ 1/4)
    (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hcode : U.card*C ≤ K*D) (hCa : C ≤ a*D)
    (hsize : 512*(r : ℝ) ≤ a*U.card)
    (hmany : 16*(r : ℝ)^2*(K+1)^2 ≤ a^5*U.card)
    (hsub : ∀ e ∈ S, A e ⊆ U) (hr : ∀ e ∈ S, (A e).card = r)
    (hdeg : ∀ v ∈ U, |((incident S A v).card : ℝ) - D| ≤ ε)
    (hcodeg : ∀ v ∈ U, ∀ w ∈ U, v ≠ w →
      ((incident S A v ∩ incident S A w).card : ℝ) ≤ C) :
    ∃ W : Finset V, ∃ T M : Finset E,
      W ⊆ U ∧ T ⊆ S ∧ (∀ e ∈ T, A e ⊆ W) ∧ M ⊆ S ∧
      (M : Set E).Pairwise (fun e f ↦ Disjoint (A e) (A f)) ∧
      Disjoint W (M.biUnion A) ∧
      ((W.card : ℝ) ≤ (1-a/2)*U.card) ∧
      (((U \ (W ∪ M.biUnion A)).card : ℝ) ≤ (16*(r : ℝ)+1)*a^2*U.card) ∧
      ∀ v ∈ W, |((incident T A v).card : ℝ) - (1-((r-1 : ℕ) : ℝ)*a)*D| ≤
        (1+2*(r : ℝ)*a)*ε + 8*(r : ℝ)^2*a^2*D

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.residual_degree_eq
statement:
lemma residual_degree_eq (U : Finset V) (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V)
    (hsub : ∀ e ∈ S, A e ⊆ U) (s : E → Bool) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ untouched U S A s) :
    ((incident (restrictEdges S A (untouched U S A s)) A v).card : ℝ) =
      ∑ e ∈ incident S A v, noHit (hits S A ((A e).erase v)) s

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.residual_degree_mean
statement:
lemma residual_degree_mean (U : Finset V) (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V)
    {r : ℕ} (hr0 : 1 ≤ r) {D ε C p : ℝ} (hD : 0 ≤ D) (he : 0 ≤ ε) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (hsub : ∀ e ∈ S, A e ⊆ U) (hr : ∀ e ∈ S, (A e).card = r)
    (hdeg : ∀ v ∈ U, |((incident S A v).card : ℝ) - D| ≤ ε)
    (hcodeg : ∀ v ∈ U, ∀ w ∈ U, v ≠ w →
      ((incident S A v ∩ incident S A w).card : ℝ) ≤ C)
    (v : V) (_hv : v ∈ U) :
    |expectation p (fun s ↦ ∑ e ∈ incident S A v, noHit (hits S A ((A e).erase v)) s) -
      (incident S A v).card * (1 - p * ((r-1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * D)| ≤
      (incident S A v).card * (p * ((r : ℝ)*ε + (r : ℝ)^2*C) +
        (p * ((r : ℝ)*(D+ε)))^2/2)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.residual_degree_variance
statement:
lemma residual_degree_variance (U : Finset V) (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V)
    {r : ℕ} {D C p : ℝ} (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (hsub : ∀ e ∈ S, A e ⊆ U) (hr : ∀ e ∈ S, (A e).card ≤ r)
    (hdeg : ∀ v ∈ U, ((incident S A v).card : ℝ) ≤ D)
    (hcodeg : ∀ v ∈ U, ∀ w ∈ U, v ≠ w →
      ((incident S A v ∩ incident S A w).card : ℝ) ≤ C)
    (v : V) (hv : v ∈ U) :
    let Y : (E → Bool) → ℝ := fun s ↦
      ∑ e ∈ incident S A v, noHit (hits S A ((A e).erase v)) s
    expectation p (fun s ↦ (Y s - expectation p Y)^2) ≤ p * (r : ℝ)^2 * D^2 * C

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.residual_mean_estimate
statement:
lemma residual_mean_estimate (U : Finset V) (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V)
    {r : ℕ} (hr0 : 1 ≤ r) {D ε C p a : ℝ}
    (hD : 0 < D) (he : 0 ≤ ε) (heD : ε ≤ D) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hCa : C ≤ a*D)
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hpa : p*D = a)
    (hra : (r : ℝ)*a ≤ 1)
    (hsub : ∀ e ∈ S, A e ⊆ U) (hr : ∀ e ∈ S, (A e).card = r)
    (hdeg : ∀ v ∈ U, |((incident S A v).card : ℝ) - D| ≤ ε)
    (hcodeg : ∀ v ∈ U, ∀ w ∈ U, v ≠ w →
      ((incident S A v ∩ incident S A w).card : ℝ) ≤ C)
    (v : V) (hv : v ∈ U) :
    |expectation p (fun s ↦ ∑ e ∈ incident S A v, noHit (hits S A ((A e).erase v)) s) -
      (1 - ((r-1 : ℕ) : ℝ)*a)*D| ≤ (1+2*(r : ℝ)*a)*ε + 6*(r : ℝ)^2*a^2*D

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.residual_test_frequency
statement:
lemma residual_test_frequency (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V) (v : V) (f : E) :
    ((incident S A v).filter fun e ↦ f ∈ hits S A ((A e).erase v)) =
      if f ∈ S then ((A f).erase v).biUnion (fun w ↦ incident S A v ∩ incident S A w) else ∅

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.untouched_card
statement:
lemma untouched_card (U : Finset V) (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V) (s : E → Bool) :
    ((untouched U S A s).card : ℝ) = ∑ v ∈ U, noHit (incident S A v) s

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.untouched_mean_upper
statement:
lemma untouched_mean_upper (U : Finset V) (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V)
    {D Emax p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (hE : 0 ≤ Emax)
    (hdeg : ∀ v ∈ U, D ≤ ((incident S A v).card : ℝ) ∧
      ((incident S A v).card : ℝ) ≤ Emax) :
    expectation p (fun s ↦ ((untouched U S A s).card : ℝ)) ≤
      U.card * (1 - p * D + (p * Emax)^2 / 2)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.untouched_variance
statement:
lemma untouched_variance (U : Finset V) (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V)
    {r : ℕ} {D p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (hr : ∀ e ∈ S, (A e).card ≤ r)
    (hdeg : ∀ v ∈ U, ((incident S A v).card : ℝ) ≤ D) :
    let Y : (E → Bool) → ℝ := fun s ↦ ((untouched U S A s).card : ℝ)
    expectation p (fun s ↦ (Y s - expectation p Y)^2) ≤ p * U.card * D * r

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.wasted_vertices_le
statement:
lemma wasted_vertices_le (U : Finset V) (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V)
    {r : ℕ} (hsub : ∀ e ∈ S, A e ⊆ U) (hr : ∀ e ∈ S, (A e).card ≤ r)
    (s : E → Bool) :
    ((U \ (untouched U S A s ∪ (isolated S A s).biUnion A)).card : ℝ) ≤
      r * collisionCount U S A s

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.matching_after_pruning
statement:
lemma matching_after_pruning (r : ℕ) (hr : 1≤r) {K₀ η : ℝ}
    (hK₀ : 0≤K₀) (hη : 0<η) :
    ∃ e T : ℝ, 0<e ∧ 0<T ∧
    ∀ {V E : Type} [DecidableEq V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E],
    ∀ (U B : Finset V) (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V) (D C : ℝ),
      B⊆U → T≤D → T≤((U\B).card : ℝ) → 0≤C → C≤e*D →
      U.card*C≤K₀*D → B.card*C≤e*D/2 →
      (∀ i∈S, A i⊆U) → (∀ i∈S, (A i).card=r) →
      (∀ v∈U\B, |((incident S A v).card : ℝ)-D|≤e*D/2) →
      (∀ v∈U, ∀ w∈U, v≠w → ((incident S A v∩incident S A w).card : ℝ)≤C) →
      ∃ M⊆S, (M : Set E).Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (A i) (A j)) ∧
        (1-η)*((U\B).card : ℝ)≤r*(M.card : ℝ)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Nibble.pruned_degree_near
statement:
lemma pruned_degree_near (U B : Finset V) (S : Finset E) (A : E → Finset V)
    {D C e : ℝ} (hC : 0≤C) (hsub : ∀ i∈S, A i⊆U)
    (hdeg : ∀ v∈U\B, |((incident S A v).card : ℝ)-D|≤e*D/2)
    (hcode : ∀ v∈U, ∀ w∈U, v≠w → ((incident S A v∩incident S A w).card : ℝ)≤C)
    (hB : B⊆U) (hsmall : (B.card : ℝ)*C≤e*D/2) :
    ∀ v∈U\B, |((incident (restrictEdges S A (U\B)) A v).card : ℝ)-D|≤e*D

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_abs
statement: lemma avg_abs {f : Ω → ℝ} : |avg f|≤avg (fun ω ↦ |f ω|)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_add
statement: lemma avg_add (f g : Ω → ℝ) : avg (fun ω ↦ f ω+g ω)=avg f+avg g

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_bad_union
statement:
lemma avg_bad_union {I : Type uI} (S : Finset I) (P : I → Ω → Prop)
    [∀ i, DecidablePred (P i)] :
    avg (fun ω ↦ if ∃ i∈S, P i ω then 1 else 0) ≤
      ∑ i∈S, avg (fun ω ↦ if P i ω then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_chebyshev
statement:
lemma avg_chebyshev {Z : Ω → ℝ} (p : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0<t) :
    avg (fun ω ↦ if t≤|Z ω-p| then 1 else 0) ≤
      avg (fun ω ↦ (Z ω-p)^2)/t^2

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_comm
statement:
lemma avg_comm {Λ : Type uΛ} [Fintype Λ] [Nonempty Λ] (f : Ω → Λ → ℝ) :
    avg (fun ω ↦ avg (f ω))=avg (fun x ↦ avg (fun ω ↦ f ω x))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_const
statement: lemma avg_const (c : ℝ) : avg (fun _ : Ω ↦ c) = c

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_const_mul
statement: lemma avg_const_mul (c : ℝ) (f : Ω → ℝ) : avg (fun ω ↦ c*f ω)=c*avg f

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_error_on_bad
statement:
lemma avg_error_on_bad (f : Ω → ℝ) (good : Ω → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0≤c) (hc1 : c≤1) (hf : ∀ ω, 0≤f ω ∧ f ω≤1)
    (he : ∀ ω, good ω → f ω=c) :
    |avg f-c| ≤ avg (fun ω ↦ if good ω then 0 else 1)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_indicator
statement:
lemma avg_indicator {P : Ω → Prop} [DecidablePred P] :
    avg (fun ω ↦ if P ω then 1 else 0) =
      ((Finset.univ.filter P).card : ℝ)/Fintype.card Ω

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_mono
statement: lemma avg_mono {f g : Ω → ℝ} (h : ∀ ω, f ω≤g ω) : avg f≤avg g

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_mul_avg
statement:
lemma avg_mul_avg {Λ : Type uΛ} [Fintype Λ] [Nonempty Λ]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (g : Λ → ℝ) :
    avg f*avg g = avg (fun x : Ω × Λ ↦ f x.1*g x.2)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_mul_const
statement: lemma avg_mul_const (f : Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : avg (fun ω ↦ f ω*c)=avg f*c

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_nonneg
statement: lemma avg_nonneg {f : Ω → ℝ} (h : ∀ ω, 0≤f ω) : 0≤avg f

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_prod_coordinate
statement:
lemma avg_prod_coordinate {K : Type uK} {A : Type uA} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Fintype A] [Nonempty A]
    (f : K → A → ℝ) : avg (fun ω : K → A ↦ ∏ k, f k (ω k)) = ∏ k, avg (f k)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_prod_injective
statement:
lemma avg_prod_injective {K : Type uK} {J : Type uJ} {A : Type uA} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Fintype J] [Fintype A]
    [Nonempty A] (κ : J → K) (hκ : Function.Injective κ) (f : J → A → ℝ) :
    avg (fun ω : K → A ↦ ∏ j, f j (ω (κ j))) = ∏ j, avg (f j)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_prod_type
statement:
lemma avg_prod_type {Λ : Type uΛ} [Fintype Λ] [Nonempty Λ] (f : Ω × Λ → ℝ) :
    avg f = avg (fun ω ↦ avg (fun x ↦ f (ω,x)))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_square
statement:
lemma avg_square {Y : Type uY} [Fintype Y] [Nonempty Y] (f : Y → Ω → ℝ) :
    avg (fun ω ↦ (avg (fun y ↦ f y ω))^2) =
      avg (fun yy : Y × Y ↦ avg (fun ω ↦ f yy.1 ω*f yy.2 ω))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_square_error
statement:
lemma avg_square_error {Z : Ω → ℝ} {p a : ℝ} (hp : 0≤p) (hp1 : p≤1)
    (hmean : |avg Z-p|≤a) (hsecond : |avg (fun ω ↦ Z ω^2)-p^2|≤a) :
    avg (fun ω ↦ (Z ω-p)^2) ≤ 3*a

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_sub
statement: lemma avg_sub (f g : Ω → ℝ) : avg (fun ω ↦ f ω-g ω)=avg f-avg g

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_sum
statement:
lemma avg_sum {I : Type uI} (S : Finset I) (f : I → Ω → ℝ) :
    avg (fun ω ↦ ∑ i ∈ S, f i ω)=∑ i ∈ S, avg (f i)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.exists_few_bad_centers
statement:
lemma exists_few_bad_centers {I : Type uI} [Fintype I] (Z : I → Ω → ℝ)
    (p : ℝ) {t a : ℝ} (ht : 0<t)
    (hZ : ∀ i, avg (fun ω ↦ (Z i ω-p)^2)≤a) :
    ∃ ω, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i ↦ t≤|Z i ω-p|)).card : ℝ) ≤
      Fintype.card I*a/t^2

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.exists_le_avg
statement: lemma exists_le_avg (f : Ω → ℝ) : ∃ ω, f ω≤avg f

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.moments_from_good
statement:
lemma moments_from_good {Y : Type uY} [Fintype Y] [Nonempty Y]
    (f : Y → Ω → ℝ) (good : Y → Prop) (good₂ : Y × Y → Prop)
    [DecidablePred good] [DecidablePred good₂] {p a : ℝ}
    (hp : 0≤p) (hp1 : p≤1) (hf : ∀ y ω, 0≤f y ω ∧ f y ω≤1)
    (hfirst : ∀ y, good y → avg (f y)=p)
    (hsecond : ∀ yy, good₂ yy → avg (fun ω ↦ f yy.1 ω*f yy.2 ω)=p^2)
    (hbad : avg (fun y ↦ if good y then 0 else 1)≤a)
    (hbad₂ : avg (fun yy ↦ if good₂ yy then 0 else 1)≤a) :
    avg (fun ω ↦ (avg (fun y ↦ f y ω)-p)^2) ≤ 3*a

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.conditional_card_event
statement:
lemma conditional_card_event (f g : V →ₗ[K] K)
    (hfg : Function.Surjective (f.prod g)) (s : K) (S : Finset K) :
    ((fiber f s).filter (fun v ↦ g v∈S)).card =
      S.card*((fiber f s).filter (fun v ↦ g v=0)).card

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.conditional_fiber_card
statement:
lemma conditional_fiber_card (f g : V →ₗ[K] K)
    (hfg : Function.Surjective (f.prod g)) (s t u : K) :
    ((fiber f s).filter (fun v ↦ g v=t)).card =
    ((fiber f s).filter (fun v ↦ g v=u)).card

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.conditional_fiber_count
statement:
lemma conditional_fiber_count (f g : V →ₗ[K] K)
    (hfg : Function.Surjective (f.prod g)) (s t : K) :
    Fintype.card K*((fiber f s).filter (fun v ↦ g v=t)).card=(fiber f s).card

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.dotForm_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma dotForm_apply {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] (a x : ι → K) :
    dotForm a x=dotProduct a x

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.exceptional_centers
statement:
lemma exceptional_centers {J : Type uJ} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    (f : J → V →ₗ[K] K) (hpair : ∀ j l, j≠l → Function.Surjective ((f j).prod (f l)))
    (i : J) (hfi : f i≠0) (S : Finset K) :
    ∃ E : Finset K, E.card≤2*(Fintype.card J)^2*S.card ∧
      ∀ s : K, s∉E → ∀ j l, j≠l → ∀ e : Bool,
      Function.Surjective ((f i).prod (if e then f j+f l else f j-f l)) ∨
      ∃ c : K, (if e then f j+f l else f j-f l)=c • f i ∧ c*s∉S

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.exists_nonzero_minor
statement:
lemma exists_nonzero_minor {ι : Type uι} (a b : ι → K)
    (ha : a≠0) (hnp : ∀ c : K, b≠c • a) :
    ∃ i j, a i*b j-a j*b i≠0

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.fiber_card_eq
statement:
lemma fiber_card_eq (f : V →+ W) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (x y : W) :
    (fiber f x).card=(fiber f y).card

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.fiber_card_mul
statement:
lemma fiber_card_mul (f : V →+ W) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (w : W) :
    Fintype.card W*(fiber f w).card=Fintype.card V

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.fiber_le_card
statement:
lemma fiber_le_card (f : V →+ W) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (w : W) :
    Fintype.card W ≤ Fintype.card V

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.fiber_nonempty
statement:
lemma fiber_nonempty (f : V →+ W) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (w : W) :
    (fiber f w).Nonempty

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.functional_surjective
statement: lemma functional_surjective {f : V →ₗ[K] K} (hf : f≠0) : Function.Surjective f

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.int_cast_ne_zero_of_large_prime
statement:
lemma int_cast_ne_zero_of_large_prime {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] {z : ℤ}
    (hz : z≠0) (hq : z.natAbs<q) : (z : ZMod q)≠0

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.integer_rows_eventual_pair_rank
statement:
lemma integer_rows_eventual_pair_rank {ι : Type uι} {J : Type uJ} [Fintype ι] [Fintype J]
    (a : J → ι → ℤ)
    (ha : ∀ j, (fun k ↦ (a j k : ℚ)) ≠ 0)
    (hnp : ∀ j l, j≠l → ∀ c : ℚ,
      (fun k ↦ (a l k : ℚ)) ≠ c • (fun k ↦ (a j k : ℚ))) :
    ∃ Q : ℕ, ∀ q : ℕ, ∀ (_hq : Fact q.Prime), Q<q →
      ∀ j l, j≠l → Function.Surjective
        ((dotForm (fun k ↦ (a j k : ZMod q))).prod
         (dotForm (fun k ↦ (a l k : ZMod q))))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.joint_fiber_eq
statement:
lemma joint_fiber_eq (f g : V →ₗ[K] K) (s t : K) :
    (fiber f s).filter (fun v ↦ g v=t) = fiber (f.prod g) (s,t)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.mem_fiber
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_fiber {f : V → W} {v : V} {w : W} : v∈fiber f w ↔ f v=w

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.nonparallel_pair_surjective
statement:
lemma nonparallel_pair_surjective {f g : V →ₗ[K] K} (hf : f≠0)
    (hfg : ∀ c : K, g≠c • f) : Function.Surjective (f.prod g)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.pair_surjective_integer_minor
statement:
lemma pair_surjective_integer_minor {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι]
    (a b : ι → ℤ) {i j : ι} (h : a i*b j-a j*b i≠0)
    {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] (hq : (a i*b j-a j*b i).natAbs<q) :
    Function.Surjective ((dotForm (fun k ↦ (a k : ZMod q))).prod
      (dotForm (fun k ↦ (b k : ZMod q))))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.pair_surjective_of_minor
statement:
lemma pair_surjective_of_minor {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι]
    (a b : ι → K) {i j : ι} (h : a i*b j-a j*b i≠0) :
    Function.Surjective ((dotForm a).prod (dotForm b))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.pair_surjective_or_proportional
statement:
lemma pair_surjective_or_proportional {f g : V →ₗ[K] K} (hf : f≠0) :
    Function.Surjective (f.prod g) ∨ ∃ c : K, g=c • f

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.scalar_preimage_card
statement:
lemma scalar_preimage_card {c : K} (hc : c≠0) (S : Finset K) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun s : K ↦ c*s∈S)).card≤S.card

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.actual_centers_injective
statement:
lemma actual_centers_injective (d : Fin r → ℕ) (R K q : ℕ) (i : Fin r)
    (hq : 2*(K*(R*periodLength (oddLengths d)))<q) (ω : SlotChoices d K) :
    Function.Injective (fun c : Fin K × Fin (R-1) ↦
      signedSite q (ω c.1).2 (siteCenter d R (ω c.1).1 c.1 c.2 i))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.catalogSet_card
statement:
lemma catalogSet_card (d : Fin r → ℕ) (R K q : ℕ) (i : Fin r)
    (hq : 2*(K*(R*periodLength (oddLengths d)))<q) :
    (catalogSet d R K q).card=2*K*((R-2)*periodLength (oddLengths d))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.catalogValue_injective
statement:
lemma catalogValue_injective (d : Fin r → ℕ) (R K q : ℕ) (i : Fin r)
    (hq : 2*(K*(R*periodLength (oddLengths d)))<q) :
    Function.Injective (catalogValue d R K q)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.centerOffset_bounds
statement:
lemma centerOffset_bounds (d : Fin r → ℕ) (i : Fin r) :
    0<slotPrefix (oddLengths d) i+d i+1 ∧
    slotPrefix (oddLengths d) i+d i+1≤periodLength (oddLengths d)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.choose_odd_lengths
statement:
lemma choose_odd_lengths {J : Type uJ} [Fintype J] [Nonempty J]
    (w : J → ℝ) (hw : ∀ j, 0<w j) (hs : 2*∑ j, w j<1) :
    ∃ d : J → ℕ, ∀ i, w i < (2*(d i : ℝ)+1)/(2*∑ j, (2*(d j : ℝ)+1))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.interiorSite_bounds
statement:
lemma interiorSite_bounds (d : Fin r → ℕ) {R k t : ℕ} (i : Fin r)
    (ht : t<(R-2)*periodLength (oddLengths d)) :
    k*(R*periodLength (oddLengths d)) < interiorSite d R k t ∧
    interiorSite d R k t < (k+1)*(R*periodLength (oddLengths d))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.interiorSite_chunk
statement:
lemma interiorSite_chunk (d : Fin r → ℕ) {R k t : ℕ} (i : Fin r)
    (ht : t<(R-2)*periodLength (oddLengths d)) :
    interiorSite d R k t/(R*periodLength (oddLengths d))=k

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.interior_center_exists
statement:
lemma interior_center_exists (d : Fin r → ℕ) {R t : ℕ}
    (ht : t<(R-2)*periodLength (oddLengths d)) (i : Fin r) :
    ∃ p s : ℕ, p+1<R ∧ s<periodLength (oddLengths d) ∧
      p*periodLength (oddLengths d)+s+slotPrefix (oddLengths d) i+d i+1 =
        periodLength (oddLengths d)+1+t

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.interior_hit_coordinate
statement:
lemma interior_hit_coordinate (d : Fin r → ℕ) (R K q : ℕ) (i : Fin r)
    (hq : 2*(K*(R*periodLength (oddLengths d)))<q)
    (k : Fin K) (t : Fin ((R-2)*periodLength (oddLengths d))) (e : Bool) :
    ∃ s : Fin (periodLength (oddLengths d)), ∀ ω : SlotChoices d K,
      slotHit d R K q i ω (signedSite q e (interiorSite d R k t)) ↔ ω k=(s,e)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.interior_signed_injective
statement:
lemma interior_signed_injective (d : Fin r → ℕ) (R K q : ℕ) (i : Fin r)
    (hq : 2*(K*(R*periodLength (oddLengths d)))<q) :
    Function.Injective (fun x : (Fin K × Fin ((R-2)*periodLength (oddLengths d))) × Bool ↦
      signedSite q x.2 (interiorSite d R x.1.1 x.1.2))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.periodLength_pos
statement: lemma periodLength_pos (d : Fin r → ℕ) (i : Fin r) : 0<periodLength (oddLengths d)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.prefix_add_length_le
statement:
lemma prefix_add_length_le (L : Fin r → ℕ) (i : Fin r) :
    slotPrefix L i+L i ≤ periodLength L

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.prefix_separated
statement:
lemma prefix_separated (L : Fin r → ℕ) {i j : Fin r} (hij : i<j) :
    slotPrefix L i+L i ≤ slotPrefix L j

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.signedSite_injective
statement:
lemma signedSite_injective {q A x y : ℕ} (hq : 2*A<q)
    (hx : 0<x) (hxA : x≤A) (hy : 0<y) (hyA : y≤A) (e f : Bool) :
    signedSite q e x=signedSite q f y ↔ e=f ∧ x=y

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.siteCenter_bounds
statement:
lemma siteCenter_bounds (d : Fin r → ℕ) {R shift chunk period : ℕ}
    (hs : shift<periodLength (oddLengths d)) (hp : period+1<R) (i : Fin r) :
    chunk*(R*periodLength (oddLengths d)) < siteCenter d R shift chunk period i ∧
    siteCenter d R shift chunk period i < (chunk+1)*(R*periodLength (oddLengths d))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.siteCenter_chunk
OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.slotHit_card
statement:
lemma slotHit_card (d : Fin r → ℕ) (R K q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (i : Fin r)
    (hq : 2*(K*(R*periodLength (oddLengths d)))<q) (ω : SlotChoices d K) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun t : ZMod q ↦ slotHit d R K q i ω t)).card=K*(R-1)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.slotLeft_bounds
statement:
lemma slotLeft_bounds (L : Fin r → ℕ) (R : ℕ) {shift chunk period : ℕ}
    (hs : shift<periodLength L) (hp : period+1<R) (i : Fin r) :
    chunk*(R*periodLength L) ≤ slotLeft L R shift chunk period i ∧
    slotLeft L R shift chunk period i+L i < (chunk+1)*(R*periodLength L)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.slots_separated_chunks
OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.slots_separated_same_chunk
statement:
lemma slots_separated_same_chunk (L : Fin r → ℕ) (R shift chunk : ℕ)
    {p q : ℕ} {i j : Fin r} (h : p<q ∨ p=q ∧ i<j) :
    slotLeft L R shift chunk p i+L i ≤ slotLeft L R shift chunk q j

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_bad_rows
statement:
lemma avg_bad_rows (g : J → V →ₗ[K] K)
    (hg : ∀ j, Function.Surjective (g j))
    (hpair : ∀ j l, j≠l → Function.Surjective ((g j).prod (g l)))
    (G S : Finset K) :
    avg (fun y ↦ if rowsGood g G S y then (0 : ℝ) else 1) ≤
      (Fintype.card J : ℝ)*(Fintype.card K-G.card)/Fintype.card K+
        2*(Fintype.card J : ℝ)^2*S.card/Fintype.card K

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_cross_chunks
statement:
lemma avg_cross_chunks {κ : Type uκ} [DecidableEq κ]
    (f g h : V →ₗ[K] K) (hfg : Function.Surjective (f.prod g))
    (chunk : K → κ) (s : K) {B : ℝ}
    (hB : ∀ k, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun t : K ↦ chunk t=k)).card : ℝ)≤B) :
    avg (fun yy : fiber f s × fiber f s ↦
      if chunk (g yy.1)=chunk (h yy.2) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
      B/Fintype.card K

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_cross_rows
statement:
lemma avg_cross_rows [DecidableEq κ] (f : V →ₗ[K] K) (g : J → V →ₗ[K] K)
    (hfg : ∀ j, Function.Surjective (f.prod (g j)))
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (chunk : K → κ) (s : K) {B : ℝ}
    (hB : ∀ k, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun t : K ↦ chunk t=k)).card : ℝ)≤B) :
    avg (fun yy : fiber f s × fiber f s ↦
      if ∃ j l, chunk (g j yy.1)=chunk (g l yy.2) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
        (Fintype.card J : ℝ)^2*B/Fintype.card K

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_double_selections
statement:
lemma avg_double_selections (c d : J → κ) (hc : Function.Injective c)
    (hd : Function.Injective d) (hcd : ∀ j l, c j≠d l) (a b : J → A) :
    avg (fun ω : κ → A ↦
      (∏ j, if ω (c j)=a j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)*
      (∏ j, if ω (d j)=b j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) =
      ((1/(Fintype.card A : ℝ))^(Fintype.card J))^2

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_fiber_event
statement:
lemma avg_fiber_event (f g : V →ₗ[K] K)
    (hfg : Function.Surjective (f.prod g)) (s : K) (S : Finset K) :
    avg (fun v : fiber f s ↦ if g v∈S then (1 : ℝ) else 0)=
      (S.card : ℝ)/Fintype.card K

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_fibers
statement:
lemma avg_fibers (f : V →ₗ[K] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (F : V → ℝ) :
    avg (fun s : K ↦ avg (fun v : fiber f s ↦ F v))=avg F

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_finset
statement:
lemma avg_finset {V : Type uV} [Fintype V] (S : Finset V) (F : V → ℝ) :
    avg (fun v : S ↦ F v)=(∑ v∈S,F v)/(S.card : ℝ)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_fst
statement: lemma avg_fst (F : Y → ℝ) : avg (fun yy : Y × Y ↦ F yy.1)=avg F

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_independent_selections
statement:
lemma avg_independent_selections (c : J → κ) (hc : Function.Injective c) (a : J → A) :
    avg (fun ω : κ → A ↦ ∏ j, if ω (c j)=a j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      (1/(Fintype.card A : ℝ))^(Fintype.card J)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_singleton
statement:
lemma avg_singleton (a : A) : avg (fun x : A ↦ if x=a then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
    1/(Fintype.card A : ℝ)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_snd
statement: lemma avg_snd (F : Y → ℝ) : avg (fun yy : Y × Y ↦ F yy.2)=avg F

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.avg_uniform_event
statement:
lemma avg_uniform_event (f : V →ₗ[K] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (S : Finset K) :
    avg (fun v : V ↦ if f v∈S then (1 : ℝ) else 0)=
      (S.card : ℝ)/Fintype.card K

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.bad_pair_avg_bound
statement:
lemma bad_pair_avg_bound (c : Y → J → κ) (good : Y → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
    {b d : ℝ}
    (hb : avg (fun y ↦ if good y then (0 : ℝ) else 1)≤b)
    (hd : avg (fun yy : Y × Y ↦ if ∃ j l, c yy.1 j=c yy.2 l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)≤d) :
    avg (fun yy : Y × Y ↦ if good yy.1 ∧ good yy.2 ∧ ∀ j l, c yy.1 j≠c yy.2 l
      then (0 : ℝ) else 1)≤2*b+d

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.exists_few_bad_centers_averaged
statement:
lemma exists_few_bad_centers_averaged {Ω : Type uΩ} {I : Type uI} {K : Type uK} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    [Fintype I] [Fintype K] [Nonempty K] (Z : I → K → Ω → ℝ)
    (p : ℝ) {t a : ℝ} (ht : 0<t)
    (hZ : ∀ i, avg (fun ω ↦ avg (fun s ↦ (Z i s ω-p)^2))≤a) :
    ∃ ω, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun v : I × K ↦ t≤|Z v.1 v.2 ω-p|)).card : ℝ) ≤
      Fintype.card I*Fintype.card K*a/t^2

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.exists_few_bad_centers_total
statement:
lemma exists_few_bad_centers_total {Ω : Type uΩ} {I : Type uI} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    [Fintype I] (Z : I → Ω → ℝ) (p : ℝ) {t a : ℝ} (ht : 0<t)
    (hZ : (∑ i, avg (fun ω ↦ (Z i ω-p)^2))≤a) :
    ∃ ω, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i ↦ t≤|Z i ω-p|)).card : ℝ) ≤ a/t^2

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.rowsGood_injective
statement:
lemma rowsGood_injective (g : J → V →ₗ[K] K) (G S : Finset K) (chunk : K → κ)
    (hchunk : ∀ t∈G, ∀ u∈G, chunk t=chunk u → t+u∈S ∨ t-u∈S)
    {y : V} (hy : rowsGood g G S y) : Function.Injective (fun j ↦ chunk (g j y))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.rows_bad_indicator
statement:
lemma rows_bad_indicator (g : J → V →ₗ[K] K) (G S : Finset K) (y : V) :
    (if rowsGood g G S y then (0 : ℝ) else 1) ≤
      (∑ j, if g j y∉G then (1 : ℝ) else 0)+
      ∑ jl : J × J, if jl.1≠jl.2 then
        (if g jl.1 y+g jl.2 y∈S then (1 : ℝ) else 0)+
        (if g jl.1 y-g jl.2 y∈S then 1 else 0) else 0

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.sub_form_surjective
statement:
lemma sub_form_surjective (f g : V →ₗ[K] K)
    (hfg : Function.Surjective (f.prod g)) : Function.Surjective (f-g)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.sum_form_surjective
statement:
lemma sum_form_surjective (f g : V →ₗ[K] K)
    (hfg : Function.Surjective (f.prod g)) : Function.Surjective (f+g)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.concrete_slot_vertices_card
statement:
lemma concrete_slot_vertices_card {r q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] (d : Fin r → ℕ)
    (R K : ℕ) (hq : 2*(K*(R*periodLength (oddLengths d)))<q) (ω : SlotChoices d K) :
    (slotVertices (fun i t ↦ slotHit d R K q i ω t)).card=r*K*(R-1)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.mem_slotSupport
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_slotSupport (g : I → V →ₗ[K] K) (y : V) (i : I) (t : K) :
    (i,t)∈slotSupport g y ↔ g i y=t

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.prod_indicator_eq
statement:
lemma prod_indicator_eq {J : Type uJ} [Fintype J] (P : J → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    (∏ j, if P j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = if ∀ j, P j then 1 else 0

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.random_slot_matching
statement: lemma random_slot_matching (hr : 1≤Fintype.card I) {K₀ η : ℝ} (hK₀ : 0≤K₀) (hη : 0<η) (hη₁ : η≤1) : ∃ e T : ℝ, 0

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.slotDensity_eq
statement:
lemma slotDensity_eq (g : I → V →ₗ[K] K) (hit : I → K → Prop)
    [∀ i t, Decidable (hit i t)] (i : I) (s : K) :
    slotDensity g hit i s=
      (((fiber (g i) s).filter (fun y ↦ ∀ j : {j : I // j≠i}, hit j (g j y))).card : ℝ)/
        (fiber (g i) s).card

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.slotSupport_card
statement:
lemma slotSupport_card (g : I → V →ₗ[K] K) (y : V) :
    (slotSupport g y).card=Fintype.card I

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.slotSupport_subset
statement:
lemma slotSupport_subset (g : I → V →ₗ[K] K) (hit : I → K → Prop)
    [∀ i t, Decidable (hit i t)] {y : V} (hy : y∈slotEdges g hit) :
    slotSupport g y⊆slotVertices hit

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.slotVertices_card
statement:
lemma slotVertices_card (hit : I → K → Prop) [∀ i t, Decidable (hit i t)] :
    (slotVertices hit).card=∑ i, (Finset.univ.filter (hit i)).card

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.slot_codegree
statement:
lemma slot_codegree (g : I → V →ₗ[K] K) (hit : I → K → Prop)
    [∀ i t, Decidable (hit i t)]
    (hg : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (g i))
    (hpair : ∀ i j, i≠j → Function.Surjective ((g i).prod (g j)))
    (v w : I × K) (hvw : v≠w) :
    ((incident (slotEdges g hit) (slotSupport g) v ∩
      incident (slotEdges g hit) (slotSupport g) w).card : ℝ) ≤
        Fintype.card V/(Fintype.card K : ℝ)^2

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.slot_codegree_subset
statement:
lemma slot_codegree_subset (g : I → V →ₗ[K] K) (hit : I → K → Prop)
    [∀ i t, Decidable (hit i t)] (i j : I) (s t : K) :
    incident (slotEdges g hit) (slotSupport g) (i,s) ∩
      incident (slotEdges g hit) (slotSupport g) (j,t) ⊆
        (fiber (g i) s).filter (fun y ↦ g j y=t)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.slot_degree_density
statement:
lemma slot_degree_density (g : I → V →ₗ[K] K) (hit : I → K → Prop)
    [∀ i t, Decidable (hit i t)] (hg : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (g i))
    (i : I) (s : K) (hs : hit i s) :
    ((incident (slotEdges g hit) (slotSupport g) (i,s)).card : ℝ)=
      (Fintype.card V/(Fintype.card K : ℝ))*slotDensity g hit i s

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.slot_degree_fiber
statement:
lemma slot_degree_fiber (g : I → V →ₗ[K] K) (hit : I → K → Prop)
    [∀ i t, Decidable (hit i t)] (i : I) (s : K) (hs : hit i s) :
    incident (slotEdges g hit) (slotSupport g) (i,s)=
      (fiber (g i) s).filter (fun y ↦ ∀ j : {j : I // j≠i}, hit j (g j y))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.slot_degree_near
statement:
lemma slot_degree_near (g : I → V →ₗ[K] K) (hit : I → K → Prop)
    [∀ i t, Decidable (hit i t)] (hg : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (g i))
    (i : I) (s : K) (hs : hit i s) {p e : ℝ}
    (hne : |slotDensity g hit i s-p|≤e*p) :
    |((incident (slotEdges g hit) (slotSupport g) (i,s)).card : ℝ)-
      (Fintype.card V/(Fintype.card K : ℝ))*p| ≤
        e*((Fintype.card V/(Fintype.card K : ℝ))*p)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.slot_same_row_disjoint
statement:
lemma slot_same_row_disjoint (g : I → V →ₗ[K] K) (hit : I → K → Prop)
    [∀ i t, Decidable (hit i t)] (i : I) {s t : K} (hst : s≠t) :
    Disjoint (incident (slotEdges g hit) (slotSupport g) (i,s))
      (incident (slotEdges g hit) (slotSupport g) (i,t))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.chunkCount_bounds
statement:
lemma chunkCount_bounds {B q : ℕ} (hB : 0<B) (hq : 0<q) :
    B*chunkCount B q<q ∧ q≤B*(chunkCount B q+1)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.chunkCount_pos
statement: lemma chunkCount_pos {B q : ℕ} (hB : 0<B) (hq : B<q) : 0<chunkCount B q

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.chunkCount_ratio_error
statement:
lemma chunkCount_ratio_error {B q : ℕ} (hB : 0<B) (hq : 0<q) :
    |(chunkCount B q : ℝ)/q-1/(B : ℝ)|≤1/(q : ℝ)

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.chunkCount_ratio_tendsto
statement:
lemma chunkCount_ratio_tendsto {B : ℕ} (hB : 0<B) :
    Tendsto (fun q : ℕ ↦ (chunkCount B q : ℝ)/q) atTop (𝓝 (1/(B : ℝ)))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.concrete_slot_nv
statement:
lemma concrete_slot_nv {r q R : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime]
    (d : Fin r → ℕ) (i₀ : Fin r) (hR : 1≤R)
    (ω : SlotChoices d (chunkCount (2*R*periodLength (oddLengths d)) q)) :
    ((slotVertices (fun i t ↦ slotHit d R
      (chunkCount (2*R*periodLength (oddLengths d)) q) q i ω t)).card : ℝ)=
      (q : ℝ)*packingNV r (periodLength (oddLengths d)) R q

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.packingALimit_tendsto
statement:
lemma packingALimit_tendsto (r : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (packingALimit r) atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.packingAV_tendsto
statement:
lemma packingAV_tendsto {r L R : ℕ} (hL : 0<L) (hR : 0<R) :
    Tendsto (packingAV r L R) atTop (𝓝 (packingALimit r R))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.packingBLimit_tendsto
statement:
lemma packingBLimit_tendsto (r : ℕ) (e p : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun R ↦ packingBLimit r R e p) atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ))

name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.packingBV_nonneg
statement:
lemma packingBV_nonneg (r L R q : ℕ) (e p : ℝ) :
    0≤packingBV r L R e p q
