name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.compressionDecode_mem_compressionList
statement:
theorem compressionDecode_mem_compressionList
    (L : (i : Fin u) → X → Label i) (E : FixedLabels L q) (h s : ℕ) (θ : ℝ)
    (code : CompressionCode u q h s (weightCodeSize (roundingStep θ s u))) :
    compressionDecode L E h s θ code ∈ compressionList L E h s θ

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.compressionList_card_le
statement:
theorem compressionList_card_le
    (L : (i : Fin u) → X → Label i) (E : FixedLabels L q) (h s : ℕ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hθ : 0 < θ) (hs : 0 < s) :
    ((compressionList L E h s θ).card : ℝ) ≤
      (u : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) ^ (h * s) *
        (1 + (s : ℝ) * 2 ^ u / θ) ^ (h * s * 2 ^ u)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.compressionList_card_le_nat
statement:
theorem compressionList_card_le_nat
    (L : (i : Fin u) → X → Label i) (E : FixedLabels L q) (h s : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (compressionList L E h s θ).card ≤
      u * q ^ (h * s) * weightCodeSize (roundingStep θ s u) ^ (h * s * 2 ^ u)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.compressionList_nonempty
statement:
theorem compressionList_nonempty
    (L : (i : Fin u) → X → Label i) (E : FixedLabels L q) (h s : ℕ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hu : 0 < u) (hq : 0 < q) : (compressionList L E h s θ).Nonempty

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.mem_compressionList
statement:
theorem mem_compressionList (L : (i : Fin u) → X → Label i) (E : FixedLabels L q)
    (h s : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) (a : X → ℝ) :
    a ∈ compressionList L E h s θ ↔
      ∃ code : CompressionCode u q h s (weightCodeSize (roundingStep θ s u)),
        compressionDecode L E h s θ code = a

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.sum_groupedWeight_le_one
statement:
theorem sum_groupedWeight_le_one (assignment : Y → Option K) (tag : Y → T)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.sum_groupedWeight_mul

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GraphProfile.abs_row_sub_le_one
statement:
theorem abs_row_sub_le_one (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i)
    (𝒯 : Finset (Finset ι)) {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GraphProfile.column_eq_sum
statement:
theorem column_eq_sum (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i) (𝒯 : Finset (Finset ι))
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (y : Columns X 𝒯) (x : X) :
    column L 𝒯 h y x = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range h,
      if PartitionGraph.distance L y.2.val x y.1 ≤ (j : ℕ∞)
      then LogProfile.gamma h j else 0

    (hd : (h : ℕ∞) ≤ PartitionGraph.distance L y.2.val x y.1) :

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GraphProfile.column_le_one

theorem column_le_one (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i) (𝒯 : Finset (Finset ι))

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GraphProfile.dist_row_eq_one
statement:
theorem dist_row_eq_one [Fintype X]
    (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i) (𝒯 : Finset (Finset ι))
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (x z : X)
    (hsep : ∃ T ∈ 𝒯, (h : ℕ∞) < PartitionGraph.distance L T x z) :

theorem norm_row_sub_eq_one [Fintype X]

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.ProfileMixtures.dilated_level_sum_le
statement:
theorem dilated_level_sum_le (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i) (v : Y → X)
    (T : Y → Finset ι) (μ : Y → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y)
    (hmass : ∑ y, μ y ≤ 1) {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) {θ : ℝ}
    (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hprofile : Real.log 3 / Real.log ((h : ℝ) + 1) ≤ θ) (x : X) :
    (∑ j : Fin h, LogProfile.gamma h j.val *
      CompressionLevels.levelValue L v T μ (3 * j.val + 2) x) ≤
        profileMixture L v T h μ x + θ

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.ProfileMixtures.profileMixture_columns
statement:
theorem profileMixture_columns [Fintype X]
    (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i) (𝒯 : Finset (Finset ι)) (h : ℕ)
    (μ : GraphProfile.Columns X 𝒯 → ℝ) (x : X) :
    profileMixture L (fun y : GraphProfile.Columns X 𝒯 => y.1)
        (fun y => y.2.val) h μ x =
      columnCombination (GraphProfile.column L 𝒯 h) μ x

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.ProfileMixtures.profileMixture_eq_sum
statement:
theorem profileMixture_eq_sum (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i) (v : Y → X)
    (T : Y → Finset ι) {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (μ : Y → ℝ) (x : X) :
    profileMixture L v T h μ x = ∑ j : Fin h,
      LogProfile.gamma h j.val * CompressionLevels.levelValue L v T μ j.val x

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.ProfileMixtures.rounded_level_sum_bounds
statement:
theorem rounded_level_sum_bounds (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i) (v : Y → X)
    (T : Y → Finset ι) (μ : Y → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y)
    (hmass : ∑ y, μ y ≤ 1) {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) {θ : ℝ}
    (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hprofile : Real.log 3 / Real.log ((h : ℝ) + 1) ≤ θ)
    (x : X) (assigned rounded : Fin h → ℝ)
    (hlower : ∀ j, CompressionLevels.levelValue L v T μ j.val x - 2 * θ ≤ assigned j)
    (hupper : ∀ j, assigned j ≤ CompressionLevels.levelValue L v T μ (3 * j.val + 2) x)
    (hround : ∀ j, 0 ≤ assigned j - rounded j ∧ assigned j - rounded j ≤ θ) :
    profileMixture L v T h μ x - 3 * θ ≤
        ∑ j : Fin h, LogProfile.gamma h j.val * rounded j ∧
      (∑ j : Fin h, LogProfile.gamma h j.val * rounded j) ≤
        profileMixture L v T h μ x + θ

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.ProfileMixtures.sum_gamma_fin
statement:
theorem sum_gamma_fin {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    (∑ j : Fin h, LogProfile.gamma h j.val) = 1

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GreedyPivots.bad_of_subset
statement:

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.exists_greedy_pivots
statement:
theorem exists_greedy_pivots {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] [Fintype Y]
    (μ : Y → ℝ) (I : X → Finset Y) (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y)
    (hmass : ∑ y, μ y ≤ 1) (θ : ℝ) (_hθ : 0 < θ) (s : ℕ)
    (hs : 1 ≤ (s : ℝ) * θ) :
    ∃ centers : Fin s → X, ∃ assigned : Y → Option (Fin s),
      (∀ y k, assigned y = some k → y ∈ I (centers k)) ∧
      (∀ y, (∃ k, y ∈ I (centers k)) ↔ assigned y ≠ none) ∧
      (∀ x, ∑ y ∈ (I x).filter (fun y => assigned y = none), μ y ≤ θ)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.exists_profile_pivots
statement:
theorem exists_profile_pivots {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY}
    [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] [Fintype Y]
    {u : ℕ} {Label : Fin u → Type uLabel}
    (L : (i : Fin u) → X → Label i) (v : Y → X) (T : Y → Finset (Fin u))
    (μ : Y → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y) (hmass : ∑ y, μ y ≤ 1)
    (hu : 0 < u) (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ (s : ℝ) * θ)
    (hcomp : ∀ y, ((Finset.univ \ T y).card : ℝ) ≤ θ * (u : ℝ)) (h : ℕ) :
    ∃ i : Fin u, ∃ centers : Fin h → Fin s → X,
      ∃ assigned : Fin h → Y → Option (Fin s),
        (∑ y ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun y => i ∉ T y), μ y) ≤ θ ∧
        (∀ j y k, assigned j y = some k →
          i ∈ T y ∧ PartitionGraph.near L (T y) j.val (centers j k) (v y)) ∧
        (∀ j x, (∑ y ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun y =>
          i ∈ T y ∧ PartitionGraph.near L (T y) j.val x (v y) ∧
            assigned j y = none), μ y) ≤ θ)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.compressionList_bounds
statement:
theorem compressionList_bounds
    (L : (i : Fin u) → X → Label i) (E : FixedLabels L q)
    (𝒯 : Finset (Finset (Fin u)))
    (hu : 0 < u) (hh : 0 < h) (hs : 0 < s)
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hsθ : 1 ≤ (s : ℝ) * θ)
    (hprofile : Real.log 3 / Real.log ((h : ℝ) + 1) ≤ θ)
    (hcomp : ∀ T ∈ 𝒯, ((Finset.univ \ T).card : ℝ) ≤ θ * (u : ℝ))
    (μ : GraphProfile.Columns X 𝒯 → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y) (hmass : ∑ y, μ y ≤ 1) :
    ∃ a ∈ compressionList L E h s θ, ∀ x,
      columnCombination (GraphProfile.column L 𝒯 h) μ x - 3 * θ ≤ a x ∧
        a x ≤ columnCombination (GraphProfile.column L 𝒯 h) μ x + θ

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.exists_compressionCode
statement:
theorem exists_compressionCode
    (L : (i : Fin u) → X → Label i) (E : FixedLabels L q)
    (v : Y → X) (T : Y → Finset (Fin u)) (μ : Y → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y) (hmass : ∑ y, μ y ≤ 1)
    (hu : 0 < u) (hh : 0 < h) (hs : 0 < s)
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hsθ : 1 ≤ (s : ℝ) * θ)
    (hprofile : Real.log 3 / Real.log ((h : ℝ) + 1) ≤ θ)
    (hcomp : ∀ y, ((Finset.univ \ T y).card : ℝ) ≤ θ * (u : ℝ)) :
    ∃ code : CompressionCode u q h s (weightCodeSize (roundingStep θ s u)),
      ∀ x, profileMixture L v T h μ x - 3 * θ ≤ compressionDecode L E h s θ code x ∧
        compressionDecode L E h s θ code x ≤ profileMixture L v T h μ x + θ

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.uniform_compression
statement:
theorem uniform_compression
    (L : (i : Fin u) → X → Label i)
    (hlabels : ∀ i, Nat.card (Set.range (L i)) ≤ q)
    (𝒯 : Finset (Finset (Fin u)))
    (hu : 0 < u) (hq : 0 < q) (hh : 0 < h) (hs : 0 < s)
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hsθ : 1 ≤ (s : ℝ) * θ)
    (hprofile : Real.log 3 / Real.log ((h : ℝ) + 1) ≤ θ)
    (hcomp : ∀ T ∈ 𝒯, ((Finset.univ \ T).card : ℝ) ≤ θ * (u : ℝ)) :
    ∃ A : Finset (X → ℝ), A.Nonempty ∧
      (A.card : ℝ) ≤ (u : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) ^ (h * s) *
        (1 + (s : ℝ) * 2 ^ u / θ) ^ (h * s * 2 ^ u) ∧
      SignedCompression.PositiveApproximation (GraphProfile.column L 𝒯 h) θ A

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.uniform_signed_compression
statement:
theorem uniform_signed_compression
    (L : (i : Fin u) → X → Label i)
    (hlabels : ∀ i, Nat.card (Set.range (L i)) ≤ q)
    (𝒯 : Finset (Finset (Fin u)))
    (hu : 0 < u) (hq : 0 < q) (hh : 0 < h) (hs : 0 < s)
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hsθ : 1 ≤ (s : ℝ) * θ)
    (hprofile : Real.log 3 / Real.log ((h : ℝ) + 1) ≤ θ)
    (hcomp : ∀ T ∈ 𝒯, ((Finset.univ \ T).card : ℝ) ≤ θ * (u : ℝ)) :
    ∃ A B : Finset (X → ℝ), A.Nonempty ∧
      (A.card : ℝ) ≤ (u : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) ^ (h * s) *
        (1 + (s : ℝ) * 2 ^ u / θ) ^ (h * s * 2 ^ u) ∧
      B.card ≤ A.card ^ 2 ∧
      UniformApproximation (GraphProfile.column L 𝒯 h) (6 * θ) B

      8 * b * (h : ℝ) ^ 2 * (pivotSlots (accuracy a) : ℝ) < (r : ℝ) + h - 1 ∧

      0 < directionCount r h (accuracy a) ∧
      (h : ℝ) * (2 * (formDimension r h : ℝ)) ≤

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.form_entropy_ratio_le
statement:
theorem form_entropy_ratio_le {r h s p Q : ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hh : 0 < h) (hp : 1 < p)
    (hQ : Real.log (Q : ℝ) ≤ (h : ℝ) * (s : ℝ) *
      Real.log ((p : ℝ) ^ formDimension r (h - 1)) + C) :
    Real.log ((Q : ℝ) ^ 2) / Real.log ((p : ℝ) ^ formDimension r h) ≤
      2 * (h : ℝ) ^ 2 * (s : ℝ) / ((r : ℝ) + h - 1) +
        2 * C / ((formDimension r h : ℝ) * Real.log (p : ℝ))

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.form_entropy_ratio_le_of_count
statement:
theorem form_entropy_ratio_le_of_count {r h p u Q : ℕ} {θ : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hh : 0 < h) (hp : 1 < p) (hu : 0 < u)
    (hθ : 0 < θ) (hQ : 0 < Q)
    (hcount : (Q : ℝ) ≤ (u : ℝ) *
      ((p ^ formDimension r (h - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (h * pivotSlots θ) *
        (1 + (pivotSlots θ : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ u / θ) ^
          (h * pivotSlots θ * 2 ^ u)) :
    Real.log ((Q : ℝ) ^ 2) / Real.log ((p : ℝ) ^ formDimension r h) ≤
      2 * (h : ℝ) ^ 2 * (pivotSlots θ : ℝ) / ((r : ℝ) + h - 1) +
        2 * encodingCost h θ u / ((formDimension r h : ℝ) * Real.log (p : ℝ))

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.log_card_le_encodingCost
statement:
theorem log_card_le_encodingCost {α : Type uα} {A : Finset α} {h u q : ℕ} {θ : ℝ}
    (hu : 0 < u) (hq : 0 < q) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hA : A.Nonempty)
    (hcount : (A.card : ℝ) ≤ (u : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) ^ (h * pivotSlots θ) *
      (1 + (pivotSlots θ : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ u / θ) ^
        (h * pivotSlots θ * 2 ^ u)) :
    Real.log (A.card : ℝ) ≤ (h : ℝ) * (pivotSlots θ : ℝ) * Real.log (q : ℝ) +
      encodingCost h θ u

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.log_count_le_encodingCost

      (1 + (pivotSlots θ : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ u / θ) ^
        (h * pivotSlots θ * 2 ^ u)) :
    Real.log (Q : ℝ) ≤ (h : ℝ) * (pivotSlots θ : ℝ) * Real.log (q : ℝ) +

statement:
theorem form_entropy_ratio_le_rank {r h s p Q : ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hh : 0 < h) (hp : 1 < p) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hQ : Real.log (Q : ℝ) ≤ (h : ℝ) * (s : ℝ) *

    (hprime : Real.exp ((r : ℝ) * C / (formDimension r h : ℝ)) < (p : ℝ)) :

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.form_entropy_ratio_lt
statement:
theorem form_entropy_ratio_lt {r h s p Q : ℕ} {C b : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hh : 0 < h) (hp : 1 < p) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hQ : Real.log (Q : ℝ) ≤ (h : ℝ) * (s : ℝ) *
      Real.log ((p : ℝ) ^ formDimension r (h - 1)) + C)
    (hrank : 8 * b * (h : ℝ) ^ 2 * (s : ℝ) < (r : ℝ) + h - 1)
    (hprime : Real.exp (8 * b * C / (formDimension r h : ℝ)) < (p : ℝ)) :

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.form_entropy_ratio_lt_of_count
statement:
theorem form_entropy_ratio_lt_of_count {r h p u Q : ℕ} {θ b : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hh : 0 < h) (hp : 1 < p) (hu : 0 < u)
    (hθ : 0 < θ) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (hcount : (Q : ℝ) ≤ (u : ℝ) *

    (hrank : 8 * b * (h : ℝ) ^ 2 * (pivotSlots θ : ℝ) < (r : ℝ) + h - 1)
    (hprime : Real.exp (8 * b * encodingCost h θ u / (formDimension r h : ℝ)) <
      (p : ℝ)) :

statement:
theorem matrix_to_body [Nonempty X] (g : Y → X → ℝ) {ε t : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hsep : ∀ x x', x ≠ x' → ∃ y, 1 ≤ |g y x - g y x'|)
    (A : Finset (RealSpace X)) (hA : UniformApproximation g ε A) :
    IsSymmetricConvexBody (matrixBody g t) ∧
      IsSymmetricConvexBody (cube Y) ∧
      Coverable (matrixBody g t) (cube Y) ∧
      Coverable (polar (cube Y)) ((6 * ε + 2 * t) • polar (matrixBody g t)) ∧
      Fintype.card X ≤ coveringNumber (matrixBody g t) (cube Y) ∧
      coveringNumber (polar (cube Y))
        ((6 * ε + 2 * t) • polar (matrixBody g t)) ≤ A.card

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.matrix_to_body_fin
statement:
theorem matrix_to_body_fin [Nonempty X] [Nonempty Y]
    (g : Y → X → ℝ) {ε t : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hsep : ∀ x x', x ≠ x' → ∃ y, 1 ≤ |g y x - g y x'|)
    (A : Finset (RealSpace X)) (hA : UniformApproximation g ε A) :
    0 < Fintype.card Y ∧
      ∃ K : Set (RealSpace (Fin (Fintype.card Y))),
        IsSymmetricConvexBody K ∧
        IsSymmetricConvexBody (cube (Fin (Fintype.card Y))) ∧
        Coverable K (cube (Fin (Fintype.card Y))) ∧
        Coverable (polar (cube (Fin (Fintype.card Y)))) ((6 * ε + 2 * t) • polar K) ∧
        Fintype.card X ≤ coveringNumber K (cube (Fin (Fintype.card Y))) ∧
        coveringNumber (polar (cube (Fin (Fintype.card Y))))
          ((6 * ε + 2 * t) • polar K) ≤ A.card

statement:
theorem exists_prime_after_parameters (h u D : ℕ) (C B bound : ℝ) :
    ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ bound < (p : ℝ) ∧ h < p ∧
      h ^ 2 * u ^ (2 * h) < p ∧ Real.exp (B * C / (D : ℝ)) < (p : ℝ)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.exists_prime_for_rank
statement:
theorem exists_prime_for_rank {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (B bound : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B) :
    let h := compressionRadius a
    let D := formDimension r h
    let u := directionCount r h (accuracy a)
    let C := encodingCost h (accuracy a) u
    ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ bound < (p : ℝ) ∧ h < p ∧
      h ^ 2 * u ^ (2 * h) < p ∧ Real.exp (B * C / (D : ℝ)) < (p : ℝ) ∧
      0 < Real.log (p : ℝ) ∧ B * C < (D : ℝ) * Real.log (p : ℝ) ∧
      2 * C / ((D : ℝ) * Real.log (p : ℝ)) < 2 / B ∧ 0 < C

statement:

    ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ bound < (p : ℝ) ∧ h < p ∧
      h ^ 2 * u ^ (2 * h) < p ∧ Real.exp (B * C / (D : ℝ)) < (p : ℝ) ∧
      0 < Real.log (p : ℝ) ∧ B * C < (D : ℝ) * Real.log (p : ℝ) ∧
      2 * C / ((D : ℝ) * Real.log (p : ℝ)) < 2 / B

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.entropyPair_of_matrix
statement:
theorem entropyPair_of_matrix {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y]
    [Nonempty X] [Nonempty Y] (a : ℝ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hprime : Real.exp (B * encodingCost (compressionRadius a) (accuracy a)
      (directionCount r (compressionRadius a) (accuracy a)) /
        (formDimension r (compressionRadius a) : ℝ)) < (p : ℝ))
    (g : Y → X → ℝ)
    (hrows : Fintype.card X = p ^ formDimension r (compressionRadius a))
    (hcolumns : Fintype.card X ≤ Fintype.card Y)
    (hsep : ∀ x x', x ≠ x' → ∃ y, 1 ≤ |g y x - g y x'|)
    (A : Finset (RealSpace X))
    (hA : UniformApproximation g (6 * accuracy a) A)
    (Q : ℕ) (hAQ : A.card ≤ Q ^ 2)
    (hQ : Real.log (Q : ℝ) ≤
      (compressionRadius a : ℝ) * (pivotSlots (accuracy a) : ℝ) *
        Real.log ((p : ℝ) ^ formDimension r (compressionRadius a - 1)) +
          encodingCost (compressionRadius a) (accuracy a)
            (directionCount r (compressionRadius a) (accuracy a))) :
    Nonempty (EntropyPair a r B)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.halfGraph_add
statement:
lemma halfGraph_add (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) {x y a b : H}
    (hxy : (x,y) ∈ D.halfGraph) (hab : (a,b) ∈ D.halfGraph) : (x+a,y+b) ∈ D.halfGraph

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.halfGraph_adjoint_iff
statement:
lemma halfGraph_adjoint_iff (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (x y : H) :
    (x,y) ∈ D.halfGraph ↔ ∀ a b, (a,b) ∈ D.halfGraph → inner ℂ y a = inner ℂ x b

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.halfGraph_iff_resolvent
statement:
lemma halfGraph_iff_resolvent (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (x y : H) :
    (x,y) ∈ D.halfGraph ↔ D.calculus halfResolvent (x+y) = x

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.halfGraph_isClosed
statement: lemma halfGraph_isClosed (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) : IsClosed D.halfGraph

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.halfGraph_nonneg
statement:
lemma halfGraph_nonneg (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) {x y : H}
    (hxy : (x,y) ∈ D.halfGraph) : 0 ≤ (inner ℂ x y).re

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.halfGraph_resolvent
statement:
lemma halfGraph_resolvent (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (h : H) :
    (D.calculus halfResolvent h, h-D.calculus halfResolvent h) ∈ D.halfGraph

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.halfGraph_sub
statement:
lemma halfGraph_sub (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) {x y a b : H}

lemma halfGraph_unique (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) {x y z : H}

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.halfResolvent_cutoff_tendsto
statement:
lemma halfResolvent_cutoff_tendsto (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (h : H) :
    Tendsto (fun n => D.calculus (halfExponentialCutoff n * halfResolvent) h)
      atTop (𝓝 (D.calculus (1-halfResolvent) h))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.kernel_of_separated_zero
statement:
lemma kernel_of_separated_zero (D : RealSpectralCalculus H)
    (g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (s : ℝ)
    (hsep : ∀ d : ℝ, 0 < d → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧
      ∀ u : ℝ, d ≤ |u-s| → c ≤ |g u|)
    {x : H} (hx : D.calculus (realMultiplier g) x = 0)
    (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℂ) (hf : f s = 0) : D.calculus f x = 0

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.modularMixedResolvent_halfGraph
statement:
lemma modularMixedResolvent_halfGraph (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (a : ℝ) (h : H) :
    (D.calculus (modularMixedResolvent a) h,
      h - (Real.exp a : ℂ) • D.calculus (modularResolvent a) h) ∈ D.halfGraph

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.modularResolvent_halfGraph
statement:
lemma modularResolvent_halfGraph (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (a : ℝ) (h : H) :
    (D.calculus (modularResolvent a) h, D.calculus (modularMixedResolvent a) h) ∈ D.halfGraph

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.tendsto_calculus_of_compact_eventual
statement:
lemma tendsto_calculus_of_compact_eventual (D : RealSpectralCalculus H)
    (f : ℕ → BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℂ) (g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℂ)
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hf : ∀ n, ‖f n‖ ≤ C)
    (he : ∀ q : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℂ, HasCompactSupport (q : ℝ → ℂ) →
      ∀ᶠ n in atTop, f n * q = g * q) (h : H) :
    Tendsto (fun n => D.calculus (f n) h) atTop (𝓝 (D.calculus g h))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.centeredHalfResolvent_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma centeredHalfResolvent_apply (u : ℝ) :
    centeredHalfResolvent u = (Real.exp (u/2)+1)⁻¹ - 1/2

statement: lemma centeredHalfResolvent_strictAnti : StrictAnti centeredHalfResolvent

statement: @[simp] lemma centeredHalfResolvent_zero : centeredHalfResolvent 0 = 0

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.exists_multiplier_approx
statement:
lemma exists_multiplier_approx (g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (s : ℝ)
    (hsep : ∀ d : ℝ, 0 < d → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧
      ∀ u : ℝ, d ≤ |u-s| → c ≤ |g u|)
    (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℂ) (hf : f s = 0) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) :
    ∃ q : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℂ, ‖f - q * realMultiplier g‖ ≤ eps

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.exp_eq_sq_exp_half
statement: lemma exp_eq_sq_exp_half (u : ℝ) : Real.exp u = Real.exp (u/2) ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.halfResolvent_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma halfResolvent_apply (u : ℝ) :
    halfResolvent u = (((Real.exp (u/2) + 1)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.halfResolvent_cutoff_norm
statement: lemma halfResolvent_cutoff_norm (n : ℕ) : ‖halfExponentialCutoff n * halfResolvent‖ ≤ 1

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.halfResolvent_selfAdjoint
statement: lemma halfResolvent_selfAdjoint : IsSelfAdjoint halfResolvent

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.realMultiplier_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma realMultiplier_apply (g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (u : ℝ) :

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.realMultiplier_centeredHalfResolvent
statement:
lemma realMultiplier_centeredHalfResolvent :
    realMultiplier centeredHalfResolvent = halfResolvent - (1/2 : ℂ) • 1

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.regularizedQuotient_remainder
statement:
lemma regularizedQuotient_remainder (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℂ)
    (g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (u : ℝ) :
    (f - regularizedQuotient f g k hk * realMultiplier g) u =
      f u * ((k / ((g u)^2 + k) : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffFunction_continuous
statement:
lemma cutoffFunction_continuous {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    Continuous (cutoffFunction K)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffFunction_eq_one
statement:
lemma cutoffFunction_eq_one {K r : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hr : Real.sqrt r ≤ K) :
    cutoffFunction K r = 1

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffFunction_error_bound
statement:
lemma cutoffFunction_error_bound {K r : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    (1 - cutoffFunction K r) * r * (1 - cutoffFunction K r) ≤ r ^ 2 / K ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffFunction_le_one
statement:
lemma cutoffFunction_le_one {K r : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    cutoffFunction K r ≤ 1

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffFunction_nonneg
statement:
lemma cutoffFunction_nonneg {K r : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    0 ≤ cutoffFunction K r

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffFunction_norm_bound
statement:
lemma cutoffFunction_norm_bound {K r : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    cutoffFunction K r * r * cutoffFunction K r ≤ K ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffLeftFunction_continuous
statement:
lemma cutoffLeftFunction_continuous {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    Continuous (cutoffLeftFunction K)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffLeftFunction_mul_right
statement:
lemma cutoffLeftFunction_mul_right {K r : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    cutoffLeftFunction K r * cutoffRightFunction K r = 1 - cutoffFunction K r

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffLeftFunction_sq
statement:
lemma cutoffLeftFunction_sq {K r : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    cutoffLeftFunction K r ^ 2 = (1 - cutoffFunction K r) / max K (Real.sqrt r)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffLeft_loss
statement:
lemma cutoffLeft_loss (a : A) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    (2*K) • (cutoffLeft a K * star (cutoffLeft a K)) ≤
      a * star a - polarCutoff a K * star (polarCutoff a K)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffLeft_mul_right
statement:
lemma cutoffLeft_mul_right (a : A) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    cutoffLeft a K * cutoffRight a K = a - polarCutoff a K

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffRightFunction_continuous
statement:
lemma cutoffRightFunction_continuous {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    Continuous (cutoffRightFunction K)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffRightFunction_sq
statement:
lemma cutoffRightFunction_sq {K r : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    cutoffRightFunction K r ^ 2 = (1 - cutoffFunction K r) * max K (Real.sqrt r)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffRight_loss
statement:
lemma cutoffRight_loss (a : A) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    (2*K) • (star (cutoffRight a K) * cutoffRight a K) ≤
      star a * a - star (polarCutoff a K) * polarCutoff a K

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoff_left_loss
statement:
lemma cutoff_left_loss {K r : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    (2*K) * cutoffLeftFunction K r ^ 2 ≤ 1 - cutoffFunction K r ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoff_right_loss
statement:
lemma cutoff_right_loss {K r : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    (2*K) * cutoffRightFunction K r ^ 2 ≤ r - cutoffFunction K r * r * cutoffFunction K r

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.norm_polarCutoff_le
statement:
lemma norm_polarCutoff_le (z : A) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    ‖polarCutoff z K‖ ≤ K

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.polarCutoff_error_le
statement:
lemma polarCutoff_error_le (z : A) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    star (z - polarCutoff z K) * (z - polarCutoff z K) ≤
      (K ^ 2)⁻¹ • (star z * z) ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.polarCutoff_error_square
statement:
lemma polarCutoff_error_square (z : A) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    star (z - polarCutoff z K) * (z - polarCutoff z K) =
      cfc (fun r => (1 - cutoffFunction K r) * r * (1 - cutoffFunction K r))
        (star z * z)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.polarCutoff_square
statement:
lemma polarCutoff_square (z : A) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    star (polarCutoff z K) * polarCutoff z K =
      cfc (fun r => cutoffFunction K r * r * cutoffFunction K r) (star z * z)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.halfGraph_energy_identity
statement:
lemma halfGraph_energy_identity (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (lam : ℝ) (b : H)
    {z q x y : H} (hzq : (z,q) ∈ D.halfGraph)
    (hqb : (q,b-(lam:ℂ) • z) ∈ D.halfGraph) (hxy : (x,y) ∈ D.halfGraph) :
    modularEnergy lam b x y - modularEnergy lam b z q =
      lam * ‖x-z‖ ^ 2 + ‖y-q‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.core_halfGraph
statement:
lemma core_halfGraph (S : StandardModularData H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) (ha : a ∈ S.M) :
    (a S.xi, S.J ((star a) S.xi)) ∈ S.D.halfGraph

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.fundamental_resolvent_lift
statement:
lemma fundamental_resolvent_lift (S : StandardModularData H) (r : ℝ)
    (b : H →L[ℂ] H) (hb : b ∈ S.M.commutant) :
    ∃ a : H →L[ℂ] H, a ∈ S.M ∧ ‖a‖ ≤ ‖b‖ * (1+(Real.exp r)⁻¹)+1 ∧
      a S.xi = S.D.calculus (modularResolvent r) (b S.xi)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.bounded_orbit_lift
statement:
lemma bounded_orbit_lift (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (xi : H)
    (hsep : ∀ a : H →L[ℂ] H, a ∈ M → a xi = 0 → a = 0)
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) {h : H}
    (hh : h ∈ closure {v : H | ∃ a : H →L[ℂ] H, a ∈ M ∧ ‖a‖ ≤ C ∧ a xi = v}) :
    ∃ a : H →L[ℂ] H, a ∈ M ∧ ‖a‖ ≤ C ∧ a xi = h

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.commutant_cyclic
statement:
lemma commutant_cyclic (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (xi : H)
    (hsep : ∀ a : H →L[ℂ] H, a ∈ M → a xi = 0 → a = 0) :
    Dense (operatorOrbit M.commutant xi : Set H)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffLeft_mem
statement:
lemma cutoffLeft_mem (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) {a : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : a ∈ M) (K : ℝ) :
    cutoffLeft a K ∈ M

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffLeft_vector_loss
statement:
lemma cutoffLeft_vector_loss (xi : H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    (2*K) * ‖star (cutoffLeft a K) xi‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖(star a) xi‖ ^ 2 - ‖star (polarCutoff a K) xi‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffRight_vector_loss
statement:
lemma cutoffRight_vector_loss (xi : H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    (2*K) * ‖cutoffRight a K xi‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖a xi‖ ^ 2 - ‖polarCutoff a K xi‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoff_cross_term
statement:
lemma cutoff_cross_term (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (xi : H)
    (a b : H →L[ℂ] H) (ha : a ∈ M) (hb : b ∈ M.commutant) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    2 * (inner ℂ (b xi) ((a-polarCutoff a K) xi)).re ≤
      ‖b‖ * (‖star (cutoffLeft a K) xi‖ ^ 2 + ‖cutoffRight a K xi‖ ^ 2)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoff_energy_le
statement:
lemma cutoff_energy_le (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (xi : H)
    (a b : H →L[ℂ] H) (ha : a ∈ M) (hb : b ∈ M.commutant)
    {lam K : ℝ} (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (hK : 0 < K) (h1 : ‖b‖ ≤ 2*K) (h2 : ‖b‖ ≤ lam*(2*K)) :
    modularEnergy lam (b xi) (polarCutoff a K xi) (star (polarCutoff a K) xi) ≤
      modularEnergy lam (b xi) (a xi) ((star a) xi)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.isClosed_bounded_orbit
statement:
lemma isClosed_bounded_orbit (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (xi : H)
    (hsep : ∀ a : H →L[ℂ] H, a ∈ M → a xi = 0 → a = 0)
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    IsClosed {v : H | ∃ a : H →L[ℂ] H, a ∈ M ∧ ‖a‖ ≤ C ∧ a xi = v}

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.operatorOrbit_invariant
statement:

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.polarCutoff_mem

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.re_vectorState_mono

statement:

lemma vectorState_star_mul (xi : H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.vonNeumannAlgebra_isClosed

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.HilbertPair.diag_pair

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.HilbertPair.fst_diag
statement:

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.HilbertPair.fst_inl

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.HilbertPair.fst_inr
statement: @[simp] lemma fst_inr (x : H) : WithLp.fstL 2 ℂ H H (inr x) = 0

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.HilbertPair.inl_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma inl_apply (x : H) : inl x = pair x 0

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.HilbertPair.inner_pair
statement:
@[simp] lemma inner_pair (x y z w : H) :
    inner ℂ (pair x y) (pair z w) = inner ℂ x z + inner ℂ y w

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.HilbertPair.inr_apply

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.HilbertPair.norm_pair_le

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.HilbertPair.pair_add

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.HilbertPair.pair_eq_inl_add_inr
statement: lemma pair_eq_inl_add_inr (x y : H) : pair x y = inl x + inr y

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.HilbertPair.pair_smul

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.HilbertPair.snd_diag
statement:
@[simp] lemma snd_diag (a : H →L[ℂ] H) (v : HilbertPair H) :

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.HilbertPair.snd_inl

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.HilbertPair.snd_inr
statement: @[simp] lemma snd_inr (x : H) : WithLp.sndL 2 ℂ H H (inr x) = x

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.HilbertPair.star_inl

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.HilbertPair.star_inr
statement: lemma star_inr : inr.adjoint = WithLp.sndL 2 ℂ H H

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.halfGraph_smul
statement:

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.nonneg_of_jordan_pairing
statement:
lemma nonneg_of_jordan_pairing (φ : A →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)
    (hp : ∀ a : A, 0 ≤ (φ (star a * a)).re)
    (hf : ∀ a : A, (φ (star a * a)).re = 0 → a = 0)
    (x : A) (hx : IsSelfAdjoint x)
    (ht : ∀ y : A, 0 ≤ y → 0 ≤ (φ (x*y+y*x)).re) : 0 ≤ x

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.weightedMatrixFunctional_faithful
statement:
lemma weightedMatrixFunctional_faithful (φ : A →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (w : n → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hp : ∀ a : A, 0 ≤ (φ (star a*a)).re)
    (hf : ∀ a : A, (φ (star a*a)).re = 0 → a = 0)
    (a : CStarMatrix n n A) (ha : (weightedMatrixFunctional φ w (star a*a)).re = 0) : a = 0

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.weightedMatrixFunctional_nonneg
statement:
lemma weightedMatrixFunctional_nonneg (φ : A →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (w : n → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hp : ∀ a : A, 0 ≤ (φ (star a*a)).re)
    (a : CStarMatrix n n A) :
    0 ≤ (weightedMatrixFunctional φ w (star a*a)).re

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.weightedMatrixFunctional_star_mul
statement:
lemma weightedMatrixFunctional_star_mul (φ : A →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (w : n → ℝ)
    (a : CStarMatrix n n A) :
    (weightedMatrixFunctional φ w (star a*a)).re =
      ∑ i, w i * ∑ j, (φ (star (a j i) * a j i)).re

    (hf : Continuous f) (C : ℝ) (hC : ∀ r, ‖f r‖ ≤ C) :
    (∫ x, ∫ y, f (x-y) ∂gaussianReal 0 v ∂gaussianReal 0 v) =

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.integral_comp_simple
statement:
lemma integral_comp_simple {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} {E : Type uE} [MeasurableSpace X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (q : SimpleFunc X Y) (f : Y → E) :
    ∫ x, f (q x) ∂μ = ∑ y ∈ q.range, μ.real (q ⁻¹' {y}) • f y

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.integral_gaussianCutoff_eq
statement:
lemma integral_gaussianCutoff_eq {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (n : ℕ) (f : ℝ → E) :
    (∫ r, gaussianCutoff n r • f r) = gaussianNormalization n •
      ∫ r, f r ∂gaussianReal 0 (gaussianVariance n+gaussianVariance n)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.integral_positive_kernel
statement:
lemma integral_positive_kernel {X : Type uX} [PseudoMetricSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X]
    [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (x₀ : X) (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (K : X → X → ℂ) (hcont : Continuous (fun p : X × X => K p.1 p.2))
    (C : ℝ) (hbound : ∀ x y, ‖K x y‖ ≤ C)
    (hpos : ∀ (n : Type uX) [Fintype n] (x : n → X) (c : n → ℂ),
      0 ≤ (∑ i, ∑ j, (starRingEnd ℂ) (c i) * c j * K (x i) (x j)).re) :
    0 ≤ (∫ x, ∫ y, K x y ∂μ ∂μ).re

statement:
lemma norm_integral_smul_bounded_orbit {k : ℝ → ℂ} (hk : Integrable k)
    {F : ℝ → E} {C : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ t, ‖F t‖ ≤ C) :
    ‖∫ t, k t • F t‖ ≤ (∫ t, ‖k t‖) * C

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.norm_strongIntegral_le
statement:
lemma norm_strongIntegral_le (k : ℝ → ℂ) (hk : Integrable k) (F : ℝ → E →L[ℂ] E)
    (hF : ∀ h, Continuous (fun t => F t h)) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ t, ‖F t‖ ≤ C) :
    ‖strongIntegral k hk F hF C hbound‖ ≤ (∫ t, ‖k t‖) * C

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.strongIntegral_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma strongIntegral_apply (k : ℝ → ℂ) (hk : Integrable k) (F : ℝ → E →L[ℂ] E)
    (hF : ∀ h, Continuous (fun t => F t h)) (C : ℝ) (hbound : ∀ t, ‖F t‖ ≤ C) (h : E) :
    strongIntegral k hk F hF C hbound h = ∫ t, k t • F t h

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.kernelCutoffError_tendsto
statement:
lemma kernelCutoffError_tendsto (R : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n => kernelCutoffError n R) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.kernelFourier_zero
statement: lemma kernelFourier_zero : kernelFourier 0 = (kernelMass:ℂ)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.kernelMass_pos
statement: lemma kernelMass_pos : 0 < kernelMass

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.kernelMultiplier_mul_tendsto
statement:
lemma kernelMultiplier_mul_tendsto (t : ℝ) (q : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℂ)
    (hq : HasCompactSupport (q:ℝ → ℂ)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => kernelMultiplier n t*q) atTop
      (𝓝 ((kernelFourier t • spectralCharacter t)*q))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.kernelMultiplier_shift
statement:
lemma kernelMultiplier_shift (n : ℕ) (t u : ℝ) :
    kernelMultiplier n t u = spectralCharacter t u*
      ∫ r, (gaussianCutoff n (r+u):ℂ)*spectralCharacter t r*(kernelScalar r:ℂ)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.norm_kernelFourier_le
statement: lemma norm_kernelFourier_le (t : ℝ) : ‖kernelFourier t‖ ≤ kernelMass

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.norm_kernelMultiplier_le
statement: lemma norm_kernelMultiplier_le (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ‖kernelMultiplier n t‖ ≤ kernelMass

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.norm_kernelMultiplier_sub_le
statement:
lemma norm_kernelMultiplier_sub_le (n : ℕ) (t u R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hu : |u| ≤ R) :
    ‖kernelMultiplier n t u-kernelFourier t*spectralCharacter t u‖ ≤ kernelCutoffError n R

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.kernelMultiplier_strong_tendsto
statement:
lemma kernelMultiplier_strong_tendsto (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (t : ℝ) (h : H) :
    Tendsto (fun n => D.calculus (kernelMultiplier n t) h) atTop
      (𝓝 (kernelFourier t • D.unitary t h))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.tendsto_calculus_of_compact
statement:
lemma tendsto_calculus_of_compact (D : RealSpectralCalculus H)
    (f : ℕ → BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℂ) (g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℂ)
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hf : ∀ n, ‖f n‖ ≤ C)
    (he : ∀ q : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℂ, HasCompactSupport (q : ℝ → ℂ) →
      Tendsto (fun n => f n*q) atTop (𝓝 (g*q))) (h : H) :
    Tendsto (fun n => D.calculus (f n) h) atTop (𝓝 (D.calculus g h))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.tendsto_apply_of_tendsto_xi
statement:
lemma tendsto_apply_of_tendsto_xi (S : StandardModularData H)
    (a : ℕ → S.M.toStarSubalgebra) (b : S.M.toStarSubalgebra)
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (ha : ∀ n, ‖a n‖ ≤ C)
    (hx : Tendsto (fun n => (a n:H →L[ℂ] H) S.xi) atTop (𝓝 ((b:H →L[ℂ] H) S.xi))) (h : H) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (a n:H →L[ℂ] H) h) atTop (𝓝 ((b:H →L[ℂ] H) h))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.kernelFourier_eq_real
statement: lemma kernelFourier_eq_real (t : ℝ) : ((kernelFourier t).re:ℂ) = kernelFourier t

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.kernelFourier_positive_near_zero
statement:
lemma kernelFourier_positive_near_zero : ∃ d : ℝ, 0 < d ∧
    ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < d → 0 < (kernelFourier t).re

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.kernelFourier_star
statement: lemma kernelFourier_star (t : ℝ) : star (kernelFourier t) = kernelFourier t

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.exists_fourierKernel_lift
statement:
lemma exists_fourierKernel_lift (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (b : S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) :
    ∃ a : H →L[ℂ] H, a ∈ S.M ∧ ‖a‖ ≤ 4*kernelMass*‖b‖ ∧
      a S.xi = kernelFourier t • S.D.unitary t (S.J ((↑(star b):H →L[ℂ] H) S.xi))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.fourierKernel_add
statement:
lemma fourierKernel_add (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (b c : S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) :
    S.fourierKernel t (b+c) = S.fourierKernel t b + S.fourierKernel t c

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.fourierKernel_gram_vector_nonneg
statement:
lemma fourierKernel_gram_vector_nonneg (S : StandardModularData H)
    {m : Type uM} [Fintype m] (t : ℝ)
    (b : m → S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) (h : m → H) :
    0 ≤ (∑ i,∑ j,inner ℂ (h i) ((S.fourierKernel t (star (b j)*b i):H →L[ℂ] H) (h j))).re

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.fourierKernel_one
statement:
lemma fourierKernel_one (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) :
    S.fourierKernel t 1 = kernelFourier t • 1

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.fourierKernel_smul
statement:
lemma fourierKernel_smul (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (b : S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) (z : ℂ) :
    S.fourierKernel t (z • b) = z • S.fourierKernel t b

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.fourierKernel_star
statement:
lemma fourierKernel_star (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (b : S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) :
    star (S.fourierKernel t b) = S.fourierKernel t (star b)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.fourierKernel_strong_tendsto
statement:
lemma fourierKernel_strong_tendsto (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (b : S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) (h : H) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (S.kernelAverage n t b:H →L[ℂ] H) h) atTop
      (𝓝 ((S.fourierKernel t b:H →L[ℂ] H) h))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.fourierKernel_xi
statement:
lemma fourierKernel_xi (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (b : S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) :
    (S.fourierKernel t b:H →L[ℂ] H) S.xi =
      kernelFourier t • S.D.unitary t (S.J ((↑(star b):H →L[ℂ] H) S.xi))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.kernelFourier_ne_zero
statement: lemma kernelFourier_ne_zero {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < (kernelFourier t).re) : kernelFourier t ≠ 0

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.norm_fourierKernel_le
statement:
lemma norm_fourierKernel_le (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (b : S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) : ‖S.fourierKernel t b‖ ≤ 4*kernelMass*‖b‖

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.normalizedFourier_add
statement:
lemma normalizedFourier_add (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (b c : S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) :
    S.normalizedFourier t (b+c) = S.normalizedFourier t b + S.normalizedFourier t c

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.normalizedFourier_gram_vector_nonneg
statement:
lemma normalizedFourier_gram_vector_nonneg (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < (kernelFourier t).re) {m : Type uM} [Fintype m]
    (b : m → S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) (h : m → H) :
    0 ≤ (∑ i,∑ j,inner ℂ (h i) ((S.normalizedFourier t (star (b j)*b i):H →L[ℂ] H) (h j))).re

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.normalizedFourier_one
statement:
lemma normalizedFourier_one (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : kernelFourier t ≠ 0) : S.normalizedFourier t 1 = 1

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.normalizedFourier_schwarz
statement:
lemma normalizedFourier_schwarz (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < (kernelFourier t).re) (b : S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) :
    S.normalizedFourier t b * star (S.normalizedFourier t b) ≤
      S.normalizedFourier t (star b*b)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.normalizedFourier_smul
statement:
lemma normalizedFourier_smul (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (z : ℂ) (b : S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) :
    S.normalizedFourier t (z • b) = z • S.normalizedFourier t b

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.normalizedFourier_star
statement:
lemma normalizedFourier_star (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (b : S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) :
    star (S.normalizedFourier t b) = S.normalizedFourier t (star b)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.normalizedFourier_xi
statement:
lemma normalizedFourier_xi (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : kernelFourier t ≠ 0) (b : S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) :
    (S.normalizedFourier t b:H →L[ℂ] H) S.xi =
      S.D.unitary t (S.J ((↑(star b):H →L[ℂ] H) S.xi))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.jConjugate_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma jConjugate_apply (S : StandardModularData H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) (h : H) :
    S.jConjugate a h = S.J (a (S.J h))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.jConjugate_involutive
statement:
@[simp] lemma jConjugate_involutive (S : StandardModularData H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.jConjugate (S.jConjugate a) = a

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.jConjugate_mem
statement:
lemma jConjugate_mem (S : StandardModularData H) (b : H →L[ℂ] H) (hb : b ∈ S.M.commutant) :
    S.jConjugate b ∈ S.M

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.jConjugate_mem_commutant
statement:
lemma jConjugate_mem_commutant (S : StandardModularData H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) (ha : a ∈ S.M) :
    S.jConjugate a ∈ S.M.commutant

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.modular_covariance
statement:
lemma modular_covariance (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) (ha : a ∈ S.M) :
    S.D.unitary t * a * S.D.unitary (-t) ∈ S.M

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.modular_covariance_iff
statement:
lemma modular_covariance_iff (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.sigma t a ∈ S.M ↔ a ∈ S.M

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.normalizedFourier_on_dense
statement:
lemma normalizedFourier_on_dense (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < (kernelFourier t).re) (b : S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) (x : H) :
    (S.normalizedFourier t b:H →L[ℂ] H) (S.D.unitary t (S.J x)) =
      S.D.unitary t (S.J ((star (b:H →L[ℂ] H)) x))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.normalizedFourier_spatial
statement:
lemma normalizedFourier_spatial (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < (kernelFourier t).re) (b : S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) :
    (S.normalizedFourier t b:H →L[ℂ] H) = S.sigma t (S.jConjugate (star (b:H →L[ℂ] H)))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_add_time
statement:
lemma sigma_add_time (S : StandardModularData H) (s t : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.sigma (s+t) a = S.sigma s (S.sigma t a)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_jConjugate_mem
statement:
lemma sigma_jConjugate_mem (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < (kernelFourier t).re) (b : H →L[ℂ] H) (hb : b ∈ S.M.commutant) :
    S.sigma t (S.jConjugate b) ∈ S.M

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_mem_of_fourier_positive
statement:
lemma sigma_mem_of_fourier_positive (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < (kernelFourier t).re) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) (ha : a ∈ S.M) :
    S.sigma t a ∈ S.M

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma sigma_zero (S : StandardModularData H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) : S.sigma 0 a = a

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.continuous_sigma_apply
statement:
lemma continuous_sigma_apply (S : StandardModularData H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) (h : H) :
    Continuous (fun t => S.sigma t a h)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.exists_finite_average_pair
statement:
lemma exists_finite_average_pair (S : StandardModularData H)
    (hscalar : S.ScalarCentralizer) {a b : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : a ∈ S.M) (hb : b ∈ S.M)
    {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (p t : Fin n → ℝ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) ∧ (∑ i, p i) = 1 ∧
      ‖(∑ i, p i • S.D.unitary (t i) (a S.xi)) - S.state a • S.xi‖ < eps ∧
      ‖(∑ i, p i • S.D.unitary (t i) (b S.xi)) - S.state b • S.xi‖ < eps

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.fixed_eq_state_of_mem_closed_convex_orbit
statement:
lemma fixed_eq_state_of_mem_closed_convex_orbit (S : StandardModularData H)
    (hscalar : S.ScalarCentralizer) {a : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : a ∈ S.M)
    {v : H} (hv : v ∈ closure (convexHull ℝ (Set.range (fun t => S.D.unitary t (a S.xi)))))
    (hfix : ∀ t, S.D.unitary t v = v) : v = S.state a • S.xi

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.fixed_of_fixed_vector
OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.inner_fixed_on_closed_convex_orbit
statement:
lemma inner_fixed_on_closed_convex_orbit (S : StandardModularData H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H)
    {v : H} (hv : v ∈ closure (convexHull ℝ (Set.range (fun t => S.D.unitary t (a S.xi))))) :
    inner ℂ S.xi v = S.state a

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.norm_sigma
statement:
lemma norm_sigma (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    ‖S.sigma t a‖ = ‖a‖

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.norm_star_apply_xi_le
statement:
lemma norm_star_apply_xi_le (S : StandardModularData H) {a : H →L[ℂ] H}
    (ha : a ∈ S.M) {I : Set ℝ} (hband : S.D.HasSpectralSupport I (a S.xi))
    {b : ℝ} (hb : ∀ u ∈ I, u ≤ b) :
    ‖star a S.xi‖ ≤ Real.exp (b / 2) * ‖a S.xi‖

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.norm_state_le
statement: lemma norm_state_le (S : StandardModularData H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) : ‖S.state a‖ ≤ ‖a‖

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.norm_state_real_star_mul
statement:
lemma norm_state_real_star_mul (S : StandardModularData H) (y : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    ‖y S.xi‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖y‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.pair_state_mem_closed_convex_orbit
statement:
lemma pair_state_mem_closed_convex_orbit (S : StandardModularData H)
    (hscalar : S.ScalarCentralizer) {a b : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : a ∈ S.M) (hb : b ∈ S.M) :
    WithLp.toLp 2 (S.state a • S.xi, S.state b • S.xi) ∈ closure (convexHull ℝ
      (Set.range (fun t => WithLp.toLp 2
        (S.D.unitary t (a S.xi), S.D.unitary t (b S.xi)))))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigmaLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma sigmaLinear_apply (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.sigmaLinear t a = S.sigma t a

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_add
statement:
lemma sigma_add (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) (a b : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.sigma t (a + b) = S.sigma t a + S.sigma t b

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_apply_xi
statement:
@[simp] lemma sigma_apply_xi (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.sigma t a S.xi = S.D.unitary t (a S.xi)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_mem
statement:
lemma sigma_mem (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) {a : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : a ∈ S.M) :
    S.sigma t a ∈ S.M

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_mul
statement:
lemma sigma_mul (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) (a b : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.sigma t (a * b) = S.sigma t a * S.sigma t b

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma sigma_one (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) :
    S.sigma t 1 = 1

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_real_smul
statement:
lemma sigma_real_smul (S : StandardModularData H) (t c : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.sigma t (c • a) = c • S.sigma t a

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_smul
statement:
lemma sigma_smul (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) (c : ℂ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.sigma t (c • a) = c • S.sigma t a

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_star
statement:
lemma sigma_star (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.sigma t (star a) = star (S.sigma t a)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_sum
statement:
lemma sigma_sum {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (a : ι → H →L[ℂ] H) : S.sigma t (∑ i, a i) = ∑ i, S.sigma t (a i)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_covariant_sandwich
statement:
lemma state_covariant_sandwich (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) (y a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.state (star (S.sigma t y) * a * S.sigma t y) =
      S.state (star y * S.sigma (-t) a * y)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_eq_vectorState
statement:
lemma state_eq_vectorState (S : StandardModularData H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.state a = vectorStateLM S.xi a

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_mem_closed_convex_orbit
statement:
lemma state_mem_closed_convex_orbit (S : StandardModularData H) (hscalar : S.ScalarCentralizer)
    {a : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : a ∈ S.M) :
    S.state a • S.xi ∈ closure (convexHull ℝ (Set.range (fun t => S.D.unitary t (a S.xi))))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_mul_star
statement:
lemma state_mul_star (S : StandardModularData H) (y : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.state (y * star y) = (‖star y S.xi‖ ^ 2 : ℝ)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_real_smul
statement:
lemma state_real_smul (S : StandardModularData H) (c : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.state (c • a) = c • S.state a

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_sandwich
statement:
lemma state_sandwich (S : StandardModularData H) (y a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.state (star y * a * y) = inner ℂ (y S.xi) (a (y S.xi))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_sigma
statement:
lemma state_sigma (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.state (S.sigma t a) = S.state a

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_sq_re
statement:
lemma state_sq_re (S : StandardModularData H) {a : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) :
    (S.state (a ^ 2)).re = ‖a S.xi‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_star_mul
statement:
lemma state_star_mul (S : StandardModularData H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.state (star a * a) = (‖a S.xi‖ ^ 2 : ℝ)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_star_mul_re
statement:
lemma state_star_mul_re (S : StandardModularData H) (y : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    (S.state (star y * y)).re = ‖y S.xi‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_sum
statement:
lemma state_sum {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] (S : StandardModularData H)
    (a : ι → H →L[ℂ] H) : S.state (∑ i, a i) = ∑ i, S.state (a i)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.convex_bounded_orbit
statement:
lemma convex_bounded_orbit (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (xi : H) (C : ℝ) :
    Convex ℝ {v : H | ∃ a : H →L[ℂ] H, a ∈ M ∧ ‖a‖ ≤ C ∧ a xi = v}

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.convex_minimizer_unique
statement:
lemma convex_minimizer_unique {K : Set E} (hK : Convex ℝ K) {v w : E}
    (hv : v ∈ K) (hw : w ∈ K)
    (hvm : ‖(0 : E) - v‖ = ⨅ a : K, ‖(0 : E) - a‖)
    (hwm : ‖(0 : E) - w‖ = ⨅ a : K, ‖(0 : E) - a‖) : v = w

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.exists_fixed_in_closed_convex_orbit
statement:
lemma exists_fixed_in_closed_convex_orbit
    (U : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (hadd : ∀ t r, U (t + r) = U t * U r)
    (hnorm : ∀ t v, ‖U t v‖ = ‖v‖) (x : E) :
    ∃ v ∈ closure (convexHull ℝ (Set.range (fun t => U t x))), ∀ t, U t v = v

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.map_mem_closed_convexHull
OAI.BoundedRecovery.re_vectorState_sq
statement:
lemma re_vectorState_sq (xi : H) {a : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) :
    (vectorStateLM xi (a ^ 2)).re = ‖a xi‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.re_vectorState_star_mul_nonneg
statement:
lemma re_vectorState_star_mul_nonneg (xi : H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    0 ≤ (vectorStateLM xi (star a * a)).re

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.small_on_separating_controls_vector
statement:
lemma small_on_separating_controls_vector (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (xi : H)
    (hsep : ∀ a : H →L[ℂ] H, a ∈ M → a xi = 0 → a = 0)
    (h : H) {C eps : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (heps : 0 < eps) :
    ∃ delta : ℝ, 0 < delta ∧ ∀ a : H →L[ℂ] H, a ∈ M → ‖a‖ ≤ C →
      ‖a xi‖ < delta → ‖a h‖ < eps

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.averageReverseSquare_eq
statement:
lemma averageReverseSquare_eq (S : StandardModularData H) (p t : ι → ℝ) (y : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    (∑ i, p i • (S.sigma (t i) y * star (S.sigma (t i) y))) =
      S.modularAverage p t (y * star y)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.averageSquare_eq
statement:
lemma averageSquare_eq (S : StandardModularData H) (p t : ι → ℝ) (y : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    (∑ i, p i • (star (S.sigma (t i) y) * S.sigma (t i) y)) =
      S.modularAverage p t (star y * y)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.isSelfAdjoint_averageSquare
statement:
lemma isSelfAdjoint_averageSquare (p : ι → ℝ) (z : ι → H →L[ℂ] H) :
    IsSelfAdjoint (∑ i, p i • (star (z i) * z i))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.modularAverage_apply_xi
statement:
lemma modularAverage_apply_xi (S : StandardModularData H) (p t : ι → ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.modularAverage p t a S.xi = ∑ i, p i • S.D.unitary (t i) (a S.xi)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.modularAverage_mem
statement:
lemma modularAverage_mem (S : StandardModularData H) (p t : ι → ℝ) {a : H →L[ℂ] H}
    (ha : a ∈ S.M) : S.modularAverage p t a ∈ S.M

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.modularAverage_sandwich
statement:
lemma modularAverage_sandwich (S : StandardModularData H) (p t : ι → ℝ) (y b : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    (∑ i, p i * (S.state (star (S.sigma (t i) y) * b * S.sigma (t i) y)).re) =
      (inner ℂ (y S.xi) (S.modularAverage p (fun i => -t i) b (y S.xi))).re

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.norm_modularAverage_apply_xi_sub_le
statement:
lemma norm_modularAverage_apply_xi_sub_le (S : StandardModularData H) (p t : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hsum : (∑ i, p i) = 1) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) (c : ℂ) :
    ‖S.modularAverage p t a S.xi - c • S.xi‖ ≤ ‖a S.xi - c • S.xi‖

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.norm_modularAverage_le
statement:
lemma norm_modularAverage_le (S : StandardModularData H) (p t : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hsum : (∑ i, p i) = 1) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    ‖S.modularAverage p t a‖ ≤ ‖a‖

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.re_inner_operator_le_of_small
statement:
lemma re_inner_operator_le_of_small (h : H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) (b : ℝ)
    (hsmall : ‖(a - b • (1 : H →L[ℂ] H)) h‖ < 1 / (‖h‖+1)) :
    (inner ℂ h (a h)).re < b * ‖h‖ ^ 2 + 1

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.real_smul_mem
statement:
lemma real_smul_mem (S : StandardModularData H) {a : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : a ∈ S.M) (r : ℝ) :
    r • a ∈ S.M

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.norm_sum_probability_smul_le
statement:
lemma norm_sum_probability_smul_le {E : Type uE} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (p : ι → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hsum : (∑ i, p i) = 1)
    (f : ι → E) {C : ℝ} (hf : ∀ i, ‖f i‖ ≤ C) : ‖∑ i, p i • f i‖ ≤ C

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.abs_mean_orbitDefect_sub_le
statement:
lemma abs_mean_orbitDefect_sub_le (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ)
    (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (h k : H) :
    |fixedMean omega (D.orbitDefect T h) - fixedMean omega (D.orbitDefect T k)| ≤
      ‖T‖ ^ 2 * (‖h‖+‖k‖) * ‖h-k‖

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.mean_orbitDefect_le
statement:
lemma mean_orbitDefect_le (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ)
    (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (h : H) :
    fixedMean omega (D.orbitDefect T h) ≤ ‖T‖ ^ 2 * ‖h‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.mean_orbitDefect_nonneg
statement:
lemma mean_orbitDefect_nonneg (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ)
    (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (h : H) : 0 ≤ fixedMean omega (D.orbitDefect T h)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.norm_orbitDefect_le
statement:
lemma norm_orbitDefect_le (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (h : H) :
    ‖D.orbitDefect T h‖ ≤ ‖T‖ ^ 2 * ‖h‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.norm_orbitDefect_sub_le
statement:
lemma norm_orbitDefect_sub_le (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (h k : H) :
    ‖D.orbitDefect T h - D.orbitDefect T k‖ ≤ ‖T‖ ^ 2 * (‖h‖+‖k‖) * ‖h-k‖

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.orbitDefect_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma orbitDefect_apply (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (h : H) (t : ℝ) :
    D.orbitDefect T h t = ‖T (D.unitary t h)‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.orbitDefect_unitary
statement:
lemma orbitDefect_unitary (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (r : ℝ) (h : H) :
    D.orbitDefect T (D.unitary r h) = translateBCF (D.orbitDefect T h) r

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.exists_finite_moment_average
statement:
lemma exists_finite_moment_average (S : StandardModularData H)
    (hscalar : S.ScalarCentralizer) {y : H →L[ℂ] H} (hy : y ∈ S.M) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (p t : Fin n → ℝ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) ∧ (∑ i, p i) = 1 ∧
      (S.state ((S.modularAverage p t (star y * y)) ^ 2)).re ≤
        (‖y S.xi‖ ^ 2 + 1) ^ 2 ∧
      (∑ i, p i * (S.state (star (S.sigma (t i) y) *
        S.modularAverage p t (y * star y) * S.sigma (t i) y)).re) ≤
        ‖y S.xi‖ ^ 2 * ‖star y S.xi‖ ^ 2 + 1

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.exists_lt_of_lt_fixedMean
statement:
lemma exists_lt_of_lt_fixedMean (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ) (hω : (omega : Filter ℕ) ≤ atTop)
    (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : c < fixedMean omega f) :
    ∃ t, c < f t

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.fixedMean_add
statement:
lemma fixedMean_add (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ) (f g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) :
    fixedMean omega (f+g) = fixedMean omega f + fixedMean omega g

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.fixedMean_const
statement:
lemma fixedMean_const (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ) (hω : (omega : Filter ℕ) ≤ atTop) (c : ℝ) :
    fixedMean omega (fun _ => c) = c

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.fixedMean_mono
statement:
lemma fixedMean_mono (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ) (f g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ)
    (hfg : ∀ t, f t ≤ g t) : fixedMean omega f ≤ fixedMean omega g

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.fixedMean_smul
statement:
lemma fixedMean_smul (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ) (c : ℝ) (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) :
    fixedMean omega (c • f) = c * fixedMean omega f

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.fixedMean_translate
statement:
lemma fixedMean_translate (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ) (hω : (omega : Filter ℕ) ≤ atTop)
    (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (r : ℝ) :
    fixedMean omega (translateBCF f r) = fixedMean omega f

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.meanCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma meanCLM_apply (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ) (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) :
    meanCLM omega f = fixedMean omega f

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.norm_fixedMean_le
statement:
lemma norm_fixedMean_le (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ) (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) :
    ‖fixedMean omega f‖ ≤ ‖f‖

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.norm_symmetricAverage_le
statement:
lemma norm_symmetricAverage_le (f : ℝ → ℝ) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hf : ∀ t, ‖f t‖ ≤ C) (k : ℕ) : ‖symmetricAverage f k‖ ≤ C

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.norm_symmetricAverage_translate_sub_le
statement:
lemma norm_symmetricAverage_translate_sub_le (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ)
    (r : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖symmetricAverage (translateBCF f r) k - symmetricAverage f k‖ ≤
      (2 * (k : ℝ))⁻¹ * (2 * ‖f‖ * |r|)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.symmetricAverage_add
statement:
lemma symmetricAverage_add (f g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    symmetricAverage (f+g) k = symmetricAverage f k + symmetricAverage g k

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.symmetricAverage_const
statement:
lemma symmetricAverage_const (c : ℝ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    symmetricAverage (fun _ => c) k = c

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.symmetricAverage_mono
statement:
lemma symmetricAverage_mono (f g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ)
    (hfg : ∀ t, f t ≤ g t) (k : ℕ) : symmetricAverage f k ≤ symmetricAverage g k

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.symmetricAverage_smul
statement:
lemma symmetricAverage_smul (c : ℝ) (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    symmetricAverage (c • f) k = c * symmetricAverage f k

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.tendsto_symmetricAverage_mean
statement:
lemma tendsto_symmetricAverage_mean (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ)
    (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) :
    Tendsto (symmetricAverage f) (omega : Filter ℕ) (𝓝 (fixedMean omega f))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.tendsto_symmetricAverage_translate_sub
statement:
lemma tendsto_symmetricAverage_translate_sub (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (r : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun k => symmetricAverage (translateBCF f r) k - symmetricAverage f k)
      atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.translateBCF_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma translateBCF_apply (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (r t : ℝ) :
    translateBCF f r t = f (t+r)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.average_sandwich_state_translate
statement:
lemma average_sandwich_state_translate (S : StandardModularData H) (p t : ι → ℝ)
    (r : ℝ) (y : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    (∑ i, p i * (S.state (star (S.sigma (r+t i) y) *
      S.modularAverage p (fun j => r+t j) (y*star y) * S.sigma (r+t i) y)).re) =
    (∑ i, p i * (S.state (star (S.sigma (t i) y) *
      S.modularAverage p t (y*star y) * S.sigma (t i) y)).re)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.average_square_state_translate
statement:
lemma average_square_state_translate (S : StandardModularData H) (p t : ι → ℝ)
    (r : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.state ((S.modularAverage p (fun i => r+t i) a)^2) =
      S.state ((S.modularAverage p t a)^2)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.exists_finite_defect_moment_average
statement:
lemma exists_finite_defect_moment_average (S : StandardModularData H)
    (hscalar : S.ScalarCentralizer) (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ)
    (hω : (omega : Filter ℕ) ≤ atTop) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) {y : H →L[ℂ] H}
    (hy : y ∈ S.M) {gamma : ℝ}
    (hg : gamma < fixedMean omega (S.D.orbitDefect T (y S.xi))) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (p t : Fin n → ℝ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) ∧ (∑ i, p i) = 1 ∧
      gamma ≤ ∑ i, p i * ‖T (S.sigma (t i) y S.xi)‖ ^ 2 ∧
      (S.state ((S.modularAverage p t (star y * y)) ^ 2)).re +
      (∑ i, p i * (S.state (star (S.sigma (t i) y) *
        S.modularAverage p t (y * star y) * S.sigma (t i) y)).re) ≤
        (‖y S.xi‖ ^ 2 + 1) ^ 2 + ‖y S.xi‖ ^ 2 * ‖star y S.xi‖ ^ 2 + 1

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.exists_translate_defect
statement:
lemma exists_translate_defect (S : StandardModularData H) (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ)
    (hω : (omega : Filter ℕ) ≤ atTop) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (y : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (p t : ι → ℝ) (hsum : (∑ i, p i) = 1) {gamma : ℝ}
    (hg : gamma < fixedMean omega (S.D.orbitDefect T (y S.xi))) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, gamma < ∑ i, p i * ‖T (S.sigma (r+t i) y S.xi)‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.modularAverage_add_time
statement:
lemma modularAverage_add_time (S : StandardModularData H) (p t : ι → ℝ)
    (r : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.modularAverage p (fun i => r + t i) a = S.sigma r (S.modularAverage p t a)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.phaseMean_defect
statement:
lemma phaseMean_defect (S : StandardModularData H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (n : ℕ) (p : Fin n → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (z : Fin n → H →L[ℂ] H) :
    phaseMean n (fun e => ‖T (phaseSum (fun i => Real.sqrt (p i) • z i) e S.xi)‖ ^ 2) =
      ∑ i, p i * ‖T (z i S.xi)‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.phaseMean_fourth_le
statement:
lemma phaseMean_fourth_le (S : StandardModularData H)
    (n : ℕ) (p : Fin n → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (z : Fin n → H →L[ℂ] H) :
    phaseMean n (fun e => (S.state ((star (phaseSum (fun i => Real.sqrt (p i) • z i) e) *
      phaseSum (fun i => Real.sqrt (p i) • z i) e) ^ 2)).re) ≤
      (S.state ((∑ i, p i • (star (z i) * z i)) ^ 2)).re +
      ∑ i, p i * (S.state (star (z i) * (∑ j, p j • (z j * star (z j))) * z i)).re

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.real_sqrt_reverse_square
statement:
lemma real_sqrt_reverse_square {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (z : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    (Real.sqrt p • z) * star (Real.sqrt p • z) = p • (z * star z)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.real_sqrt_sandwich
statement:
lemma real_sqrt_sandwich {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (z b : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    star (Real.sqrt p • z) * b * (Real.sqrt p • z) = p • (star z * b * z)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.real_sqrt_square
statement:
lemma real_sqrt_square {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (z : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    star (Real.sqrt p • z) * (Real.sqrt p • z) = p • (star z * z)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_T_square
statement:
lemma state_T_square (S : StandardModularData H) (T z : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    (S.state (star z * (star T * T) * z)).re = ‖T (z S.xi)‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.exists_phaseMean_le
statement:
lemma exists_phaseMean_le (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → Fin 4) → ℝ) :
    ∃ e, phaseMean n f ≤ f e

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_add
statement:
lemma phaseExpectation_add (n : ℕ) (f g : (Fin n → Fin 4) → A) :
    phaseExpectation n (fun e => f e + g e) = phaseExpectation n f + phaseExpectation n g

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_const
statement: lemma phaseExpectation_const (n : ℕ) (a : A) : phaseExpectation n (fun _ => a) = a

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_fourth
statement:
lemma phaseExpectation_fourth (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → A) :
    phaseExpectation n (fun e => (star (phaseSum a e) * phaseSum a e) ^ 2) =
      (∑ i, star (a i) * a i) ^ 2 +
        (∑ i, star (a i) * (∑ j, a j * star (a j)) * a i) -
        ∑ i, (star (a i) * a i) ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_map
statement:
lemma phaseExpectation_map {B : Type uB} [AddCommMonoid B] [Module ℂ B]
    (L : A →ₗ[ℂ] B) (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → Fin 4) → A) :
    phaseExpectation n (fun e => L (f e)) = L (phaseExpectation n f)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_mul_left
statement:
lemma phaseExpectation_mul_left (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → Fin 4) → A) (a : A) :
    phaseExpectation n (fun e => a * f e) = a * phaseExpectation n f

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_mul_right
statement:
lemma phaseExpectation_mul_right (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → Fin 4) → A) (a : A) :
    phaseExpectation n (fun e => f e * a) = phaseExpectation n f * a

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_quadratic
statement:
lemma phaseExpectation_quadratic (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → A) (b : A) :
    phaseExpectation n (fun e => star (phaseSum a e) * b * phaseSum a e) =
      ∑ i, star (a i) * b * a i

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_reverse_quadratic
statement:
lemma phaseExpectation_reverse_quadratic (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → A) (b : A) :
    phaseExpectation n (fun e => phaseSum a e * b * star (phaseSum a e)) =
      ∑ i, a i * b * star (a i)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_reverse_square
statement:
lemma phaseExpectation_reverse_square (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → A) :
    phaseExpectation n (fun e => phaseSum a e * star (phaseSum a e)) =
      ∑ i, a i * star (a i)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_smul
statement:
lemma phaseExpectation_smul (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → Fin 4) → A) (c : ℂ) :
    phaseExpectation n (fun e => c • f e) = c • phaseExpectation n f

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_square
statement:
lemma phaseExpectation_square (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → A) :
    phaseExpectation n (fun e => star (phaseSum a e) * phaseSum a e) =
      ∑ i, star (a i) * a i

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_sub
statement:
lemma phaseExpectation_sub (n : ℕ) (f g : (Fin n → Fin 4) → A) :
    phaseExpectation n (fun e => f e - g e) = phaseExpectation n f - phaseExpectation n g

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseMean_add
statement:
lemma phaseMean_add (n : ℕ) (f g : (Fin n → Fin 4) → ℝ) :
    phaseMean n (fun e => f e + g e) = phaseMean n f + phaseMean n g

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseMean_const
statement: lemma phaseMean_const (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) : phaseMean n (fun _ => c) = c

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseMean_mono
statement:
lemma phaseMean_mono (n : ℕ) {f g : (Fin n → Fin 4) → ℝ} (h : ∀ e, f e ≤ g e) :
    phaseMean n f ≤ phaseMean n g

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseMean_mul
statement:
lemma phaseMean_mul (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (f : (Fin n → Fin 4) → ℝ) :
    phaseMean n (fun e => c * f e) = c * phaseMean n f

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseMean_nonneg
statement:
lemma phaseMean_nonneg (n : ℕ) {f : (Fin n → Fin 4) → ℝ} (hf : ∀ e, 0 ≤ f e) :
    0 ≤ phaseMean n f

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseMean_re
statement:
lemma phaseMean_re (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → Fin 4) → ℂ) :
    phaseMean n (fun e => (f e).re) = (phaseExpectation n f).re

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseSum_succ
statement:
lemma phaseSum_succ {n : ℕ} (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) (i : Fin 4) (e : Fin n → Fin 4) :
    phaseSum a (Fin.cons i e) = phaseSum (fun j => a j.succ) e + phase i • a 0

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phase_fourth_step
statement:
lemma phase_fourth_step (x y : A) :
    phaseAverage (fun i => (star (x + phase i • y) * (x + phase i • y)) ^ 2) =
      (star x * x) ^ 2 + (star y * y) ^ 2 +
        star x * x * (star y * y) + star y * y * (star x * x) +
        star x * (y * star y) * x + star y * (x * star x) * y

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phase_quadratic_step
statement:
lemma phase_quadratic_step (x y b : A) :
    phaseAverage (fun i => star (x + phase i • y) * b * (x + phase i • y)) =
      star x * b * x + star y * b * y

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phase_reverse_quadratic_step
statement:
lemma phase_reverse_quadratic_step (x y b : A) :
    phaseAverage (fun i => (x + phase i • y) * b * star (x + phase i • y)) =
      x * b * star x + y * b * star y

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.calculus_apply_eq_integral
statement:
lemma calculus_apply_eq_integral (D : RealSpectralCalculus H)
    (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℂ) (k : ℝ → ℂ) (hk : Integrable k)
    (hfk : ∀ u, f u = ∫ t, k t * spectralCharacter t u) (h : H) :
    D.calculus f h = ∫ t, k t • D.unitary t h

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.calculus_eq_integratedUnitary
statement:
lemma calculus_eq_integratedUnitary (D : RealSpectralCalculus H)
    (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℂ) (k : ℝ → ℂ) (hk : Integrable k)
    (hfk : ∀ u, f u = ∫ t, k t * spectralCharacter t u) :
    D.calculus f = D.integratedUnitary k hk

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.integral_character_mul
statement:
lemma integral_character_mul (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℂ)
    (k : ℝ → ℂ) (hk : Integrable k)
    (hfk : ∀ u, f u = ∫ t, k t * spectralCharacter t u)

OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.bounded_recovery_finite_step
statement:
lemma bounded_recovery_finite_step (S : StandardModularData H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H)
    {s d gamma Q K : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) (hg : 0 < gamma) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hcut : ‖T‖ ^ 2 * (K ^ 2)⁻¹ * Q ≤ gamma / 4)
    {y : H →L[ℂ] H} (hy : y ∈ S.M)
    (hband : S.D.HasSpectralSupport (Icc (s-d) (s+d)) (y S.xi))
    (n : ℕ) (p t : Fin n → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i)
    (hdef : gamma ≤ ∑ i, p i * ‖T (S.sigma (t i) y S.xi)‖ ^ 2)
    (hmom : (S.state ((S.modularAverage p t (star y * y)) ^ 2)).re +
      (∑ i, p i * (S.state (star (S.sigma (t i) y) *
        S.modularAverage p t (y * star y) * S.sigma (t i) y)).re) ≤ Q) :
    ∃ v : H →L[ℂ] H, v ∈ S.M ∧ ‖v‖ ≤ filterL1 * K ∧
      Real.sqrt gamma / 2 ≤ ‖T (v S.xi)‖ ∧
      S.D.HasSpectralSupport (Icc (s-2*d) (s+2*d)) (v S.xi)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.bounded_recovery_single
statement:
lemma bounded_recovery_single (S : StandardModularData H) (hscalar : S.ScalarCentralizer)
    (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ) (hω : (omega : Filter ℕ) ≤ atTop) (T : H →L[ℂ] H)
    {s rho gamma K : ℝ} (hrho : 0 < rho) (hwidth : 2*rho ≤ 1)
    (hg : 0 < gamma) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hcut : ‖T‖^2 * (K^2)⁻¹ * recoveryMomentBound s ≤ gamma/4)
    {h : H} (hn : ‖h‖ = 1) (hband : S.D.HasSpectralSupport (Icc (s-rho) (s+rho)) h)
    (hdef : 4*gamma ≤ fixedMean omega (S.D.orbitDefect T h)) :
    ∃ v : H →L[ℂ] H, v ∈ S.M ∧ ‖v‖ ≤ filterL1*K ∧ Real.sqrt gamma/2 ≤ ‖T (v S.xi)‖ ∧
      S.D.HasSpectralSupport (Icc (s-4*rho) (s+4*rho)) (v S.xi)

    (hrho : 0 < rho) (hg : 0 < gamma) {h : H} (hn : ‖h‖ = 1)
    (hband : S.D.HasSpectralSupport (Icc (s-rho) (s+rho)) h)
    (hdef : 4*gamma ≤ fixedMean omega (S.D.orbitDefect T h)) :
    ∃ y : H →L[ℂ] H, y ∈ S.M ∧ ‖y S.xi‖ ≤ 2 ∧
      S.D.HasSpectralSupport (Icc (s-2*rho) (s+2*rho)) (y S.xi) ∧
      gamma < fixedMean omega (S.D.orbitDefect T (y S.xi))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.moment_bound_of_narrow_band
statement:
lemma moment_bound_of_narrow_band (S : StandardModularData H) {s rho : ℝ}
    (hwidth : 2*rho ≤ 1) {y : H →L[ℂ] H} (hy : y ∈ S.M) (hn : ‖y S.xi‖ ≤ 2)
    (hband : S.D.HasSpectralSupport (Icc (s-2*rho) (s+2*rho)) (y S.xi)) :
    (‖y S.xi‖^2+1)^2 + ‖y S.xi‖^2 * ‖star y S.xi‖^2 + 1 ≤ recoveryMomentBound s

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.bounded_recovery
statement:
theorem bounded_recovery (S : StandardModularData H) (hscalar : S.ScalarCentralizer)
    (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ) (hfree : (omega : Filter ℕ) ≤ Filter.atTop)
    (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (s : ℝ) (delta : ℕ → ℝ) (hdelta : ∀ n, 0 < delta n)
    (hdelta0 : Tendsto delta atTop (𝓝 0)) (h : ℕ → H) (hunit : ∀ n, ‖h n‖ = 1)
    (hband : ∀ n, S.D.HasSpectralSupport (Icc (s - delta n) (s + delta n)) (h n))
    (hpositive : 0 < Filter.limsup
      (fun n => fixedMean omega (fun t => ‖T (S.D.unitary t (h n))‖ ^ 2)) atTop) :
    RecoveryConclusion S T s delta

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.injOn_locally_uniform_limit

    (hF : ∀ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F n) U) (hi : ∀ n, InjOn (F n) U)
    (hl : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn F f atTop U)
    {a : ℂ} (ha : a ∈ U) (hda : deriv f a ≠ 0) : InjOn f U

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.noncritical_holomorphic_inverse
statement:
theorem noncritical_holomorphic_inverse {U : Set ℂ} {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f U) (hinj : InjOn f U)
    (hd : ∀ z ∈ U, deriv f z ≠ 0) :
    IsOpen (f '' U) ∧ ∃ g : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g (f '' U) ∧
      MapsTo g (f '' U) U ∧ (∀ z ∈ U, g (f z) = z) ∧
      (∀ w ∈ f '' U, f (g w) = w)

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.zero_free_locally_uniform_limit

    (hn : ∀ n z, z ∈ U → F n z ≠ 0)
    (hl : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn F f atTop U)

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.analytic_local_inverse_neighborhood

      ∃ ψ : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticOnNhd ℂ ψ (F '' V) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ V, ψ (F z) = z) ∧ (∀ w ∈ F '' V, F (ψ w) = w)

lemma analytic_chart_rescale_avoid {U : Set ℂ} {χ : ℂ → ℂ} {a : ℂ}
    (ha : AnalyticAt ℂ χ 0) (hd : deriv χ 0 ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ᶠ z : ℂ in 𝓝 0, χ z ∈ U ↔ 0 < z.im)
    (hb : ∀ᶠ z : ℂ in 𝓝 0, z.im = 0 → χ z ∈ frontier U)
    (hav : ∀ᶠ z : ℂ in 𝓝 0, χ z ≠ a) :
    ∃ ψ : ℂ → ℂ, ψ 0 = χ 0 ∧ AnalyticOnNhd ℂ ψ (ball 0 2) ∧
      InjOn ψ (ball 0 2) ∧ (∀ z ∈ ball 0 2, deriv ψ z ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ ball 0 2, ψ z ∈ U ↔ 0 < z.im) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ ball 0 2, z.im = 0 → ψ z ∈ frontier U) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ ball 0 2, ψ z ≠ a)

theorem exists_convex_barrier {K U : Set ℂ} (hK : IsCompact K) (hne : K.Nonempty)

    ∃ (N : ℕ) (l : Fin N → ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (a : Fin N → ℝ),
      (∀ i z, z ∈ K → l i z < a i) ∧

statement:
theorem exteriorCorrection_eq {G : ℂ → ℂ} {w t : ℂ}
    (htw : t ≠ w) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℂ G t) (hne : G t ≠ G w) :
    exteriorCorrection G w t =

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.exteriorCorrection_eq_left

lemma exteriorCorrection_eq_left {G : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ}

    exteriorCorrection G w t =
      -t * dslope (fun z => deriv G t / dslope G t z) t w

      exteriorDividedDifference a h x y

lemma actualExteriorKernel_circleB {a b : ℂ} {h : ℂ → ℂ} {R : ℝ}

    (hi : InjOn (exteriorMap a b h) {t | R⁻¹ < ‖t‖})
    (hd : ∀ t, R⁻¹ < ‖t‖ → deriv (exteriorMap a b h) t ≠ 0)
    (hsupport : ∀ w t : Circle,
      0 ≤ (conj ((t : ℂ)*deriv (exteriorMap a b h) t)*
        (exteriorMap a b h t-exteriorMap a b h w)).re)

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.circle_convex_cauchy
statement:
theorem circle_convex_cauchy {U : Set ℂ} (hU : Convex ℝ U)
    {F G : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F U)
    (hG : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ G (sphere 0 1))
    (hcurve : MapsTo G (sphere 0 1) U) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ U)
    (hne : ∀ t ∈ sphere (0:ℂ) 1, G t ≠ z)
    (hmass : (∫ t : UnitAddCircle,
      (t.toCircle : ℂ)*deriv G (t.toCircle : ℂ) / (G (t.toCircle : ℂ)-z)
        ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) = 1) :
    (∫ t : UnitAddCircle,
      ((t.toCircle : ℂ)*deriv G (t.toCircle : ℂ) / (G (t.toCircle : ℂ)-z)) *
        F (G (t.toCircle : ℂ)) ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) = F z

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.convex_closed_curve_cauchy
statement:
theorem convex_closed_curve_cauchy {U : Set ℂ} (hU : Convex ℝ U)
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F U)
    {γ γ' : ℝ → ℂ} (hγ : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt γ (γ' t) t)
    (hγ' : ContinuousOn γ' (Icc 0 1)) (hend : γ 1 = γ 0)
    (hcurve : MapsTo γ (Icc 0 1) U) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ U)
    (hne : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, γ t ≠ z) :
    (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, γ' t / (γ t-z) * F (γ t)) =
      (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, γ' t / (γ t-z)) * F z

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.convex_closed_curve_remainder
statement:
theorem convex_closed_curve_remainder {U : Set ℂ} (hU : Convex ℝ U)

    (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, γ' t / (γ t-z) * (F (γ t)-F z)) = 0

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.exterior_cauchy_kernel_integral

theorem exterior_cauchy_kernel_integral {a b : ℂ} {h : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ}

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.physicalCauchy_extension
statement:
theorem physicalCauchy_extension {G : ℂ → ℂ} {U Ω : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ G U) (hi : InjOn G U)
    (hd : ∀ w ∈ U, deriv G w ≠ 0) (hTU : sphere 0 1 ⊆ U)
    (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hboundary : frontier Ω ⊆ G '' sphere 0 1)
    (houtside : ∀ t ∈ U, G t ∈ Ω → t ∈ ball 0 1)
    (hdis : ∀ t ∈ sphere (0:ℂ) 1, G t ∉ Ω)
    {u : UnitAddCircle → ℂ} (hu : Continuous u) {q : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hq : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ q U)
    (he : ∀ w ∈ U ∩ ball 0 1, physicalCauchy G u (G w) =
      q w + cauchyCorrectionIntegral G u w) :
    ∃ v : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticOnNhd ℂ v (closure Ω) ∧
      EqOn v (physicalCauchy G u) Ω ∧
      ∀ t ∈ sphere (0:ℂ) 1, v (G t) = q t + cauchyCorrectionIntegral G u t

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.physicalCauchy_fourier_extension
statement:
theorem physicalCauchy_fourier_extension {G : ℂ → ℂ} {U Ω : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ G U) (hi : InjOn G U)
    (hd : ∀ w ∈ U, deriv G w ≠ 0) (hTU : sphere 0 1 ⊆ U)
    (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hboundary : frontier Ω ⊆ G '' sphere 0 1)
    (houtside : ∀ t ∈ U, G t ∈ Ω → t ∈ ball 0 1)
    (hdis : ∀ t ∈ sphere (0:ℂ) 1, G t ∉ Ω) (n : ℤ) :
    ∃ v : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticOnNhd ℂ v (closure Ω) ∧
      EqOn v (physicalCauchy G (fourier n)) Ω ∧
      ∀ t : UnitAddCircle, v (G t.toCircle) =
        (if 0 ≤ n then fourier n t else 0) +
          cauchyCorrectionIntegral G (fourier n) t.toCircle

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.FourierResolution.adjoint_module_apply
statement:
lemma adjoint_module_apply (M L : E →L[ℂ] E)
    (hswap : M.comp (D.proj 1) = (D.proj 2).comp M)
    (hmod : (D.cauchy M).comp (L.comp (D.cauchy M)) = L.comp (D.cauchy M))
    (r : E) :
    D.cauchyAdjoint M (L.adjoint (D.cauchyAdjoint M r)) =
      D.cauchyAdjoint M (L.adjoint r)

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.FourierResolution.density_comparison_core
statement:
theorem density_comparison_core (M L R : E →L[ℂ] E)
    (hM : ‖M‖ ≤ 1) (hL : ‖L‖ ≤ 1) (hR : ‖R‖ ≤ 1)
    (hswap : M.comp (D.proj 1) = (D.proj 2).comp M)
    (hmodL : (D.cauchy M).comp (L.comp (D.cauchy M)) = L.comp (D.cauchy M))
    (hmodR : (D.cauchy M).comp (R.comp (D.cauchy M)) = R.comp (D.cauchy M))
    (p q r : E) (hp : p = L.adjoint r) (hq : q = R.adjoint r)
    (hpJ : J p = p) (hqJ : J q = q) (hr : D.proj 0 r = 0)
    (hp0 : D.proj 0 p ≠ 0) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hblock : 2 * ‖(κ : ℂ) • D.cauchyAdjoint M r +
        ((κ⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) • J (D.cauchyAdjoint M (J r))‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖D.cauchyAdjoint M p + J (D.cauchyAdjoint M p)‖ ^ 2 +
      ‖D.cauchyAdjoint M q + J (D.cauchyAdjoint M q)‖ ^ 2) : κ ≤ 2

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.FourierResolution.hermitian_diagonal_bound
statement:
lemma hermitian_diagonal_bound (M L : E →L[ℂ] E)
    (hM : ‖M‖ ≤ 1) (hL : ‖L‖ ≤ 1)
    (hswap : M.comp (D.proj 1) = (D.proj 2).comp M)
    (hmod : (D.cauchy M).comp (L.comp (D.cauchy M)) = L.comp (D.cauchy M))
    (p r : E) (hp : p = L.adjoint r) (hpJ : J p = p) :
    ‖D.cauchyAdjoint M p + J (D.cauchyAdjoint M p)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      4 * ‖D.cauchyAdjoint M r‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.FourierResolution.hermitian_fourier_norm
statement:
lemma hermitian_fourier_norm (v : E) (hv : D.proj 2 v = 0)
    (hv0 : J (D.proj 0 v) = D.proj 0 v) :
    ‖v + J v‖ ^ 2 = 2 * (‖v‖ ^ 2 + ‖D.proj 0 v‖ ^ 2)
