name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.aeval_primary_restrict
statement:
lemma aeval_primary_restrict
    {V : Type u_63} [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module ℂ V] [FiniteDimensional ℂ V]
    (T : Module.End ℂ V) (β : ℂ) (p : ℂ[X])
    (x : T.maxGenEigenspace β) :
    ((Polynomial.aeval (primaryNilpotent T β +
      algebraMap ℂ (Module.End ℂ (T.maxGenEigenspace β)) β) p) x : V) =
      (Polynomial.aeval T p) (x : V)

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.analytic_first_order_remainder
statement:
lemma analytic_first_order_remainder {f : ℂ → ℂ} {β : ℂ}
    (hf : AnalyticAt ℂ f β) :
    ∃ R : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ R β ∧ ∀ᶠ z in nhds β,
      f z - f β = (z-β)*R z

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.analytic_taylor_remainder
statement:
lemma analytic_taylor_remainder {f : ℂ → ℂ} {β : ℂ}
    (hf : AnalyticAt ℂ f β) (s : ℕ) :
    ∃ R : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ R β ∧ ∀ᶠ z in nhds β,
      f z = (jetPolynomial β s f).eval z + (z-β)^s * R z

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.iteratedDeriv_polynomial
statement:
lemma iteratedDeriv_polynomial (p : ℂ[X]) (k : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (fun z => p.eval z) = fun z => ((Polynomial.derivative^[k]) p).eval z

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.jetPolynomial_eval
statement:
lemma jetPolynomial_eval (β z : ℂ) (s : ℕ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) :
    (jetPolynomial β s f).eval z =
      ∑ i ∈ range s, ((z-β)^i / (i.factorial : ℂ)) * iteratedDeriv i f β

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.matrix_nilpotent_resolvent
statement:
lemma matrix_nilpotent_resolvent {n : Type u_62} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {N : Matrix n n ℂ} {s : ℕ} (hs : N ^ s = 0) {z β : ℂ} (hz : z ≠ β) :
    (z • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - (β • 1 + N))⁻¹ =
      ∑ i ∈ range s, ((z-β)⁻¹ ^ (i+1)) • N ^ i

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.nilpotent_resolvent_product
statement:
lemma nilpotent_resolvent_product {N : A} {s : ℕ} (hs : N ^ s = 0)
    {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (∑ i ∈ range s, (c⁻¹ ^ (i+1)) • N ^ i) * (algebraMap ℂ A c - N) = 1

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.primaryEquiv_coe
statement:
lemma primaryEquiv_coe (T : Module.End ℂ V) (β : ℂ) (x : T.maxGenEigenspace β) :

statement:
lemma primaryEquiv_symm_lof (T : Module.End ℂ V) (β : ℂ) (x : T.maxGenEigenspace β) :

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.primaryEval_coe
statement:
lemma primaryEval_coe (T : Module.End ℂ V) (f : ℂ → ℂ)
    (β : ℂ) (x : T.maxGenEigenspace β) :
    primaryEval T f (x : V) =

        T.maxGenEigenspace β) : V)

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.primaryEval_comp
statement:
lemma primaryEval_comp (T : Module.End ℂ V) {f g : ℂ → ℂ}

    (hg : ∀ β ∈ spectrum ℂ T, AnalyticAt ℂ g (f β)) :
    primaryEval T (fun z => g (f z)) = primaryEval (primaryEval T f) g

statement:
lemma primaryEval_const (T : Module.End ℂ V) (c : ℂ) :

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.primaryEval_eventuallyEq
OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.primaryEval_id
statement: lemma primaryEval_id (T : Module.End ℂ V) : primaryEval T id = T

statement:
lemma primaryEval_intertwine (S T L : Module.End ℂ V)

statement:
lemma primaryEval_mapsTo_generalized (T : Module.End ℂ V) {f : ℂ → ℂ}

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.primaryEval_mul
statement:
lemma primaryEval_mul (T : Module.End ℂ V) {f g : ℂ → ℂ}

    (hg : ∀ β ∈ spectrum ℂ T, AnalyticAt ℂ g β) :

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.primaryEval_on_generalized
statement:
lemma primaryEval_on_generalized (T : Module.End ℂ V) (f : ℂ → ℂ)
    (β : ℂ) (x : T.maxGenEigenspace β) :

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.primaryEval_spectrum_subset
OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.primaryEval_sub
statement:
lemma primaryEval_sub (T : Module.End ℂ V) {f g : ℂ → ℂ}

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.scalarJetEval_comp

lemma scalarJetEval_comp {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {β : ℂ}

lemma scalarJetEval_const {N : A} {s : ℕ} (hs : N^s = 0) (β c : ℂ) :

    (N : A) (s : ℕ)

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.scalarJetEval_eventuallyEq
OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.scalarJetEval_intertwine
statement:
lemma scalarJetEval_intertwine
    {V : Type u_63} [AddCommGroup V] [_root_.Module ℂ V] [FiniteDimensional ℂ V]

    (hH : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ H (closedBall 0 1))
    (hmass : ∀ z ∈ ball (0:ℂ) 1,
      (∫ t : UnitAddCircle, (t.toCircle : ℂ)*deriv ψ (t.toCircle : ℂ) /
        (ψ (t.toCircle : ℂ)-z) ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) = 1)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ ball (0:ℂ) 1) :
    (∫ t : UnitAddCircle, ((t.toCircle : ℂ)*deriv ψ (t.toCircle : ℂ) /

    {H X₀ Y₀ : Matrix n n ℂ} {τ : ℝ}
    (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hX : 0 ≤ X₀) (hY : 0 ≤ Y₀) (hτ : 1 < τ)
    (hSX : H*X₀ = τ • X₀) (hSY : H*Y₀ = Y₀)
    (htrX : (Matrix.trace X₀).re = 1) (htrY : (Matrix.trace Y₀).re = τ) :
    ∃ X Y : Matrix n n ℂ,

      (Matrix.trace (X*Xᴴ)).re = 1 ∧ (Matrix.trace (Y*Yᴴ)).re = 1 ∧

    (hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f V) (hfi : InjOn f V)
    (hG : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ G (sphere 0 1))
    (hcurve : MapsTo G (sphere 0 1) K) {a : ℂ} (ha : a ∈ K)
    (hfa : deriv f a ≠ 0)
    (hne : ∀ t ∈ sphere (0:ℂ) 1, G t ≠ a)
    (hmass : (∫ t : UnitAddCircle,
      (t.toCircle : ℂ)*deriv G (t.toCircle : ℂ) / (G (t.toCircle : ℂ)-a)
        ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) = 1) :
    (∫ t : UnitAddCircle,
      (t.toCircle : ℂ)*deriv (f ∘ G) (t.toCircle : ℂ) /
        (f (G (t.toCircle : ℂ))-f a) ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) = 1

lemma sampleSelector_head {d : Edge} (hd : d.val ∈ T.vertices) :
    T.sampleSelector e d = none

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.FiniteHead.stitched_head
statement:
lemma stitched_head (z : ((ι → Sample) × Sample) × Sample) (v : Vertex) (hv : v ∈ T.vertices) :
    pathProduct v (T.stitched e z) = pathProduct v z.2

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.FiniteHead.stitched_path
statement:
lemma stitched_path (z : ((ι → Sample) × Sample) × Sample) (v : Vertex) (i : ι)
    (hi : (e i).val.val <+: v) :
    pathProduct v (T.stitched e z) = pathProduct (e i).val.val.dropLast z.2 * z.1.2 (e i).val *
      ∏ d ∈ pathEdges v \ pathEdges (e i).val.val, z.1.1 i d

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.measurePreserving_expandSamples
statement:
lemma measurePreserving_expandSamples (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] :
    MeasurePreserving (expandSamples (ι := ι))
      (((Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => productMeasure μ)).prod (productMeasure μ)).prod (productMeasure μ))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Option (Option ι) => productMeasure μ))

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.pathProduct_split
statement:
lemma pathProduct_split (v : Vertex) (e : Edge) (he : e.val <+: v) (ω : Sample) :
    pathProduct v ω = pathProduct e.val.dropLast ω * ω e *
      ∏ d ∈ pathEdges v \ pathEdges e.val, ω d

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.FiniteHead.measurable_tailCoefficient
statement:
lemma measurable_tailCoefficient {ι : Type uι} {κ : Type uκ}
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι]
    (T : FiniteHead) (e : ι → T.Boundary) (v : κ → Vertex) (j : κ → ι) (a : κ → ℝ) (i : ι) :
    Measurable (fun z : Sample × Sample => T.tailCoefficient e v j a z.1 i z.2)

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.FiniteHead.sum_tailCoefficient
statement:
lemma sum_tailCoefficient (z : ((ι → Sample) × Sample) × Sample)
    (he : Function.Injective e) (hv : ∀ k, (e (j k)).val.val <+: v k) :
    ∑ k, a k * pathProduct (v k) (T.stitched e z) =
      ∑ i, T.tailCoefficient e v j a z.2 i (z.1.1 i) * z.1.2 (e i).val

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.integrable_rep
statement:
lemma integrable_rep (x : productSpan μ) (f : Sample → ℝ)

statement: lemma measurable_residualProduct (v : Vertex) (e : Edge) : Measurable (residualProduct v e)

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.norm_eq_integral_abs_rep
statement:
lemma norm_eq_integral_abs_rep [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (x : productSpan μ) (f : Sample → ℝ)
    (hf : x.val =ᵐ[productMeasure μ] f) : ‖x‖ = ∫ ω, |f ω| ∂productMeasure μ

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.representative_sub
statement:
lemma representative_sub [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (x y : productSpan μ) (f g : Sample → ℝ)
    (hf : x.val =ᵐ[productMeasure μ] f) (hg : y.val =ᵐ[productMeasure μ] g) :
    ((x - y).val : Sample → ℝ) =ᵐ[productMeasure μ] fun ω => f ω - g ω

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.representative_sum
statement:
lemma representative_sum [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι]
    (x : ι → productSpan μ)
    (f : ι → Sample → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, (x i).val =ᵐ[productMeasure μ] f i) (a : ι → ℝ) :
    ((∑ i, a i • x i).val : Sample → ℝ) =ᵐ[productMeasure μ] fun ω => ∑ i, a i * f i ω

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.FiniteHead.ancestor_of_boundary_prefix
statement:
lemma ancestor_of_boundary_prefix (T : FiniteHead) (v : Vertex) (e : T.Boundary)
    (he : e.val.val <+: v) : T.ancestor v = e.val.val.dropLast

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.FiniteHead.stitched_head_polynomial
statement:
lemma stitched_head_polynomial {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (T : FiniteHead) (e : ι → T.Boundary) (a : T.vertices → ℝ)
    (z : ((ι → Sample) × Sample) × Sample) :
    (∑ v : T.vertices, a v * pathProduct v (T.stitched e z)) =
      ∑ v : T.vertices, a v * pathProduct v z.2

statement:
lemma integrable_exponentialLaw_iff {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

statement:
lemma integral_complex_exp_exponentialLaw (z : ℂ) (hz : z.re < 1) :

lemma integral_exponentialLaw {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

    (∫ x, f x ∂exponentialLaw) = ∫ x in Ioi 0, Real.exp (-x) • f x

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.exponential_difference_charFun
statement:
lemma exponential_difference_charFun (a : ι → ℝ) (q : ℝ) :
    charFun ((exponentialVector.prod exponentialVector).map (exponentialDifference a)) q =
      ∏ i, 1 / (1 + ((q * a i : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2)

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.exponential_difference_mixture
statement:
lemma exponential_difference_mixture (a : ι → ℝ) :
    (exponentialVector.prod exponentialVector).map (exponentialDifference a) =
      (exponentialVector.prod (gaussianReal 0 1)).map (exponentialMixture a)

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.exponential_eval_hasLaw
statement:
lemma exponential_eval_hasLaw (i : ι) :
    HasLaw (fun x : ι → ℝ => x i) exponentialLaw exponentialVector

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.exponential_mixture_charFun
statement:
lemma exponential_mixture_charFun (a : ι → ℝ) (q : ℝ) :
    charFun ((exponentialVector.prod (gaussianReal 0 1)).map (exponentialMixture a)) q =
      ∏ i, 1 / (1 + ((q * a i : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2)

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.exponential_vector_characteristic
statement:
lemma exponential_vector_characteristic (a : ι → ℝ) (q : ℝ) :
    (∫ x : ι → ℝ, Complex.exp ((q : ℂ) * (∑ i, a i * x i) * Complex.I) ∂exponentialVector) =
      ∏ i, 1 / (1 - (q * a i : ℝ) * Complex.I)

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.exponential_vector_complexMGF
statement:
lemma exponential_vector_complexMGF (z : ι → ℂ) (hz : ∀ i, (z i).re < 1) :
    (∫ x : ι → ℝ, Complex.exp (∑ i, z i * x i) ∂exponentialVector) =
      ∏ i, 1 / (1 - z i)

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.gaussian_scaled_characteristic
statement:
lemma gaussian_scaled_characteristic (v q : ℝ) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    (∫ g : ℝ, Complex.exp ((q : ℂ) * ((Real.sqrt v * g : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∂gaussianReal 0 1) =
      Complex.exp (-((v * q ^ 2 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))

statement:
lemma excess_scaled_lower (K s v x : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hsv : s ≤ v) :

statement:

statement: lemma exponential_eval_memLp (i : ι) : MemLp (fun u : ι → ℝ => u i) 2 exponentialVector

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.exponential_mixture_excess
statement:
lemma exponential_mixture_excess (a : ι → ℝ) (K : ℝ) :
    (1 / 8 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (∑ i, a i ^ 2) *
      (∫ g : ℝ, max (|g| - 2 * K) 0 ∂gaussianReal 0 1) ≤
      ∫ z : (ι → ℝ) × ℝ, excess 1 (2 * K * Real.sqrt (∑ i, a i ^ 2))
        (exponentialMixture a z) ∂exponentialVector.prod (gaussianReal 0 1)

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.exponential_scalar_excess
statement:
lemma exponential_scalar_excess {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] (a : ι → ℝ) (b K t r : ℝ)
    (hK : 0 < K) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    (t * excessConstant K) * Real.sqrt (∑ i, a i ^ 2) - (excessConstant K / K) * r ≤
      ∫ u : ι → ℝ, excess t r (b + ∑ i, a i * u i) ∂exponentialVector

lemma exponential_scalar_excess_unit (a : ι → ℝ) (b K : ℝ) :

      ∫ u : ι → ℝ, excess 1 (K * Real.sqrt (∑ i, a i ^ 2)) (b + ∑ i, a i * u i) ∂exponentialVector

statement:
theorem fields_minimal (v p q : ι → ℝ) (hp : ∀ s, 0 ≤ p s) (hq : ∀ s, 0 ≤ q s)
    (hdiff : ∀ s, p s - q s = v s) (hpU : T.Upper p) (hqU : T.Upper q) (s : ι) :
    (T.fields v s).1 ≤ p s ∧ (T.fields v s).2 ≤ q s

statement:
lemma fields_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_upper
statement:
lemma fields_upper (v : ι → ℝ) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.head_initial

statement:
lemma pMaximum_bound (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pMaximum_level
statement:
lemma pMaximum_level (v : ι → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    e.agg (T.headLevel Finset.univ j) (T.pMaximum e v) ≤
      e.agg (T.headLevel Finset.univ j) v + e.agg (T.headLevel Finset.univ (j+1)) (T.pMaximum e v)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pMaximum_level_sum
statement:
lemma pMaximum_level_sum (v : ι → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    T.pMaximum e v T.root ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, e.agg (T.headLevel Finset.univ j) v) +
      e.agg (T.headLevel Finset.univ n) (T.pMaximum e v)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pMaximum_nonneg
statement: lemma pMaximum_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) : 0 ≤ T.pMaximum e v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_level_lower
statement:
lemma pRootSum_level_lower (v : ι → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    e.agg (T.headLevel Finset.univ j) v ≤ T.pRootSum e v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_lower_comparison
statement:
lemma pRootSum_lower_comparison (h : ℕ) (hh : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h) (v : ι → ℝ) :
    e.agg Finset.univ v ≤ (h+1 : ℝ) ^ (1/e.val) * T.pRootSum e v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_nonneg
statement: lemma pRootSum_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) : 0 ≤ T.pRootSum p v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_upper_comparison
statement:
lemma pRootSum_upper_comparison (hp : 1 < e.val) (h : ℕ) (hh : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h) (v : ι → ℝ) :
    T.pRootSum e v ≤ 2 * (h+1 : ℝ) ^ (1 - 1/e.val) * e.agg Finset.univ v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_difference
statement:
lemma pfields_difference (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    (T.pfields p v s).1 - (T.pfields p v s).2 = v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_eq
statement:
lemma pfields_eq (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.pfields p v s = leastPair (v s)
      (p.agg (T.children s) (fun c => (T.pfields p v c).1))
      (p.agg (T.children s) (fun c => (T.pfields p v c).2))

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_minimal
statement:
theorem pfields_minimal (v a b : ι → ℝ) (ha : ∀ s, 0 ≤ a s) (hb : ∀ s, 0 ≤ b s)
    (hdiff : ∀ s, a s - b s = v s) (haU : T.PUpper p a) (hbU : T.PUpper p b) (s : ι) :
    (T.pfields p v s).1 ≤ a s ∧ (T.pfields p v s).2 ≤ b s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_nonneg
statement:
lemma pfields_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    0 ≤ (T.pfields p v s).1 ∧ 0 ≤ (T.pfields p v s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_upper
statement:
lemma pfields_upper (v : ι → ℝ) :
    T.PUpper p (fun s => (T.pfields p v s).1) ∧ T.PUpper p (fun s => (T.pfields p v s).2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.potentials_add_le
statement:
lemma potentials_add_le (v w : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.P (v + w) s ≤ T.P v s + T.P w s ∧ T.Q (v + w) s ≤ T.Q v s + T.Q w s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.potentials_minimal
statement:
lemma potentials_minimal (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (p q : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ s, 0 ≤ p s) (hq : ∀ s, 0 ≤ q s) (hdiff : ∀ s, p s - q s = v s)
    (hpU : T.GlobalUpper p) (hqU : T.GlobalUpper q) (s : ι) :
    T.P v s ≤ p s ∧ T.Q v s ≤ q s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.potentials_neg
statement:
lemma potentials_neg (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.potentials_smul_le
statement:
lemma potentials_smul_le (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.P (a • v) s ≤ a * T.P v s ∧ T.Q (a • v) s ≤ a * T.Q v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.potentials_smul_nonneg
statement:
lemma potentials_smul_nonneg (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :

statement:
lemma projectHead_apply (H : Finset ι) (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :

statement:
lemma sum_children_on (S : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.sum_level_rpow
statement:
lemma sum_level_rpow {ι : Type uIndex} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (T : FiniteRootedTree ι)
    (e : ChildExponent) (h : ℕ) (hh : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h) (v : ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (h+1), e.agg (T.headLevel Finset.univ j) v ^ e.val) = e.agg Finset.univ v ^ e.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.sum_restrict_children
statement:
lemma sum_restrict_children (H : Finset ι) (hH : T.Initial H) (s : H) (f : ι → ℝ) :
    ∑ c ∈ (T.restrict H hH).children s, f c.1 =
      ∑ c ∈ H.filter (fun c => c ≠ T.root ∧ T.parent c = s.1), f c

statement: lemma support_subset_head (v : ι →₀ ℝ) : v.support ⊆ T.head v

statement:
lemma potentials_minimal (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (p q : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ s, 0 ≤ p s) (hq : ∀ s, 0 ≤ q s) (hdiff : ∀ s, p s - q s = v s)
    (hpU : GlobalUpper T e p) (hqU : GlobalUpper T e q) (s : ι) :

statement:
lemma potentials_neg (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.potentials_on_head
statement:
theorem potentials_on_head (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (H : Finset ι) (hH : T.Initial H)

    P T e v s.1 = ((T.restrict H hH).pfields e (fun c => v c.1) s).1 ∧
    Q T e v s.1 = ((T.restrict H hH).pfields e (fun c => v c.1) s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.potentials_smul_le

statement:
lemma potentials_smul_nonneg (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.averaged_feasible
statement:
lemma averaged_feasible (x z : ι → ℝ) :
    T.Upper (fun s => ((T.fields (x + z) s).1 + (T.fields (x - z) s).1) / 2) ∧
    T.Upper (fun s => ((T.fields (x + z) s).2 + (T.fields (x - z) s).2) / 2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.commonRoot_finite_cubic
statement:
theorem commonRoot_finite_cubic {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (x z : ι → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0) (hz : ∀ s ∈ H, z s = 0)
    (hxroot : x T.root = 0) (hz0 : z ≠ 0) :
    T.rootCommon x + (T.rootCommon z) ^ 3 /
        (8 * (2 * T.rootCommon x + T.rootCommon z) ^ 2) ≤
      (T.rootCommon (x + z) + T.rootCommon (x - z)) / 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.defect_energy_step
statement:
lemma defect_energy_step (x z : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    ∑ c ∈ T.children s, energy (T.fields x c).1 (T.fields x c).2 (T.defect x z c) ≤
      energy (T.fields x s).1 (T.fields x s).2 (T.defect x z s)

statement: lemma defect_nonneg (x z : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) : 0 ≤ T.defect x z s

lemma defect_off_head {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (x z : ι → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0) (s : ι) (hs : s ∉ H) :
    T.defect x z s = ((T.fields z s).1 + (T.fields z s).2) / 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.defect_representation
statement:
lemma defect_representation (x z : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    ((T.fields (x + z) s).1 + (T.fields (x - z) s).1) / 2 =
      (T.fields x s).1 + T.defect x z s ∧
    ((T.fields (x + z) s).2 + (T.fields (x - z) s).2) / 2 =
      (T.fields x s).2 + T.defect x z s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_add_le
statement:
lemma fields_add_le (v w : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    (T.fields (v + w) s).1 ≤ (T.fields v s).1 + (T.fields w s).1 ∧
    (T.fields (v + w) s).2 ≤ (T.fields v s).2 + (T.fields w s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_eq_off_head
statement:
theorem fields_eq_off_head {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (v w : ι → ℝ)
    (hvw : ∀ s ∉ H, v s = w s) (s : ι) (hs : s ∉ H) :
    T.fields v s = T.fields w s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_head_zero
statement:
lemma fields_head_zero {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (v : ι → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ s ∉ H, v s = 0) (s : ι) (hs : s ∉ H) : T.fields v s = (0, 0)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_neg
statement:
lemma fields_neg (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.fields (-v) s = ((T.fields v s).2, (T.fields v s).1)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_smul
statement:
lemma fields_smul (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.fields (a • v) s = (a * (T.fields v s).1, a * (T.fields v s).2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_smul_le
statement:
lemma fields_smul_le (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    (T.fields (a • v) s).1 ≤ a * (T.fields v s).1 ∧
    (T.fields (a • v) s).2 ≤ a * (T.fields v s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_tight
statement:
lemma fields_tight (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    (∑ c ∈ T.children s, (T.fields v c).1 ^ 2 = (T.fields v s).1 ^ 2) ∨
    (∑ c ∈ T.children s, (T.fields v c).2 ^ 2 = (T.fields v s).2 ^ 2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_zero
statement: lemma fields_zero (s : ι) : T.fields (fun _ => 0) s = (0, 0)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.max_fields_sq_le_children
statement:
lemma max_fields_sq_le_children (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) (hv : v s = 0) :
    (max (T.fields v s).1 (T.fields v s).2) ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ c ∈ T.children s, (max (T.fields v c).1 (T.fields v c).2) ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_cubic
statement:
theorem normSum_cubic (x z : ι →₀ ℝ) {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hx : x.support ⊆ H) (hz : ∀ s ∈ H, z s = 0) :
    (T.normSum z) ^ 3 ≤ 8 * T.meanExcess x z *
      (2 * T.normSum x + T.meanExcess x z) ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_on_head
statement:
lemma normSum_on_head (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (H : Finset ι) (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hv : v.support ⊆ H) : T.normSum v = (T.restrict H hH).rootSum (fun s => v s.1)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.potentials_le_normSum
statement:
lemma potentials_le_normSum (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.P v s ≤ T.normSum v ∧ T.Q v s ≤ T.normSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.potentials_lipschitz
statement:
lemma potentials_lipschitz (v w : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :
    |T.P v s - T.P w s| ≤ T.normSum (v - w) ∧
    |T.Q v s - T.Q w s| ≤ T.normSum (v - w)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.potentials_on_head
statement:
theorem potentials_on_head (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (H : Finset ι) (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hv : v.support ⊆ H) (s : H) :
    T.P v s.1 = ((T.restrict H hH).fields (fun c => v c.1) s).1 ∧
    T.Q v s.1 = ((T.restrict H hH).fields (fun c => v c.1) s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.restrict_initial
statement:
lemma restrict_initial (K : Finset ι) (hK : T.Initial K) (H : Finset ι)
    (hH : T.Initial H) :
    (T.restrict K hK).Initial (Finset.univ.filter (fun s : K => s.1 ∈ H))

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootCommon_eq_half_sum
statement:
lemma rootCommon_eq_half_sum (v : ι → ℝ) (hv : v T.root = 0) :
    T.rootCommon v = T.rootSum v / 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_add_le
statement: lemma rootSum_add_le (v w : ι → ℝ) : T.rootSum (v + w) ≤ T.rootSum v + T.rootSum w

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_cubic
statement:
theorem rootSum_cubic {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (x z : ι → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0) (hz : ∀ s ∈ H, z s = 0) :
    (T.rootSum z) ^ 3 ≤ 64 * T.defect x z T.root *
      (T.rootSum x + T.defect x z T.root) ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_defect
statement:
lemma rootSum_defect (x z : ι → ℝ) :
    (T.rootSum (x + z) + T.rootSum (x - z)) / 2 =
      T.rootSum x + 2 * T.defect x z T.root

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_eq_twice_max_of_root_zero
statement:
lemma rootSum_eq_twice_max_of_root_zero (v : ι → ℝ) (hv : v T.root = 0) :
    T.rootSum v = 2 * max (T.fields v T.root).1 (T.fields v T.root).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_finite_midpoint_gap
statement:
theorem rootSum_finite_midpoint_gap {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (x z : ι → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0) (hz : ∀ s ∈ H, z s = 0)
    (hunit : T.rootSum x = 1) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1)
    (hzt : t ≤ T.rootSum z) :
    1 + t ^ 3 / 128 ≤ (T.rootSum (x + z) + T.rootSum (x - z)) / 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma rootSum_neg (v : ι → ℝ) : T.rootSum (-v) = T.rootSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_nonneg
statement: lemma rootSum_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) : 0 ≤ T.rootSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_pos
statement: lemma rootSum_pos {v : ι → ℝ} (hv : v ≠ 0) : 0 < T.rootSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_smul_nonneg
statement:
lemma rootSum_smul_nonneg (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (v : ι → ℝ) :
    T.rootSum (a • v) = a * T.rootSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma rootSum_zero : T.rootSum (fun _ => 0) = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.root_mem_ancestors
statement: lemma root_mem_ancestors (s : ι) : T.root ∈ T.ancestors s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.sum_children
statement:
lemma sum_children (e : ι → ℝ) :
    ∑ s, ∑ c ∈ T.children s, e c = ∑ c ∈ Finset.univ.erase T.root, e c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.sum_leaves_le_root
statement:
lemma sum_leaves_le_root (e : ι → ℝ)
    (he : ∀ s, ∑ c ∈ T.children s, e c ≤ e s) :
    ∑ b ∈ T.leaves, e b ≤ e T.root

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.tail_energy
statement:
theorem tail_energy {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (x z : ι → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0) (hz : ∀ s ∈ H, z s = 0) (s : ι) :
    (max (T.fields z s).1 (T.fields z s).2) ^ 2 ≤
      4 * energy (T.fields x s).1 (T.fields x s).2 (T.defect x z s)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.two_field_energy
statement:
theorem two_field_energy (p q d : ι → ℝ) (J : Finset ι) (hJ : J ⊆ T.leaves)
    (hp : ∀ s, 0 ≤ p s) (hq : ∀ s, 0 ≤ q s) (hd : ∀ s, 0 ≤ d s)
    (hpU : T.Upper p) (hqU : T.Upper q)
    (hp'U : T.Upper (fun s => p s + d s))
    (hq'U : T.Upper (fun s => q s + d s))
    (htight : ∀ s, (T.children s).Nonempty →
      (∑ c ∈ T.children s, p c ^ 2 = p s ^ 2) ∨
      (∑ c ∈ T.children s, q c ^ 2 = q s ^ 2))
    (_hzero : ∀ b ∈ J, p b = 0 ∧ q b = 0) :
    ∑ b ∈ J, d b ^ 2 ≤ energy (p T.root) (q T.root) (d T.root)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.two_field_energy_all_leaves
statement:
theorem two_field_energy_all_leaves (p q d : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ s, 0 ≤ p s) (hq : ∀ s, 0 ≤ q s) (hd : ∀ s, 0 ≤ d s)
    (hpU : T.Upper p) (hqU : T.Upper q)
    (hp'U : T.Upper (fun s => p s + d s))
    (hq'U : T.Upper (fun s => q s + d s))
    (htight : ∀ s, (T.children s).Nonempty →
      (∑ c ∈ T.children s, p c ^ 2 = p s ^ 2) ∨
      (∑ c ∈ T.children s, q c ^ 2 = q s ^ 2)) :
    ∑ b ∈ T.leaves, d b ^ 2 ≤ energy (p T.root) (q T.root) (d T.root)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.P_coe
statement: @[simp] lemma P_coe (s : ι) (v : TreeVector T) : P T s (v : TreeSpace T) = T.P v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.P_nonneg
statement: lemma P_nonneg (s : ι) (x : TreeSpace T) : 0 ≤ P T s x

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.Q_coe
statement: @[simp] lemma Q_coe (s : ι) (v : TreeVector T) : Q T s (v : TreeSpace T) = T.Q v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.Q_nonneg
statement: lemma Q_nonneg (s : ι) (x : TreeSpace T) : 0 ≤ Q T s x

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.averaged_modulus_cubic
statement:
theorem averaged_modulus_cubic [Infinite ι] {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1) :
    t ^ 3 / 128 ≤ averagedModulus (TreeSpace T) t

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.continuous_P
statement: @[continuity, fun_prop] lemma continuous_P (s : ι) : Continuous (P T s)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.continuous_Q
statement: @[continuity, fun_prop] lemma continuous_Q (s : ι) : Continuous (Q T s)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.continuous_meanExcess
statement:
@[continuity, fun_prop] lemma continuous_meanExcess :
    Continuous (fun p : TreeSpace T × TreeSpace T => meanExcess T p.1 p.2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.meanExcess_coe
statement:
@[simp] lemma meanExcess_coe (x z : TreeVector T) :
    meanExcess T (x : TreeSpace T) (z : TreeSpace T) = T.meanExcess x z

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.meanExcess_le
statement: lemma meanExcess_le (x z : TreeSpace T) : meanExcess T x z ≤ ‖z‖

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.meanExcess_nonneg
statement: lemma meanExcess_nonneg (x z : TreeSpace T) : 0 ≤ meanExcess T x z

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.norm_eq
statement: theorem norm_eq (x : TreeSpace T) : ‖x‖ = P T T.root x + Q T T.root x

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeVector.basisVector_apply
statement: lemma basisVector_apply (s c : ι) : basisVector T s c = if s = c then 1 else 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeVector.lipschitz_P
statement: lemma lipschitz_P (s : ι) : LipschitzWith 1 (fun v : TreeVector T => T.P v s)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeVector.lipschitz_Q
statement: lemma lipschitz_Q (s : ι) : LipschitzWith 1 (fun v : TreeVector T => T.Q v s)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeVector.norm_def
statement: lemma norm_def (v : TreeVector T) : ‖v‖ = T.normSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.averagedGain_lower
statement: lemma averagedGain_lower (x : E) (t : ℝ) (y : E) : ‖x‖ - 1 ≤ averagedGain x t y

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.averagedInner_bddBelow
statement:
lemma averagedInner_bddBelow (x : E) (t : ℝ) (F : CofiniteSubspace E) :
    BddBelow {r : ℝ | ∃ y ∈ F.space, 1 ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ r = averagedGain x t y}

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.averagedInner_le
statement:
lemma averagedInner_le (x : E) (hx : ‖x‖ = 1) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (F : CofiniteSubspace E) (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) : averagedInner x t F ≤ t

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.averagedInner_nonempty
statement:
lemma averagedInner_nonempty (x : E) (t : ℝ) (F : CofiniteSubspace E)
    (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) :
    {r : ℝ | ∃ y ∈ F.space, 1 ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ r = averagedGain x t y}.Nonempty

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.averagedModulus_lower_of_witness
statement:
theorem averagedModulus_lower_of_witness (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E)
    {t c : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hw : ∀ x : E, ‖x‖ = 1 → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∃ F : CofiniteSubspace E, ∀ y ∈ F.space, 1 ≤ ‖y‖ → c - ε ≤ averagedGain x t y) :
    c ≤ averagedModulus E t

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.cube_le_of_sq_le_energy
statement:
lemma cube_le_of_sq_le_energy {r k p q d : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hk : 0 ≤ k)
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (h : r ^ 2 ≤ k ^ 2 * energy p q d) :
    r ^ 3 ≤ k ^ 3 * (d * (2 * p + d) * (2 * q + d))

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.energy_factor
statement:
lemma energy_factor {p q d : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    energy p q d =
      (d * (2 * p + d)) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * ((2 * q + d) ^ 2) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.energy_nonneg
statement:
lemma energy_nonneg {p q d : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    0 ≤ energy p q d

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.energy_rpow_three_halves
statement:
lemma energy_rpow_three_halves {p q d : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    (energy p q d) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) = d * (2 * p + d) * (2 * q + d)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.energy_step
statement:
lemma energy_step {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) (p q d : ι → ℝ)
    {P Q D : ℝ} (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i) (hq : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ q i)
    (hd : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ d i)
    (hPupper : ∑ i ∈ s, p i ^ 2 ≤ P ^ 2)
    (hQupper : ∑ i ∈ s, q i ^ 2 ≤ Q ^ 2)
    (hPupper' : ∑ i ∈ s, (p i + d i) ^ 2 ≤ (P + D) ^ 2)
    (hQupper' : ∑ i ∈ s, (q i + d i) ^ 2 ≤ (Q + D) ^ 2)
    (htight : (∑ i ∈ s, p i ^ 2 = P ^ 2) ∨ (∑ i ∈ s, q i ^ 2 = Q ^ 2)) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, energy (p i) (q i) (d i) ≤ energy P Q D

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.energy_step_first
statement:
lemma energy_step_first {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) (p q d : ι → ℝ)
    {P Q D : ℝ} (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i) (hq : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ q i)
    (hd : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ d i)
    (hPtight : ∑ i ∈ s, p i ^ 2 = P ^ 2)
    (hQupper : ∑ i ∈ s, q i ^ 2 ≤ Q ^ 2)
    (hPupper' : ∑ i ∈ s, (p i + d i) ^ 2 ≤ (P + D) ^ 2)
    (hQupper' : ∑ i ∈ s, (q i + d i) ^ 2 ≤ (Q + D) ^ 2) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, energy (p i) (q i) (d i) ≤ energy P Q D

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.energy_symm
statement: lemma energy_symm (p q d : ℝ) : energy p q d = energy q p d

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.energy_zero_base
statement: lemma energy_zero_base {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 ≤ d) : energy 0 0 d = d ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.holder_two_thirds
statement:
lemma holder_two_thirds {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) (u v : ι → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ u i) (hv : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ v i) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, (u i) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (v i) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, u i) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ s, v i) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.leastPair_tight
statement:
lemma leastPair_tight (x a b : ℝ) :
    (leastPair x a b).1 = a ∨ (leastPair x a b).2 = b

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.sq_rpow_three_halves
statement:
lemma sq_rpow_three_halves {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    (a ^ 2) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) = a ^ 3

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.GlobalUpper.zero
statement:
lemma GlobalUpper.zero {ι : Type uIndex} [DecidableEq ι] (T : FiniteRootedTree ι) :
    T.GlobalUpper (0 : ι → ℝ)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.attached_upper
statement:
lemma attached_upper (s : ι) (b : ι → ℝ) (hb0 : ∀ c, 0 ≤ b c)
    (hb : ∀ c, b c ≠ 0 → c ≠ T.root ∧ T.parent c = s)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hsq : ∀ S : Finset ι, ∑ c ∈ S, b c ^ 2 ≤ R ^ 2) :
    T.GlobalUpper (fun c => R * T.path s c + b c)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.child_function_zero_on_ancestors
statement:
lemma child_function_zero_on_ancestors (s : ι) (b : ι → ℝ)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.child_not_mem_ancestors
statement:
lemma child_not_mem_ancestors {s c : ι} (hc : c ≠ T.root) (hp : T.parent c = s) :
    c ∉ T.ancestors s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.cutPath_root
statement: lemma cutPath_root (s : ι) : T.cutPath s T.root = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.cutPath_step
statement:
lemma cutPath_step (c : ι) (hc : c ≠ T.root) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.depth_le_of_mem_ancestors
statement:
lemma depth_le_of_mem_ancestors (s : ι) {c : ι} (hc : c ∈ T.ancestors s) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_cutPath
statement: lemma normSum_cutPath (s : ι) (hs : s ≠ T.root) : T.normSum (T.cutPath s) = 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_path
statement: lemma normSum_path (s : ι) : T.normSum (T.path s) = 1

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_siblings_le
statement:
theorem normSum_siblings_le (s : ι) (v : ι →₀ ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ c ∈ v.support, c ≠ T.root ∧ T.parent c = s) :
    T.normSum v ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (∑ c ∈ v.support, v c ^ 2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_single
statement:
lemma normSum_single (c : ι) (hc : c ≠ T.root) :
    T.normSum (Finsupp.single c 1) = 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.parent_ancestors_injective
statement:
lemma parent_ancestors_injective (s : ι) {a b : ι} (ha : a ∈ T.ancestors s)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.path_apply
statement: lemma path_apply (s c : ι) : T.path s c = if c ∈ T.ancestors s then 1 else 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.path_fields
statement: theorem path_fields (s c : ι) : T.P (T.path s) c = T.path s c ∧ T.Q (T.path s) c = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.path_nonneg
statement: lemma path_nonneg (s c : ι) : 0 ≤ T.path s c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.path_root
statement: lemma path_root (s : ι) : T.path s T.root = 1

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.path_step
statement:
lemma path_step (c : ι) (hc : c ≠ T.root) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.path_upper
statement: lemma path_upper (s : ι) : T.GlobalUpper (T.path s)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.positivePart_sq_le
statement: lemma positivePart_sq_le (a : ℝ) : max a 0 ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.sum_sq_le_support
statement:
lemma sum_sq_le_support (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (S : Finset ι) :
    ∑ c ∈ S, v c ^ 2 ≤ ∑ c ∈ v.support, v c ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.twice_coordinate_le_normSum
statement:
lemma twice_coordinate_le_normSum (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (hv : v T.root = 0) (s : ι) :
    2 * |v s| ≤ T.normSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.XJoined_averaged_modulus
statement:
theorem XJoined_averaged_modulus {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1) :
    t ^ 3 / 128 ≤ averagedModulus XJoined t

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.XSigma_averaged_modulus
statement:
theorem XSigma_averaged_modulus {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1) :
    t ^ 3 / 128 ≤ averagedModulus XSigma t

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.bounded_tree_step
statement:
lemma bounded_tree_step (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) {u : E} (hu : u ≠ 0)
    (d : ℕ → E) (hd : WeaklyNull d) {M c γ : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (hc : 0 < c)
    (huM : ‖u‖ ≤ M) (hdc : ∀ k, c ≤ ‖d k‖) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hmod : γ < A.modulus (A.lower * c / (2 * A.upper * M))) :
    ∃ k, (1 + γ / 2) * A.N u ≤ A.N (u + d k)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.continuous
statement: lemma continuous : Continuous A.N

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma eq_zero_iff (x : E) : A.N x = 0 ↔ x = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.exists_unit
statement:
lemma exists_unit (F : CofiniteSubspace E) (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) :
    ∃ y ∈ F.space, A.N y = 1

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.extend_radius
statement:
lemma extend_radius {x y : E} (hx : A.N x = 1) (_hy : A.N y = 1)
    {t r γ : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (htr : t ≤ r) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hg : 1 + γ ≤ A.N (x + t • y)) : 1 + γ ≤ A.N (x + r • y)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.inner_bddBelow
statement:
lemma inner_bddBelow (x : E) (t : ℝ) (F : CofiniteSubspace E) :
    BddBelow {r : ℝ | ∃ y ∈ F.space, A.N y = 1 ∧ r = A.N (x + t • y) - 1}

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.inner_lower
statement:
lemma inner_lower (x : E) (t : ℝ) (F : CofiniteSubspace E)
    (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) : -1 ≤ A.inner x t F

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.inner_nonempty
statement:
lemma inner_nonempty (x : E) (t : ℝ) (F : CofiniteSubspace E)
    (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) :
    {r : ℝ | ∃ y ∈ F.space, A.N y = 1 ∧ r = A.N (x + t • y) - 1}.Nonempty

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.inner_upper
statement:
lemma inner_upper {x : E} (hx : A.N x = 1) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (F : CofiniteSubspace E) (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) : A.inner x t F ≤ t

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.lipschitz_estimate
statement: lemma lipschitz_estimate (x y : E) : |A.N x - A.N y| ≤ A.upper * ‖x - y‖

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.long_perturbation
statement:
lemma long_perturbation {u w : E} (hu : u ≠ 0) {t γ : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (F : CofiniteSubspace E) (hw : w ∈ F.space) (hwn : t * A.N u ≤ A.N w)
    (hF : ∀ y ∈ F.space, A.N y = 1 →
      1 + γ ≤ A.N ((A.N u)⁻¹ • u + t • y)) :
    (1 + γ) * A.N u ≤ A.N (u + w)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.modulus_le_sup
statement:
lemma modulus_le_sup {x : E} (hx : A.N x = 1) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) : A.modulus t ≤ sSup (Set.range (A.inner x t))

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.modulus_nonneg
statement: lemma modulus_nonneg (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) : 0 ≤ A.modulus t

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.nonneg
statement: lemma nonneg (x : E) : 0 ≤ A.N x

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.norming_functional
statement:
lemma norming_functional {x : E} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ f : E →L[ℝ] ℝ, f x = A.N x ∧ ∀ y, ‖f y‖ ≤ A.N y

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.pos
statement: lemma pos {x : E} (hx : x ≠ 0) : 0 < A.N x

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.sub_le
statement: lemma sub_le (x y : E) : A.N x - A.N y ≤ A.N (x - y)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.upper_pos
statement: lemma upper_pos : 0 < A.upper

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.witness
statement:
lemma witness {t γ : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hγ : γ < A.modulus t)
    (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) (x : E) (hx : A.N x = 1) :
    ∃ F : CofiniteSubspace E, ∀ y ∈ F.space, A.N y = 1 →
      1 + γ ≤ A.N (x + t • y)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_emb_siblings
statement:
lemma normSum_emb_siblings (s : ι) (f : ℕ ↪ ι)
    (hf : ∀ k, f k ≠ T.root ∧ T.parent (f k) = s) (a : ℕ →₀ ℝ) :
    T.normSum (a.embDomain f) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (∑ k ∈ a.support, a k ^ 2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.WeaklyNull.approximate_cofinite
statement:
lemma WeaklyNull.approximate_cofinite {E : Type uSpace} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {d : ℕ → E} (hd : WeaklyNull d) (F : CofiniteSubspace E) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∃ w ∈ F.space, ‖d k - w‖ < ε

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.WeaklyNull.quotient_tendsto
statement:
lemma WeaklyNull.quotient_tendsto {E : Type uSpace} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {d : ℕ → E} (hd : WeaklyNull d) (F : CofiniteSubspace E) :
    Tendsto (fun k => F.space.mkQL (d k)) atTop (𝓝 0)

statement: theorem XJoined_no_equivalent_AUC (A : EquivalentNorm XJoined) : ¬A.AUC

statement:

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.XSigma_no_equivalent_AUC
statement: theorem XSigma_no_equivalent_AUC (A : EquivalentNorm XSigma) : ¬A.AUC

statement:

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.bounded_trees_modulus_eq_zero
statement:
theorem bounded_trees_modulus_eq_zero {E : Type uSpace} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) (A : EquivalentNorm E) (u : ℕ → List ℕ → E)
    {m M c : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hM : 0 < M) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hu : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length ≤ h → m ≤ ‖u h s‖ ∧ ‖u h s‖ ≤ M)
    (hd : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length < h →
      WeaklyNull (fun k => u h (s ++ [k]) - u h s))
    (hdc : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length < h →
      ∀ k, c ≤ ‖u h (s ++ [k]) - u h s‖) :
    A.modulus (A.lower * c / (2 * A.upper * M)) = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.bounded_trees_modulus_le_zero
statement:
theorem bounded_trees_modulus_le_zero {E : Type uSpace} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) (A : EquivalentNorm E) (u : ℕ → List ℕ → E)
    {m M c : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hM : 0 < M) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hu : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length ≤ h → m ≤ ‖u h s‖ ∧ ‖u h s‖ ≤ M)
    (hd : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length < h →
      WeaklyNull (fun k => u h (s ++ [k]) - u h s))
    (hdc : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length < h →
      ∀ k, c ≤ ‖u h (s ++ [k]) - u h s‖) :
    A.modulus (A.lower * c / (2 * A.upper * M)) ≤ 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.bounded_trees_not_AUC
statement:
theorem bounded_trees_not_AUC {E : Type uSpace} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) (A : EquivalentNorm E) (u : ℕ → List ℕ → E)
    {m M c : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hM : 0 < M) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hu : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length ≤ h → m ≤ ‖u h s‖ ∧ ‖u h s‖ ≤ M)
    (hd : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length < h →
      WeaklyNull (fun k => u h (s ++ [k]) - u h s))
    (hdc : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length < h →
      ∀ k, c ≤ ‖u h (s ++ [k]) - u h s‖) : ¬A.AUC

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.joinedChildren_spec
statement:
lemma joinedChildren_spec (h : ℕ) (s : List ℕ) (hs : s.length < h) (k : ℕ) :
    joinedChildren h s hs k ≠ joinedTree.root ∧
      joinedTree.parent (joinedChildren h s hs k) = joinedNode h s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.joinedNode_ne_root
statement: lemma joinedNode_ne_root (h : ℕ) (s : List ℕ) : joinedNode h s ≠ joinedTree.root

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.joinedNode_parent
statement:
lemma joinedNode_parent (h : ℕ) (s : List ℕ) (hs : s.length < h) (k : ℕ) :
    joinedTree.parent (joinedNode h (s ++ [k])) = joinedNode h s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.sequenceChildren_spec
statement:
lemma sequenceChildren_spec (s : List ℕ) (k : ℕ) :
    sequenceChildren s k ≠ sequenceTree.root ∧
      sequenceTree.parent (sequenceChildren s k) = s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.weaklyNull_of_finsupp_bound
statement:
lemma weaklyNull_of_finsupp_bound {E : Type uSpace} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (L : (ℕ →₀ ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] E) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hL : ∀ a, ‖L a‖ ≤ C * Real.sqrt (∑ k ∈ a.support, a k ^ 2)) :
    WeaklyNull (fun k => L (Finsupp.single k 1))

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.weaklyNull_of_square_sum_bound
statement:
lemma weaklyNull_of_square_sum_bound {E : Type uSpace} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (d : ℕ → E) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (h : ∀ (S : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ),
      ‖∑ i ∈ S, a i • d i‖ ≤ C * Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ S, (a i) ^ 2)) : WeaklyNull d

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.weighted_square_bound
statement:
lemma weighted_square_bound {a r k B : ℝ} (hk : 0 ≤ k) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hr : r ^ 2 ≤ k * B) : (a + r) ^ 2 ≤ (k + 1) * (a ^ 2 + B)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.block_square_comparison
statement:
lemma block_square_comparison (v : ι → ℝ) (h : ℕ) (hh : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h) :
    ((max (T.fields v T.root).1 (T.fields v T.root).2) ^ 2 ≤
      ((h : ℝ) + 1) * ∑ s, v s ^ 2) ∧
    ((∑ s, v s ^ 2) ≤ 4 * ((h : ℝ) + 1) *
      (max (T.fields v T.root).1 (T.fields v T.root).2) ^ 2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.descEnergy_eq
statement:
lemma descEnergy_eq (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.descEnergy v s = v s ^ 2 + ∑ c ∈ T.children s, T.descEnergy v c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.descEnergy_nonneg
statement: lemma descEnergy_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) : 0 ≤ T.descEnergy v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.descEnergy_root
statement: lemma descEnergy_root (v : ι → ℝ) : T.descEnergy v T.root = ∑ s, v s ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.max_fields_le
statement:
lemma max_fields_le (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    max (T.fields v s).1 (T.fields v s).2 ≤
      |v s| + Real.sqrt (∑ c ∈ T.children s, (max (T.fields v c).1 (T.fields v c).2) ^ 2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.max_fields_square_le
statement:
lemma max_fields_square_le (v : ι → ℝ) (h : ℕ) (hh : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h) (s : ι) :
    (max (T.fields v s).1 (T.fields v s).2) ^ 2 ≤
      ((h : ℝ) + 1 - T.depth s) * T.descEnergy v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.upper_sum_square_le
statement:
lemma upper_sum_square_le {p : ι → ℝ} (hp : T.Upper p) (h : ℕ)
    (hh : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h) : ∑ s, p s ^ 2 ≤ ((h : ℝ) + 1) * p T.root ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.weighted_sum_children
statement:
lemma weighted_sum_children (w e : ι → ℝ) :
    ∑ s, w s * ∑ c ∈ T.children s, e c =
      ∑ c ∈ Finset.univ.erase T.root, w (T.parent c) * e c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.IsReflexive.of_equiv
statement:
lemma IsReflexive.of_equiv {E : Type uSpace} {F : Type uOther} [NormedAddCommGroup E]

statement:

statement:

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.Joined.components_rootVector
statement:
lemma components_rootVector (a : ℝ) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.Joined.field_embed
statement:
@[simp] lemma field_embed (r : ℝ) (f : ∀ h : ℕ+, ComponentNode h → ℝ) (h : ℕ+) (s : ComponentNode h) :
    field r f (embed h s) = f h s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.Joined.field_nonneg
statement:
lemma field_nonneg (r : ℝ) (f : ∀ h : ℕ+, ComponentNode h → ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hf : ∀ h s, 0 ≤ f h s) (c : JoinedNode) : 0 ≤ field r f c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.Joined.field_root
statement:
@[simp] lemma field_root (r : ℝ) (f : ∀ h : ℕ+, ComponentNode h → ℝ) :
    field r f joinedTree.root = r

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.Joined.field_upper
statement:
lemma field_upper (r : ℝ) (f : ∀ h : ℕ+, ComponentNode h → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ h, (componentTree h).GlobalUpper (f h))
    (hr : ∀ S : Finset ℕ+, ∑ h ∈ S, f h (componentTree h).root ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2) :
    joinedTree.GlobalUpper (field r f)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.Joined.norm_le_root_add_outer
statement:
lemma norm_le_root_add_outer (v : TreeVector joinedTree) :
    ‖v‖ ≤ |v joinedTree.root| + 2 * ‖components v‖

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.Joined.put_root
statement: lemma put_root (h : ℕ+) (v : TreeVector (componentTree h)) : put h v joinedTree.root = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.SquareSum.exists_half_norming
statement:
lemma exists_half_norming {X : Type uTarget} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.SquareSum.isReflexive

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.averaged_modulus_all_radii_lower
statement:
theorem averaged_modulus_all_radii_lower [Infinite ι] {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.averaged_modulus_pos
statement:
theorem averaged_modulus_pos [Infinite ι] {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.hilbert_isReflexive
statement:
lemma hilbert_isReflexive {E : Type uSpace} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] : IsReflexive E

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.isReflexive_iff
statement:
lemma isReflexive_iff {E : Type uSpace} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] :
    IsReflexive E ↔ ∀ F : (E →L[ℝ] ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ, ∃ x : E, ∀ f : E →L[ℝ] ℝ, F f = f x

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.lens_half_difference
statement:
lemma lens_half_difference {x z w : E} {R : ℝ}
    (hzp : ‖x+z‖ ≤ R) (hzm : ‖x-z‖ ≤ R)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.norm_center_le
statement: lemma norm_center_le {x y : E} {R : ℝ} (hp : ‖x+y‖ ≤ R) (hm : ‖x-y‖ ≤ R) : ‖x‖ ≤ R

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.norm_perturbation_le
statement: lemma norm_perturbation_le {x y : E} {R : ℝ} (hp : ‖x+y‖ ≤ R) (hm : ‖x-y‖ ≤ R) : ‖y‖ ≤ R

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.ChildExponent.agg_le_iff
statement:
lemma agg_le_iff {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    p.agg s f ≤ a ↔ (∑ i ∈ s, |f i| ^ p.val) ≤ a ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.ChildExponent.agg_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma agg_neg {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ) : p.agg s (-f) = p.agg s f

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.PUpper.add
statement:
lemma PUpper.add {a b : ι → ℝ} (ha : T.PUpper p a) (hb : T.PUpper p b) :
    T.PUpper p (a+b)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.PUpper.le_root
statement: lemma PUpper.le_root {a : ι → ℝ} (ha : T.PUpper p a) (s : ι) : a s ≤ a T.root

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.PUpper.smul
statement:
lemma PUpper.smul {a : ι → ℝ} (ha : T.PUpper p a) {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 ≤ k) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.PUpper.zero

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.exists_tight_label
statement:
lemma exists_tight_label (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    ∃ b : Bool, T.pField p v b s ^ p.val = ∑ c ∈ T.children s, T.pField p v b c ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.exitCut_succ
statement:
lemma exitCut_succ {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1) (j : ℕ) :
    T.exitCut H (j+1) = T.childrenOf (T.headLevel H j) ∪ T.stoppedExit H j

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.exitCut_succ_disjoint
OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.exitCut_zero
statement: lemma exitCut_zero {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) : T.exitCut H 0 = {T.root}

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_cut_mass
statement:
lemma fields_cut_mass {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (v : ι → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    ∑ s ∈ T.exitCut H j, (T.pField p v true s ^ p.val + T.pField p v false s ^ p.val) ≤
      T.pRootSum p v ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_subcut_mass
statement:
lemma fields_subcut_mass {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (v : ι → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (S : Finset ι) (hS : S ⊆ T.exitCut H j) :
    ∑ s ∈ S, (T.pField p v true s ^ p.val + T.pField p v false s ^ p.val) ≤
      T.pRootSum p v ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.headLevel_stopped_disjoint
statement:
lemma headLevel_stopped_disjoint (H : Finset ι) (j : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (T.headLevel H j) (T.stoppedExit H j)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pField_nonneg
statement: lemma pField_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) (b : Bool) (s : ι) : 0 ≤ T.pField p v b s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pField_power_sum_le_norm
statement:
lemma pField_power_sum_le_norm (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.pField p v true s ^ p.val + T.pField p v false s ^ p.val ≤
      ((T.pfields p v s).1 + (T.pfields p v s).2) ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pField_power_upper
statement:
lemma pField_power_upper (v : ι → ℝ) (b : Bool) (s : ι) :
    ∑ c ∈ T.children s, T.pField p v b c ^ p.val ≤ T.pField p v b s ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_add_le
statement: lemma pRootSum_add_le (v w : ι → ℝ) : T.pRootSum p (v+w) ≤ T.pRootSum p v + T.pRootSum p w

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_coordinate
statement: lemma pRootSum_coordinate (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) : |v s| ≤ T.pRootSum p v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma pRootSum_neg (v : ι → ℝ) : T.pRootSum p (-v) = T.pRootSum p v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_smul_nonneg
statement:
lemma pRootSum_smul_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    T.pRootSum p (a • v) = a * T.pRootSum p v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_tail_midpoint
statement:
lemma pRootSum_tail_midpoint (x y : ι → ℝ) :
    T.pRootSum p y ≤ (T.pRootSum p (x+y) + T.pRootSum p (x-y)) / 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma pRootSum_zero : T.pRootSum p (fun _ => 0) = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_add_le
statement:
lemma pfields_add_le (v w : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    (T.pfields p (v+w) s).1 ≤ (T.pfields p v s).1 + (T.pfields p w s).1 ∧
    (T.pfields p (v+w) s).2 ≤ (T.pfields p v s).2 + (T.pfields p w s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_eq_off_head
statement:
lemma pfields_eq_off_head {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (v w : ι → ℝ)
    (hvw : ∀ s ∉ H, v s = w s) (s : ι) (hs : s ∉ H) : T.pfields p v s = T.pfields p w s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_head_le
statement:
lemma pfields_head_le {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (v w : ι → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ s ∉ H, v s = 0) (hvw : ∀ s ∈ H, v s = w s) (s : ι) :
    (T.pfields p v s).1 ≤ (T.pfields p w s).1 ∧ (T.pfields p v s).2 ≤ (T.pfields p w s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_head_zero
statement:
lemma pfields_head_zero {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (v : ι → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ s ∉ H, v s = 0) (s : ι) (hs : s ∉ H) : T.pfields p v s = (0,0)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_neg
statement:
lemma pfields_neg (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.pfields p (-v) s = ((T.pfields p v s).2, (T.pfields p v s).1)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_smul
statement:
lemma pfields_smul (v : ι → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (s : ι) :
    T.pfields p (a • v) s = (a * (T.pfields p v s).1, a * (T.pfields p v s).2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_smul_le
statement:
lemma pfields_smul_le (v : ι → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (s : ι) :
    (T.pfields p (a • v) s).1 ≤ a * (T.pfields p v s).1 ∧
    (T.pfields p (a • v) s).2 ≤ a * (T.pfields p v s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_tight
statement:
lemma pfields_tight (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    (T.pfields p v s).1 = p.agg (T.children s) (fun c => (T.pfields p v c).1) ∨
    (T.pfields p v s).2 = p.agg (T.children s) (fun c => (T.pfields p v c).2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_zero
statement: lemma pfields_zero (s : ι) : T.pfields p (fun _ => 0) s = (0,0)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.root_le_sum_exitCut
statement:
lemma root_le_sum_exitCut {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (f : ι → ℝ) (hf : ∀ s ∈ H, f s ≤ ∑ c ∈ T.children s, f c) (j : ℕ) :
    f T.root ≤ ∑ c ∈ T.exitCut H j, f c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.sum_exitCut_le_root
statement:
lemma sum_exitCut_le_root {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (f : ι → ℝ) (hf : ∀ s ∈ H, ∑ c ∈ T.children s, f c ≤ f s) (j : ℕ) :
    ∑ c ∈ T.exitCut H j, f c ≤ f T.root

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.sum_exitCut_succ
statement:
lemma sum_exitCut_succ {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1) (j : ℕ) (f : ι → ℝ) :
    ∑ c ∈ T.exitCut H (j+1), f c =
      (∑ s ∈ T.headLevel H j, ∑ c ∈ T.children s, f c) + ∑ c ∈ T.stoppedExit H j, f c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.tightLabel_spec
statement:
lemma tightLabel_spec (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.pField p v (T.tightLabel p v s) s ^ p.val =
      ∑ c ∈ T.children s, T.pField p v (T.tightLabel p v s) c ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.uniform_sequential_separation
statement:
theorem uniform_sequential_separation {ι : Type uIndex} [DecidableEq ι]
    (T : FiniteRootedTree ι) (x z : ℕ → ι →₀ ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ n, T.normSum (x n) = 1)
    (hz : ∀ n s, s ∈ T.head (x n) → z n s = 0)
    (hm : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (T.normSum (x n + z n) + T.normSum (x n - z n))/2)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 1)) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => T.normSum (z n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.accumulated_bound
statement:
lemma accumulated_bound {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (K : ℕ → ℝ) (hK : ∀ j, 0 ≤ K j)
    {h : ℕ} (hrec : ∀ j < h, K (j+1) ^ p ≤ p * (3 : ℝ) ^ ((p-1)/p) * K j) :
    ∀ j ≤ h, K j ≤ recurrenceCeiling * K 0 ^ ((1/p)^j)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.accumulated_cut_recursion
statement:
lemma accumulated_cut_recursion {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (a d : Bool → ι → ℝ) (ha : ∀ σ s, 0 ≤ a σ s) (hd : ∀ σ s, 0 ≤ d σ s)
    (hloc : ∀ σ s, s ∈ H → ∑ c ∈ T.children s, d σ c ^ p ≤
      p * a σ s ^ (p-1) * d σ s)
    (hext : ∀ σ s, s ∉ H → a σ s = d σ s)
    (j : ℕ) (hA : ∑ σ, ∑ s ∈ T.exitCut H j, a σ s ^ p ≤ 3) :
    cutEnergy T p H d (j+1) ^ p ≤
      p * (3 : ℝ) ^ ((p-1)/p) * cutEnergy T p H d j

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.coefficient_nonneg
statement: lemma coefficient_nonneg (σ : Bool) (s : ι) : 0 ≤ coefficient T p H x y σ s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.common_increment
statement:
lemma common_increment (σ b : Bool) (s : ι) (hs : s ∈ H) :
    T.pField p (x + signed y σ) b s = T.pField p x b s + increment T p H x y σ s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.cubic_of_accumulated
statement:
lemma cubic_of_accumulated (h : ℕ+) (K : ℕ → ℝ) (hK : ∀ j, 0 ≤ K j)
    (hrec : ∀ j < h.val, K (j+1) ^ heightExponent h ≤
      heightExponent h * (3 : ℝ) ^ ((heightExponent h - 1) / heightExponent h) * K j)
    {Y : ℝ} (hY0 : 0 ≤ Y) (hY1 : Y ≤ 1) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * K h.val) :
    cubicConstant * Y ^ 3 ≤ K 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.cutEnergy_nonneg
statement:
lemma cutEnergy_nonneg (p : ℝ) (H : Finset ι) (d : Bool → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ σ s, 0 ≤ d σ s) (j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ cutEnergy T p H d j

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.cutEnergy_pow
statement:
lemma cutEnergy_pow {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (H : Finset ι) (d : Bool → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ σ s, 0 ≤ d σ s) (j : ℕ) :
    cutEnergy T p H d j ^ p = ∑ σ, ∑ s ∈ T.exitCut H j, d σ s ^ p

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.cutEnergy_zero_le_gap
statement:
lemma cutEnergy_zero_le_gap (hp : 1 < p.val) :
    cutEnergy T p.val H (increment T p H x y) 0 ≤
      (T.pRootSum p (x+y) + T.pRootSum p (x-y)) / 2 - T.pRootSum p x

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.endpoint_on_head
statement:
lemma endpoint_on_head {ι : Type uIndex} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {H : Finset ι} {x y : ι → ℝ}
    (hy : ∀ s ∈ H, y s = 0) (σ : Bool) (s : ι) (hs : s ∈ H) : (x + signed y σ) s = x s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.exit_sign_mass
statement:
lemma exit_sign_mass (s : ι) (hs : s ∉ H) :
    (∑ σ, increment T p H x y σ s ^ p.val) =
      T.pField p y true s ^ p.val + T.pField p y false s ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.finite_cubic
statement:
theorem finite_cubic (h : ℕ+) (hp : p.val = heightExponent h)
    (hH : T.Initial H) (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0) (hy : ∀ s ∈ H, y s = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (hheight : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h.val) :
    cubicConstant * T.pRootSum p y ^ 3 ≤
      ((T.pRootSum p (x+y) + T.pRootSum p (x-y)) / 2 - T.pRootSum p x) *
        max (T.pRootSum p (x+y)) (T.pRootSum p (x-y)) ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.finite_cubic_normalized
statement:
theorem finite_cubic_normalized (h : ℕ+) (hp : p.val = heightExponent h)
    (hH : T.Initial H) (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0) (hy : ∀ s ∈ H, y s = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (hheight : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h.val)
    (hM : ∀ σ, T.pRootSum p (x + signed y σ) ≤ 1) :
    cubicConstant * T.pRootSum p y ^ 3 ≤
      (T.pRootSum p (x+y) + T.pRootSum p (x-y)) / 2 - T.pRootSum p x

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.head_field_le
statement:
lemma head_field_le (σ b : Bool) (s : ι) :
    T.pField p x b s ≤ T.pField p (x + signed y σ) b s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.heightExponent_le_two
statement: lemma heightExponent_le_two (h : ℕ+) : heightExponent h ≤ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.heightExponent_pow_le_exp
statement: lemma heightExponent_pow_le_exp (h : ℕ+) : heightExponent h ^ h.val ≤ Real.exp 1

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.holder_powers
statement:
lemma holder_powers {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (a d : ι → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ a i) (hd : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ d i) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, a i ^ (p-1) * d i ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, a i ^ p) ^ ((p-1)/p) * (∑ i ∈ s, d i ^ p) ^ (1/p)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.holder_powers_two
statement:
lemma holder_powers_two {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p)
    (a d : Bool → ι → ℝ) (ha : ∀ σ i, 0 ≤ a σ i) (hd : ∀ σ i, 0 ≤ d σ i) :
    ∑ σ, ∑ i ∈ s, a σ i ^ (p-1) * d σ i ≤
      (∑ σ, ∑ i ∈ s, a σ i ^ p) ^ ((p-1)/p) *
      (∑ σ, ∑ i ∈ s, d σ i ^ p) ^ (1/p)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.increment_nonneg
statement: lemma increment_nonneg (σ : Bool) (s : ι) : 0 ≤ increment T p H x y σ s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.layer_increment
statement:
lemma layer_increment (_hp : 1 < p.val) (σ : Bool) (s : ι) (hs : s ∈ H) :
    ∑ c ∈ T.children s, increment T p H x y σ c ^ p.val ≤
      p.val * coefficient T p H x y σ s ^ (p.val-1) * increment T p H x y σ s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.outside_field_eq
statement:
lemma outside_field_eq (σ b : Bool) (s : ι) (hs : s ∉ H) :
    T.pField p (x + signed y σ) b s = T.pField p (signed y σ) b s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.prefix_child_increment
statement:
lemma prefix_child_increment (σ : Bool) (s : ι) (_hs : s ∈ H) (c : ι) (hc : c ∈ T.children s) :
    T.pField p (x + signed y σ) (T.tightLabel p x s) c =
      T.pField p x (T.tightLabel p x s) c + increment T p H x y σ c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.recurrenceCeiling_one_le
statement: lemma recurrenceCeiling_one_le : 1 ≤ recurrenceCeiling

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.recurrenceCeiling_pos
statement: lemma recurrenceCeiling_pos : 0 < recurrenceCeiling

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.recurrence_coefficient_le
statement:
lemma recurrence_coefficient_le {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    p * (3 : ℝ) ^ ((p-1)/p) ≤ recurrenceCeiling ^ (p-1)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.rpow_increment_le
statement:
lemma rpow_increment_le {p a d : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    (a+d)^p - a^p ≤ p * (a+d)^(p-1) * d

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.rpow_sub_one_mul
statement:
lemma rpow_sub_one_mul {p d : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    d ^ (p-1) * d = d ^ p

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.signed_false
statement: @[simp] lemma signed_false (y : ι → ℝ) : signed y false = -y

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.signed_smul
statement:
lemma signed_smul {ι : Type uIndex} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (a : ℝ) (y : ι → ℝ) (σ : Bool) :
    signed (a • y) σ = a • signed y σ

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.signed_true
statement: @[simp] lemma signed_true (y : ι → ℝ) : signed y true = y

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.tailFlux_dominates
statement: lemma tailFlux_dominates (b : Bool) (s : ι) : T.pField p y b s ^ p.val ≤ tailFlux T p H y s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.tailFlux_head_terminal
statement:
lemma tailFlux_head_terminal {h : ℕ} (hheight : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h)
    (s : ι) (hs : s ∈ T.headLevel H h) : tailFlux T p H y s = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.tailFlux_local
statement:
lemma tailFlux_local (s : ι) (hs : s ∈ H) :
    tailFlux T p H y s ≤ ∑ c ∈ T.children s, tailFlux T p H y c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.tail_le_cutEnergy
statement:
lemma tail_le_cutEnergy (hp : 1 < p.val) {h : ℕ} (hheight : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h) :
    T.pRootSum p y ≤ 2 * cutEnergy T p.val H (increment T p H x y) h

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.total_coefficient_mass
statement:
lemma total_coefficient_mass {ι : Type uIndex} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (T : FiniteRootedTree ι)
    (p : ChildExponent) {H : Finset ι} {x y : ι → ℝ} (hH : T.Initial H) (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0)
    (_hy : ∀ s ∈ H, y s = 0) (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (hM : ∀ σ, T.pRootSum p (x + signed y σ) ≤ 1) (j : ℕ) :
    ∑ σ, ∑ s ∈ T.exitCut H j, coefficient T p H x y σ s ^ p.val ≤ 3

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.SegmentFamily.norm_column_le
statement: theorem norm_column_le (F : SegmentFamily V) (v : V) : ‖F.column v‖ ≤ 1

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.SegmentFamily.norm_test_le
statement:
theorem norm_test_le (F : SegmentFamily V) (u : V →₀ ℝ) :
    ‖F.test u‖ ≤ ∑ v ∈ u.support, |u v|

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.SegmentFamily.seminorm_sq
statement:
theorem seminorm_sq (F : SegmentFamily V) (u : V →₀ ℝ) :
    F.seminorm u ^ 2 = ∑ S : F.sets, (∑ v ∈ S.val, u v) ^ 2

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.SegmentFamily.singleton_seminorm
statement:
theorem singleton_seminorm (v : V) (u : V →₀ ℝ) :
    (singleton v).seminorm u = |u v|

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.SegmentFamily.test_apply
statement:
theorem test_apply (F : SegmentFamily V) (u : V →₀ ℝ) (S : F.sets) :
    F.test u S = ∑ v ∈ S.val, u v

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.abs_coord_le
statement:
theorem abs_coord_le {V : Type*} [SegmentSystem V] (u : V →₀ ℝ) (v : V) :
    |u v| ≤ segmentSeminorm V u

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.forestAncestor_antisymm
statement:
theorem forestAncestor_antisymm {a b : ForestVertex}
    (hab : ForestAncestor a b) (hba : ForestAncestor b a) : a = b

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.forestAncestor_refl
statement: theorem forestAncestor_refl (v : ForestVertex) : ForestAncestor v v

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.indexed_test_bound
statement:
theorem indexed_test_bound {V ι : Type*} [SegmentSystem V] [Fintype ι]
    (u : V →₀ ℝ) (S : ι → Finset V)
    (hS : ∀ i, S i = ∅ ∨ SegmentSystem.isSegment (S i))
    (hd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (S i) (S j)) :
    ∑ i, (∑ v ∈ S i, u v) ^ 2 ≤ segmentSeminorm V u ^ 2

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.le_segmentSeminorm
statement:
theorem le_segmentSeminorm {V : Type*} [SegmentSystem V]
    (F : SegmentFamily V) (u : V →₀ ℝ) : F.seminorm u ≤ segmentSeminorm V u

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.prefix_antisymm
statement:
theorem prefix_antisymm {a b : List ℕ}
    (hab : a.IsPrefix b) (hba : b.IsPrefix a) : a = b

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.refinement_test_bound
statement:
theorem refinement_test_bound {V ι : Type*} [SegmentSystem V] [Fintype ι]
    (u : V →₀ ℝ) (S A B : ι → Finset V)
    (hd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (S i) (S j))
    (hA : ∀ i, A i ⊆ S i) (hB : ∀ i, B i ⊆ S i)
    (hAB : ∀ i, Disjoint (A i) (B i))
    (hsA : ∀ i, A i = ∅ ∨ SegmentSystem.isSegment (A i))
    (hsB : ∀ i, B i = ∅ ∨ SegmentSystem.isSegment (B i)) :
    ∑ i, ((∑ v ∈ A i, u v) ^ 2 + (∑ v ∈ B i, u v) ^ 2) ≤
      segmentSeminorm V u ^ 2

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.segmentSeminorm_apply
statement:
theorem segmentSeminorm_apply {V : Type*} [SegmentSystem V] (u : V →₀ ℝ) :
    segmentSeminorm V u = ⨆ F : SegmentFamily V, F.seminorm u

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.segmentSeminorm_eq_zero
statement:
theorem segmentSeminorm_eq_zero {V : Type*} [SegmentSystem V] (u : V →₀ ℝ) :
    segmentSeminorm V u = 0 ↔ u = 0

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.segmentTests_bdd
statement:
theorem segmentTests_bdd (V : Type*) [SegmentSystem V] :
    BddAbove (Set.range (SegmentFamily.seminorm (V := V)))

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.SegmentFamily.boundary_nonzero
statement:
theorem boundary_nonzero (F : SegmentFamily V) (p : V →₀ ℝ)
    {g : V} (hne : F.boundary p g ≠ 0) : ∃ S : F.sets, g ∈ S.val

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.SegmentFamily.boundary_of_mem
statement:
theorem boundary_of_mem (F : SegmentFamily V) (p : V →₀ ℝ)
    {g : V} (S : F.sets) (hg : g ∈ S.val) :
    F.boundary p g = ∑ v ∈ S.val, p v

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.SegmentFamily.first_le_last
statement: theorem first_le_last (F : SegmentFamily V) (S : F.sets) : F.first S ≤ F.last S

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.SegmentFamily.gate_unique
statement:
theorem gate_unique {H : Finset V} (F : SegmentFamily V) (S : F.sets)
    {g g' : V} (hg : Gate H g) (hg' : Gate H g') (hm : g ∈ S.val) (hm' : g' ∈ S.val) :
    g = g'

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.SegmentFamily.repr
statement:
theorem repr (F : SegmentFamily V) (S : F.sets) :
    S.val = Finset.Icc (F.first S) (F.last S)

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.SegmentFamily.repr_disjoint
statement:

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.matched_opposite_crossing
statement:
theorem matched_opposite_crossing {ι κ Γ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype Γ]
    {H : Finset V} (hH : Ancestral (· ≤ ·) H)
    (p : V →₀ ℝ) (hp : p.support ⊆ H)
    (a b : ι → V) (a' b' : κ → V)
    (hab : ∀ i, a i ≤ b i) (hab' : ∀ j, a' j ≤ b' j)
    (hd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (Finset.Icc (a i) (b i)) (Finset.Icc (a j) (b j)))
    (hd' : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (Finset.Icc (a' i) (b' i)) (Finset.Icc (a' j) (b' j)))
    (gate : Γ → V) (left : Γ → ι) (right : Γ → κ)
    (hl : Function.Injective left) (hr : Function.Injective right)
    (hgate : ∀ g, gate g ∉ H)
    (hmem : ∀ g, a (left g) ≤ gate g ∧ gate g ≤ b (left g))
    (hmem' : ∀ g, a' (right g) ≤ gate g ∧ gate g ≤ b' (right g))
    (hop : ∀ g, (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a (left g)) (b (left g)), p v) *
      (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a' (right g)) (b' (right g)), p v) < 0) :
    2 * ∑ g, |(∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a (left g)) (b (left g)), p v) *
        (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a' (right g)) (b' (right g)), p v)| ≤
      (segmentSeminorm V p ^ 2 - ∑ i, (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a i) (b i), p v) ^ 2) +
      (segmentSeminorm V p ^ 2 - ∑ j, (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a' j) (b' j), p v) ^ 2)

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.opposite_crossing
statement:
theorem opposite_crossing (F F' : SegmentFamily V) {H : Finset V}
    (hH : Ancestral (· ≤ ·) H) (p : V →₀ ℝ) (hp : p.support ⊆ H)
    (G : Finset V) (hG : ∀ g ∈ G, Gate H g) :
    (∑ g : G, (|F.boundary p g.val * F'.boundary p g.val| -
      F.boundary p g.val * F'.boundary p g.val)) ≤
      (segmentSeminorm V p ^ 2 - F.seminorm p ^ 2) +
      (segmentSeminorm V p ^ 2 - F'.seminorm p ^ 2)

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.opposite_split_gain
statement:
theorem opposite_split_gain {H : Finset V} (hH : Ancestral (· ≤ ·) H)
    {p : V →₀ ℝ} (hp : p.support ⊆ H) {a c g b b' : V}
    (hac : a ≤ c) (hcg : c ≤ g) (hgb : g ≤ b) (hgb' : g ≤ b')
    (hg : g ∉ H)
    (hop : (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc a b, p v) * (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc c b', p v) < 0) :
    2 * |(∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc a b, p v) * (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc c b', p v)| ≤
      (∑ v ∈ Finset.Ico a c, p v) ^ 2 + (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc c b, p v) ^ 2 -
        (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc a b, p v) ^ 2

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.segment_sum_eq_head
statement:

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.selected_split_budget
statement:
theorem selected_split_budget {ι Γ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype Γ]
    (p : V →₀ ℝ) (a b : ι → V) (hab : ∀ i, a i ≤ b i)
    (hd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (Finset.Icc (a i) (b i)) (Finset.Icc (a j) (b j)))
    (select : Γ → ι) (hinj : Function.Injective select) (cut : Γ → V)
    (hcut : ∀ g, a (select g) ≤ cut g ∧ cut g ≤ b (select g))
    (cost : Γ → ℝ) (hcost : ∀ g, 0 ≤ cost g)
    (hgain : ∀ g, cost g ≤
      (∑ v ∈ Finset.Ico (a (select g)) (cut g), p v) ^ 2 +
      (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (cut g) (b (select g)), p v) ^ 2 -
      (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a (select g)) (b (select g)), p v) ^ 2) :
    ∑ g, cost g ≤ segmentSeminorm V p ^ 2 -
      ∑ i, (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a i) (b i), p v) ^ 2

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.joint_identity
statement:
theorem joint_identity (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) {ι : Ω → Type*}
    [∀ ω, Fintype (ι ω)] (a b : (ω : Ω) → ι ω → ℝ) (r : ℝ)
    (hpair : μ.mean (fun ω => ∑ i, a ω i * b ω i) = r ^ 2) :
    μ.mean (fun ω => ∑ i, (a ω i - b ω i) ^ 2) +
      μ.mean (fun ω => r ^ 2 - ∑ i, b ω i ^ 2) =
      μ.mean (fun ω => ∑ i, a ω i ^ 2) - r ^ 2

    (∑ g, μ.mean (fun ω => |b ω g|) ^ 2) ≤
      (∑ g, μ.mean (fun ω => b ω g) ^ 2) + 2 * μ.mean L

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.absolute_mass_identity

theorem absolute_mass_identity (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (b : Ω → Γ → ℝ) :

      (∑ g, μ.mean (fun ω => b ω g) ^ 2) =
    (μ.product μ).mean (fun ω => ∑ g, (|b ω.1 g * b ω.2 g| - b ω.1 g * b ω.2 g))

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.joint_mass_bound
statement:
theorem joint_mass_bound (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (b W : Ω → Γ → ℝ) (V L : Ω → ℝ)
    (hzero : ∀ g, μ.mean (fun ω => b ω g + W ω g) = 0)
    (hW : ∀ ω, (∑ g, W ω g ^ 2) ≤ V ω)
    (hc : ∀ ω ω', (∑ g, (|b ω g * b ω' g| - b ω g * b ω' g)) ≤ L ω + L ω') :
    (∑ g, μ.mean (fun ω => |b ω g|) ^ 2) ≤ μ.mean V + 2 * μ.mean L

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.pooled_expect

theorem pooled_expect {Ω' E : Type*} [Fintype Ω'] [AddCommMonoid E] [Module ℝ E]

    (μ.pooled ν).expect (Sum.elim f g) = (1/2 : ℝ) • μ.expect f + (1/2 : ℝ) • ν.expect g

    (hbound : ∀ x ∈ s, ‖x - z‖ ≤ R)

      z + (r : ℂ) * ((Real.cos θ : ℂ) + (Real.sin θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∈ s} ≤ B) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.bad_cap_bracket
statement:
theorem bad_cap_bracket (S ν : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure S] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    {x z : ℂ} {r ρ δ T U : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδρ : δ ≤ ρ ^ 2 / 1600)
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hU : 0 < U) (hz : z ∈ thinShell x r δ)
    (hi : S (Metric.ball x (r - δ)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal T)
    (hb : ENNReal.ofReal (2 * U) < (S + ν) (thinShell x r δ \ Metric.ball z ρ)) :
    1 ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal U)⁻¹ * pairMass ν ρ δ x z +
      rayIndicator S ρ T U (200 * δ / ρ ^ 2) x z

theorem lintegral_shellMajorant (ν S : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure S]

statement:
theorem one_le_majorant_of_no_cap (ν S : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure S]
    {ρ δ T U : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδρ : δ ≤ ρ ^ 2 / 1600) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hU : 0 < U)
    {x : ℂ} {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2)
    (hν : ENNReal.ofReal U ≤ ν (thinShell x r δ))
    (hS : S (Metric.ball x (r - δ)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal T)
    (hbad : ∀ z ∈ thinShell x r δ,
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * U) < (S + ν) (thinShell x r δ \ Metric.ball z ρ)) :
    1 ≤ shellMajorant ν S ρ δ T U x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.shellMajorant_eq_bracket
statement:
theorem shellMajorant_eq_bracket (ν S : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure S]
    (ρ δ T U : ℝ) (x : ℂ) :
    shellMajorant ν S ρ δ T U x = (ENNReal.ofReal U)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ z,
      ((ENNReal.ofReal U)⁻¹ * pairMass ν ρ δ x z +
        rayIndicator S ρ T U (200 * δ / ρ ^ 2) x z) ∂ν

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.shell_concentration
statement:
theorem shell_concentration (ν S : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure S]
    {ρ δ T U : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδρ : δ ≤ ρ ^ 2 / 1600) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hU : 0 < U) :
    ∃ E : Set ℂ, MeasurableSet E ∧
      volume E ≤
        (ENNReal.ofReal U)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (ENNReal.ofReal (156 * δ / ρ) * ν univ * ν univ) +
        (ENNReal.ofReal U)⁻¹ * ((ENNReal.ofReal (6 * Real.pi) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (200 * δ / ρ ^ 2) * (1 + T / U))) * ν univ) ∧
      ∀ x ∉ E, ∀ r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2,
        ENNReal.ofReal U ≤ ν (thinShell x r δ) →
        S (Metric.ball x (r - δ)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal T →
        ∃ z ∈ thinShell x r δ,
          (S + ν) (thinShell x r δ \ Metric.ball z ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * U)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.integral_rotation
statement:
lemma integral_rotation (g : ℂ → ℝ) (x : ℂ) (r t : ℝ) :
    (∫ z in Metric.ball 0 r, g (x + rotation t z)) =
      ∫ z in Metric.ball 0 r, g (x + z)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.integral_scale_ball
statement:
lemma integral_scale_ball {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (f : ℂ → E) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    (∫ z in Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, f (t • z)) =
      (t^2)⁻¹ • ∫ z in Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) t, f z

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.integral_translate_ball
statement:
lemma integral_translate_ball {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (f : ℂ → E) (x : ℂ) (r : ℝ) :
    (∫ z in Metric.ball 0 r, f (x + z)) = ∫ y in Metric.ball x r, f y

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.real_moment_integrand
statement:
lemma real_moment_integrand (g : ℂ → ℝ) (x z : ℂ) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.rotation_apply
statement:
lemma rotation_apply (t : ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    rotation t z = ((Real.cos t : ℂ) + (Real.sin t : ℂ) * Complex.I) * z

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.rotation_norm
statement: lemma rotation_norm (t : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : ‖rotation t z‖ = ‖z‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.rotation_zero
statement: lemma rotation_zero (z : ℂ) : rotation 0 z = z

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.rotational_moment_zero
statement:
theorem rotational_moment_zero {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g)
    (x : ℂ) (r : ℝ) :
    (∫ z in Metric.ball 0 r, (fderiv ℝ g (x + z)) (Complex.I * z)) = 0

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.signedAverage_fixedDomain
statement:
lemma signedAverage_fixedDomain (g : ℂ → ℝ) (x : ℂ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.continuousOn_inverseCube

lemma continuousOn_inverseCube {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.convex_zero
statement:
lemma convex_zero {A B : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : B ≤ 0) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.cubeDensity_bound
statement:
lemma cubeDensity_bound {a b : ℝ} (ha : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ a) (hb : b ≤ 3) (hab : a < b)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.cubeDensity_integrable
statement: lemma cubeDensity_integrable {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) : Integrable (cubeDensity a b)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.cubeDensity_integral
statement:
lemma cubeDensity_integral {a b : ℝ} (ha : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ a) (hb : b ≤ 3) (hab : a < b) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.cubeDensity_nonneg
statement:
lemma cubeDensity_nonneg {a b : ℝ} (ha : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ a) (hb : b ≤ 3) (hab : a < b)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.cubeMass_lower
statement:
lemma cubeMass_lower {a b : ℝ} (ha : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ a) (hb : b ≤ 3) :
    (b-a)/27 ≤ cubeMass a b

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.cubeMass_pos
statement:
lemma cubeMass_pos {a b : ℝ} (ha : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ a) (hb : b ≤ 3) (hab : a < b) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.inverseCube_bounds
statement:
lemma inverseCube_bounds {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc ((1 : ℝ)/2) 3) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.kernel_eq_integral
statement:
lemma kernel_eq_integral {a b : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity a b M) (x y : ℂ) :
    kernel k x y = ∫ t, k t * (Metric.ball x t).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.kernel_lipschitz
statement:
lemma kernel_lipschitz {a b : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity a b M) (x : ℂ) :
