name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.kernel_one
statement:
lemma kernel_one {a b : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity a b M) (x : ℂ)
    {y : ℂ} (hy : y ∈ Metric.ball x a) : kernel k x y = 1

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.kernel_pairing
statement:
theorem kernel_pairing {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {a b : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity a b M) (x : ℂ)
    {f : ℂ → E} (hf : Integrable f) :
    (∫ y, kernel k x y • f y) = ∫ t, k t • ∫ y in Metric.ball x t, f y

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.kernel_pairing_local
statement:
theorem kernel_pairing_local {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] {a b : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity a b M) (x : ℂ)
    {f : ℂ → E} (hf : IntegrableOn f (Metric.ball x b)) :
    (∫ y, kernel k x y • f y) = ∫ t, k t • ∫ y in Metric.ball x t, f y

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.kernel_zero
statement:
lemma kernel_zero {a b : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity a b M) (x : ℂ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.tail_le_one
statement:
lemma tail_le_one {a b : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity a b M) (u : ℝ) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.tail_lipschitz
statement:
lemma tail_lipschitz {a b : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity a b M) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.tail_nonneg

lemma tail_nonneg {a b : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity a b M) (u : ℝ) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.tail_one
statement:
lemma tail_one {a b : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity a b M) {u : ℝ} (hu : u < a) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.tail_zero
statement:
lemma tail_zero {a b : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity a b M) {u : ℝ} (hu : b ≤ u) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.balanced_kernel
statement:
theorem balanced_kernel {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (x : ℂ)
    {r δ : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ' : δ ≤ 1/4)
    (hm : signedAverage g x (r-δ) ≤ signedAverage g x r)
    (hp : signedAverage g x (r+δ) ≤ signedAverage g x r) :
    ∃ k : RadiusDensity (r-δ) (r+δ) ⟨216/δ, by positivity⟩,
      (∫ y, kernel k x y • (star (y-x) * gradient g y)) = 0

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.continuous_radialDerivative
statement:
lemma continuous_radialDerivative {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (x : ℂ) :
    Continuous (radialDerivative g x)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.cubeDensity_moment_integrable
statement:
lemma cubeDensity_moment_integrable {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (x : ℂ)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    Integrable (fun t => cubeDensity a b t • moment g x t)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.cubeDensity_moment_integral
statement:
lemma cubeDensity_moment_integral {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (x : ℂ)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (∫ t, cubeDensity a b t • moment g x t) =
      (((Real.pi / cubeMass a b) * (signedAverage g x b - signedAverage g x a) : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.gradient_hasCompactSupport
statement:
lemma gradient_hasCompactSupport {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hc : HasCompactSupport g) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.integral_radialDerivative
statement:
lemma integral_radialDerivative {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (x : ℂ)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (∫ t in Icc a b, radialDerivative g x t) = signedAverage g x b - signedAverage g x a

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.moment_coefficient
statement:
lemma moment_coefficient {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (x : ℂ)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) : (moment g x t).re / (Real.pi * t^3) = radialDerivative g x t

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.moment_density_integrable
statement:
lemma moment_density_integrable {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (hc : HasCompactSupport g) (x : ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun y => star (y-x) * gradient g y)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.moment_eq
statement:
lemma moment_eq {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (x : ℂ)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    moment g x t = ((Real.pi * t^3 * radialDerivative g x t : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.ErrorPiece.mass_nonneg
statement: lemma ErrorPiece.mass_nonneg {Cs : ℝ} (b : ErrorPiece Cs) : 0 ≤ b.mass

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.bounded_pairing
statement:
lemma bounded_pairing {b F : ℂ → ℂ} (hb : Integrable b) {M : ℝ}

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.coarseMass_bound
statement:
lemma coarseMass_bound {Cs α δ : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) : coarseMass b δ univ ≤ errorPrice b α / δ^(2*α)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.coarseMass_nonneg
statement:
lemma coarseMass_nonneg {Cs : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (δ : ℝ) (D : Set ℂ) :
    0 ≤ coarseMass b δ D

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.coarseMass_univ
statement:
lemma coarseMass_univ {Cs : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (δ : ℝ) :
    coarseMass b δ univ = ∑ d ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun d => δ^2 ≤ (b d).size), (b d).mass

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.coarseMeasure_apply
statement:
lemma coarseMeasure_apply {Cs : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (δ : ℝ) {D : Set ℂ}
    (hD : MeasurableSet D) : coarseMeasure b δ D = ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b δ D)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.coarse_mass_mul_le
statement:
lemma coarse_mass_mul_le {Cs α δ : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    δ^(2*α) * (∑ d ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun d => δ^2 ≤ (b d).size), (b d).mass) ≤
      errorPrice b α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.corrected_lipschitz
statement:
lemma corrected_lipschitz {F : ℂ → ℂ} {L M R H : ℝ≥0} (hF : LipschitzWith L F)
    (hM : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ M) (x z : ℂ)
    (hR : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → ‖y-x‖ ≤ R) (hH : ‖(star (z-x))⁻¹‖ ≤ H) :
    LipschitzWith (L+H*(R*L+M)) (fun y => correction x z y * F y)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.corrected_pairing_cap
statement:
lemma corrected_pairing_cap {b F : ℂ → ℂ} (hb : Integrable b) {D : Set ℂ}
    (hD : MeasurableSet D) (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1)
    (hFD : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D) (x z : ℂ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖) (hD3 : ∀ y ∈ D, ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3) :
    ‖∫ y, correction x z y*F y*b y‖ ≤
      2*ρ*(∫ y, ‖b y‖)+7*(∫ y in D \ Metric.ball z ρ, ‖b y‖)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.correction_bounded
statement:
lemma correction_bounded {x z y : ℂ} (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖)
    (hy : ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3) : ‖correction x z y‖ ≤ 7

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.correction_cap_bound
OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.correction_eq
statement:
lemma correction_eq {x z y : ℂ} (hz : z ≠ x) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.densityMeasure_apply
statement:
lemma densityMeasure_apply {b : ℂ → ℂ} (hb : Integrable b) {D : Set ℂ}

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.densityMeasure_finite
statement: lemma densityMeasure_finite {b : ℂ → ℂ} (hb : Integrable b) : IsFiniteMeasure (densityMeasure b)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.densityMeasure_univ
statement:
lemma densityMeasure_univ {b : ℂ → ℂ} (hb : Integrable b) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.errorPrice_nonneg
statement:
lemma errorPrice_nonneg {Cs : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (α : ℝ) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.fine_pairing_bound
statement:
lemma fine_pairing_bound {Cs α δ : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs)
    (hα : α ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    {L : ℝ≥0} {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : LipschitzWith L F) :
    ‖∑ d ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun d => (b d).size < δ^2), ∫ y, F y*(b d).density y‖ ≤
      (L : ℝ)*Cs*δ^(2*(1-α))*errorPrice b α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.fine_size_sum_le
statement:
lemma fine_size_sum_le {Cs α δ : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (hα : α ≤ 1)
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    (∑ d ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun d => (b d).size < δ^2), (b d).size*(b d).mass) ≤
      δ^(2*(1-α))*errorPrice b α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.increment_bound
statement:
lemma increment_bound {Cs α δ : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs)
    (hα : α ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    {L : ℝ≥0} {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : LipschitzWith L F) {D : Set ℂ} (hD : MeasurableSet D)
    (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) (hFD : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D) :
    ‖∑ d, ∫ y, F y*(b d).density y‖ ≤
      coarseMass b δ D+(L : ℝ)*Cs*δ^(2*(1-α))*errorPrice b α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.integrable_lip_mul
OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.lip_cancellation
statement:
lemma lip_cancellation {b F : ℂ → ℂ} (hb : Integrable b) (hzero : ∫ y, b y = 0)

    (hsupp : ∀ᵐ y, b y ≠ 0 → ‖y-z‖ ≤ s) :

statement:
lemma min_one_le_rpow {a α : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hα0 : 0 ≤ α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.moment_correction
statement:
lemma moment_correction {b F : ℂ → ℂ} (x z : ℂ)
    (hF : Integrable (fun y => F y*b y))
    (hM : Integrable (fun y => star (y-x)*F y*b y))
    (hzero : ∫ y, star (y-x)*F y*b y = 0) :
    (∫ y, F y*b y) = ∫ y, (1-star (y-x)/star (z-x))*F y*b y

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.norm_correction
statement:
lemma norm_correction {x z y : ℂ} (hz : z ≠ x) :
    ‖correction x z y‖ = ‖y-z‖ / ‖z-x‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.pairing_majorant
statement:
lemma pairing_majorant {b F : ℂ → ℂ} (hb : Integrable b) {A : Set ℂ}
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) (c d : ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ c + d*A.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y) :
    ‖∫ y, F y*b y‖ ≤ c*(∫ y, ‖b y‖)+d*(∫ y in A, ‖b y‖)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.piece_discount
statement:
lemma piece_discount {Cs α δ C : ℝ} (b : ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hα0 : 0 ≤ α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hC : 1 ≤ C) {L : ℝ≥0} {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : LipschitzWith L F)
    (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) (hLC : (L : ℝ) * Cs ≤ C / δ) :
    ‖∫ y, F y * b.density y‖ ≤ C * (b.size / δ) ^ α * b.mass

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.position_lipschitz
statement:

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.supported_pairing

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.total_pairing_discount
statement:
lemma total_pairing_discount {Cs α δ C : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hα0 : 0 ≤ α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)

OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.measurableSet_shellPairs

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.difference_bound

statement:
lemma difference_support {r δ ε : ℝ} {M N : ℝ≥0}

lemma corrected_increment_bound {Cs α δ ρ : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs)
    (hα : α ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    {L : ℝ≥0} {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : LipschitzWith L F) {D : Set ℂ} (hD : MeasurableSet D)
    (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) (hFD : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D) (x z : ℂ)
    (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖) (hD3 : ∀ y ∈ D, ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3)
    (hzero : ∑ d, ∫ y, star (y-x)*F y*(b d).density y = 0) :
    ‖∑ d, ∫ y, F y*(b d).density y‖ ≤
      2*ρ*coarseMass b δ univ+7*coarseMass b δ (D \ Metric.ball z ρ)+
      ((L : ℝ)+2*(3*(L : ℝ)+1))*Cs*δ^(2*(1-α))*errorPrice b α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.size_step
statement:
theorem size_step {Cs α δ ρ U : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hα : α ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1) (hδρ : δ ≤ ρ^2/1600) (hU : 0 < U) :
    ∃ E : Set ℂ, MeasurableSet E ∧
      volume E ≤
        (ENNReal.ofReal U)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
          (ENNReal.ofReal (156*δ/ρ)*ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b δ univ)*ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b δ univ)) +
        (ENNReal.ofReal U)⁻¹ *
          ((ENNReal.ofReal (6*Real.pi)*ENNReal.ofReal (2*(200*δ/ρ^2)))*ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b δ univ)) ∧
      ∀ x ∉ E, ∀ r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2, ∀ (L : ℝ≥0) (F : ℂ → ℂ),
        LipschitzWith L F → (∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) →
        (∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → y ∈ thinShell x r δ) →
        (U ≤ coarseMass b δ (thinShell x r δ) →
          (∑ d, ∫ y, star (y-x)*F y*(b d).density y) = 0) →
        ‖∑ d, ∫ y, F y*(b d).density y‖ ≤
          2*ρ*coarseMass b δ univ+14*U+
            ((L : ℝ)+2*(3*(L : ℝ)+1))*Cs*δ^(2*(1-α))*errorPrice b α

      ((ENNReal.ofReal (6*Real.pi)*ENNReal.ofReal (2*(200*δ/(δ^(1/5 : ℝ))^2)))*ENNReal.ofReal M) ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal (156*(A/t)^2*δ^(14/25 : ℝ)+2400*Real.pi*(A/t)*δ^(9/25 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.size_endpoint_raw
statement:
theorem size_endpoint_raw {Cs d t : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hdq : d ≤ 1/4)
    (hgeom : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ d → δ ≤ (δ^(1/5 : ℝ))^2/1600)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t)
    {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) :
    ∃ E : Set ℂ, MeasurableSet E ∧
      volume E ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, (
        (ENNReal.ofReal (t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ)))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
          (ENNReal.ofReal (156*width d n/(width d n)^(1/5 : ℝ))*
            ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b (width d n) univ)*ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b (width d n) univ)) +
        (ENNReal.ofReal (t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ)))⁻¹ *
          ((ENNReal.ofReal (6*Real.pi)*ENNReal.ofReal (2*(200*width d n/((width d n)^(1/5 : ℝ))^2)))*
            ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b (width d n) univ)) +
        ENNReal.ofReal (24*Real.pi*width d n)*ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b (width d n) univ)/
          ENNReal.ofReal (t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ))) ∧
      ∀ x ∉ E,
        (∀ᵐ y, y ∈ Metric.ball x 3 → ∑ j, (b j).density y = gradient g y) →
        ∀ r, EndpointRadius g x r →
        ‖∫ y in Metric.ball x r, gradient g y‖ ≤
          (1+216*Cs)/d^(1/100 : ℝ)*errorPrice b (1/100)+
          (16+4538*Cs)*t*d^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.size_sequence
statement:
theorem size_sequence {Cs d t : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hdq : d ≤ 1/4)
    (hgeom : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ d → δ ≤ (δ^(1/5 : ℝ))^2/1600)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t) :
    ∃ E : Set ℂ, MeasurableSet E ∧
      volume E ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, (
        (ENNReal.ofReal (t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ)))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
          (ENNReal.ofReal (156*width d n/(width d n)^(1/5 : ℝ))*
            ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b (width d n) univ)*ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b (width d n) univ)) +
        (ENNReal.ofReal (t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ)))⁻¹ *
          ((ENNReal.ofReal (6*Real.pi)*ENNReal.ofReal (2*(200*width d n/((width d n)^(1/5 : ℝ))^2)))*
            ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b (width d n) univ))) ∧
      ∀ x ∉ E, ∀ r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2,
        ∀ k : ∀ n : ℕ, RadiusDensity (r-width d n) (r+width d n)
          ⟨216/width d n, div_nonneg (by norm_num) (width_pos hd n).le⟩,
        (∀ n, t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ) ≤ coarseMass b (width d n) (thinShell x r (width d n)) →
          (∑ j, ∫ y, star (y-x)*((kernel (k (n+1)) x y : ℂ)-kernel (k n) x y)*(b j).density y) = 0) →
        ‖∑ j, ∫ y in Metric.ball x r, (b j).density y‖ ≤
          (1+216*Cs)/d^(1/100 : ℝ)*errorPrice b (1/100)+
          (16+4538*Cs)*t*d^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ))

statement:

        ∀ x ∉ E,

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.cone_corrected_cap

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.cone_pairing
statement:
lemma cone_pairing {e : ℂ} {κ : ℝ} (a : ConeDensity e κ)
    {K : ℂ → ℝ} (hK : AEStronglyMeasurable K) (hK0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ K y)
    (hK1 : ∀ y, K y ≤ 1) :
    κ*(∫ y, K y*‖a.density y‖) ≤ inner ℝ e (∫ y, (K y : ℂ)*a.density y)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.convex_pairing
statement:
lemma convex_pairing {a : ℂ → ℂ} {K L : ℂ → ℝ}
    (hiK : Integrable (fun y => (K y : ℂ)*a y))
    (hiL : Integrable (fun y => (L y : ℂ)*a y)) (θ : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, ((θ*K y+(1-θ)*L y : ℝ) : ℂ)*a y) =
      θ • (∫ y, (K y : ℂ)*a y)+(1-θ) • (∫ y, (L y : ℂ)*a y)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.corrected_error_bound
statement:
lemma corrected_error_bound {Cs α δ ρ : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs)
    (hα : α ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    {L : ℝ≥0} {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : LipschitzWith L F) {D : Set ℂ} (hD : MeasurableSet D)
    (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) (hFD : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D) (x z : ℂ)
    (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖) (hD3 : ∀ y ∈ D, ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3) :
    ‖∑ d, ∫ y, correction x z y*F y*(b d).density y‖ ≤
      2*ρ*coarseMass b δ univ+7*coarseMass b δ (D \ Metric.ball z ρ)+
      ((L : ℝ)+2*(3*(L : ℝ)+1))*Cs*δ^(2*(1-α))*errorPrice b α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.corrected_inactive_bound
statement:
lemma corrected_inactive_bound {Cs α δ : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs)
    (hα : α ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    {L : ℝ≥0} {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : LipschitzWith L F) {D : Set ℂ} (hD : MeasurableSet D)
    (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) (hFD : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D) (x z : ℂ)
    (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖) (hD3 : ∀ y ∈ D, ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3) :
    ‖∑ d, ∫ y, correction x z y*F y*(b d).density y‖ ≤
      7*coarseMass b δ D+((L : ℝ)+2*(3*(L : ℝ)+1))*Cs*δ^(2*(1-α))*errorPrice b α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.correction_kernel_bound
statement:
lemma correction_kernel_bound {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.crossing_interpolation
statement:
lemma crossing_interpolation (e p q : ℂ) (hq : inner ℝ e q < 0) :
    ∃ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ ∧ θ ≤ 1 ∧
      inner ℝ e (θ • p+(1-θ) • q) ≤ 0 ∧
      max 0 (-inner ℝ e (θ • p+(1-θ) • q)) = max 0 (-inner ℝ e p)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.increment_bound_general
statement:
lemma increment_bound_general {Cs α δ M : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs)
    (hα : α ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    {L : ℝ≥0} {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : LipschitzWith L F) {D : Set ℂ} (hD : MeasurableSet D)
    (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ M) (hFD : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D) :
    ‖∑ d, ∫ y, F y*(b d).density y‖ ≤
      M*coarseMass b δ D+(L : ℝ)*Cs*δ^(2*(1-α))*errorPrice b α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.inner_unit_bound
statement: lemma inner_unit_bound {e p : ℂ} (he : ‖e‖ = 1) : |inner ℝ e p| ≤ ‖p‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.negative_gap_cap
statement:
lemma negative_gap_cap {e : ℂ} {κ B ρ H : ℝ} (a : ConeDensity e κ)
    (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    {K L : ℂ → ℝ} (hK : AEStronglyMeasurable K) (hL : AEStronglyMeasurable L)
    (hK0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ K y) (hK1 : ∀ y, K y ≤ 1)
    (hL0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ L y) (hL1 : ∀ y, L y ≤ 1)
    {D : Set ℂ} (hD : MeasurableSet D) (hsupp : ∀ y, L y-K y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D)
    (x z : ℂ) (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖) (hD3 : ∀ y ∈ D, ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3)
    (hcap : (∫ y in D \ Metric.ball z ρ, ‖a.density y‖) ≤ H)
    {p q R : ℂ} (hp : ‖p‖ ≤ B) (hq : ‖q‖ ≤ B)
    (hneg : inner ℝ e ((∫ y, (L y : ℂ)*a.density y)+q) < 0)
    (hcor : ((∫ y, (L y : ℂ)*a.density y)+q)-((∫ y, (K y : ℂ)*a.density y)+p) =
      (∫ y, correction x z y*((L y : ℂ)-K y)*a.density y)+R) :
    max 0 (-inner ℝ e ((∫ y, (L y : ℂ)*a.density y)+q)) ≤
      max 0 (-inner ℝ e ((∫ y, (K y : ℂ)*a.density y)+p))+
        4*ρ*(B/κ)+7*H+‖R‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.negative_projection_change
statement:
lemma negative_projection_change (e p q : ℂ) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.negative_projection_le_norm

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.balanced_kernel_gap_identity
statement:
lemma balanced_kernel_gap_identity {Cs : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) {a : ℂ → ℂ}
    (ha : Integrable a) {r δ ε : ℝ} {M N : ℝ≥0}
    (k : RadiusDensity (r-δ) (r+δ) M) (l : RadiusDensity (r-ε) (r+ε) N)
    (x z : ℂ) (hrδ : r+δ ≤ 3) (hrε : r+ε ≤ 3) (hεδ : ε ≤ δ)
    (hMk : (∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel k x y : ℂ)*a y)+
      (∑ j, ∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel k x y : ℂ)*(b j).density y) = 0)
    (hMl : (∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel l x y : ℂ)*a y)+
      (∑ j, ∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel l x y : ℂ)*(b j).density y) = 0) :
    ((∫ y, (kernel l x y : ℂ)*a y)+(∑ j, ∫ y, (kernel l x y : ℂ)*(b j).density y))-
      ((∫ y, (kernel k x y : ℂ)*a y)+(∑ j, ∫ y, (kernel k x y : ℂ)*(b j).density y)) =
    (∫ y, correction x z y*((kernel l x y : ℂ)-kernel k x y)*a y)+
      (∑ j, ∫ y, correction x z y*((kernel l x y : ℂ)-kernel k x y)*(b j).density y)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.cone_negative_le_error
statement:

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.corrected_kernel_gap
statement:
lemma corrected_kernel_gap {Cs d t r : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hdq : d ≤ 1/4) (hr : r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2)
    (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t)
    (k : ∀ n : ℕ, RadiusDensity (r-width d n) (r+width d n)
      ⟨216/width d n, div_nonneg (by norm_num) (width_pos hd n).le⟩) (x z : ℂ) {j n : ℕ} (hjn : j < n)
    (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖)
    (hcap : coarseMass b (width d j) (thinShell x r (width d j) \ Metric.ball z ((width d j)^(1/5 : ℝ))) ≤
      2*(t*(width d j)^(1/10 : ℝ)))
    (hsmall : ∀ i, j < i → i < n → coarseMass b (width d i) (thinShell x r (width d i)) ≤
      t*(width d i)^(1/10 : ℝ)) :
    ‖∑ v, ∫ y, correction x z y*((kernel (k n) x y : ℂ)-kernel (k j) x y)*(b v).density y‖ ≤
      (16+4538*Cs)*t*(width d j)^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.corrected_kernel_integrable
statement:
lemma corrected_kernel_integrable {a : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a)
    {r δ : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity (r-δ) (r+δ) M) (x z : ℂ)
    (hr : r+δ ≤ 3) (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖) :
    Integrable (fun y => correction x z y*(kernel k x y : ℂ)*a y)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.corrected_kernel_pairing_sub
statement:
lemma corrected_kernel_pairing_sub {a : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a)
    {r δ ε : ℝ} {M N : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity (r-δ) (r+δ) M)
    (l : RadiusDensity (r-ε) (r+ε) N) (x z : ℂ)
    (hrδ : r+δ ≤ 3) (hrε : r+ε ≤ 3) (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖) :
    (∫ y, correction x z y*(kernel l x y : ℂ)*a y)-
      (∫ y, correction x z y*(kernel k x y : ℂ)*a y) =
      ∫ y, correction x z y*((kernel l x y : ℂ)-kernel k x y)*a y

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.correcting_pairing
statement:
lemma correcting_pairing {a F : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a)
    (hF : AEStronglyMeasurable F) (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) (x z : ℂ)
    (hsupp : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3) :
    (∫ y, correction x z y*F y*a y) = (∫ y, F y*a y) -
      (star (z-x))⁻¹*(∫ y, star (y-x)*F y*a y)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.general_kernel_pairing_sub

lemma general_kernel_pairing_sub {a : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.inactive_kernel_distance
statement:
lemma inactive_kernel_distance {Cs d t r : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)

    (hsmall : coarseMass b (width d n) (thinShell x r (width d n)) ≤ t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ)) :
    dist (∑ j, ∫ y, (kernel (k n) x y : ℂ)*(b j).density y)
      (∑ j, ∫ y, (kernel (k (n+1)) x y : ℂ)*(b j).density y) ≤

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.kernel_gap_errors
statement:
lemma kernel_gap_errors {Cs d t r : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1) (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t)
    (k : ∀ n : ℕ, RadiusDensity (r-width d n) (r+width d n)
      ⟨216/width d n, div_nonneg (by norm_num) (width_pos hd n).le⟩) (x : ℂ) {j n : ℕ} (hjn : j < n)
    (hsmall : ∀ i, j < i → i < n → coarseMass b (width d i) (thinShell x r (width d i)) ≤
      t*(width d i)^(1/10 : ℝ)) :
    let B := (2*(1+216*Cs)+(16+4538*Cs)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ)))*t*(width d j)^(-(1/50 : ℝ))
    ‖∑ v, ∫ y, (kernel (k j) x y : ℂ)*(b v).density y‖ ≤ B ∧
    ‖∑ v, ∫ y, (kernel (k n) x y : ℂ)*(b v).density y‖ ≤ B

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.moment_kernel_pairing_sub
statement:
lemma moment_kernel_pairing_sub {a : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a)

statement:
lemma direction_cap_scale {Cs κ δ t : ℝ} (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    4*δ^(1/5 : ℝ)*((errorGapConstant Cs*t*δ^(-(1/50 : ℝ)))/κ)+14*(t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ))+
      (16+4538*Cs)*t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ)) ≤
      directionGapConstant Cs κ*t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.direction_shell_tail_scaled
statement:
lemma direction_shell_tail_scaled {A t δ M H : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M) (hH : 0 ≤ H)
    (hM : M ≤ A*δ^(-(1/50 : ℝ))) :
    (ENNReal.ofReal (t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ)))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
      (ENNReal.ofReal (156*δ/δ^(1/5 : ℝ))*ENNReal.ofReal M*ENNReal.ofReal M) +
    (ENNReal.ofReal (t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ)))⁻¹ *
      ((ENNReal.ofReal (6*Real.pi)*ENNReal.ofReal
        (2*(200*δ/(δ^(1/5 : ℝ))^2)*(1+(H*t*δ^(-(1/50 : ℝ)))/(t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ)))))*ENNReal.ofReal M) ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal ((1+H)*(156*(A/t)^2*δ^(14/25 : ℝ)+2424*Real.pi*(A/t)*δ^(9/25 : ℝ)))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.direction_start_identity
statement:

    t*((1+216*Cs)*(A/t)^(99/100 : ℝ)+
      directionGapConstant Cs κ*(A/t)^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ)))

          directionGapConstant Cs κ*δ^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ)) ≤ 1)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.direction_raw
statement:
theorem direction_raw {e : ℂ} {κ Cs d t : ℝ} (a : ConeDensity e κ)
    (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hdq : d ≤ 1/4)
    (hgeom : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ d → δ ≤ (δ^(1/5 : ℝ))^2/1600)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t)
    {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) :
    ∃ E : Set ℂ, MeasurableSet E ∧
      volume E ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, directionShellBound b κ t (width d n) ∧
      ∀ x ∉ E,
        (∀ᵐ y, y ∈ Metric.ball x 3 → a.density y+∑ j, (b j).density y = gradient g y) →
        ∀ r, NeighborhoodRadius g x r →
        max 0 (-inner ℝ e (∫ y in Metric.ball x r, gradient g y)) ≤
          (1+216*Cs)/d^(1/100 : ℝ)*errorPrice b (1/100)+
          directionGapConstant Cs κ*t*d^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.direction_sequence
statement:
theorem direction_sequence {e : ℂ} {κ Cs d t : ℝ} (a : ConeDensity e κ)
    (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hdq : d ≤ 1/4)
    (hgeom : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ d → δ ≤ (δ^(1/5 : ℝ))^2/1600)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t) :
    ∃ E : Set ℂ, MeasurableSet E ∧
      volume E ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, directionShellBound b κ t (width d n) ∧
      ∀ x ∉ E, ∀ r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2,
        ∀ k : ∀ n : ℕ, RadiusDensity (r-width d n) (r+width d n)
          ⟨216/width d n, div_nonneg (by norm_num) (width_pos hd n).le⟩,
        (∀ n, (∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel (k n) x y : ℂ)*a.density y)+
          (∑ v, ∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel (k n) x y : ℂ)*(b v).density y) = 0) →
        max 0 (-inner ℝ e ((∫ y in Metric.ball x r, a.density y)+
          (∑ v, ∫ y in Metric.ball x r, (b v).density y))) ≤
          (1+216*Cs)/d^(1/100 : ℝ)*errorPrice b (1/100)+
          directionGapConstant Cs κ*t*d^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.direction_sequence_point
statement:
lemma direction_sequence_point {Cs κ d t r : ℝ} {e : ℂ} (a : ConeDensity e κ)
    (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hdq : d ≤ 1/4) (hr : r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2)
    (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t)
    (k : ∀ n : ℕ, RadiusDensity (r-width d n) (r+width d n)
      ⟨216/width d n, div_nonneg (by norm_num) (width_pos hd n).le⟩) (x : ℂ)
    (hM : ∀ n, (∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel (k n) x y : ℂ)*a.density y)+
      (∑ v, ∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel (k n) x y : ℂ)*(b v).density y) = 0)
    (hcap : ∀ j, t*(width d j)^(1/10 : ℝ) ≤ coarseMass b (width d j) (thinShell x r (width d j)) →
      (∫ y in Metric.ball x (r-width d j), ‖a.density y‖) ≤
        (errorGapConstant Cs/κ)*t*(width d j)^(-(1/50 : ℝ)) →
      ∃ z ∈ thinShell x r (width d j),
        (∫ y in thinShell x r (width d j) \ Metric.ball z ((width d j)^(1/5 : ℝ)), ‖a.density y‖)+
        coarseMass b (width d j) (thinShell x r (width d j) \ Metric.ball z ((width d j)^(1/5 : ℝ))) ≤
          2*(t*(width d j)^(1/10 : ℝ))) :
    max 0 (-inner ℝ e ((∫ y in Metric.ball x r, a.density y)+(∑ v, ∫ y in Metric.ball x r, (b v).density y))) ≤
      (1+216*Cs)/d^(1/100 : ℝ)*errorPrice b (1/100)+
      directionGapConstant Cs κ*t*d^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ))

statement:
theorem positive_residual {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α}
    {h : α → ℝ} (hh : Integrable h μ) (hc : 0 ≤ ∫ x, h x ∂μ) :
    ∃ ρ : α → ℝ, Integrable ρ μ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x) ∧
      (∀ x, ρ x ≤ max (h x) 0) ∧ (∫ x, ρ x ∂μ) = ∫ x, h x ∂μ ∧
      (∫ x, |h x-ρ x| ∂μ) = (∫ x, |h x| ∂μ) - ∫ x, h x ∂μ ∧
      (∀ x, h x = 0 → ρ x = 0)

OAI.SignedDisk.ScalarCancellation.refinement_residual
statement:
theorem refinement_residual {α ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α}
    [Fintype ι] (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (ρ : ι → α → ℝ)
    (hρ : ∀ i, Integrable (ρ i) μ) :
    ∃ R β : α → ℝ, Integrable R μ ∧ Integrable β μ ∧
      (∀ x, (∑ i, w i*ρ i x) = R x+β x) ∧
      (∫ x, R x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i*(∫ x, ρ i x ∂μ) ∧
      (∫ x, β x ∂μ) = 0 ∧
      (∫ x, |R x| ∂μ) = |∑ i, w i*(∫ x, ρ i x ∂μ)| ∧
      (∫ x, |β x| ∂μ) ≤
        (∑ i, w i*(∫ x, |ρ i x| ∂μ))-|∑ i, w i*(∫ x, ρ i x ∂μ)| ∧
      ((0 ≤ ∑ i, w i*(∫ x, ρ i x ∂μ)) → ∀ x, 0 ≤ R x) ∧
      (∀ x, (∀ i, w i*ρ i x = 0) → R x = 0 ∧ β x = 0)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ScalarCancellation.residual_split
statement:
theorem residual_split {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α}
    {h : α → ℝ} (hh : Integrable h μ) :
    ∃ ρ β : α → ℝ, Integrable ρ μ ∧ Integrable β μ ∧
      (∀ x, h x = ρ x+β x) ∧ (∫ x, ρ x ∂μ) = ∫ x, h x ∂μ ∧
      (∫ x, β x ∂μ) = 0 ∧ (∫ x, |ρ x| ∂μ) = |∫ x, h x ∂μ| ∧
      (∫ x, |β x| ∂μ) = (∫ x, |h x| ∂μ)-|∫ x, h x ∂μ| ∧
      ((0 ≤ ∫ x, h x ∂μ) → ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x) ∧
      ((∫ x, h x ∂μ) < 0 → ∀ x, ρ x ≤ 0) ∧
      (∀ x, h x = 0 → ρ x = 0 ∧ β x = 0)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ScalarCancellation.root_spec
statement:
lemma root_spec {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f μ) :
    Integrable (root μ f) μ ∧
      (∫ x, root μ f x ∂μ) = ∫ x, f x ∂μ ∧
      (∫ x, |root μ f x| ∂μ) = |∫ x, f x ∂μ| ∧
      (∫ x, |f x-root μ f x| ∂μ) = (∫ x, |f x| ∂μ)-|∫ x, f x ∂μ| ∧
      ((0 ≤ ∫ x, f x ∂μ) → ∀ x, 0 ≤ root μ f x) ∧
      ((∫ x, f x ∂μ) < 0 → ∀ x, root μ f x ≤ 0) ∧
      (∀ x, f x = 0 → root μ f x = 0)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ScalarCancellation.errors_total_cost
statement:
theorem errors_total_cost (w : ℕ → ι → ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k q s, 0 ≤ w k q s)
    (hcol : ∀ k s, ∑ q, w k q s = 1) {f : ι → α → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ q, Integrable (f q) μ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ range (n+1), ∑ q, ∫ x, |errors μ w f k q x| ∂μ) +
      (∑ q, |∫ x, refined w f n q x ∂μ|) ≤ ∑ q, ∫ x, |f q x| ∂μ

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ScalarCancellation.errors_total_cost_le
statement:
lemma errors_total_cost_le (w : ℕ → ι → ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k q s, 0 ≤ w k q s)
    (hcol : ∀ k s, ∑ q, w k q s = 1) {f : ι → α → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ q, Integrable (f q) μ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ range (n+1), ∑ q, ∫ x, |errors μ w f k q x| ∂μ) ≤ ∑ q, ∫ x, |f q x| ∂μ

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ScalarCancellation.scalar_defect_sum
statement:
lemma scalar_defect_sum (w : ℕ → ι → ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k q s, 0 ≤ w k q s)
    (hcol : ∀ k s, ∑ q, w k q s = 1) {f : ι → α → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ q, Integrable (f q) μ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ q, ∫ x, |errors μ w f (k+1) q x| ∂μ) ≤
      (∑ q, |∫ x, refined w f k q x ∂μ|)-(∑ q, |∫ x, refined w f (k+1) q x ∂μ|)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ScalarCancellation.telescoped_decomposition
statement:
theorem telescoped_decomposition [DecidableEq ι] (w : ℕ → ι → ι → ℝ) (f : ι → α → ℝ)
    (Λ : ℕ → ℕ → ι → ι → ℝ)
    (hdiag : ∀ k q s, Λ k k q s = if q = s then 1 else 0)
    (hstep : ∀ k j q s, j ≤ k → Λ (k+1) j q s = ∑ a, w k q a*Λ k j a s)
    (k : ℕ) (q : ι) (x : α) :
    refined w f k q x = roots μ w f k q x +
      ∑ j ∈ range (k+1), ∑ s, Λ k j q s*errors μ w f j s x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.switchRow_distance
statement:
theorem switchRow_distance [DecidableEq ι] (old : ι) (sample sample' : Law κ)
    (target : κ → ι) (p : κ → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) :
    l1dist (switchRow old sample target p hp0 hp1) (switchRow old sample' target p hp0 hp1)
      ≤ 2*∑ z, |sample z-sample' z| *p z

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.switchRow_formula
statement:
lemma switchRow_formula [DecidableEq ι] (old : ι) (sample : Law κ) (target : κ → ι)
    (p : κ → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) (j : ι) :
    switchRow old sample target p hp0 hp1 j =
      delta old j+∑ z, sample z*p z*(delta (target z) j-delta old j)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.PlanePotential.green_difference_bound
statement:
theorem green_difference_bound {ψ : ℂ → ℝ} (hψm : Measurable ψ) {R X B L : ℝ}
    (hψs : ∀ z, ψ z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ ≤ R) (hψB : ∀ z, |ψ z| ≤ B)
    (hψL : ∀ u v, |ψ u-ψ v| ≤ L*‖u-v‖)
    (hM : 0 < R+X) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    {x y z : ℂ} (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ X) (hzx : z ≠ x) (hyz : ‖y-z‖ ≤ ‖z-x‖/2) :
    ‖green ψ x y-green ψ x z‖ ≤
      (8*B*(R+X)^2+(64/3:ℝ)*L*(R+X)^3)*‖y-z‖/‖z-x‖^2

name: OAI.SignedDisk.PlanePotential.kernel_lp_three_halves

theorem kernel_lp_three_halves {α β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]

    {K : α × β → ℝ≥0∞} (hK : Measurable K) {C : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hC : ∀ y, (∫⁻ x, (K (x,y))^(3/2:ℝ) ∂μ) ≤ C^(3/2:ℝ)) :
    (∫⁻ x, (∫⁻ y, K (x,y) ∂ν)^(3/2:ℝ) ∂μ) ≤ (C*ν univ)^(3/2:ℝ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.PlanePotential.green_far_column
statement:
lemma green_far_column {ψ : ℂ → ℝ} (hψm : Measurable ψ) {R X B L a : ℝ}
    (hψs : ∀ z, ψ z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ ≤ R) (hψB : ∀ z, |ψ z| ≤ B)
    (hψL : ∀ u v, |ψ u-ψ v| ≤ L*‖u-v‖)
    (hM : 0 < R+X) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (ha : 0 < a)
    (z y : ℂ) (hy : ‖y-z‖ ≤ a) :
    (∫⁻ x in {x : ℂ | ‖x‖ ≤ X ∧ 2*a < ‖x-z‖},
      (ENNReal.ofReal ‖green ψ x y-green ψ x z‖)^(3/2:ℝ)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (((8*B*(R+X)^2+(64/3:ℝ)*L*(R+X)^3)*a)^(3/2:ℝ) *
        (2*Real.pi/(2*a)))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.PlanePotential.green_near_column

    (∫⁻ x in {x : ℂ | ‖x‖ ≤ X ∧ ‖x-z‖ ≤ 2*a},
      (ENNReal.ofReal ‖green ψ x y‖)^(3/2:ℝ)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((2*B*(R+X)^2)^(3/2:ℝ)*(4*Real.pi*(4*a)^(1/2:ℝ)))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.PlanePotential.green_piece_column

lemma lintegral_norm_rpow_far {a r : ℝ} (ha : a < -2) (hr : 0 < r) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.VectorRefinement.pair_defect_bound
statement:
theorem pair_defect_bound {ι E : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (w a : ι → ℝ) (θ : ι → E) (n : E) (A : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i)
    (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hθ : ∀ i, ‖θ i‖ = 1)
    (href : A • n = ∑ i, (w i*a i) • θ i)
    {q s : ι} (hwaq : 1/4 ≤ w q) (hwas : 9/64 ≤ w s) (has : a q ≤ a s) :
    a q*‖θ q-θ s‖^2 ≤ 48*((∑ i, w i*a i)-A)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.VectorRefinement.quadratic_defect
statement:
theorem quadratic_defect {ι E : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (w a : ι → ℝ) (θ : ι → E) (n : E) (A : ℝ)
    (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hθ : ∀ i, ‖θ i‖ = 1)
    (href : A • n = ∑ i, (w i*a i) • θ i) :
    (∑ i, w i*a i)-A = (1/2:ℝ)*∑ i, w i*a i*‖θ i-n‖^2

name: OAI.SignedDisk.PlanePotential.cancelled_potential_lp
statement:
theorem cancelled_potential_lp {ψ : ℂ → ℝ} {β : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hψm : Measurable ψ) {R X B L a : ℝ}
    (hψs : ∀ z, ψ z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ ≤ R) (hψB : ∀ z, |ψ z| ≤ B)
    (hψL : ∀ u v, |ψ u-ψ v| ≤ L*‖u-v‖)
    (hM : 0 < R+X) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (ha : 0 < a)
    (z : ℂ) (hβ : Integrable β) (hβs : ∀ y, β y ≠ 0 → ‖y-z‖ ≤ a) :
    (∫⁻ x in {x : ℂ | ‖x‖ ≤ X},
      (ENNReal.ofReal |∫ y, ⟪cancelledGreen ψ z a x y,β y⟫|)^(3/2:ℝ)) ≤
    (ENNReal.ofReal ((2*B*(R+X)^2)^(3/2:ℝ)*(4*Real.pi*(4*a)^(1/2:ℝ))) +
    ENNReal.ofReal (((8*B*(R+X)^2+(64/3:ℝ)*L*(R+X)^3)*a)^(3/2:ℝ) *
        (2*Real.pi/(2*a)))) * (ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y, ‖β y‖))^(3/2:ℝ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.PlanePotential.column_scaling

      (D*a)^(3/2:ℝ)*(2*Real.pi/(2*a)) =
      (8*Real.pi*K^(3/2:ℝ)+Real.pi*D^(3/2:ℝ))*a^(1/2:ℝ)

    (hM : 0 < R+X) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (ha : 0 < a)
    (z : ℂ) (hβ : Integrable β) (hzero : ∫ y, β y = 0)
    (hβs : ∀ y, β y ≠ 0 → ‖y-z‖ ≤ a) :
    (∫⁻ x in {x : ℂ | ‖x‖ ≤ X},
      (ENNReal.ofReal |∫ y, ⟪green ψ x y,β y⟫|)^(3/2:ℝ)) ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal ((8*Real.pi*(2*B*(R+X)^2)^(3/2:ℝ)+
      Real.pi*(8*B*(R+X)^2+(64/3:ℝ)*L*(R+X)^3)^(3/2:ℝ))*a^(1/2:ℝ)) *

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LabelSwitches.count_energy

theorem count_energy (mark sw : ℕ → Bool) (E : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) {c : ℝ}

    (hsep : ∀ i j, i < j → j < n → sw i = true → sw j = true →
      ∃ k, i ≤ k ∧ k ≤ j ∧ (mark k = true ∨ c < E k)) :
    ((count sw n : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 1+2*((count mark n : ℕ) : ℝ)+(2/c)*∑ i ∈ range n, E i

OAI.SignedDisk.PlanePotential.green_finite_decomposition
statement:
theorem green_finite_decomposition {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {ψ g : ℂ → ℝ} (hψ : Continuous ψ) (hψc : HasCompactSupport ψ)
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) {D R X Y B : ℝ}
    (hD : ∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ g y‖ ≤ D) (hψ1 : ∫ z, ψ z = 1)
    (hψs : ∀ z, ψ z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ ≤ R) (hψB : ∀ z, |ψ z| ≤ B)
    (hRX : R ≤ X) (hM : 0 < R+X) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hXY : 0 < X+Y)
    (β : ι → ℂ → ℂ) (hβ : ∀ i, Integrable (β i))
    (hβs : ∀ i y, β i y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ Y)
    (hdecomp : ∀ᵐ y, ‖y‖ ≤ X → gradient g y = ∑ i, β i y) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict {x : ℂ | ‖x‖ ≤ X},
      g x-∫ z, ψ z*g z = ∑ i, ∫ y, ⟪green ψ x y,β i y⟫

    (∫ y, ⟪green ψ x y,gradient g y⟫) = g x-∫ z, ψ z*g z

    (hr : r ∈ Icc a b) (hc : ∀ y, ContinuousOn (fun t => u t y) (Icc a b))
    (he : envelope u a b x = u r x)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.probability_compare

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.probability_le_one
statement: lemma probability_le_one (τ d : ℝ) : probability τ d ≤ 1

statement:
lemma probability_le_rate_energy {τ r E : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (hr : 0 < r)

    (z : ℤ × ℤ) (hz : boxNorm (point r z-q) ≤ 200*r) :
    probability τ ‖n-Θ z‖ ≤ 2*switchRate τ r Θ n y+8*τ⁻¹^2*E

OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_component_lipschitz
statement:
lemma spatialRow_component_lipschitz (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) {r B : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hpB : ∀ z, p z ≤ B) (j : ι) :
    LipschitzWith (Real.toNNReal (16*B/r)) (fun x => spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x j)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_distance
statement:
lemma spatialRow_distance (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) {r B : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hpB : ∀ z, p z ≤ B) (x y : ℂ) :
    l1dist (spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x) (spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r y) ≤
      (Fintype.card ι:ℝ)*(16*B/r)*‖x-y‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_formula
statement:
lemma spatialRow_formula (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ) (j : ι) :
    spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x j =
      delta old j+interpolate r (fun z => p z*(delta (target z) j-delta old j)) x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_local_derivative
statement:
lemma spatialRow_local_derivative (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) {r B : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    {q x : ℂ} (hx : boxNorm (x-q) < 199*r)
    (hpB : ∀ z, boxNorm (point r z-q) ≤ 200*r → p z ≤ B) :
    r*∑ j : ι, ‖gradient (fun y => spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r y j) x‖ ≤
      16*(Fintype.card ι:ℝ)*B

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_local_distance
statement:
lemma spatialRow_local_distance (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) {r B : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    {q x y : ℂ} (hx : boxNorm (x-q) < 199*r) (hy : boxNorm (y-q) < 199*r)
    (hpB : ∀ z, boxNorm (point r z-q) ≤ 200*r → p z ≤ B) :
    l1dist (spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x) (spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r y) ≤
      (Fintype.card ι:ℝ)*(16*B/r)*‖x-y‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_truncate
statement:
lemma spatialRow_truncate (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) {q x : ℂ}
    (hx : boxNorm (x-q) < 199*r) (j : ι) :
    spatialRow old target (truncate r q p) (truncate_nonneg r q hp0)
      (truncate_le (by norm_num) (fun z _ => hp1 z)) r x j =
    spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x j

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialSwitchRow_local_derivative
statement:
lemma spatialSwitchRow_local_derivative {τ r E : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (hr : 0 < r) (hE0 : 0 ≤ E)
    (label : ι → ℂ) (Θ : ℤ × ℤ → ℂ) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (old : ι)
    (θ q x y : ℂ) (hx : boxNorm (x-q) < 199*r) (hy : boxNorm (y-q) < 199*r)
    (hE : ∀ z, boxNorm (point r z-q) ≤ 200*r → ‖Θ z-θ‖^2 ≤ E) :
    r*∑ j : ι, ‖gradient (fun x => spatialSwitchRow τ r label Θ target old x j) x‖ ≤
      16*(Fintype.card ι:ℝ)*(2*switchRate τ r Θ (label old) y+8*τ⁻¹^2*E)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialSwitchRow_local_distance
statement:
lemma spatialSwitchRow_local_distance {τ r E : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (hr : 0 < r) (hE0 : 0 ≤ E)
    (label : ι → ℂ) (Θ : ℤ × ℤ → ℂ) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (old : ι)
    (θ q x y : ℂ) (hx : boxNorm (x-q) < 199*r) (hy : boxNorm (y-q) < 199*r)
    (hE : ∀ z, boxNorm (point r z-q) ≤ 200*r → ‖Θ z-θ‖^2 ≤ E) :
    l1dist (spatialSwitchRow τ r label Θ target old x) (spatialSwitchRow τ r label Θ target old y) ≤
      (Fintype.card ι:ℝ)*
        (16*(2*switchRate τ r Θ (label old) y+8*τ⁻¹^2*E)/r)*‖x-y‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.switchRate_local_compare
statement:
lemma switchRate_local_compare {τ r E : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (hr : 0 < r)

statement:
lemma scale_discount {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) {j k : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.scale_ratio

lemma scale_ratio {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) {j k : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_mixture
statement:
lemma spatialRow_mixture (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ) (j : ι) :
    spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x j =
      interpolate r (fun z => (1-p z)*delta old j+p z*delta (target z) j) x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_vanish
statement:
lemma spatialRow_vanish (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)

    (hj : ∀ z, hat r z x ≠ 0 → (1-p z)*delta old j+p z*delta (target z) j = 0) :
    spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x j = 0

name: OAI.SignedDisk.PricePieces.errorPiece_mass
statement:
lemma errorPiece_mass {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ)) {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Integrable h)
    (hsupp : ∀ y, h y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) (k j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k) (p : ℂ) (q : Grid N)
    {n : ℂ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) {s : ℝ} (hs : s^2 = 1) :
    (errorPiece hh hr k j hj p q n s).mass ≤ (scale r k)⁻¹*
      (2*densityDefect N r (fun x => coordinate n s (h x)) j q)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.law_drift
statement:
lemma law_drift {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (h : ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℤ × ℤ)
    {x : ℂ} (hx : boxNorm (x-point r q) ≤ 50*r)
    (hE : energy h r q ≤ (1/1000:ℝ)^2) {anchor : ℂ}
    (ha : ‖theta h r q-anchor‖ ≤ 1/800) (μ : Law Label) :
    expect (move μ (row h r x)) (badWeight anchor)+expect μ (rate h r x) =
      expect μ (badWeight anchor)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.row_drift
statement:
theorem row_drift {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (h : ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℤ × ℤ)
    {x : ℂ} (hx : boxNorm (x-point r q) ≤ 50*r)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.switchCost_sum
statement:
theorem switchCost_sum (h : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℕ → ℝ) (q : ℕ → ℤ × ℤ) (x : ℂ)
    (anchor : ℕ → ℂ) (exceptional : ℕ → Bool) {b m : ℕ} (hbm : b ≤ m)
    (hr : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico b m, 0 < r (k+1))
    (hx : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico b m, boxNorm (x-point (r (k+1)) (q (k+1))) ≤ 50*r (k+1))
    (hE : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico b m, exceptional (k+1) = false →
      energy h (r (k+1)) (q (k+1)) ≤ (1/1000:ℝ)^2)
    (ha : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico b m, exceptional (k+1) = false →
      anchor (k+1) = anchor k ∧ ‖theta h (r (k+1)) (q (k+1))-anchor k‖ ≤ 1/800) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico b m, switchCost h r x (k+1)) ≤
      1+2*∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico b m, if exceptional (k+1) then (1:ℝ) else 0

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_absorbing
statement:
lemma spatialRow_absorbing (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ)
    (b : ι → ℝ) (hb : b old = 0 ∨ b old = 1)
    (ht : ∀ z, hat r z x ≠ 0 → b (target z) = 0)
    (hz : b old = 0 → ∀ z, hat r z x ≠ 0 → p z = 0) :
    expect (spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x) b+interpolate r p x = b old

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_expect
statement:
lemma spatialRow_expect (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ) (f : ι → ℝ) :
    expect (spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x) f =
      f old+interpolate r (fun z => p z*(f (target z)-f old)) x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.IntrinsicMarks.anchor_step
statement:
lemma anchor_step (e : E) (δ : ℝ) (t : Tree ι E) (n : E) (p : List ι)
    (hp : validPath t p) {s : ℕ} (hs : s < p.length)
    (hm : markIndicator e δ t n (p.take (s+1)) = 0) :
    anchor e δ t n (p.take (s+1)) = anchor e δ t n (p.take s) ∧
      ‖direction e (vector (atPath t (p.take (s+1))))-anchor e δ t n (p.take s)‖ ≤ δ

statement:
lemma badPiece_mass {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ)) {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Integrable h)
    (hsupp : ∀ y, h y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) (k : ℕ) (p : ℂ) (S : Finset (Grid N))
    {n : ℂ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) :
    (badPiece hr hh k p S n).mass ≤ (scale r k)⁻¹*4*badPrice h r k S n

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.discounted_smallPiece_mass
statement:
lemma discounted_smallPiece_mass {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ)) {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Integrable h)
    (hsupp : ∀ y, h y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) (k : ℕ) (p : ℂ) (S : Finset (Grid N))
    {n : ℂ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (i : ErrorIndex N k) :
    (smallPiece hh hr k p S n i).size^(1/100:ℝ)*(smallPiece hh hr k p S n i).mass ≤
      (scale r k)⁻¹*2*(rho^(k-i.1)*
        (rootWeight S k i.1 i.2.1*densityDefect N r (fun x => coordinate n (sign i.2.2) (h x)) i.1 i.2.1))

    rootSum h r k (goodRoots h r k S n) n y+rootSum h r k (badRoots h r k S n) n y = rootSum h r k S n y

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.smallPiece_mass
statement:
lemma smallPiece_mass {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ)) {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Integrable h)
    (hsupp : ∀ y, h y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) (k : ℕ) (p : ℂ) (S : Finset (Grid N))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.smallPiece_pair_sum
statement:
lemma smallPiece_pair_sum {N : ℕ} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Integrable h)
    (k : ℕ) (p : ℂ) (S : Finset (Grid N)) (n : ℂ) (j : Fin (k+1)) (q : Grid N) (X : ℂ) :
    (∑ b : Bool, (smallPiece hh hr k p S n (j,q,b)).density X) =
      rootWeight S k j q • rescale p (scale r k) (errorVector N r h j q n) X

    gradient (fun Y => g (p+r • Y)) X = rescale p r (gradient g) X

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.cellPrice_budget
statement:
theorem cellPrice_budget {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ)) {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Integrable h)
    (hsupp : ∀ y, h y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) (m : ℕ) (P : ℕ → Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) :
    (∑ k ∈ range (m+1), ∑ p ∈ P k, cellPrice N r h k (cellRoots N p)) ≤
      1681*((fixedPalette.labels.card:ℝ)*2/(1-rho))*(∫ y, ‖h y‖)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.directional_cell_price
statement:
theorem directional_cell_price : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ))
    {g : ℂ → ℝ}, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → Integrable (gradient g) →
    (∀ y, gradient g y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) → ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    {n : ℂ}, n ∈ fixedPalette.labels → ∀ {s : ℝ}, (s = 1 ∨ s = -1) →
    ∀ Q : Set ℂ, volume Q ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 1 →
    ∃ F : ℂ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable F ∧
      (∫⁻ X in Q, F X) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C*(scale r k)⁻¹*
        (badPrice (gradient g) r k (cellRoots N p) n+cellPrice N r (gradient g) k (cellRoots N p))) ∧
      ∀ X, ‖X‖ ≤ 2 → ∀ t,
        NeighborhoodRadius (fun Y => g (point (scale r k) p+scale r k • Y)) X t →
        ENNReal.ofReal (max 0 (-inner ℝ (axis n s)
          (∫ Y in Metric.ball X t, gradient (fun Z => g (point (scale r k) p+scale r k • Z)) Y))) ≤ F X

    {g : ℂ → ℝ}, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → Integrable (gradient g) →

lemma green_root_lp_local {ψ : ℂ → ℝ} {β : ℂ → ℂ}

    (hψs : ∀ z, ψ z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ ≤ R) (hψB : ∀ z, |ψ z| ≤ B)
    (hRX : R ≤ X) (hM : 0 < R+X) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hX : 0 < X)
    (hβ : Integrable β) :
    (∫⁻ x in {x : ℂ | ‖x‖ ≤ X}, (ENNReal.ofReal |∫ y, ⟪green ψ x y,β y⟫|)^(3/2:ℝ)) ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal ((2*B*(R+X)^2)^(3/2:ℝ)*(4*Real.pi*(4*X)^(1/2:ℝ))) *
      (ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y, ‖β y‖))^(3/2:ℝ)

    (hψs : ∀ z, ψ z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ ≤ R) (hψB : ∀ z, |ψ z| ≤ B)
    (hψL : ∀ u v, |ψ u-ψ v| ≤ L*‖u-v‖)
    (hM : 0 < R+X) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (ha : 0 < a)
    (z : ℂ) (hβ : Integrable β) (hzero : ∫ y, β y = 0)
    (hβs : ∀ᵐ y, β y ≠ 0 → ‖y-z‖ ≤ a) :
    (∫⁻ x in {x : ℂ | ‖x‖ ≤ X},
      (ENNReal.ofReal |∫ y, ⟪green ψ x y,β y⟫|)^(3/2:ℝ)) ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal ((8*Real.pi*(2*B*(R+X)^2)^(3/2:ℝ)+
      Real.pi*(8*B*(R+X)^2+(64/3:ℝ)*L*(R+X)^3)^(3/2:ℝ))*a^(1/2:ℝ)) *
      (ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y, ‖β y‖))^(3/2:ℝ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.physical_size_price
statement:
theorem physical_size_price : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ))
    {g : ℂ → ℝ}, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → Integrable (gradient g) →
    (∀ y, gradient g y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) →
    (∃ D : ℝ, ∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ g y‖ ≤ D) → ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    {n : ℂ}, n ∈ fixedPalette.labels →
    ∃ F : ℂ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable F ∧
      (∫⁻ y in cell (point (scale r k) p) (scale r k), F y) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
        (C*(rootMass (gradient g) r k (cellRoots N p)+cellPrice N r (gradient g) k (cellRoots N p))) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ cell (point (scale r k) p) (scale r k), ∀ t,
        PhysicalEndpointRadius g (scale r k) y t →
        ENNReal.ofReal ‖gradient (fun z => signedAverage g z t) y‖ ≤ F y

lemma potential_divergence {g : ℂ → ℝ} {r : ℕ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g)
    (hgc : HasCompactSupport g) (hr : ∀ k, 0 < r k) (p : List Label) (x : ℂ)
    (hd : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → DifferentiableAt ℝ (runEnvelope g r i j) x) :
    divergence (fun y => potential g r y p) x =
      ((runs p).map fun a => inner ℝ (a.dir:ℂ)
        (gradient (runEnvelope g r a.first a.last) x-gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y (r a.first)) x)).sum

name: OAI.SignedDisk.SignedRuns.run_unfavorable_bound
statement:
lemma run_unfavorable_bound {g : ℂ → ℝ} {r : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (hc : HasCompactSupport g)
    (hr : ∀ k, 0 < r k) (hstep : ∀ k, 2*r (k+1) = r k)
    (H : ℕ → Label → ℝ) (J : ℕ → ℝ) (hH : ∀ k n, 0 ≤ H k n) (hJ : ∀ k, 0 ≤ J k)
    (x : ℂ) (n : Label) {i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≤ j)
    (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (runEnvelope g r i j) x)
    (hinterior : ∀ k t, PhysicalNeighborhoodRadius g (r k) x t →
      unfavorable n (gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x) ≤ H k n)
    (hend : ∀ k t, PhysicalEndpointRadius g (r k) x t →
      ‖gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x‖ ≤ J k) :
    unfavorable n (gradient (runEnvelope g r i j) x) ≤
      (∑ k ∈ Icc i j, H k n)+2*(J i+J j)

    (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (hc : HasCompactSupport g)
    (hr : ∀ k, 0 < r k) (hstep : ∀ k, 2*r (k+1) = r k)
    (H : ℕ → Label → ℝ) (J : ℕ → ℝ) (hH : ∀ k n, 0 ≤ H k n) (hJ : ∀ k, 0 ≤ J k)
    (old : Label) (m : ℕ) (x : ℂ)
    (hd : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → DifferentiableAt ℝ (runEnvelope g r i j) x)
    (hinterior : ∀ k n t, PhysicalNeighborhoodRadius g (r k) x t →
      unfavorable n (gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x) ≤ H k n)
    (hend : ∀ k t, PhysicalEndpointRadius g (r k) x t →
      ‖gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x‖ ≤ J k) :
    ‖gradient (runEnvelope g r 0 m) x‖ ≤ 12*(
      leafSum (fun q => weight h r old x q*divergence (fun y => potential g r y q) x) (m+1) []+
      (∑ k ∈ range (m+1), expect (marginal h r k x) (H k))+
      3*(∑ k ∈ range (m+1), boundaryCost h r x m k*J k))

    (hend : ∀ k t, PhysicalEndpointRadius g (r k) x t →
      ‖gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x‖ ≤ J k) :
    ((runs (n::p)).map fun a => coneContribution a.dir (gradient (runEnvelope g r a.first a.last) x)).sum ≤

      ((runs (n::p)).map fun a => J a.first).sum+

OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.MatrixEnergy.contraction_deficit_identity
statement:
lemma contraction_deficit_identity
    (x : ι → ℝ) (y : κ → ℝ) (m n : ι → κ → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) (hy : ∀ j, 0 < y j)
    (hn : ∀ i j, n i j = m i j * y j / x i)
    (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, n i j = 1) (hcol : ∀ j, ∑ i, n i j = 1) :
    (∑ j, potential (y j)) - (∑ i, potential (x i)) =
      (∑ i, ∑ j, n i j * scalarRemainder (y j) (x i)) +
      (∑ i, (1 - ∑ j, m i j) * weight (x i)) / 2 +
      (∑ j, (1 - ∑ i, m i j) * weight (y j)) / 2

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.MatrixEnergy.contraction_spectral_bound
statement:
lemma contraction_spectral_bound
    (x : ι → ℝ) (y : κ → ℝ) (m n : ι → κ → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) (hy : ∀ j, 0 < y j)
    (hm : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ m i j)
    (hmrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, m i j ≤ 1) (hmcol : ∀ j, ∑ i, m i j ≤ 1)
    (hn : ∀ i j, n i j = m i j * y j / x i)
    (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, n i j = 1) (hcol : ∀ j, ∑ i, n i j = 1) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, m i j * (1 + y j) * (cutoff (x i) - cutoff (y j)) ^ 2) +
      (∑ i, (1 - ∑ j, m i j) * cutoff (x i) ^ 2) +
      (∑ j, (1 - ∑ i, m i j) * (1 + y j) * cutoff (y j) ^ 2) ≤
        115200 * ((∑ j, potential (y j)) - (∑ i, potential (x i)))

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.MatrixEnergy.gain_deficit_identity
statement:
lemma gain_deficit_identity
    (x : ι → ℝ) (y : κ → ℝ) (m n : ι → κ → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i)
    (hn : ∀ i j, n i j = m i j * y j / x i)
    (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, m i j = 1) (hcol : ∀ j, ∑ i, m i j = 1) :
    (∑ i, potential (x i)) - (∑ j, potential (y j)) =
      (∑ i, ∑ j, m i j * scalarRemainder (x i) (y j)) +
      (∑ i, (1 - ∑ j, n i j) * weight (x i)) / 2 +
      (∑ j, (1 - ∑ i, n i j) * weight (y j)) / 2

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.MatrixEnergy.gain_spectral_bound
statement:
lemma gain_spectral_bound
    (x : ι → ℝ) (y : κ → ℝ) (m n : ι → κ → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) (hy : ∀ j, 0 < y j)
    (hm : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ m i j)
    (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, m i j = 1) (hcol : ∀ j, ∑ i, m i j = 1)
    (hn : ∀ i j, n i j = m i j * y j / x i)
    (hnrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, n i j ≤ 1) (hncol : ∀ j, ∑ i, n i j ≤ 1) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, m i j * (1 + y j) * (cutoff (x i) - cutoff (y j)) ^ 2) +
      (∑ i, x i * (1 - ∑ j, n i j) * cutoff (x i) ^ 2) ≤
        115200 * ((∑ i, potential (x i)) - (∑ j, potential (y j)))

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Spectral.cfc_mixed_basis
statement:
lemma cfc_mixed_basis {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (f g : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix ι ι ℝ).transpose * (cfc f A - cfc g B) *
        hB.eigenvectorUnitary =
      diagonal (fun i => f (hA.eigenvalues i)) * overlapBasis hA hB -
        (overlapBasis hA hB : Matrix ι ι ℝ) * diagonal (fun j => g (hB.eigenvalues j))

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Spectral.cfc_mixed_basis_apply
statement:
lemma cfc_mixed_basis_apply {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (i j : ι) :
    ((hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix ι ι ℝ).transpose * (cfc f A - cfc g B) *
        hB.eigenvectorUnitary) i j =
      (f (hA.eigenvalues i) - g (hB.eigenvalues j)) * overlapBasis hA hB i j

OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Spectral.trace_cfc_product
statement:
lemma trace_cfc_product {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (f g : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (cfc f A * cfc g B).trace = ∑ i, ∑ j,
      (overlapBasis hA hB i j) ^ 2 * f (hA.eigenvalues i) * g (hB.eigenvalues j)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Spectral.trace_cfc_remainder
statement:
lemma trace_cfc_remainder {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (f f' : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (cfc f A).trace - (cfc f B).trace - (cfc f' B * (A - B)).trace =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (overlapBasis hA hB i j) ^ 2 *
        (f (hA.eigenvalues i) - f (hB.eigenvalues j) -
         f' (hB.eigenvalues j) * (hA.eigenvalues i - hB.eigenvalues j))

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Spectral.trace_conjugate
statement:
lemma trace_conjugate (U : unitaryGroup ι ℝ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Spectral.trace_convex_monotone
statement:
lemma trace_convex_monotone {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hAB : A ≤ B)
    (f f' : ℝ → ℝ) {S : Set ℝ}
    (hAS : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ S) (hBS : ∀ i, hB.eigenvalues i ∈ S)
    (hfp : ∀ y ∈ S, 0 ≤ f' y)
    (htan : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, f' y * (x - y) ≤ f x - f y) :
    (cfc f A).trace ≤ (cfc f B).trace

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Spectral.trace_diagonal_product
statement:
lemma trace_diagonal_product (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (a b : ι → ℝ) :
    (diagonal a * M * diagonal b * M.transpose).trace =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, a i * b j * (M i j) ^ 2

statement:
lemma trace_psd_pairing {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Spectral.trace_rpow_contraction
statement:
lemma trace_rpow_contraction {A C : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (hC : C * C.transpose ≤ 1) {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) :
    (cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ a) (C * A * C.transpose)).trace ≤

    (D * diagonal w * D.transpose).trace = ∑ i, ∑ j, w j * (D i j) ^ 2

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Spectral.trace_tangent_le
statement:
lemma trace_tangent_le {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (f f' : ℝ → ℝ)
    {S : Set ℝ} (hAS : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ S)
    (hBS : ∀ j, hB.eigenvalues j ∈ S)
    (htan : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, f' y * (x - y) ≤ f x - f y) :
    (cfc f' B * (A - B)).trace ≤ (cfc f A).trace - (cfc f B).trace

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Spectral.trace_weighted_basis
statement:
lemma trace_weighted_basis {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (U : unitaryGroup ι ℝ) (V : unitaryGroup κ ℝ)
    (D : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (w : κ → ℝ) :
    (D * ((V : Matrix κ κ ℝ) * diagonal w * (V : Matrix κ κ ℝ).transpose) *
      D.transpose).trace =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, w j * ((U : Matrix ι ι ℝ).transpose * D * (V : Matrix κ κ ℝ)) i j ^ 2

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Spectral.weighted_cfc_distance
statement:
lemma weighted_cfc_distance {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (f g w : ℝ → ℝ) :
    ((cfc f A - cfc g B) * cfc w B * (cfc f A - cfc g B).transpose).trace =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (overlapBasis hA hB i j) ^ 2 * w (hB.eigenvalues j) *
        (f (hA.eigenvalues i) - g (hB.eigenvalues j)) ^ 2

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Coefficient.contraction_endpoint
statement:
lemma contraction_endpoint {A B C : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (hC : IsUnit C) (hContract : C * C.transpose ≤ 1)
    (heq : A = C * B * C.transpose)
    (R S : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (hR : R * R.transpose = 1) (hS : S * S.transpose = 1)
    (W : Matrix κ κ ℝ) (hW : W.transpose = W)
    (hRW : R * W * R.transpose = 1 + A) (hSW : S * W * S.transpose = 1 + B)
    (hRS : R * S.transpose = C) (hRWS : R * W * S.transpose = C * (1 + B)) :
    weightedSq (lift R (cfc cutoff A) - lift S (cfc cutoff B)) W ≤
      115200 * ((cfc potential B).trace - (cfc potential A).trace)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Coefficient.endpoint_comparison
statement:
lemma endpoint_comparison {X Y Z C : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hX : X.PosDef) (hY : Y.PosDef) (hZ : Z.PosDef)
    (hC : IsUnit C) (hContract : C * C.transpose ≤ 1)
    (hZeq : Z = C * Y * C.transpose)
    (T S : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (hT : T * T.transpose = 1) (hS : S * S.transpose = 1)
    (Qold Qnew : Matrix κ κ ℝ) (hOldPSD : Qold.PosSemidef) (hNewPSD : Qnew.PosSemidef)
    (hOldS : S * Qold * S.transpose = Y) (hOldT : T * Qold * T.transpose = Z)
    (hTS : T * S.transpose = C) (hCross : T * Qold * S.transpose = C * Y)
    (hNewT : T * Qnew * T.transpose = X - Z)
    (hZero : lift S (cfc cutoff Y) * Qnew = 0) :
    weightedSq (lift T (cfc cutoff X) - lift S (cfc cutoff Y)) ((1 + Qold) + Qnew) ≤
      230400 * (((cfc potential Y).trace - (cfc potential Z).trace) +
        ((cfc potential X).trace - (cfc potential Z).trace))

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Coefficient.gain_endpoint_lift
statement:
lemma gain_endpoint_lift {X Z : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hX : X.PosDef) (hZ : Z.PosDef) (hZX : Z ≤ X)
    (R : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (hR : R * R.transpose = 1)
    (E Qold Qnew : Matrix κ κ ℝ) (hNew : Qnew.transpose = Qnew)
    (hEq : E * Qnew = 0)
    (hOld : R * Qold * R.transpose = Z) (hNewState : R * Qnew * R.transpose = X - Z) :
    weightedSq (lift R (cfc cutoff X) - lift R (cfc cutoff Z)) (1 + Qold) +
      weightedSq (lift R (cfc cutoff X) - E) Qnew ≤
      115200 * ((cfc potential X).trace - (cfc potential Z).trace)

statement:
lemma weightedSq_sub (D E : Matrix ι κ ℝ) {W : Matrix κ κ ℝ} (hW : W.transpose = W) :
    weightedSq (D - E) W = weightedSq D W + weightedSq E W -
      2 * (D * W * E.transpose).trace

OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Coefficient.weightedSq_triangle
statement:
lemma weightedSq_triangle (D E : Matrix ι κ ℝ) {W : Matrix κ κ ℝ} (hW : W.PosSemidef) :

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.congruence_inverse
OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.contraction_distance_identity
statement:
lemma contraction_distance_identity {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ]
    (x : ι → ℝ) (y : κ → ℝ) (m : ι → κ → ℝ) (f : ι → ℝ) (g : κ → ℝ)
    (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, m i j * y j = x i) :
    (∑ i, (1 + x i) * f i ^ 2) + (∑ j, (1 + y j) * g j ^ 2) -
      2 * (∑ i, ∑ j, m i j * (1 + y j) * f i * g j) =
    (∑ i, ∑ j, m i j * (1 + y j) * (f i - g j) ^ 2) +
      (∑ i, (1 - ∑ j, m i j) * f i ^ 2) +
      (∑ j, (1 - ∑ i, m i j) * (1 + y j) * g j ^ 2)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.contraction_endpoint_spectral
statement:
lemma contraction_endpoint_spectral {A B C : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (hC : IsUnit C) (hContract : C * C.transpose ≤ 1)
    (heq : A = C * B * C.transpose) :
    (cfc (fun x => (1 + x) * cutoff x ^ 2) A).trace +
      (cfc (fun x => (1 + x) * cutoff x ^ 2) B).trace -
      2 * (cfc cutoff A * C * cfc (fun x => (1 + x) * cutoff x) B * C.transpose).trace ≤
      115200 * ((cfc potential B).trace - (cfc potential A).trace)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.diag_le
statement: lemma diag_le {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hAB : A ≤ B) (i : ι) : A i i ≤ B i i

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.diagonalize
statement:
lemma diagonalize {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix ι ι ℝ).transpose * A * hA.eigenvectorUnitary =
      diagonal hA.eigenvalues

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.diagonalize_inverse
statement:
lemma diagonalize_inverse {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    (hA.1.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix ι ι ℝ).transpose * A⁻¹ * hA.1.eigenvectorUnitary =
      diagonal (fun i => (hA.1.eigenvalues i)⁻¹)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.gain_endpoint
statement:
lemma gain_endpoint {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (hBA : B ≤ A) :
    ((cfc cutoff A - cfc cutoff B) * cfc (fun (x : ℝ) => 1 + x) B *
        (cfc cutoff A - cfc cutoff B).transpose).trace +
      (cfc (fun x => cutoff x ^ 2) A * (A - B)).trace ≤
      115200 * ((cfc potential A).trace - (cfc potential B).trace)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.gain_new_coordinates
statement:
lemma gain_new_coordinates {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    (cfc (fun x => cutoff x ^ 2) A * (A - B)).trace =
      ∑ i, hA.1.eigenvalues i *
        (1 - ∑ j, (overlapBasis hA.1 hB i j) ^ 2 * hB.eigenvalues j /
          hA.1.eigenvalues i) * cutoff (hA.1.eigenvalues i) ^ 2

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.inverse_spectral
statement:
lemma inverse_spectral {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    A⁻¹ = (hA.1.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix ι ι ℝ) *
      diagonal (fun i => (hA.1.eigenvalues i)⁻¹) *
      (hA.1.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix ι ι ℝ).transpose

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.overlap_col_inverse_weight
statement:
lemma overlap_col_inverse_weight {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (hBA : B ≤ A) (j : ι) :
    ∑ i, (overlapBasis hA.1 hB.1 i j) ^ 2 / hA.1.eigenvalues i ≤
      (hB.1.eigenvalues j)⁻¹

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.overlap_conjugate
statement:
lemma overlap_conjugate {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix ι ι ℝ).transpose * B * hA.eigenvectorUnitary =
      (overlapBasis hA hB : Matrix ι ι ℝ) * diagonal hB.eigenvalues *
        (overlapBasis hA hB : Matrix ι ι ℝ).transpose

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.overlap_inverse_conjugate
statement:
lemma overlap_inverse_conjugate {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    (hB.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix ι ι ℝ).transpose * A⁻¹ * hB.eigenvectorUnitary =
      (overlapBasis hA.1 hB : Matrix ι ι ℝ).transpose *
        diagonal (fun i => (hA.1.eigenvalues i)⁻¹) * overlapBasis hA.1 hB

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.overlap_ratio_col
statement:
lemma overlap_ratio_col {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (hBA : B ≤ A) (j : ι) :
    ∑ i, (overlapBasis hA.1 hB.1 i j) ^ 2 * hB.1.eigenvalues j /
      hA.1.eigenvalues i ≤ 1

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.overlap_ratio_row
statement:
lemma overlap_ratio_row {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (hBA : B ≤ A) (i : ι) :
    ∑ j, (overlapBasis hA.1 hB.1 i j) ^ 2 * hB.1.eigenvalues j /
      hA.1.eigenvalues i ≤ 1

OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.sandwich_diagonal_apply
statement:
lemma sandwich_diagonal_apply (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (w : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) :
    (M * diagonal w * M.transpose) i i = ∑ j, (M i j) ^ 2 * w j

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.trace_cfc_mul_diag
statement:
lemma trace_cfc_mul_diag {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (B : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (cfc f A * B).trace = ∑ i, f (hA.eigenvalues i) *
      ((hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix ι ι ℝ).transpose * B * hA.eigenvectorUnitary) i i

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.trace_cfc_transport_product
statement:
lemma trace_cfc_transport_product {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (C : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (f g : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (cfc f A * C * cfc g B * C.transpose).trace = ∑ i, ∑ j,
      transportBasis hA hB C i j ^ 2 * f (hA.eigenvalues i) * g (hB.eigenvalues j)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.transport_col_bound
OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.transport_col_inverse_weight
statement:
lemma transport_col_inverse_weight {A B C : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (hC : IsUnit C)
    (heq : A = C * B * C.transpose) (j : ι) :
    ∑ i, transportBasis hA.1 hB.1 C i j ^ 2 / hA.1.eigenvalues i =
      (hB.1.eigenvalues j)⁻¹

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.transport_col_matrix
statement:
lemma transport_col_matrix {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (C : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    (transportBasis hA hB C).transpose * transportBasis hA hB C =
      (hB.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix ι ι ℝ).transpose * (C.transpose * C) *
        hB.eigenvectorUnitary

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.transport_inverse_spectral
statement:
lemma transport_inverse_spectral {A B C : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (hC : IsUnit C)
    (heq : A = C * B * C.transpose) :
    (transportBasis hA.1 hB.1 C).transpose *
      diagonal (fun i => (hA.1.eigenvalues i)⁻¹) * transportBasis hA.1 hB.1 C =
        diagonal (fun i => (hB.1.eigenvalues i)⁻¹)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.transport_ratio_col
statement:
lemma transport_ratio_col {A B C : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) (hC : IsUnit C)
    (heq : A = C * B * C.transpose) (j : ι) :
    ∑ i, transportBasis hA.1 hB.1 C i j ^ 2 * hB.1.eigenvalues j / hA.1.eigenvalues i = 1

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.transport_ratio_row
OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.transport_row_bound

statement:
lemma transport_row_matrix {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (C : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    transportBasis hA hB C * (transportBasis hA hB C).transpose =
      (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix ι ι ℝ).transpose * (C * C.transpose) *
        hA.eigenvectorUnitary

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.transport_row_weight
OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Endpoint.transport_spectral
statement:
lemma transport_spectral {A B C : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (heq : A = C * B * C.transpose) :
    transportBasis hA hB C * diagonal hB.eigenvalues * (transportBasis hA hB C).transpose =
      diagonal hA.eigenvalues

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Gain.accumulated_gain_bound
statement:
lemma accumulated_gain_bound {Y : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hY : Y.PosSemidef)
    {ps : List (Move ι)} (hp : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Admissible) {E : ℝ}
    (hcost : gainCost Y ps ≤ E) (hsmall : E ≤ 1 / (16 * gainConstant)) :
    let q := (gainConstant * E) ^ (1 / exponent)
    0 ≤ q ∧ q < 1 / 4 ∧
    (follow Y 0 ps).2 ≤ q • (1 + (follow Y 0 ps).1) ∧
    (follow Y 0 ps).2 ≤ q • (1 + ((follow Y 0 ps).1 + (follow Y 0 ps).2))

OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Coefficient.weighted_increment
statement:
lemma weighted_increment {X Y Z C : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hX : X.PosDef) (hY : Y.PosDef) (hZ : Z.PosDef)
    (hC : IsUnit C) (hContract : C * C.transpose ≤ 1)
    (hZeq : Z = C * Y * C.transpose)
    (T S : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (hT : T * T.transpose = 1) (hS : S * S.transpose = 1)
    (Qold Qnew : Matrix κ κ ℝ) (hOldPSD : Qold.PosSemidef) (hNewPSD : Qnew.PosSemidef)
    (hOldS : S * Qold * S.transpose = Y) (hOldT : T * Qold * T.transpose = Z)
    (hTS : T * S.transpose = C) (hCross : T * Qold * S.transpose = C * Y)
    (hNewT : T * Qnew * T.transpose = X - Z)
    (hZero : lift S (cfc cutoff Y) * Qnew = 0)
    (ps : List (Move ι)) (hp : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Admissible)
    (hEndX : X = finish Y ps) (hEndZ : Z = (follow Y 0 ps).1)
    {E : ℝ} (hCost : cost Y ps ≤ E) (hSmall : E ≤ 1 / (16 * gainConstant)) :
    weightedSq (lift T (cfc cutoff X) - lift S (cfc cutoff Y)) ((1 + Qold) + Qnew) ≤
      incrementConstant * (1 + (cfc sizeWeight X).trace) * E ^ (1 / exponent)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Energy.endpoint_cost
statement:
lemma endpoint_cost {Y : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hY : Y.PosSemidef) {ps : List (Move ι)}
    (hp : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Admissible) {E : ℝ} (hcost : cost Y ps ≤ E)
    (hsmall : E ≤ 1 / (16 * gainConstant)) :
    let Z := (follow Y 0 ps).1
    let X := finish Y ps
    (pTrace Y - pTrace Z) + (pTrace X - pTrace Z) ≤
      E + 16 * (gainConstant * E) ^ (1 / exponent) * (cfc sizeWeight X).trace

    let X := finish Y ps
    (pTrace Y - pTrace Z) + (pTrace X - pTrace Z) ≤
