    (hf : Fresh R ps) (q : κ → ℝ) :
    run R ps * oldQ (newSet ps) q * (run R ps).transpose =
      product ps * state q R * (product ps).transpose

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.run_state
statement:
lemma run_state {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} {ps : List (Step ι κ)} (q : κ → ℝ)
    (hf : Fresh R ps) (hd : (ps.map Step.j).Nodup) :
    state q (run R ps) = finish (state q R) (ps.map (fun p => p.move q))

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.state_posDef
statement:
lemma state_posDef {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} (hR : R * R.transpose = 1)
    {q : κ → ℝ} (hq : ∀ j, 0 < q j) : (state q R).PosDef

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.step_apply_column
statement:
lemma step_apply_column (p : Step ι κ) (R : Matrix ι κ ℝ) {j : κ}
    (hj : j ≠ p.j) (hR : ∀ i, R i j = 0) : ∀ i, p.apply R i j = 0

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.weighted_increment
statement:
lemma weighted_increment {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} (hR : R * R.transpose = 1)
    {ps : List (Step ι κ)} (hp : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Good) (hf : Fresh R ps)
    (hd : (ps.map Step.j).Nodup) {q : κ → ℝ} (hq : ∀ j, 0 < q j)
    {E : ℝ} (hCost : cost (state q R) (ps.map (fun p => p.move q)) ≤ E)
    (hSmall : E ≤ 1 / (16 * gainConstant)) :
    Coefficient.weightedSq
      (Coefficient.lift (run R ps) (cfc cutoff (state q (run R ps))) -
        Coefficient.lift R (cfc cutoff (state q R))) (1 + diagonal q) ≤
      incrementConstant * (1 + (cfc sizeWeight (state q (run R ps))).trace) *
        E ^ (1 / exponent)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Scale.dyadic_normalize
statement:
lemma dyadic_normalize {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, 1 ≤ x / (2 : ℝ) ^ k ∧ x / (2 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ 2

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Scale.gain_rate_le_size
statement:
lemma gain_rate_le_size {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    GainScalar.rate x ≤ sizeWeight x

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Scale.hasSum_decay
statement: lemma hasSum_decay : HasSum (fun n : ℤ => (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ n.natAbs) 7

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Scale.hasSum_decay_nat
statement: lemma hasSum_decay_nat : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ n) 4

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Scale.hasSum_decay_neg
statement:
lemma hasSum_decay_neg :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (-(n + 1 : ℤ)).natAbs) 3

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Scale.potential_rate_le_size
statement:
lemma potential_rate_le_size {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    PotentialScalar.rate x ≤ sizeWeight x

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Scale.size_dyadic_nat
statement:
lemma size_dyadic_nat {y : ℝ} (_hy : 0 ≤ y) (hy2 : y ≤ 2) (n : ℕ) :
    sizeWeight (y / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) ≤ 2 * (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ n

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Scale.size_dyadic_neg_nat
statement:
lemma size_dyadic_neg_nat {y : ℝ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) (n : ℕ) :
    sizeWeight (y / (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℤ))) ≤ 2 * (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ n

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Scale.size_le_inv
statement: lemma size_le_inv (x : ℝ) : sizeWeight x ≤ x⁻¹

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Scale.size_le_sqrt
statement: lemma size_le_sqrt (x : ℝ) : sizeWeight x ≤ Real.sqrt x

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Scale.size_nonneg
statement: lemma size_nonneg {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : 0 ≤ sizeWeight x

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Scale.size_normalized
statement:
lemma size_normalized {y : ℝ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hy2 : y ≤ 2) (n : ℤ) :
    sizeWeight (y / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) ≤ 2 * (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ n.natAbs

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Scale.size_shifted
statement:
lemma size_shifted {x : ℝ} {k : ℤ} (hk : 1 ≤ x / (2 : ℝ) ^ k)
    (hk2 : x / (2 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ 2) (n : ℤ) :
    sizeWeight (x / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) ≤ 2 * (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (n - k).natAbs

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Scale.sum_decay_shift
statement:
lemma sum_decay_shift (S : Finset ℤ) (k : ℤ) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (n - k).natAbs) ≤ 7

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Scale.sum_rates_dyadic
statement:
lemma sum_rates_dyadic (S : Finset ℤ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, (PotentialScalar.rate (x / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) +
      GainScalar.extendedRate (x / (2 : ℝ) ^ n))) ≤ 28

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Scale.sum_size_dyadic
statement:
lemma sum_size_dyadic (S : Finset ℤ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, sizeWeight (x / (2 : ℝ) ^ n)) ≤ 14

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.ScaleEnergy.aggregateCost_eq
statement:
lemma aggregateCost_eq {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {ps : List (Move ι)} (hp : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Admissible) (S : Finset ℤ) :
    aggregateCost S A ps = ∑ n ∈ S, (2 : ℝ) ^ n *
      cost (((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ • A) (ps.map (rescale (((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹)))

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.ScaleEnergy.aggregateCost_le_variation
statement:
lemma aggregateCost_le_variation {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {ps : List (Move ι)} (hp : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Admissible) (S : Finset ℤ) :
    aggregateCost S A ps ≤ 28 * variation A ps

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.ScaleEnergy.finish_psd
statement:
lemma finish_psd {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {ps : List (Move ι)} (hp : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Admissible) : (finish A ps).PosSemidef

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.ScaleEnergy.rescale_next
statement:
lemma rescale_next (c : ℝ) (p : Move ι) (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    (rescale c p).next (c • A) = c • p.next A

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.ScaleEnergy.rescale_old
statement:
lemma rescale_old (c : ℝ) (p : Move ι) (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    (rescale c p).old (c • A) = c • p.old A

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.ScaleEnergy.scale_energy_bound
statement:
lemma scale_energy_bound {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {ps : List (Move ι)} (hp : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Admissible) (S : Finset ℤ) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, (2 : ℝ) ^ n *
      cost (((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ • A) (ps.map (rescale (((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹)))) ≤
      28 * (A.trace + 2 * gainSum ps)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.ScaleEnergy.sum_stepCost_eq
statement:
lemma sum_stepCost_eq {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {p : Move ι} (hp : p.Admissible) (S : Finset ℤ) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, (2 : ℝ) ^ n * stepCost (rescale (((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹) p)
      (((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ • A)) =
      scaleTrace S A - scaleTrace S (p.old A) + scaleTrace S (p.next A) - scaleTrace S (p.old A)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.ScaleEnergy.variation_eq
statement:
lemma variation_eq (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (ps : List (Move ι)) :
    variation A ps = A.trace + 2 * gainSum ps - (finish A ps).trace

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.ScaleEnergy.variation_le
statement:
lemma variation_le {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {ps : List (Move ι)} (hp : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Admissible) :
    variation A ps ≤ A.trace + 2 * gainSum ps

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.ScaleMatrix.cfc_scaled
statement:
lemma cfc_scaled {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    cfc f (c • A) = cfc (fun x : ℝ => f (c * x)) A

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.ScaleMatrix.primitiveTrace_eq
statement:
lemma primitiveTrace_eq {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    primitiveTrace A = hTrace A

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.ScaleMatrix.rateMatrix_cfc
statement:
lemma rateMatrix_cfc {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (n : ℤ) :
    rateMatrix (((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ • A) =
      cfc (fun x : ℝ => PotentialScalar.rate (x / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) +
        GainScalar.extendedRate (x / (2 : ℝ) ^ n)) A

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.ScaleMatrix.scaleRate_cfc
statement:
lemma scaleRate_cfc {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (S : Finset ℤ) :
    scaleRate S A = cfc (fun x : ℝ => ∑ n ∈ S,
      (PotentialScalar.rate (x / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) +
        GainScalar.extendedRate (x / (2 : ℝ) ^ n))) A

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.ScaleMatrix.scaleRate_le
statement:
lemma scaleRate_le {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (S : Finset ℤ) :
    scaleRate S A ≤ (28 : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.ScaleMatrix.scaleTrace_charpoly
statement:
lemma scaleTrace_charpoly {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hAB : A.charpoly = B.charpoly) (S : Finset ℤ) :
    scaleTrace S A = scaleTrace S B

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.ScaleMatrix.scaleTrace_contraction_bound
statement:
lemma scaleTrace_contraction_bound {A C : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (hC : C * C.transpose ≤ 1) (T : Finset ℤ) :
    scaleTrace T A - scaleTrace T (C * A * C.transpose) ≤
      28 * (A.trace - (C * A * C.transpose).trace)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.ScaleMatrix.scaleTrace_eq
statement:
lemma scaleTrace_eq {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (S : Finset ℤ) :
    scaleTrace S A = ∑ n ∈ S, (2 : ℝ) ^ n * hTrace (((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ • A)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.ScaleMatrix.scaleTrace_mono_bound
statement:
lemma scaleTrace_mono_bound {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (hAB : A ≤ B) (S : Finset ℤ) :
    scaleTrace S B - scaleTrace S A ≤ 28 * (B.trace - A.trace)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.ScaleMatrix.trace_charpoly
statement:
lemma trace_charpoly {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hAB : A.charpoly = B.charpoly) : A.trace = B.trace

name: OAI.GaussianTail.eigenvalue_le_of_form_le
OAI.GaussianTail.gram_form
statement:
lemma gram_form (B : Matrix κ ι ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    ⟪x,toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (B.transpose*B) x⟫ = ‖matrixMap B x‖^2

name: OAI.GaussianTail.gram_trace
statement: lemma gram_trace (B : Matrix κ ι ℝ) : (B.transpose*B).trace = squareMass B

name: OAI.GaussianTail.integrable_exp_square
statement:
lemma integrable_exp_square {t : ℝ} (ht : -1 < t) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (-t * x ^ 2 / 2)) (gaussianReal 0 1)

name: OAI.GaussianTail.integral_exp_square
statement:
lemma integral_exp_square (t : ℝ) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, Real.exp (-t * x ^ 2 / 2) ∂gaussianReal 0 1) =
      (Real.sqrt (1 + t))⁻¹

name: OAI.GaussianTail.interpolated_form
statement:
lemma interpolated_form (B : Matrix κ ι ℝ) {v : ℝ} (hv : 0 ≤ v)
    (hS : squareMass B ≤ v) (hB : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι,‖matrixMap B x‖^2 ≤ 4*‖x‖^2) :
    ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι,‖matrixMap B x‖^2 ≤ (2*Real.sqrt v)*‖x‖^2

name: OAI.GaussianTail.inverse_sqrt_one_sub_le_exp
statement:
lemma inverse_sqrt_one_sub_le_exp {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hu' : u ≤ 1/2) :
    (Real.sqrt (1-u))⁻¹ ≤ Real.exp u

name: OAI.GaussianTail.norm_sq_le_squareMass
statement:
lemma norm_sq_le_squareMass (B : Matrix κ ι ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    ‖matrixMap B x‖^2 ≤ squareMass B*‖x‖^2

name: OAI.GaussianTail.quadratic_eigenbasis
statement:
lemma quadratic_eigenbasis {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    ⟪∑ i, x i • hA.eigenvectorBasis i,
      toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A (∑ i, x i • hA.eigenvectorBasis i)⟫ =
      ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues i * x i ^ 2

name: OAI.GaussianTail.quadratic_mgf_eq
statement:
lemma quadratic_mgf_eq {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι, Real.exp (⟪x, toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A x⟫ / 2)
      ∂stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) = ∏ i, (Real.sqrt (1-hA.eigenvalues i))⁻¹

name: OAI.GaussianTail.quadratic_mgf_integrable
statement:
lemma quadratic_mgf_integrable {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hEig : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i < 1) :
    Integrable (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => Real.exp (⟪x, toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A x⟫ / 2))
      (stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι))

name: OAI.GaussianTail.squareMass_nonneg
statement: lemma squareMass_nonneg (B : Matrix κ ι ℝ) : 0 ≤ squareMass B

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Energy.cost_append
statement:
lemma cost_append (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (ps qs : List (Move ι)) :

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Energy.cost_prefix
statement:
lemma cost_prefix {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) {ps qs : List (Move ι)}
    (hp : ∀ p∈qs,p.Admissible) (h : ps <+: qs) : cost A ps ≤ cost A qs

statement:

statement: lemma Step.b_square_le {p : Step ι κ} (hp : p.Good) : ∑ i,p.b i^2 ≤ 1

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.coisometry_column
statement:
lemma coisometry_column {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} (hR : R*R.transpose=1) (j : κ) :
    (∑ i,R i j^2) ≤ 1

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.coisometry_norm_le
statement: lemma coisometry_norm_le {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} (hR : R*R.transpose=1) : ‖R‖ ≤ 1

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.contraction_apply
statement:
lemma contraction_apply (b x : ι → ℝ) :
    symmetricContraction b*ᵥx = x-(eta b*(b ⬝ᵥ x)) • b

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.contraction_loss
statement:
lemma contraction_loss {b : ι → ℝ} (hb : vectorMass b≤1) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    vectorMass x-vectorMass (symmetricContraction b*ᵥx)=(b ⬝ᵥ x)^2

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.cost_prefix_difference
statement:
lemma cost_prefix_difference {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} {ps qs : List (Step ι κ)}
    (hf : Fresh R (ps++qs)) (hd : ((ps++qs).map Step.j).Nodup) (q : κ → ℝ) :
    cost (state q R) ((ps++qs).map (fun p => p.move q)) -
      cost (state q R) (ps.map (fun p => p.move q)) =
      cost (state q (run R ps)) (qs.map (fun p => p.move q))

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.cutoff_norm_le
statement: lemma cutoff_norm_le (X : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : ‖cfc cutoff X‖ ≤ 1

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.cutoff_scaled_size
statement: lemma cutoff_scaled_size {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : x*cutoff x^2 ≤ 16*sizeWeight x

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.cutoff_size
statement: lemma cutoff_size {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hf : cutoff x≠0) : 1/4 ≤ sizeWeight x

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.cutoff_square_size
statement: lemma cutoff_square_size {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : cutoff x^2 ≤ 4*sizeWeight x

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.eta_identity
statement: lemma eta_identity {b : ι → ℝ} (hb : vectorMass b≤1) : 2*eta b-eta b^2*vectorMass b=1

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.eta_le_one
statement: lemma eta_le_one (b : ι → ℝ) : eta b≤1

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.eta_pos
statement: lemma eta_pos (b : ι → ℝ) : 0<eta b

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.fresh_prefix
statement:
lemma fresh_prefix {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} {ps qs : List (Step ι κ)} (hf : Fresh R qs) (h : ps <+: qs) :
    Fresh R ps

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.gains_le_total
statement:
lemma gains_le_total {L : List (Step ι κ)} (hp : ∀ p∈L,p.Good) (hd : (L.map Step.j).Nodup)
    {q : κ → ℝ} (hq : ∀ j,0≤q j) : gainSum (L.map (fun p => p.move q)) ≤ ∑ j,q j

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.good_prefix
statement:
lemma good_prefix {ps qs : List (Step ι κ)} (hp : ∀ p∈qs,p.Good) (h : ps <+: qs) :
    ∀ p∈ps,p.Good

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.lift_cutoff_contract
statement:
lemma lift_cutoff_contract {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} (hR : R*R.transpose=1)
    {X : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (_hX : X.IsHermitian) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ κ) :
    ‖matrixMap (lift R (cfc cutoff X)) x‖^2 ≤ ‖x‖^2

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.lift_cutoff_mass
statement:
lemma lift_cutoff_mass {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} (hR : R*R.transpose=1)
    {X : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hX : X.PosSemidef) :
    squareMass (lift R (cfc cutoff X)) ≤ 4*(cfc sizeWeight X).trace

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.lift_cutoff_size
statement:
lemma lift_cutoff_size {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} {X : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hX : X.PosSemidef)
    (hf : lift R (cfc cutoff X)≠0) : 1/4 ≤ (cfc sizeWeight X).trace

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.lift_cutoff_time
statement:
lemma lift_cutoff_time {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} (hR : R*R.transpose=1)
    {q : κ → ℝ} (hq : ∀ j,0<q j) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0<θ) :
    weightedSq (lift R (cfc cutoff (state (fun j => q j/θ) R))) (diagonal q) ≤
      16*(cfc sizeWeight (state (fun j => q j/θ) R)).trace*θ

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.local_prefix_increment
statement:
lemma local_prefix_increment {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} (hR : R*R.transpose=1)
    {L : List (Step ι κ)} (hp : ∀ p∈L,p.Good) (hf : Fresh R L) (hd : (L.map Step.j).Nodup)
    {ps qs : List (Step ι κ)} (hps : ps <+: qs) (hqs : qs <+: L)
    {q : κ → ℝ} (hq : ∀ j,0<q j)
    (hsmall : cost (state q R) (qs.map (fun p => p.move q)) -
      cost (state q R) (ps.map (fun p => p.move q)) ≤ 1/(16*gainConstant)) :
    Coefficient.weightedSq
      (Coefficient.lift (run R qs) (cfc cutoff (state q (run R qs))) -
       Coefficient.lift (run R ps) (cfc cutoff (state q (run R ps)))) (1+diagonal q) ≤
      incrementConstant*(1+(cfc sizeWeight (state q (run R qs))).trace)*
      (cost (state q R) (qs.map (fun p => p.move q)) -
       cost (state q R) (ps.map (fun p => p.move q)))^(1/exponent)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.move_scale
statement:
lemma move_scale (p : Step ι κ) (q : κ → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) :
    p.move (fun j => q j/θ) = rescale θ⁻¹ (p.move q)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.moves_good
statement:
lemma moves_good {ps : List (Step ι κ)} (hp : ∀ p∈ps,p.Good) {q : κ → ℝ} (hq : ∀ j,0≤q j) :
    ∀ p∈ps.map (fun p => p.move q),p.Admissible

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.nodup_prefix
statement:
lemma nodup_prefix {ps qs : List (Step ι κ)} (hd : (qs.map Step.j).Nodup) (h : ps <+: qs) :
    (ps.map Step.j).Nodup

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.rank_square
statement: lemma rank_square (b : ι → ℝ) : vecMulVec b b*vecMulVec b b=vectorMass b • vecMulVec b b

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.run_append
statement:
lemma run_append (R : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (ps qs : List (Step ι κ)) :
    run R (ps++qs)=run (run R ps) qs

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.run_fresh_append
statement:
lemma run_fresh_append {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} {ps qs : List (Step ι κ)}
    (hf : Fresh R (ps++qs)) (hd : ((ps++qs).map Step.j).Nodup) : Fresh (run R ps) qs

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.squareMass_le_weighted
statement:
lemma squareMass_le_weighted (B : Matrix κ ι ℝ) {q : ι → ℝ} (hq : ∀ i,0 ≤ q i) :
    squareMass B ≤ weightedSq B (1+diagonal q)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.squareMass_weighted
statement: lemma squareMass_weighted (B : Matrix κ ι ℝ) : squareMass B=weightedSq B 1

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.state_trace_le
statement:
lemma state_trace_le {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} (hR : R*R.transpose=1)
    {q : κ → ℝ} (hq : ∀ j,0≤q j) : (state q R).trace ≤ ∑ j,q j

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.sum_dyadic_le
statement:
lemma sum_dyadic_le {S : Finset ℤ} {b : ℝ} (hb : 0≤b) (hS : ∀ k∈S,(2:ℝ)^k≤b) :
    (∑ k∈S,(2:ℝ)^k) ≤ 2*b

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.sum_epoch_cost
statement:
lemma sum_epoch_cost {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} (hR : R*R.transpose=1)
    {L : List (Step ι κ)} (hp : ∀ p∈L,p.Good) (hd : (L.map Step.j).Nodup)
    {q : κ → ℝ} (hq : ∀ j,0≤q j) (S : Finset ℤ) :
    (∑ k∈S,(2:ℝ)^k*cost (((2:ℝ)^k)⁻¹ • state q R)
      (L.map (fun p => p.move (fun j => q j/(2:ℝ)^k)))) ≤ 84*(∑ j,q j)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.symmetricContraction_square
statement:
lemma symmetricContraction_square {b : ι → ℝ} (hb : vectorMass b≤1) :
    symmetricContraction b*symmetricContraction b+vecMulVec b b=1

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.symmetricContraction_transpose
statement: lemma symmetricContraction_transpose (b : ι → ℝ) : (symmetricContraction b).transpose=symmetricContraction b

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.symmetricContraction_unit
statement: lemma symmetricContraction_unit {b : ι → ℝ} (hb : vectorMass b<1) : IsUnit (symmetricContraction b)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.symmetricStep_good
statement: lemma symmetricStep_good {b : ι → ℝ} (hb : vectorMass b<1) (j : κ) : (symmetricStep b j).Good

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.vectorMass_nonneg
statement: lemma vectorMass_nonneg (b : ι → ℝ) : 0≤vectorMass b

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.weightedSq_diagonal_mono
statement:
lemma weightedSq_diagonal_mono (B : Matrix κ ι ℝ) {q r : ι → ℝ}
    (hqr : ∀ i,q i ≤ r i) : weightedSq B (diagonal q) ≤ weightedSq B (diagonal r)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.insert_mulVec_eq
statement: lemma insert_mulVec_eq (b : ι → ℝ) (j : κ) (x : κ → ℝ) : insert b j*ᵥx=(x j) • b

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.insertion_budget
statement:
lemma insertion_budget {L : List (Step ι κ)} (hd : (L.map Step.j).Nodup) {B : ℝ} (hB : 0≤B)
    (hb : ∀ p∈L,vectorMass p.b≤B) (j : κ) :
    (L.map (fun p => if p.j=j then vectorMass p.b else 0)).sum ≤ B

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.noiseRow_eval
statement:
lemma noiseRow_eval {ν : Type*} [Fintype ν] [DecidableEq ν] (m : ι⊕ν → ℝ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (ι⊕ν)) (hx : ∀ i,x (Sum.inl i)=0) : rowMap (noiseRow m) x=rowMap m x

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.noiseRow_mass
statement:
lemma noiseRow_mass {ν : Type*} [Fintype ν] (m : ι⊕ν → ℝ) :
    vectorMass (noiseRow m)≤vectorMass m

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.predictorRows_get
statement:
lemma predictorRows_get (R : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (L : List (Step ι κ)) (k : ℕ) (hk : k<L.length) :
    (predictorRows R L)[k]'(by rw [predictorRows_length]; exact hk) =
      rawRow (run R (L.take k)) (L[k].b)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.predictorRows_length
statement:
lemma predictorRows_length (R : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (L : List (Step ι κ)) :
    (predictorRows R L).length=L.length

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.predictor_column_bound
statement:
lemma predictor_column_bound {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} {L : List (Step ι κ)}
    (hs : ∀ p∈L,p.C=symmetricContraction p.b) (hb : ∀ p∈L,vectorMass p.b≤1)
    (hf : Fresh R L) (hd : (L.map Step.j).Nodup) {B : ℝ} (hB : 0≤B)
    (hbB : ∀ p∈L,vectorMass p.b≤B) (j : κ) (hR : ∀ i,R i j=0) :
    ((predictorRows R L).map (fun m => m j^2)).sum ≤ B

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.predictor_column_budget
statement:
lemma predictor_column_budget {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} {L : List (Step ι κ)}
    (hs : ∀ p∈L,p.C=symmetricContraction p.b) (hb : ∀ p∈L,vectorMass p.b≤1)
    (hf : Fresh R L) (hd : (L.map Step.j).Nodup) (j : κ) :
    ((predictorRows R L).map (fun m => m j^2)).sum + vectorMass (fun i => run R L i j) ≤
      vectorMass (fun i => R i j)+(L.map (fun p => if p.j=j then vectorMass p.b else 0)).sum

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.predictor_future_zero
OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.predictor_row_bound
statement:
lemma predictor_row_bound {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} (hR : R*R.transpose=1) {L : List (Step ι κ)}
    (hp : ∀ p∈L,p.Good) (hf : Fresh R L) (hd : (L.map Step.j).Nodup)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k<L.length) :
    vectorMass ((predictorRows R L)[k]'(by rw [predictorRows_length]; exact hk)) ≤ vectorMass (L[k].b)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.rawRow_eval
statement:
lemma rawRow_eval (R : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (b : ι → ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ κ) :
    rowMap (rawRow R b) x=eta b*(b ⬝ᵥ (R*ᵥx))

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.rawRow_loss
statement:
lemma rawRow_loss {p : Step ι κ} (hs : p.C=symmetricContraction p.b) (hb : vectorMass p.b≤1)
    (R : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (hR : ∀ i,R i p.j=0) (j : κ) :
    rawRow R p.b j^2+vectorMass (fun i => p.apply R i j) ≤
      vectorMass (fun i => R i j)+(if p.j=j then vectorMass p.b else 0)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.rawRow_mass
statement:
lemma rawRow_mass {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} (hR : R*R.transpose=1) (b : ι → ℝ) :
    vectorMass (rawRow R b) ≤ vectorMass b

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.rawRow_zero_col
statement:
lemma rawRow_zero_col (R : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (b : ι → ℝ) {j : κ} (h : ∀ i,R i j=0) :
    rawRow R b j=0

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.rowMap_apply
statement: lemma rowMap_apply (m : κ → ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ κ) : rowMap m x=m ⬝ᵥ x

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.rowMap_single
statement: lemma rowMap_single (m : κ → ℝ) (j : κ) : rowMap m (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)=m j

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.rowMatrix_norm
statement:
lemma rowMatrix_norm (m : κ → ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ κ) :
    ‖matrixMap (fun _ : Unit => m) x‖=|rowMap m x|

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.run_prefix_cancel
statement:
lemma run_prefix_cancel {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → Step ι κ) (R : Matrix ι κ ℝ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ κ) (ε : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i,(p i).C=symmetricContraction (p i).b)
    (hx : ∀ i,x (p i).j=rowMap (rawRow (run R ((List.ofFn p).take i.val)) (p i).b) x+ε i)
    (k : ℕ) :
    matrixMap (run R ((List.ofFn p).take k)) x = matrixMap R x+
      ((List.ofFn (fun i => ε i • WithLp.toLp 2 (p i).b)).take k).sum

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.step_cancel
statement:
lemma step_cancel {p : Step ι κ} (hs : p.C=symmetricContraction p.b) (R : Matrix ι κ ℝ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ κ) (ε : ℝ) (hx : x p.j=rowMap (rawRow R p.b) x+ε) :
    matrixMap (p.apply R) x=matrixMap R x+ε • WithLp.toLp 2 p.b

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.vectorMass_vecMul
statement:
lemma vectorMass_vecMul {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} (hR : R*R.transpose=1) (b : ι → ℝ) :
    vectorMass (b ᵥ* R)=vectorMass b

name: OAI.GaussianAR.evaluation_coisometry
statement:
lemma evaluation_coisometry (r : ι → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i,0≤r i) (hr1 : ∀ i,r i≤1)
    (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n+1)) :
    evaluation r n t*(evaluation r n t).transpose=1

name: OAI.GaussianAR.evaluation_cross_symmetric
statement:
lemma evaluation_cross_symmetric (r : ι → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i,0≤r i) (hr1 : ∀ i,r i≤1)
    (n : ℕ) (t u : Fin (n+1)) :
    evaluation r n t*(evaluation r n u).transpose = evaluation r n u*(evaluation r n t).transpose

name: OAI.GaussianAR.evaluation_difference_covariance
statement:
lemma evaluation_difference_covariance (r : ι → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i,0≤r i) (hr1 : ∀ i,r i≤1)
    (n : ℕ) (t u : Fin (n+1)) (hu : u≤t) :
    (evaluation r n t-evaluation r n u)*(evaluation r n t-evaluation r n u).transpose =
      diagonal (fun i => 2*(1-(r i)^(t.val-u.val)))

name: OAI.GaussianAR.evaluation_mul_transpose
statement:
lemma evaluation_mul_transpose (r : ι → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i,0≤r i) (hr1 : ∀ i,r i≤1)
    (n : ℕ) (t u : Fin (n+1)) (hu : u≤t) :
    evaluation r n t*(evaluation r n u).transpose = diagonal (fun i => (r i)^(t.val-u.val))

name: OAI.GaussianAR.one_sub_pow_le
statement:
lemma one_sub_pow_le (r : ℝ) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r≤1) (t : ℕ) :
    1-r^t ≤ t*(1-r)

name: OAI.GaussianAR.row_covariance
statement:
lemma row_covariance (r : ℝ) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r≤1) (n t u : ℕ) (ht : t≤n) (hu : u≤t) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), row r t k*row r u k)=r^(t-u)

name: OAI.GaussianAR.row_covariance_fin
statement:
lemma row_covariance_fin (r : ℝ) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r≤1) (n : ℕ) (t u : Fin (n+1)) (hu : u≤t) :
    (∑ k : Fin (n+1), row r t.val k.val*row r u.val k.val)=r^(t.val-u.val)

name: OAI.GaussianAR.row_diag
statement: lemma row_diag (r : ℝ) (t : ℕ) : row r (t+1) (t+1) = Real.sqrt (1-r^2)

name: OAI.GaussianAR.row_dot_step
statement:
lemma row_dot_step (r : ℝ) (n t u : ℕ) (ht : t<n) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), row r (t+1) k*row r u k) =
      r*(∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), row r t k*row r u k)+
        Real.sqrt (1-r^2)*row r u (t+1)

name: OAI.GaussianAR.row_initial
statement: lemma row_initial (r : ℝ) (t : ℕ) : row r t 0 = r^t

name: OAI.GaussianAR.row_norm
statement:
lemma row_norm (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r ≤ 1) (n t : ℕ) (ht : t≤n) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (row r t k)^2)=1

name: OAI.GaussianAR.row_norm_fin
statement:
lemma row_norm_fin (r : ℝ) (hr : 0≤r) (hr1 : r≤1) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n+1)) :
    (∑ k : Fin (n+1), (row r t.val k.val)^2)=1

name: OAI.GaussianAR.row_support
statement: lemma row_support (r : ℝ) {t k : ℕ} (h : t<k) : row r t k=0

name: OAI.GaussianAR.squareMass_evaluation
statement:
lemma squareMass_evaluation {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (B : Matrix κ ι ℝ)
    (r : ι → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i,0≤r i) (hr1 : ∀ i,r i≤1) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n+1)) :
    squareMass (B*evaluation r n t)=squareMass B

name: OAI.GaussianAR.squareMass_time_le
statement:
lemma squareMass_time_le {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (B : Matrix κ ι ℝ)
    (r : ι → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i,0≤r i) (hr1 : ∀ i,r i≤1) (n : ℕ) (t u : Fin (n+1)) :
    squareMass (B*(evaluation r n t-evaluation r n u)) ≤
      2*|(t.val:ℝ)-u.val| * (B*diagonal (fun i => 1-r i)*B.transpose).trace

name: OAI.GaussianAR.trace_weighted_square
statement:
lemma trace_weighted_square {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (B : Matrix κ ι ℝ) (w : ι → ℝ) :
    (B*diagonal w*B.transpose).trace = ∑ i,∑ j,(B i j)^2*w j

name: OAI.GaussianTail.squareMass_add_le
statement:
lemma squareMass_add_le (B C : Matrix κ ι ℝ) :
    squareMass (B+C) ≤ 2*squareMass B+2*squareMass C

name: OAI.GaussianTail.squareMass_mul_covariance
statement:
lemma squareMass_mul_covariance (B : Matrix κ ι ℝ) (C : Matrix ι ν ℝ) :
    squareMass (B*C) = (B*(C*C.transpose)*B.transpose).trace

name: OAI.GaussianTail.squareMass_neg
statement: lemma squareMass_neg (B : Matrix κ ι ℝ) : squareMass (-B)=squareMass B

name: OAI.GaussianTail.trace_covariance
statement: lemma trace_covariance (B : Matrix κ ι ℝ) : (B*B.transpose).trace=squareMass B

name: OAI.GaussianChaining.adjacent_distance
statement:
lemma adjacent_distance (p : I → ℝ × ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, InSquare (p i)) (l : ℕ) (i : I) :
    |(p (rep p (l+1) i)).1-(p (rep p l i)).1| ≤ 2*(1/64:ℝ)^l ∧
    |(p (rep p (l+1) i)).2-(p (rep p l i)).2| ≤ 2*(1/64:ℝ)^l

name: OAI.GaussianChaining.coordinate_power_bound
statement:
lemma coordinate_power_bound (n : ℕ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ 2*(1/64:ℝ)^n) :
    a^(2/3:ℝ) ≤ 2*((1/2:ℝ)^n)^4

name: OAI.GaussianChaining.edgeSet_card
statement:
lemma edgeSet_card (B : I → Matrix κ ι ℝ) (p : I → ℝ × ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, InSquare (p i)) (l : ℕ) :
    (edgeSet B p l).card ≤ 2^(24*(l+1))

name: OAI.GaussianChaining.entropy_weight
statement:
lemma entropy_weight (j l : ℕ) :
    (2:ℝ≥0∞)^(24*(l+1)) * (1/2:ℝ≥0∞)^(exponent j l) =
      (1/2:ℝ≥0∞)^(j+l+5)

name: OAI.GaussianChaining.eventually_netEnd_eq
statement:
lemma eventually_netEnd_eq (B : I → Matrix κ ι ℝ) (p : I → ℝ × ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, InSquare (p i))
    {C : ℝ} (j : ℕ) (hdiff : ∀ i k, squareMass (B i-B k) ≤ C*((2:ℝ)^j)^2*
      (|(p i).1-(p k).1|^(2/3:ℝ)+|(p i).2-(p k).2|)) :
    ∀ᶠ l : ℕ in atTop, ∀ i, netEnd B p l i = B i

name: OAI.GaussianChaining.exp_exponent_le
statement:
lemma exp_exponent_le (j l : ℕ) :
    Real.exp (-(exponent j l : ℝ)) ≤ (1/2:ℝ)^(exponent j l)

name: OAI.GaussianChaining.exponent_le
statement: lemma exponent_le (j l : ℕ) : (exponent j l : ℝ) ≤ 30*(2:ℝ)^j*(l+1)

name: OAI.GaussianChaining.nat_add_one_le_two_pow
statement: lemma nat_add_one_le_two_pow (j : ℕ) : (j:ℝ)+1 ≤ (2:ℝ)^j

name: OAI.GaussianChaining.netEdge_operator
statement:
lemma netEdge_operator (B : I → Matrix κ ι ℝ) (p : I → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hop : ∀ i x, ‖matrixMap (B i) x‖^2 ≤ ‖x‖^2) (l : ℕ) (i : I) :
    ∀ x, ‖matrixMap (netEdge B p l i) x‖^2 ≤ 4*‖x‖^2

name: OAI.GaussianChaining.netEdge_sum
statement:
lemma netEdge_sum (B : I → Matrix κ ι ℝ) (p : I → ℝ × ℝ) (i : I) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (n+1), netEdge B p l i = netEnd B p n i

name: OAI.GaussianChaining.netEdge_variance
statement:
lemma netEdge_variance (B : I → Matrix κ ι ℝ) (p : I → ℝ × ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, InSquare (p i))
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (j : ℕ)
    (hbase : ∀ i, squareMass (B i) ≤ C*((2:ℝ)^j)^2)
    (hdiff : ∀ i k, squareMass (B i-B k) ≤ C*((2:ℝ)^j)^2*
      (|(p i).1-(p k).1|^(2/3:ℝ)+|(p i).2-(p k).2|))
    (l : ℕ) (i : I) : squareMass (netEdge B p l i) ≤ variance (64*C+1) j l

name: OAI.GaussianChaining.netEnd_norm_le
statement:
lemma netEnd_norm_le (B : I → Matrix κ ι ℝ) (p : I → ℝ × ℝ) {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (j : ℕ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)
    (h : ∀ l i, ‖matrixMap (netEdge B p l i) x‖ ≤ radius A j l) (n : ℕ) (i : I) :
    ‖matrixMap (netEnd B p n i) x‖ ≤ 400*(A+1)*(2:ℝ)^j

name: OAI.GaussianChaining.radius_nonneg
statement: lemma radius_nonneg {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (j l : ℕ) : 0 ≤ radius A j l

name: OAI.GaussianChaining.radius_sum
statement:
lemma radius_sum (A : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (∑' l : ℕ, radius A j l) = 400*(A+1)*(2:ℝ)^j

name: OAI.GaussianChaining.radius_summable
statement: lemma radius_summable (A : ℝ) (j : ℕ) : Summable (fun l : ℕ => radius A j l)

name: OAI.GaussianChaining.sizeClass_bounds
statement:
lemma sizeClass_bounds {k : ℝ} (hk : 1/4 ≤ k) :
    ((2:ℝ)^(sizeClass k))^2 ≤ 4*k ∧ k < ((2:ℝ)^(sizeClass k))^2

name: OAI.GaussianChaining.sizeClass_sqrt
statement:
lemma sizeClass_sqrt {k : ℝ} (hk : 1/4 ≤ k) :
    (2:ℝ)^(sizeClass k) ≤ 2*Real.sqrt k

name: OAI.GaussianChaining.tail_threshold_le
statement:
lemma tail_threshold_le {A : ℝ} (hA : 1 ≤ A) (j l : ℕ) :
    2*variance A j l+8*Real.sqrt (variance A j l)*(exponent j l) ≤ (radius A j l)^2

name: OAI.GaussianChaining.weight_sum_all
statement: lemma weight_sum_all : (∑' j : ℕ, (1/2:ℝ≥0∞)^(j+4)) = 1/8

name: OAI.GaussianChaining.width_le_quarter
statement: lemma width_le_quarter (n : ℕ) : (1/64:ℝ)^n ≤ ((1/2:ℝ)^n)^4

name: OAI.GaussianTail.coisometry_operator
statement:
lemma coisometry_operator (B : Matrix κ ι ℝ) (hB : B*B.transpose=1) :
    ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι, ‖matrixMap B x‖^2 ≤ ‖x‖^2

name: OAI.GaussianTail.difference_operator
statement:
lemma difference_operator (B C : Matrix κ ι ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι, ‖matrixMap B x‖^2 ≤ ‖x‖^2)
    (hC : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι, ‖matrixMap C x‖^2 ≤ ‖x‖^2) :
    ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι, ‖matrixMap (B-C) x‖^2 ≤ 4*‖x‖^2

name: OAI.GaussianTail.inner_matrixMap
statement:
lemma inner_matrixMap (B : Matrix κ ι ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ κ) :
    ⟪matrixMap B x,y⟫=⟪x,matrixMap B.transpose y⟫

name: OAI.GaussianTail.matrixMap_add
statement:
@[simp] lemma matrixMap_add (B C : Matrix κ ι ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    matrixMap (B+C) x = matrixMap B x+matrixMap C x

name: OAI.GaussianTail.matrixMap_mul
statement:
lemma matrixMap_mul (B : Matrix κ ι ℝ) (C : Matrix ι ν ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ν) :
    matrixMap (B*C) x=matrixMap B (matrixMap C x)

name: OAI.GaussianTail.matrixMap_sub
statement:
@[simp] lemma matrixMap_sub (B C : Matrix κ ι ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    matrixMap (B-C) x = matrixMap B x-matrixMap C x

name: OAI.GaussianTail.matrixMap_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma matrixMap_zero (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) : matrixMap (0 : Matrix κ ι ℝ) x = 0

name: OAI.GaussianTail.squareMass_eq_zero
statement: lemma squareMass_eq_zero {B : Matrix κ ι ℝ} (h : squareMass B = 0) : B = 0

name: OAI.GridNets.abs_sub_lt_width
statement:
lemma abs_sub_lt_width (l : ℕ) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (h : cell l a = cell l b) : |a-b| < (1/64:ℝ)^l

name: OAI.GridNets.cellPair_mem
statement:
lemma cellPair_mem {k l : ℕ} (hkl : k ≤ l) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : InSquare p) :
    cellPair k p ∈ grid l

name: OAI.GridNets.cell_le
statement: lemma cell_le (l : ℕ) {a : ℝ} (ha : a ≤ 1) : cell l a ≤ 64^l

name: OAI.GridNets.eventually_cell_separates
statement:
lemma eventually_cell_separates {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    ∀ᶠ l : ℕ in atTop, cell l a = cell l b → a = b

name: OAI.GridNets.eventually_rep_eq
statement:
lemma eventually_rep_eq (p : I → ℝ × ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, InSquare (p i)) :
    ∀ᶠ l : ℕ in atTop, ∀ i, p (rep p l i) = p i

name: OAI.GridNets.grid_card
statement: lemma grid_card (l : ℕ) : (grid l).card = (64^l+1)^2

name: OAI.GridNets.grid_card_square_le
statement: lemma grid_card_square_le (l : ℕ) : (grid l).card^2 ≤ 2^(24*(l+1))

name: OAI.GridNets.image_pair_card_le
statement:
lemma image_pair_card_le {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (p : I → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, InSquare (p i)) (l : ℕ) (f : I → I → α) :
    (Finset.univ.image (fun i => f (rep p l i) (rep p (l-1) i))).card ≤ 2^(24*(l+1))

name: OAI.GridNets.rep_cell
statement:
lemma rep_cell (p : I → ℝ × ℝ) (l : ℕ) (i : I) :
    cellPair l (p (rep p l i)) = cellPair l (p i)

name: OAI.GridNets.rep_distance
statement:
lemma rep_distance (p : I → ℝ × ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, InSquare (p i)) (l : ℕ) (i : I) :
    |(p (rep p l i)).1-(p i).1| < (1/64:ℝ)^l ∧
    |(p (rep p l i)).2-(p i).2| < (1/64:ℝ)^l

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.bernsteinP_derivative
statement:
lemma bernsteinP_derivative (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (bernsteinP (n + 1) a).derivative =
      C (n + 1 : ℝ) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        C (a (k + 1) - a k) * bernsteinPolynomial ℝ n k

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.bernsteinP_derivative_nonneg
statement:
lemma bernsteinP_derivative_nonneg (n : ℕ) (f : C(ℝ, ℝ))
    (hf : MonotoneOn f (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    0 ≤ (bernsteinP n (fun k => f ((k : ℝ) / n))).derivative.eval x

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.bernsteinP_eval_le_one
statement:
lemma bernsteinP_eval_le_one (n : ℕ) (f : C(ℝ, ℝ))
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, f x ≤ 1) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (bernsteinP n (fun k => f ((k : ℝ) / n))).eval x ≤ 1

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.bernsteinP_eval_nonneg
statement:
lemma bernsteinP_eval_nonneg (n : ℕ) (f : C(ℝ, ℝ))
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, 0 ≤ f x) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    0 ≤ (bernsteinP n (fun k => f ((k : ℝ) / n))).eval x

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.bernsteinP_tendsto
statement:
lemma bernsteinP_tendsto (f : C(ℝ, ℝ)) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (bernsteinP n (fun k => f ((k : ℝ) / n))).eval x)
      atTop (𝓝 (f x))

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.blockCov_affine
statement:
lemma blockCov_affine (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (B : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (D : Matrix κ κ ℝ)
    (t : ℝ) :
    blockCov A B D t = t • blockCov A B D 1 + (1 - t) • blockCov A B D 0

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.blockCov_diag_posDef
statement:
lemma blockCov_diag_posDef {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {B : Matrix ι κ ℝ}
    {D : Matrix κ κ ℝ} (h : (blockCov A B D 1).PosDef) : A.PosDef ∧ D.PosDef

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.blockCov_posDef
OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.blockCov_schur
statement:
lemma blockCov_schur {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef)
    (B : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (D : Matrix κ κ ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (blockCov A B D t).det = A.det * (D - t ^ 2 • (B.transpose * A⁻¹ * B)).det

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.block_marginal_eq
statement:
lemma block_marginal_eq (b : ι → Bool) (v : Bool) {R : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hR : R.PosSemidef) (S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ {i // b i = v})) (hS : MeasurableSet S) :
    (multivariateGaussian 0 (interpolate b R 0)) ((coordinateCLM Subtype.val) ⁻¹' S) =
      (multivariateGaussian 0 R) ((coordinateCLM Subtype.val) ⁻¹' S)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.block_submatrix_eq
statement:
lemma block_submatrix_eq (b : ι → Bool) (v : Bool) (R : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    (interpolate b R 0).submatrix (fun i : {i // b i = v} => i.val)
      (fun i : {i // b i = v} => i.val) =
        R.submatrix (fun i : {i // b i = v} => i.val) (fun i : {i // b i = v} => i.val)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.closed_symmetric_convex_countable_slabs
statement:
lemma closed_symmetric_convex_countable_slabs {K : Set E} (hK : IsClosed K)
    (hc : Convex ℝ K) (hs : ∀ x ∈ K, -x ∈ K) (h0 : (0:E) ∈ K) :
    ∃ (u : ℕ → E) (r : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ n, 0 ≤ r n) ∧
      K = ⋂ n, {x | |⟪u n, x⟫| ≤ r n}

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.continuous_laplaceKernel
statement: lemma continuous_laplaceKernel (z : ι → ℝ) : Continuous (laplaceKernel z)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.coordinateCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma coordinateCLM_apply (f : κ → ι) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (i : κ) :
    coordinateCLM f x i = x (f i)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.cutoffProduct_tendsto
statement:
lemma cutoffProduct_tendsto (a x : ι → ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n => continuousProduct (fun i => upperCutoff n (a i)) x) atTop
      (𝓝 ((exponentialBox a).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x))

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.det_diagonal_mul_add_one
statement:
lemma det_diagonal_mul_add_one (R : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (z : ι → ℝ) :
    (diagonal z * R + 1).det = ∑ S : Finset ι,
      (∏ i ∈ S, z i) * (R.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → ι) Subtype.val).det

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.det_diagonal_mul_add_one_pos
statement:
lemma det_diagonal_mul_add_one_pos {R : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hR : R.PosSemidef)
    {z : ι → ℝ} (hz : ∀ i, 0 ≤ z i) : 0 < (diagonal z * R + 1).det

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.det_one_add_eigenvalues
statement:
lemma det_one_add_eigenvalues {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (1 + A).det = ∏ i, (1 + hA.eigenvalues i)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.det_one_add_sqrt_sandwich
statement:
lemma det_one_add_sqrt_sandwich {R : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hR : R.PosSemidef) (z : ι → ℝ) :
    (1 + CFC.sqrt R * diagonal z * CFC.sqrt R).det = (diagonal z * R + 1).det

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.eigenvector_toEuclideanCLM
statement:
lemma eigenvector_toEuclideanCLM {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : ι) :
    toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A (hA.eigenvectorBasis i) =
      hA.eigenvalues i • hA.eigenvectorBasis i

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.gaussian_blocks_independent
statement:
lemma gaussian_blocks_independent (b : ι → Bool) {R : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hR : R.PosSemidef) :
    IndepFun (coordinatePi (fun i : {i // b i = true} => i.val))
      (coordinatePi (fun i : {i // b i = false} => i.val))
        (multivariateGaussian 0 (interpolate b R 0))

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.innerCoordinates_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma innerCoordinates_apply (u : ι → E) (x : E) (i : ι) :

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.integrable_exp_square_gaussian
statement:
lemma integrable_exp_square_gaussian {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :

statement:
lemma integrable_laplaceKernel {μ : Measure (ι → ℝ)} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.integrable_mixedPolynomial
statement:
lemma integrable_mixedPolynomial {μ : Measure (ι → ℝ)} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.integrable_quadratic_exp
statement:
lemma integrable_quadratic_exp {R : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    {z : ι → ℝ} (hz : ∀ i, 0 ≤ z i) :
    Integrable (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => Real.exp (-(∑ i, z i * x i ^ 2) / 2))
      (multivariateGaussian 0 R)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.integral_exp_square_gaussian
statement:
lemma integral_exp_square_gaussian {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, Real.exp (-t * x ^ 2 / 2) ∂gaussianReal 0 1) =
      (Real.sqrt (1 + t))⁻¹

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.interpolate_blocks
statement:
lemma interpolate_blocks (p : ι → Bool) {R : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hR : R.IsHermitian) (t : ℝ) :
    let e := Equiv.sumCompl (fun i => p i = true)
    (interpolate p R t).submatrix e e =
      blockCov (R.submatrix (Subtype.val : {i // p i = true} → ι) Subtype.val)
        (R.submatrix (Subtype.val : {i // p i = true} → ι)
          (Subtype.val : {i // ¬ p i = true} → ι))
        (R.submatrix (Subtype.val : {i // ¬ p i = true} → ι) Subtype.val) t

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.interpolate_continuous
statement:
lemma interpolate_continuous (b : ι → Bool) (t : ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun R : Matrix ι ι ℝ => interpolate b R t)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.interpolate_det_differentiable
statement:
lemma interpolate_det_differentiable (p : ι → Bool) (R : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :

statement: lemma interpolate_one (p : ι → Bool) (R : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : interpolate p R 1 = R

statement:

statement:
lemma interpolate_submatrix {η : Type*} (p : ι → Bool) (R : Matrix ι ι ℝ)

    (interpolate p R t).submatrix f f = interpolate (p ∘ f) (R.submatrix f f) t

lemma interpolate_zero_posSemidef (b : ι → Bool) {R : Matrix ι ι ℝ}

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.laplaceKernel_add
statement:
lemma laplaceKernel_add (z x y : ι → ℝ) :
    laplaceKernel z (x + y) = laplaceKernel z x * laplaceKernel z y

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.laplaceKernel_le_one
statement:
lemma laplaceKernel_le_one {z x : ι → ℝ} (hz : ∀ i, 0 ≤ z i) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) :
    laplaceKernel z x ≤ 1

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.laplaceKernel_nonneg
statement: lemma laplaceKernel_nonneg (z x : ι → ℝ) : 0 ≤ laplaceKernel z x

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.laplace_squareLaw
statement:
lemma laplace_squareLaw {R : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hR : R.PosSemidef)
    {z : ι → ℝ} (hz : ∀ i, 0 ≤ z i) :
    (∫ x, laplaceKernel z x ∂squareLaw R) =
      (Real.sqrt (diagonal z * R + 1).det)⁻¹

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.laplace_sumLaw
statement:
lemma laplace_sumLaw {μ ν : Measure (ι → ℝ)} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (z : ι → ℝ) :
    (∫ x, laplaceKernel z x ∂sumLaw μ ν) =
      (∫ x, laplaceKernel z x ∂μ) * (∫ x, laplaceKernel z x ∂ν)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.map_coordinate_multivariateGaussian
statement:
lemma map_coordinate_multivariateGaussian (f : κ → ι) {R : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hR : R.PosSemidef) :
    (multivariateGaussian 0 R).map (coordinateCLM f) =
      multivariateGaussian 0 (R.submatrix f f)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.map_innerCoordinates_stdGaussian
statement:
lemma map_innerCoordinates_stdGaussian (u : ι → E) :
    (stdGaussian E).map (innerCoordinates u) = multivariateGaussian 0 (gram ℝ u)

statement:
lemma partialSlabs_iInter (u : ℕ → E) (r : ℕ → ℝ) :

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.polynomialExpectation_continuousAt
statement:
lemma polynomialExpectation_continuousAt (p : ι → ℝ[X]) {R : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hR : R.PosSemidef) : ContinuousAt (polynomialExpectation p) R

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.quadratic_diagonal
statement:
lemma quadratic_diagonal (z : ι → ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    ⟪x, toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (diagonal z) x⟫ = ∑ i, z i * x i ^ 2

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.quadratic_eigenbasis
statement:
lemma quadratic_eigenbasis {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    ⟪∑ i, x i • hA.eigenvectorBasis i,
      toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A (∑ i, x i • hA.eigenvectorBasis i)⟫ =
      ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues i * x i ^ 2

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.quadratic_laplace_multivariateGaussian
statement:
lemma quadratic_laplace_multivariateGaussian {R : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hR : R.PosSemidef)
    {z : ι → ℝ} (hz : ∀ i, 0 ≤ z i) :
    (∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι, Real.exp (-(∑ i, z i * x i ^ 2) / 2)
      ∂multivariateGaussian 0 R) = (Real.sqrt (diagonal z * R + 1).det)⁻¹

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.quadratic_laplace_stdGaussian
statement:
lemma quadratic_laplace_stdGaussian {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    (∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι, Real.exp (-⟪x, toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A x⟫ / 2)
      ∂stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) = (Real.sqrt (1 + A).det)⁻¹

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.quadratic_sandwich
statement:
lemma quadratic_sandwich (S D : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hS : S.IsHermitian)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    ⟪toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) S x,
      toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) D (toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) S x)⟫ =
      ⟪x, toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (S * D * S) x⟫

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.schur_posDef
statement:
lemma schur_posDef {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {B : Matrix ι κ ℝ} {D : Matrix κ κ ℝ}
    (h : (blockCov A B D 1).PosDef) : (D - B.transpose * A⁻¹ * B).PosDef

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.sqrt_sandwich_psd
statement:
lemma sqrt_sandwich_psd {R : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (z : ι → ℝ) (hz : ∀ i, 0 ≤ z i) :
    (CFC.sqrt R * diagonal z * CFC.sqrt R).PosSemidef

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.squareLaw_exponentialBox
statement:
lemma squareLaw_exponentialBox (R : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (t : ι → ℝ) :
    (squareLaw R).real (exponentialBox (fun i => Real.exp (-t i))) =
      (multivariateGaussian 0 R).real (quadraticBox t)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.squareLaw_nonneg
statement:
lemma squareLaw_nonneg (R : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂squareLaw R, ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i

statement:
lemma sumLaw_nonneg {μ ν : Measure (ι → ℝ)} [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν]

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.GaussianCorrelation.upperCutoff_monotone

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.cutoff_cover
statement:
lemma cutoff_cover {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (S : Finset ℤ)
    (hS : ∀ i,∃ k∈S,1≤hA.eigenvalues i/(2:ℝ)^k ∧ hA.eigenvalues i/(2:ℝ)^k≤2) :
    (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) ≤ ∑ k∈S,cfc cutoff (((2:ℝ)^k)⁻¹ • A)*cfc cutoff (((2:ℝ)^k)⁻¹ • A)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.epochFactor_ge_one
statement: lemma epochFactor_ge_one : 1≤epochFactor

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.exists_finite_scales
statement:
lemma exists_finite_scales {T : Type*} [Fintype T] (A : T → Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ t,(A t).PosDef) :
    ∃ S : Finset ℤ, (∀ t i,∃ k∈S,1≤(hA t).1.eigenvalues i/(2:ℝ)^k ∧
      (hA t).1.eigenvalues i/(2:ℝ)^k≤2) ∧
      (∀ k∈S,∃ t i,(2:ℝ)^k≤(hA t).1.eigenvalues i)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.form_mono
statement:
lemma form_mono {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hAB : A≤B) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.lift_gram
statement:
lemma lift_gram {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} (hR : R*R.transpose=1)
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.transpose=A) :
    (lift R A).transpose*lift R A = R.transpose*(A*A)*R

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.matrixMap_mul_apply
statement:
lemma matrixMap_mul_apply {ν : Type*} [Fintype ν] [DecidableEq ν]
    (A : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (B : Matrix κ ν ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ν) :
    matrixMap (A*B) x = matrixMap A (matrixMap B x)

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.momentConstant_ge
statement: lemma momentConstant_ge : 16≤ momentConstant

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.norm_sq_reconstruct
statement:
lemma norm_sq_reconstruct {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} (hR : R*R.transpose=1)
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (S : Finset ℤ)
    (hS : ∀ i,∃ k∈S,1≤hA.eigenvalues i/(2:ℝ)^k ∧ hA.eigenvalues i/(2:ℝ)^k≤2)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ κ) :
    ‖matrixMap R x‖^2 ≤ ∑ k∈S,‖matrixMap (lift R (cfc cutoff (((2:ℝ)^k)⁻¹ • A))) x‖^2

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.reconstruction_bound
statement:
lemma reconstruction_bound {R : Matrix ι κ ℝ} (hR : R*R.transpose=1)
    {q : κ → ℝ} (hq : ∀ j,0<q j) (S : Finset ℤ)
    (hS : ∀ i,∃ k∈S,1≤(state_posDef hR hq).1.eigenvalues i/(2:ℝ)^k ∧
      (state_posDef hR hq).1.eigenvalues i/(2:ℝ)^k≤2)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ κ)
    (hx : ∀ k∈S,‖matrixMap (lift R (cfc cutoff (state (fun j => q j/(2:ℝ)^k) R))) x‖ ≤
      survivalRadius*Real.sqrt ((cfc sizeWeight (state (fun j => q j/(2:ℝ)^k) R)).trace)) :
    ‖matrixMap R x‖ ≤ stateRadius*Real.sqrt (Fintype.card ι)

statement:
lemma state_scale (q : κ → ℝ) (R : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (θ : ℝ) :
    state (fun j => q j/θ) R = θ⁻¹ • state q R

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.sum_scale_size
statement:
lemma sum_scale_size {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (S : Finset ℤ) :
    (∑ k ∈ S,(cfc sizeWeight (((2:ℝ)^k)⁻¹ • A)).trace) ≤ 14*Fintype.card ι

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.survivalRadius_pos
statement: lemma survivalRadius_pos : 0<survivalRadius

name: OAI.GaussianAR.evaluation_apply
statement:
lemma evaluation_apply (r : ι → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n+1))
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+1)×ι)) (i : ι) :
    GaussianTail.matrixMap (evaluation r n t) x i =
      ∑ u : Fin (n+1),row (r i) t.val u.val*x (u,i)

name: OAI.GaussianAR.pathEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma pathEquiv_apply (r : ι → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i,0≤r i) (hr1 : ∀ i,r i<1) (n : ℕ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+1)×ι)) :
    pathEquiv r hr hr1 n x = GaussianTail.matrixMap (pathMatrix r n) x

name: OAI.GaussianAR.pathEquiv_det
statement:
lemma pathEquiv_det (r : ι → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i,0≤r i) (hr1 : ∀ i,r i<1) (n : ℕ) :
    (pathEquiv r hr hr1 n).toContinuousLinearMap.det=(∏ i,Real.sqrt (1-(r i)^2))^n

name: OAI.GaussianAR.pathEquiv_symm_initial
statement:
lemma pathEquiv_symm_initial (r : ι → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i,0≤r i) (hr1 : ∀ i,r i<1) (n : ℕ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+1)×ι)) (i : ι) :
    (pathEquiv r hr hr1 n).symm x (0,i) = x (0,i)

name: OAI.GaussianAR.pathEquiv_symm_step
statement:
lemma pathEquiv_symm_step (r : ι → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i,0≤r i) (hr1 : ∀ i,r i<1) (n : ℕ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+1)×ι)) (t : Fin n) (i : ι) :
    (pathEquiv r hr hr1 n).symm x (t.succ,i) =
      (x (t.succ,i)-r i*x (t.castSucc,i))/Real.sqrt (1-(r i)^2)

name: OAI.GaussianAR.pathMatrix_apply
statement:
lemma pathMatrix_apply (r : ι → ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+1)×ι)) (t : Fin (n+1)) (i : ι) :
    GaussianTail.matrixMap (pathMatrix r n) x (t,i) =
      GaussianTail.matrixMap (evaluation r n t) x i

name: OAI.GaussianAR.pathMatrix_det
statement:
lemma pathMatrix_det (r : ι → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :

statement:
lemma pathMatrix_lin_det (r : ι → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :

name: OAI.GaussianAR.path_initial
statement:
lemma path_initial (r : ι → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+1)×ι)) (i : ι) :
    GaussianTail.matrixMap (pathMatrix r n) x (0,i)=x (0,i)

name: OAI.GaussianAR.path_step
statement:
lemma path_step (r : ι → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+1)×ι))
    (t : Fin n) (i : ι) :
    GaussianTail.matrixMap (pathMatrix r n) x (t.succ,i)=
      r i*GaussianTail.matrixMap (pathMatrix r n) x (t.castSucc,i)+
      Real.sqrt (1-(r i)^2)*x (t.succ,i)

name: OAI.GaussianAR.reciprocal_rate
statement:
lemma reciprocal_rate {v : ℝ} (hv : 0<v) :
    let r := (1+v)⁻¹
    0<r ∧ r<1 ∧ v ≤ (1-r^2)/r ∧ (1-r^2)/r ≤ 2*v ∧ 1-r ≤ v ∧ -Real.log r ≤ v

name: OAI.GaussianAR.slabRadius_pos
statement: lemma slabRadius_pos : 0<slabRadius

name: OAI.GaussianAR.transition_scalar
statement:
lemma transition_scalar {r w : ℝ} (hr : 0<r) (hr1 : r<1) (hw : w=(1-r^2)/r)
    (hw0 : 0≤w) (x y : ℝ) :
    (Real.sqrt (1-r^2))⁻¹ * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 ((y-r*x)/Real.sqrt (1-r^2)) ≤
      (Real.sqrt r)⁻¹ * gaussianPDFReal 0 ⟨w,hw0⟩ (y-x) * Real.exp ((x^2-y^2)/4)

name: OAI.GaussianAR.weighted_diagonal_eq
statement:

lemma linear_image_density (e : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)

name: OAI.HeatL2.densityKernel_inner
statement:
lemma densityKernel_inner (ν : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (p : E → ℝ) (hp : Measurable p) (hpn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ p x) (hpb : ∀ x, p x ≤ p 0)
    (hν : ν = volume.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (p x)))
    [IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict D)] (f g : Lp ℂ 2 (volume.restrict D)) :
    ⟪extendLp D hD g, average (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E) ν (extendLp D hD f)⟫ =
      ⟪g, kernelOp (densityKernel p hp hpn hpb) f⟫

statement:
lemma inner_average_density (ν : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (p : E → ℝ) (hp : Measurable p) (hpn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ p x)
    (hν : ν = volume.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (p x)))
    (f g : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure E)) :
    ⟪g, average (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E) ν f⟫ =
      ∫ x, ∫ y, (p (y-x) : ℂ) * f y * conj (g x)

statement:
lemma path_density_eq (r : ι → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i,0≤r i) (hr1 : ∀ i,r i<1) (n : ℕ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+1)×ι)) :
    |(pathEquiv r hr hr1 n).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.det| *
      density (fun _ => 1) ((pathEquiv r hr hr1 n).symm x) =
    density (fun _ => 1) (unpack (Fin (n+1)) ι x 0) *

    (∃ j ≤ l.length,
      (((signedOrder p l).take k).map v).sum = (((l.take j).filter p).map v).sum) ∨

    (hprefix : ∀ j ≤ l.length, ‖((l.take j).map v).sum‖ ≤ B)
    (hsigned : ∀ j ≤ l.length,
      ‖((l.take j).map fun a => if p a then v a else -v a).sum‖ ≤ D)

    ‖CFC.sqrt H‖*‖(CFC.sqrt H)⁻¹‖ = Real.sqrt τ ∧
    IsUnit (CFC.sqrt H) ∧ ‖CFC.sqrt H*T*(CFC.sqrt H)⁻¹‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      ∀ R : Matrix n n ℂ, IsUnit R → ‖R*T*R⁻¹‖ ≤ 1 →
        Real.sqrt τ ≤ ‖R‖*‖R⁻¹‖

statement:
lemma orthogonal_pair_energy_identity (τ : TracialState D) {p q : D}
    (hp : IsStarProjection p) (hq : IsStarProjection q) (hpq : p * q = 0) (x : D) :
    traceTwoNorm τ (x * (p + q) - (p + q) * x) ^ 2 =
      traceTwoNorm τ (x * p - p * x) ^ 2 + traceTwoNorm τ (x * q - q * x) ^ 2 -
        2 * traceTwoNorm τ (q * x * p) ^ 2 - 2 * traceTwoNorm τ (p * x * q) ^ 2

    τ.functional (star (x * p - p * x) * (x * p - p * x)) =

lemma trace_unitary_commutator_square (τ : TracialState D) (x : unitary D)

name: OAI.CurrentMain.weightedAverage_central

    traceOneNorm τ (weightedAverage w (fun i => ι (v i)) q -
      ι (x : A) * weightedAverage w (fun i => ι (v i)) q * star (ι (x : A))) ≤
        μ * (τ.functional q).re

statement:
theorem matrix_block_sampling {e : D} (he : IsStarProjection e) (heq : e ≤ q)
    (x : unitary D) {η c : ℝ} (hη : η < 1) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (happrox : ∃ s : Matrix I I ℂ,
      ‖U.sample q * (x : D) * U.sample q - U.matrix q s‖ < η) (τ : TracialState D) :
    ‖τ.functional (U.sample e * (x : D)) -
        (c : ℂ) * τ.functional (U.sample q * (x : D))‖ ≤
      η * ((τ.functional (U.sample e)).re + c * (τ.functional (U.sample q)).re) +
        2 * |(τ.functional (U.sample e)).re - c * (τ.functional (U.sample q)).re| ∧
    |traceTwoNorm τ ((x : D) * U.sample e - U.sample e * (x : D)) ^ 2 -
        c * traceTwoNorm τ ((x : D) * U.sample q - U.sample q * (x : D)) ^ 2| ≤
      6 * η * ((τ.functional (U.sample e)).re + c * (τ.functional (U.sample q)).re) +
        10 * |(τ.functional (U.sample e)).re - c * (τ.functional (U.sample q)).re|

name: OAI.CurrentMain.orthogonal_insertion
statement:
theorem orthogonal_insertion (hRR : RealRankZero D) {z y : D}
    (hz : IsStarProjection z) (hy : IsStarProjection y) :
    ∃ t : D, IsStarProjection t ∧ t ≤ 1 - z ∧ ∀ τ : TracialState D,
      ((τ.functional y).re - 3 * (τ.functional (y * z)).re ≤ (τ.functional t).re ∧
      (τ.functional t).re ≤ (τ.functional y).re) ∧
      traceTwoNorm τ (t - y) ^ 2 ≤ 5 * (τ.functional (y * z)).re ∧
      ∀ x : D, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖τ.functional ((t - y) * x)‖ ≤
        2 * Real.sqrt (τ.functional y).re * traceTwoNorm τ (t - y)

name: OAI.CurrentMain.sampling_compression_estimates
statement:
lemma sampling_compression_estimates (τ : TracialState D) {p y z x : D}
    (hp : IsStarProjection p) (hy : IsStarProjection y) (hyp : y ≤ p)
    (hyz : Commute y z) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 2)
    {η : ℝ} (hclose : ‖p * x * p - z‖ ≤ η) :
    ‖τ.functional (y * x) - τ.functional (z * y)‖ ≤ η * (τ.functional y).re ∧
    |traceTwoNorm τ (y * x * y) ^ 2 - (τ.functional (star z * z * y)).re| ≤
      3 * η * (τ.functional y).re

name: OAI.CurrentMain.sampling_via_scalar_reference
statement:
lemma sampling_via_scalar_reference (τ : TracialState D) {p y z : D}
    (hp : IsStarProjection p) (hy : IsStarProjection y) (hyp : y ≤ p)
    (hpz : Commute p z) (hyz : Commute y z) (x : unitary D)
    {η c : ℝ} (hη : η < 1) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hclose : ‖p * (x : D) * p - z‖ < η)
    (hlin : τ.functional (z * y) * τ.functional p =
      τ.functional (z * p) * τ.functional y)
    (hsq : τ.functional (star z * z * y) * τ.functional p =
      τ.functional (star z * z * p) * τ.functional y) :
    ‖τ.functional (y * (x : D)) - (c : ℂ) * τ.functional (p * (x : D))‖ ≤
      η * ((τ.functional y).re + c * (τ.functional p).re) +
        2 * |(τ.functional y).re - c * (τ.functional p).re| ∧
    |traceTwoNorm τ ((x : D) * y - y * (x : D)) ^ 2 -
        c * traceTwoNorm τ ((x : D) * p - p * (x : D)) ^ 2| ≤
      6 * η * ((τ.functional y).re + c * (τ.functional p).re) +
        10 * |(τ.functional y).re - c * (τ.functional p).re|

name: OAI.CurrentMain.scalar_splitting_error
statement:
lemma scalar_splitting_error (τ : TracialState D) {e q : D}
    (he : IsStarProjection e) (hq : IsStarProjection q) (heq : e ≤ q)
    {s γ : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (b : D) (α : ℂ)
    (hγ : ‖q * b * q - α • q‖ ≤ γ) :
    ‖τ.functional (e * b) - (s : ℂ) * τ.functional (q * b)‖ ≤
      γ * ((τ.functional e).re + s * (τ.functional q).re) +
      ‖α‖ * ‖τ.functional e - (s : ℂ) * τ.functional q‖

    (he : ∀ i, IsStarProjection (e i)) (hs : ∑ i, e i = 1)
    (a : D) (c : I → ℝ) (hl : ∀ i, e i * a = c i • e i)
    (hr : ∀ i, a * e i = c i • e i) (x : D) :
    traceTwoNorm τ (x * a - a * x) ^ 2 =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (c i - c j) ^ 2 * traceTwoNorm τ (e i * x * e j) ^ 2

name: OAI.CurrentMain.spectral_root_sum_le

name: OAI.CurrentMain.covariance_retain_error
statement:
lemma covariance_retain_error (τ : Pureness.TracialState D) {q : D}
    (hq : IsStarProjection q) (a : I → D) (p : I → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (b : {i // p i} → D) (ha : ∀ i, a i * q = a i)
    (hb : ∀ i, b i * q = b i) {M N E σ δ : ℝ}
    (hM : ∀ i, ‖a i‖ ≤ M) (hN : ∀ i, ‖b i‖ ≤ N)
    (hdist : ∀ i, ‖b i - a i‖ ≤ E) (c : I → ℝ)
    (hdrop : ∀ i, ¬p i → c i ≤ σ)
    (hgram : ∀ i, ‖star (a i) * a i - c i • q‖ ≤ δ) :
    traceOneNorm τ ((∑ i, b i * star (b i)) - ∑ i, a i * star (a i)) ≤
      ((Fintype.card {i // p i} : ℝ) * (M + N) * E +
        (Fintype.card {i // ¬p i} : ℝ) * (σ + δ)) * (τ.functional q).re

statement:

name: OAI.CurrentMain.covariance_selfAdjoint

lemma covariance_trace_le_of_gram {q b : D} (hq : IsStarProjection q)

    (τ : Pureness.TracialState D) :

name: OAI.CurrentMain.dropped_covariance_trace
statement:
lemma dropped_covariance_trace {q : D} (hq : IsStarProjection q) (b : I → D)
    (hb : ∀ i, b i * q = b i) (c : I → ℝ) {σ δ : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i, c i ≤ σ) (hg : ∀ i, ‖star (b i) * b i - c i • q‖ ≤ δ)
    (τ : Pureness.TracialState D) :
    traceOneNorm τ (∑ i, b i * star (b i)) ≤
      (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * (σ + δ) * (τ.functional q).re

name: OAI.CurrentMain.normalize_retained_spectrum
statement:
theorem normalize_retained_spectrum {q : D} (hq : IsStarProjection q)
    (b : I → D) (c : I → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i) (hc1 : ∀ i, c i ≤ 1)
    (hb : ∀ i, b i * q = b i) {σ M δ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hbn : ∀ i, ‖b i‖ ≤ M)
    (hg : ∀ i j, ‖star (b i) * b j - (if i = j then c i • q else 0)‖ ≤ δ)
    (hsmall : (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((Real.sqrt σ)⁻¹ ^ 2 * δ) ≤ 1 / 2) :
    ∃ U : ProjectionRow {i : I // σ ≤ c i} q,
      (∀ i, ‖U.entry i - (Real.sqrt (c i))⁻¹ • b i‖ ≤
        2 * (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 3 * (Real.sqrt σ)⁻¹ ^ 3 * M * δ) ∧
      (∀ i : {i : I // σ ≤ c i}, ‖Real.sqrt (c i) • U.entry i - b i‖ ≤
        2 * (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 3 * (Real.sqrt σ)⁻¹ ^ 3 * M * δ)

name: OAI.CurrentMain.normalize_weighted_row
statement:
theorem normalize_weighted_row {q : D} (hq : IsStarProjection q)
    (b : I → D) (ρ : I → ℝ) (hρ : ∀ i, 0 < ρ i) (hρ1 : ∀ i, ρ i ≤ 1)
    (hb : ∀ i, b i * q = b i) {L M δ : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hinv : ∀ i, (ρ i)⁻¹ ≤ L) (hbn : ∀ i, ‖b i‖ ≤ M)
    (hg : ∀ i j, ‖star (b i) * b j - (if i = j then (ρ i) ^ 2 • q else 0)‖ ≤ δ)
    (hsmall : (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 2 * (L ^ 2 * δ) ≤ 1 / 2) :
    ∃ U : ProjectionRow I q,
      (∀ i, ‖U.entry i - (ρ i)⁻¹ • b i‖ ≤
        2 * (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 3 * L ^ 3 * M * δ) ∧
      (∀ i, ‖ρ i • U.entry i - b i‖ ≤
        2 * (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 3 * L ^ 3 * M * δ)

name: OAI.CurrentMain.normalized_rowPair_error
statement:
lemma normalized_rowPair_error {q : D} (U : ProjectionRow I q)
    (b : I → D) (r : I → ℝ) (x : D) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) (H : Matrix I I ℂ)
    {L M E δ : ℝ} (hr : ∀ i, 0 ≤ r i) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hri : ∀ i, r i ≤ L)
    (hbn : ∀ i, ‖b i‖ ≤ M)
    (hU : ∀ i, ‖U.entry i - r i • b i‖ ≤ E)
    (h : ∀ i j, ‖rowPair b x i j - H i j • q‖ ≤ δ) (i j : I) :
    ‖rowPair U.entry x i j - ((r i * r j) • H i j) • q‖ ≤
      E * (1 + L * M) + L ^ 2 * δ

name: OAI.CurrentMain.rawRow_pair_scalar_error
statement:
lemma rawRow_pair_scalar_error (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hw1 : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (v : I → D) {q : D} (hq : IsStarProjection q)
    (f : D →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (hf : f 1 = 1) (hfq : f q = 1)
    (x : D) (i j : I) {ε : ℝ}
    (h : ∃ α : ℂ, ‖q * (star (v i) * x * v j) * q - α • q‖ < ε) :
    ‖rowPair (rawRow w v q) x i j - f (rowPair (rawRow w v q) x i j) • q‖ < 2 * ε

name: OAI.CurrentMain.retained_spectrum_trace_error
statement:
lemma retained_spectrum_trace_error {q : D} (hq : IsStarProjection q)
    (b : I → D) (c : I → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i) (hc1 : ∀ i, c i ≤ 1)
    (hb : ∀ i, b i * q = b i) {σ M E δ : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (hσδ : 0 ≤ σ + δ) (hbn : ∀ i, ‖b i‖ ≤ M)
    (hg : ∀ i, ‖star (b i) * b i - c i • q‖ ≤ δ)
    (U : ProjectionRow {i : I // σ ≤ c i} q)
    (hU : ∀ i : {i : I // σ ≤ c i}, ‖Real.sqrt (c i) • U.entry i - b i‖ ≤ E)
    (τ : Pureness.TracialState D) :
    traceOneNorm τ ((∑ i : {i : I // σ ≤ c i}, c i • U.atom i) - ∑ i, b i * star (b i)) ≤
      ((Fintype.card I : ℝ) * ((M + 1) * E + (σ + δ))) * (τ.functional q).re

name: OAI.CurrentMain.rowPair_perturb
statement:
lemma rowPair_perturb (a b c d x : D) {E F M N : ℝ}

    ‖star a * x * c - star b * x * d‖ ≤ E * N + M * F

name: OAI.CurrentMain.rowPair_scale_error
statement:
lemma rowPair_scale_error {q : D} (a : I → D) (r : I → ℝ) (x : D)
    (H : Matrix I I ℂ) {L δ : ℝ} (hr : ∀ i, 0 ≤ r i) (hL : ∀ i, r i ≤ L)
    (h : ∀ i j, ‖rowPair a x i j - H i j • q‖ ≤ δ) (i j : I) :
    ‖rowPair (fun k => r k • a k) x i j - ((r i * r j) • H i j) • q‖ ≤ L ^ 2 * δ

name: OAI.CurrentMain.rowPair_spectral_rotation
statement:
lemma rowPair_spectral_rotation {q : D} (f : D →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (a : I → D) {δ : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ i j, ‖rowPair a 1 i j - scalarRowGram f a i j • q‖ ≤ δ) (i j : I) :
    ‖star (rotateRow a (scalarRowGram_posSemidef f a).isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary i) *
        rotateRow a (scalarRowGram_posSemidef f a).isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary j -
      (if i = j then
        (scalarRowGram_posSemidef f a).isHermitian.eigenvalues i • q else 0)‖ ≤
      (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 2 * δ

name: OAI.CurrentMain.row_covariance_trace_error
statement:
lemma row_covariance_trace_error (τ : Pureness.TracialState D) {q : D}
    (hq : IsStarProjection q) (a b : I → D)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i * q = a i) (hb : ∀ i, b i * q = b i) {M N δ : ℝ}

name: OAI.CurrentMain.ProjectionRow.layer_sum
statement:
lemma layer_sum {n : ℕ} (U : ProjectionRow (Fin n) q) (c : Fin n → ℝ) :

name: OAI.CurrentMain.ProjectionRow.positive_layer_energy
statement:
lemma positive_layer_energy (c : Fin n → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i) (hm : Monotone c)
    (τ : Pureness.TracialState D) (x : D) :
    ∑ j : {j : Fin n // 0 < orderedLayerWeights c j}, orderedLayerWeights c j *
      traceTwoNorm τ (x * (U.subrow (upperEmbedding j)).sample q -
        (U.subrow (upperEmbedding j)).sample q * x) ^ 2 =
      ∑ j, orderedLayerWeights c j * traceTwoNorm τ
        (x * upperLayerCut U.atom j - upperLayerCut U.atom j * x) ^ 2

name: OAI.CurrentMain.ProjectionRow.positive_layer_sum
statement:
lemma positive_layer_sum (c : Fin n → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i) (hm : Monotone c) :
    ∑ j : {j : Fin n // 0 < orderedLayerWeights c j},
      orderedLayerWeights c j • (U.subrow (upperEmbedding j)).sample q =
        ∑ i, c i • U.atom i

name: OAI.CurrentMain.block_tolerances
statement:
lemma block_tolerances (m : ℝ) (hm : 0 ≤ m) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ σ δ : ℝ, 0 < σ ∧ σ < 1 ∧ 0 < δ ∧
      m ^ 2 * ((Real.sqrt σ)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (m ^ 2 * δ)) ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
      m * ((m + 1) * (2 * m ^ 3 * (Real.sqrt σ)⁻¹ ^ 3 * m * (m ^ 2 * δ)) +
        (σ + m ^ 2 * δ)) ≤ η ^ 2 ∧
      m ^ 2 * ((2 * m ^ 3 * (Real.sqrt σ)⁻¹ ^ 3 * m * (m ^ 2 * δ)) *
        (1 + (Real.sqrt σ)⁻¹ * m) + (Real.sqrt σ)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (m ^ 2 * δ)) < η

theorem raw_spectral_block (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hw1 : ∑ i, w i = 1) (v : I → D) (hv : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ 1)
    (K : Finset D) (hK : ∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ 1) {η : ℝ}
    (T : BlockControl (Fintype.card I) η)
    {q : D} (hq : IsStarProjection q) (hq0 : q ≠ 0)
    (hcomp : ∀ i j, ∀ x ∈ insert 1 K, ∃ α : ℂ,
      ‖q * (star (v i) * x * v j) * q - α • q‖ < T.tolerance / 2) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, n ≤ Fintype.card I ∧ ∃ U : ProjectionRow (Fin n) q, ∃ c : Fin n → ℝ,
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ c i) ∧ (∀ i, c i ≤ 1) ∧ Monotone c ∧
      (∀ τ : Pureness.TracialState D,
        traceOneNorm τ ((∑ i, c i • U.atom i) - weightedAverage w v q) ≤
          η ^ 2 * (τ.functional q).re) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ e : Fin k ↪ Fin n, ∀ x ∈ K, ∃ H : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℂ,
        ‖(U.subrow e).sample q * x * (U.subrow e).sample q - (U.subrow e).matrix q H‖ < η)

name: OAI.CurrentMain.spectral_row_block
statement:
theorem spectral_row_block {q : D} (hq : IsStarProjection q)
    (f : D →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (hf : f 1 = 1) (a : I → D)
    (haq : ∀ i, a i * q = a i) (ha2 : ∑ i, ‖a i‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    {M σ δ : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hasum : ∑ i, ‖a i‖ ≤ M)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hgram : ∀ i j, ‖rowPair a 1 i j - scalarRowGram f a i j • q‖ ≤ δ)
    (K : Finset D)
    (htest : ∀ x ∈ K, ∃ H : Matrix I I ℂ,
      ∀ i j, ‖rowPair a x i j - H i j • q‖ ≤ δ)
    (hKn : ∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((Real.sqrt σ)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
      ((Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 2 * δ)) ≤ 1 / 2) :
    let c := (scalarRowGram_posSemidef f a).isHermitian.eigenvalues
    let E := 2 * (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 3 * (Real.sqrt σ)⁻¹ ^ 3 * M *
      ((Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 2 * δ)
    ∃ U : ProjectionRow {i : I // σ ≤ c i} q,
      (∀ τ : Pureness.TracialState D,
        traceOneNorm τ ((∑ i : {i : I // σ ≤ c i}, c i • U.atom i) -
          ∑ i, a i * star (a i)) ≤
          ((Fintype.card I : ℝ) * ((M + 1) * E + (σ + (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 2 * δ))) *
            (τ.functional q).re) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ K, ∃ H : Matrix {i : I // σ ≤ c i} {i : I // σ ≤ c i} ℂ,
        ∀ i j, ‖rowPair U.entry x i j - H i j • q‖ ≤
          E * (1 + (Real.sqrt σ)⁻¹ * M) + (Real.sqrt σ)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
            ((Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 2 * δ))

name: OAI.CurrentMain.weighted_family_of_average
statement:
theorem weighted_family_of_average {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (hRR : RealRankZero D) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hw1 : ∑ i, w i = 1) (v : I → D) (hv : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ 1)
    (K : Finset (unitary D)) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη1 : η < 1)
    (hcentral : ∀ q : D, IsStarProjection q → ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ τ : Pureness.TracialState D,
      traceOneNorm τ (weightedAverage w v q - (x : D) * weightedAverage w v q * star (x : D)) ≤
        η ^ 2 * (τ.functional q).re)
    {r : D} (hr : IsStarProjection r) :
    ∃ F : WeightedBlockFamily r,
      (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ K, ∃ H : Matrix (Fin (F.columns j)) (Fin (F.columns j)) ℂ,
        ‖F.range j * (x : D) * F.range j - (F.row j).matrix (F.base j) H‖ < η) ∧
      (∀ τ : Pureness.TracialState D,
        traceOneNorm τ (F.weightedSum - weightedAverage w v r) ≤ η ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ K, ∀ τ : Pureness.TracialState D,
        ∑ j, F.weight j * traceTwoNorm τ ((x : D) * F.range j - F.range j * (x : D)) ^ 2 ≤
          6 * η)

      packingBalance η (n + 1)

name: OAI.CurrentMain.relative_coefficient_tests
statement:
lemma relative_coefficient_tests {I : Type uI} [Fintype I] (ι : A →⋆ₐ[ℂ] D)
    (v : I → A) (hv : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ 1) :
    ∃ L : Finset (unitary A), ∀ z : D, ∀ τ : Pureness.TracialState D, ∀ E : ℝ, 0 ≤ E →
      (∀ x ∈ L, traceTwoNorm τ (z * ι (x : A) - ι (x : A) * z) ^ 2 ≤ E) →
      ∀ i, traceTwoNorm τ (z * ι (v i) - ι (v i) * z) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * E

      (⨆ τ : Pureness.TracialState D, (τ.functional g).re) < δ)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη1 : η < 1)
    (diagonals : ∀ K : Finset (unitary A), Nonempty (PositiveDiagonal A K (η ^ 2)))

name: OAI.CurrentMain.finite_set_splitting_from_diagonals

theorem finite_set_splitting_from_diagonals (ι : A →⋆ₐ[ℂ] D)
    (hRR : RealRankZero D) (hT : Nonempty (Pureness.TracialState D))
    (hsmall : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ g : D, IsStarProjection g ∧ IsFull g ∧
      (⨆ τ : Pureness.TracialState D, (τ.functional g).re) < δ)
    (diagonals : ∀ (K : Finset (unitary A)) (μ : ℝ), 0 < μ → Nonempty (PositiveDiagonal A K μ))
    (K : Finset (unitary A)) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ P : D, IsStarProjection P ∧ ∀ x ∈ K,
      uniformTwoNorm (P * ι (x : A) - ι (x : A) * P) < ε ∧
      uniformHalvingError P (ι (x : A)) < ε

name: OAI.CurrentMain.completion_central_splitting_of_finite_stages
statement:
theorem completion_central_splitting_of_finite_stages
    (hfree : (U : Filter ℕ) ≤ atTop)
    (hfinite : ∀ (K : Finset (unitary A)) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
      ∃ P : FamilyUltrapower (completionTrace τ) U, IsStarProjection P ∧ ∀ u ∈ K,
        familyTwoNorm (familyLimitTrace (completionTrace τ) U)
          (P * familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace τ) U (completionMap τ (u : A)) -
           familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace τ) U (completionMap τ (u : A)) * P) < ε ∧
        familyTraceNorm (familyLimitTrace (completionTrace τ) U)
          (P * familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace τ) U (completionMap τ (u : A)) -
           (1/2 : ℂ) • familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace τ) U (completionMap τ (u : A))) < ε) :
    ∃ p : FamilyUltrapower (completionTrace τ) U, IsStarProjection p ∧
      ∀ x : UniformTracialCompletion τ,
        p * familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace τ) U x =
          familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace τ) U x * p ∧
        ∀ s : ℕ → I, (familyLimitTrace (completionTrace τ) U s).functional
          (p * familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace τ) U x) =
          (1/2 : ℂ) * (familyLimitTrace (completionTrace τ) U s).functional
            (familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace τ) U x)

name: OAI.CurrentMain.diagonalize_finite_splittings
statement:
theorem diagonalize_finite_splittings (hfree : (U : Filter ℕ) ≤ atTop)
    (x : ℕ → D)
    (hfinite : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ P : FamilyUltrapower τ U,
      IsStarProjection P ∧ ∀ k ≤ n,
        familyTwoNorm (familyLimitTrace τ U)
          (P * familyUltrapowerMap τ U (x k) - familyUltrapowerMap τ U (x k) * P) < ε ∧
        familyTraceNorm (familyLimitTrace τ U)
          (P * familyUltrapowerMap τ U (x k) -
            (1/2 : ℂ) • familyUltrapowerMap τ U (x k)) < ε) :
    ∃ p : FamilyUltrapower τ U, IsStarProjection p ∧ ∀ k : ℕ,
      p * familyUltrapowerMap τ U (x k) = familyUltrapowerMap τ U (x k) * p ∧
      ∀ s : ℕ → I, (familyLimitTrace τ U s).functional (p * familyUltrapowerMap τ U (x k)) =
        (1/2 : ℂ) * (familyLimitTrace τ U s).functional (familyUltrapowerMap τ U (x k))

name: OAI.CurrentMain.exists_coordinate_split
statement:
lemma exists_coordinate_split (K : Finset D) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    {P : FamilyUltrapower τ U} (hP : IsStarProjection P)
    (hc : ∀ x ∈ K, familyTwoNorm (familyLimitTrace τ U)
      (P * familyUltrapowerMap τ U x - familyUltrapowerMap τ U x * P) < ε)
    (hh : ∀ x ∈ K, familyTraceNorm (familyLimitTrace τ U)
      (P * familyUltrapowerMap τ U x - (1/2 : ℂ) • familyUltrapowerMap τ U x) < ε) :
    ∃ b : D, IsSelfAdjoint b ∧ ‖b‖ ≤ 2 ∧ familyTwoNorm τ (b*b-b) < ε ∧
      ∀ x ∈ K, familyTwoNorm τ (b*x-x*b) < ε ∧
        familyTraceNorm τ (b*x-(1/2 : ℂ) • x) < ε

theorem rr_central_splitting_from_diagonals
    (hfree : (U : Filter ℕ) ≤ atTop)
    (hsimple : TopologicallySimple A) (hinf : ¬FiniteDimensional ℂ A)
    (hRR : RealRankZero (FamilyUltrapower (completionTrace (fun τ : TracialState A => τ)) U))
    (diagonals : ∀ (K : Finset (unitary A)) (μ : ℝ), 0 < μ → Nonempty (PositiveDiagonal A K μ)) :
    ∃ p : FamilyUltrapower (completionTrace (fun τ : TracialState A => τ)) U,
      IsStarProjection p ∧ ∀ x : UniformTracialCompletion (fun τ : TracialState A => τ),
        p * familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace (fun τ : TracialState A => τ)) U x =
          familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace (fun τ : TracialState A => τ)) U x * p ∧
        ∀ s : ℕ → TracialState A,
          (familyLimitTrace (completionTrace (fun τ : TracialState A => τ)) U s).functional
            (p * familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace (fun τ : TracialState A => τ)) U x) =
          (1/2 : ℂ) *
          (familyLimitTrace (completionTrace (fun τ : TracialState A => τ)) U s).functional
            (familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace (fun τ : TracialState A => τ)) U x)

name: OAI.NuclearTrace.coefficientMap_factorization

    coefficientMap α e a x =

name: OAI.CurrentMain.choi_bistochastic_family
statement:
lemma choi_bistochastic_family (Q : CStarMatrix N N D) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q)
    (hmass : ∑ i, Q i i = 1) :
    ∃ a : (N × N) → D,
      (∑ i, star (a i) * a i = 1) ∧
      (∑ i, a i * star (a i) = 1) ∧
      ∀ i j, Q i j = ∑ k, star (a (k,i)) * a (k,j)

name: OAI.CurrentMain.choi_coupling
statement:
lemma choi_coupling (φ : CStarMatrix N N ℂ →ₗ[ℂ] D) (a : (N × N) → D)
    (ha : ∀ i j, φ (scalarMatrixUnit i j) = ∑ k, star (a (k,i))*a (k,j))
    (ha1 : ∑ i, star (a i)*a i = 1)
    (T : CStarMatrix N N ℂ) (hT : ‖T‖ ≤ 1) (x : unitary D) :
    ∃ b v : ((N × N) ⊕ (N × N)) → D,
      (∀ q, (∑ i, star (b i)*q*b i) = ∑ i, star (a i)*q*a i) ∧
      (∀ q, (∑ i, star (v i)*q*v i) =
        star (x : D)*(∑ i, star (a i)*q*a i)*(x : D)) ∧
      (∑ i, star (b i)*b i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, star (v i)*v i = 1) ∧
      (∑ i, star (b i-v i)*(b i-v i)) =
        2 - star (φ T)*(x : D) - star (x : D)*φ T

name: OAI.CurrentMain.choi_evaluation
statement:
lemma choi_evaluation (φ : CStarMatrix N N ℂ →ₗ[ℂ] D) (a : (N × N) → D)
    (ha : ∀ i j, φ (scalarMatrixUnit i j) = ∑ k, star (a (k,i))*a (k,j))
    (T : CStarMatrix N N ℂ) :
    φ T = ∑ k, ∑ i, star (a (k,i))*scalarMix (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm T) (fun j => a (k,j)) i

name: OAI.CurrentMain.choi_global_partition_bound
statement:
lemma choi_global_partition_bound {I : Type uI} {J : Type uJ} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (τ : TracialState D) (b v : I → D) (z : D) (x : unitary D)
    (hb : ∑ i, star (b i)*b i = 1) (hv : ∑ i, star (v i)*v i = 1)
    (herr : (∑ i, star (b i-v i)*(b i-v i)) =
      2 - star z*(x : D) - star (x : D)*z) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : ‖z-(x : D)‖ ≤ ε) (q : J → D)
    (hq : ∀ j, IsStarProjection (q j)) (hsum : ∑ j, q j = 1) :
    (∑ j, traceOneNorm τ ((∑ i, star (b i)*q j*b i) -
      ∑ i, star (v i)*q j*v i))^2 ≤ 8*ε

name: OAI.CurrentMain.choi_global_partition_pairing
statement:
lemma choi_global_partition_pairing {I : Type uI} {J : Type uJ} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (τ : TracialState D) (b v : I → D) (z : D) (x : unitary D)
    (hb : ∑ i, star (b i)*b i = 1) (hv : ∑ i, star (v i)*v i = 1)
    (herr : (∑ i, star (b i-v i)*(b i-v i)) =
      2 - star z*(x : D) - star (x : D)*z)
    (q : J → D) (hq : ∀ j, IsStarProjection (q j)) (hsum : ∑ j, q j = 1) :
    (∑ j, traceOneNorm τ ((∑ i, star (b i)*q j*b i) -
      ∑ i, star (v i)*q j*v i))^2 ≤
        8*(τ.functional (star (x : D)*((x : D)-z))).re

name: OAI.CurrentMain.choi_sqrt_factorization
statement:
lemma choi_sqrt_factorization (Q : CStarMatrix N N D) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) :
    ∃ V : CStarMatrix N N D, IsSelfAdjoint V ∧ star V * V = Q

name: OAI.CurrentMain.cp_choi_positive
statement:
lemma cp_choi_positive [Nonempty N] (φ : CStarMatrix N N ℂ →CP D) :

name: OAI.CurrentMain.global_partition_covariance_l2
statement:
lemma global_partition_covariance_l2 {J : Type uJ} [Fintype J]
    (τ : TracialState D) (q : J → D) (hq : ∀ j, IsStarProjection (q j))
    (hsum : ∑ j, q j = 1) (a b : I → D) :
    (∑ j, traceOneNorm τ ((∑ i, star (b i) * q j * b i) -
      ∑ i, star (a i) * q j * a i)) ^ 2 ≤
      2 * ((∑ i, traceTwoNorm τ (a i)^2) + (∑ i, traceTwoNorm τ (b i)^2)) *
        (∑ i, traceTwoNorm τ (b i-a i)^2)

name: OAI.CurrentMain.linearMap_choi_expansion
statement:
lemma linearMap_choi_expansion (φ : CStarMatrix N N ℂ →ₗ[ℂ] D)

name: OAI.CurrentMain.matrixUnits_positive
statement:
lemma matrixUnits_positive [Nonempty N] :

name: OAI.CurrentMain.normalized_choi_global_averaging
statement:
lemma normalized_choi_global_averaging
    (φ : CStarMatrix N N ℂ →ₗ[ℂ] D)
    (hQ : 0 ≤ CStarMatrix.ofMatrix (fun i j => φ (scalarMatrixUnit i j)))
    (hφ : φ 1 = 1) :
    ∃ a : (N × N) → D,
      (∑ i, star (a i)*a i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, a i*star (a i) = 1) ∧
      ∀ (T : CStarMatrix N N ℂ), ‖T‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ (x : unitary D),
      ∀ (J : Type) [Fintype J] (q : J → D),
      (∀ j, IsStarProjection (q j)) → (∑ j, q j = 1) →
      ∀ τ : TracialState D,
      (∑ j, traceOneNorm τ ((∑ i, star (a i)*q j*a i) -
        star (x : D)*(∑ i, star (a i)*q j*a i)*(x : D)))^2 ≤
          8*(τ.functional (star (x : D)*((x : D)-φ T))).re

name: OAI.CurrentMain.scalarMatrixUnit_expansion
statement:
lemma scalarMatrixUnit_expansion (T : CStarMatrix N N ℂ) :

name: OAI.CurrentMain.scalarMatrixUnit_mul
statement:
@[simp] lemma scalarMatrixUnit_mul (i j k : N) :

name: OAI.CurrentMain.scalarMix_covariance
statement:
lemma scalarMix_covariance (R : Matrix O I ℂ) (a : I → D) (q : D) :
    (∑ o, star (scalarMix R a o) * q * scalarMix R a o) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (∑ o, star (R o i) * R o j) • (star (a i)*q*a j)

name: OAI.CurrentMain.scalarMix_covariance_of_isometry
statement:
lemma scalarMix_covariance_of_isometry (R : Matrix O I ℂ) (a : I → D)
    (hR : ∀ i j, (∑ o, star (R o i)*R o j) = if i=j then 1 else 0) (q : D) :
    (∑ o, star (scalarMix R a o)*q*scalarMix R a o) = ∑ i, star (a i)*q*a i

name: OAI.CurrentMain.scalarMix_dilation_covariance
statement:
lemma scalarMix_dilation_covariance {N : Type uN} [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N]
    (T S : CStarMatrix N N ℂ) (hTS : star T*T + star S*S = 1)
    (a : N → D) (q : D) :
    (∑ i, star (scalarMix (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm T) a i)*q*scalarMix (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm T) a i) +
      (∑ i, star (scalarMix (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm S) a i)*q*scalarMix (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm S) a i) =
        ∑ i, star (a i)*q*a i

name: OAI.CurrentMain.scalar_contraction_dilation
statement:
lemma scalar_contraction_dilation (T : CStarMatrix N N ℂ) (hT : ‖T‖ ≤ 1) :

name: OAI.CurrentMain.star_scalarMatrixUnit
statement:
@[simp] lemma star_scalarMatrixUnit (i j : N) :
