name: OAI.CurrentMain.sum_scalarMatrixUnit_diag
statement: lemma sum_scalarMatrixUnit_diag : (∑ i : N, scalarMatrixUnit i i) = 1

name: OAI.CurrentMain.traceOneNorm_covariance_l2
statement:
lemma traceOneNorm_covariance_l2 (τ : TracialState D) (a b : D) :
    traceOneNorm τ (b * star b - a * star a) ≤
      (traceTwoNorm τ a + traceTwoNorm τ b) * traceTwoNorm τ (b-a)

name: OAI.CurrentMain.traceOneNorm_covariance_sum_l2
statement:
lemma traceOneNorm_covariance_sum_l2 (τ : TracialState D) (a b : I → D) :
    traceOneNorm τ ((∑ i, b i * star (b i)) - (∑ i, a i * star (a i))) ^ 2 ≤
      2 * ((∑ i, traceTwoNorm τ (a i)^2) + (∑ i, traceTwoNorm τ (b i)^2)) *
        (∑ i, traceTwoNorm τ (b i-a i)^2)

name: OAI.CurrentMain.trace_choi_coupling_error
statement:
lemma trace_choi_coupling_error {I : Type uI} [Fintype I]
    (τ : TracialState D) (b v : I → D) (z : D) (x : unitary D)
    (herr : (∑ i, star (b i-v i)*(b i-v i)) =
      2 - star z*(x : D) - star (x : D)*z) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : ‖z-(x : D)‖ ≤ ε) :
    (∑ i, traceTwoNorm τ (b i-v i)^2) ≤ 2*ε

name: OAI.CurrentMain.trace_choi_coupling_pairing
statement:
lemma trace_choi_coupling_pairing {I : Type uI} [Fintype I]
    (τ : TracialState D) (b v : I → D) (z : D) (x : unitary D)
    (herr : (∑ i, star (b i-v i)*(b i-v i)) =
      2 - star z*(x : D) - star (x : D)*z) :
    (∑ i, traceTwoNorm τ (b i-v i)^2) =
      2*(τ.functional (star (x : D)*((x : D)-z))).re

name: OAI.CurrentMain.ucp_choi_bistochastic
statement:
lemma ucp_choi_bistochastic [Nonempty N] (φ : CStarMatrix N N ℂ →CP D)
    (hφ : φ 1 = 1) :
    ∃ a : (N × N) → D,
      (∑ i, star (a i) * a i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, a i * star (a i) = 1) ∧
      ∀ i j, φ (scalarMatrixUnit i j) = ∑ k, star (a (k,i)) * a (k,j)

name: OAI.CurrentMain.ucp_global_partition_averaging
statement:
lemma ucp_global_partition_averaging [Nonempty N]
    (φ : CStarMatrix N N ℂ →CP D) (hφ : φ 1 = 1) :
    ∃ a : (N × N) → D,
      (∑ i, star (a i)*a i = 1) ∧ (∑ i, a i*star (a i) = 1) ∧
      ∀ (T : CStarMatrix N N ℂ), ‖T‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ (x : unitary D) (ε : ℝ),
      ‖φ T-(x : D)‖ ≤ ε → ∀ (J : Type) [Fintype J] (q : J → D),
      (∀ j, IsStarProjection (q j)) → (∑ j, q j = 1) →
      ∀ τ : TracialState D,
      (∑ j, traceOneNorm τ ((∑ i, star (a i)*q j*a i) -
        star (x : D)*(∑ i, star (a i)*q j*a i)*(x : D)))^2 ≤ 8*ε

name: OAI.NuclearTrace.clipScalar_bounds
statement:
lemma clipScalar_bounds {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :

name: OAI.NuclearTrace.clipScalar_continuous
statement: lemma clipScalar_continuous : Continuous clipScalar

name: OAI.NuclearTrace.clipScalar_le_one

name: OAI.NuclearTrace.clipScalar_nonneg

statement:

name: OAI.NuclearTrace.rowNormalizer_nonneg

name: OAI.NuclearTrace.matrixSynthesis_difference_pairing
statement:
lemma matrixSynthesis_difference_pairing (τ : TracialState A) (a b : I → A)
    (T : CStarMatrix I I ℂ) (hT : ‖T‖ ≤ 1) (u : A) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖τ.functional (u*(matrixSynthesis a T-matrixSynthesis b T))‖^2 ≤
      2*((∑ i, traceTwoNorm τ (a i)^2)+(∑ i, traceTwoNorm τ (b i)^2))*
        (∑ i, traceTwoNorm τ (a i-b i)^2)

name: OAI.NuclearTrace.rowNormalizer_error_mass
statement:
lemma rowNormalizer_error_mass (a : I → A) :
    (∑ i, star (a i-a i*rowNormalizer (∑ j, star (a j)*a j)) *
      (a i-a i*rowNormalizer (∑ j, star (a j)*a j))) =
    (1-rowNormalizer (∑ j, star (a j)*a j))*(∑ j, star (a j)*a j)*
      (1-rowNormalizer (∑ j, star (a j)*a j))

name: OAI.NuclearTrace.rowNormalizer_mass
statement:
lemma rowNormalizer_mass (a : I → A) :
    (∑ i, star (a i*rowNormalizer (∑ j, star (a j)*a j)) *
      (a i*rowNormalizer (∑ j, star (a j)*a j))) =
    rowNormalizer (∑ j, star (a j)*a j)*(∑ j, star (a j)*a j)*
      rowNormalizer (∑ j, star (a j)*a j)

name: OAI.NuclearTrace.rowNormalizer_pairing_bound
statement:
theorem rowNormalizer_pairing_bound (τ : TracialState A) (a : I → A)
    (T : CStarMatrix I I ℂ) (hT : ‖T‖ ≤ 1) (u : A) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hmass : (τ.functional (∑ i, star (a i)*a i)).re ≤ 1+δ)
    (herr : (τ.functional (CFC.abs ((∑ i, star (a i)*a i)-1))).re ≤ δ) :
    ‖τ.functional (u*(matrixSynthesis a T-
      matrixSynthesis (fun i => a i*rowNormalizer (∑ j, star (a j)*a j)) T))‖^2 ≤
        2*(2+δ)*δ

name: OAI.NuclearTrace.row_mass_nonneg
statement: lemma row_mass_nonneg (a : I → A) : 0 ≤ ∑ i, star (a i)*a i

name: OAI.NuclearTrace.scalarMix_sub

      scalarMix (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm T) a i -
      scalarMix (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm T) b i

name: OAI.NuclearTrace.scalarMix_trace_sq_le

name: OAI.NuclearTrace.FiniteCoefficientSystem.normalize_pairing
statement:
lemma normalize_pairing (F : FiniteCoefficientSystem A) (i₀ : F.Index)
    (τ : TracialState A) (x u : A) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hmass : (τ.functional F.mass).re ≤ 1+δ)
    (herr : traceOneNorm τ (F.mass-1) ≤ δ) :

name: OAI.CurrentMain.layer_energy_global
statement:
theorem layer_energy_global (τ : Pureness.TracialState D)
    (n : J → ℕ) (e : (j : J) → Fin (n j) → D)
    (he : ∀ j i, IsStarProjection (e j i))
    (ho : ∀ j, Pairwise (fun i k => e j i * e j k = 0))
    (c : (j : J) → Fin (n j) → ℝ) (hc : ∀ j i, 0 ≤ c j i)
    (hm : ∀ j, Monotone (c j)) (x : unitary D)
    (h : J → D) (hh : ∀ j, 0 ≤ h j) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη1 : η ≤ 1)
    (hclose : ∑ j, traceOneNorm τ ((∑ i, c j i • e j i) - h j) ≤ η^2)
    (hmass : ∑ j, (τ.functional (h j)).re ≤ 1)
    (hcentral : ∑ j, traceOneNorm τ (h j - (x : D)*h j*star (x : D)) ≤ η^2) :
    ∑ j, ∑ i, orderedLayerWeights (c j) i * traceTwoNorm τ
      ((x : D)*upperLayerCut (e j) i - upperLayerCut (e j) i*(x : D))^2 ≤ 6*η

name: OAI.CurrentMain.raw_kraus_spectral_block
statement:
theorem raw_kraus_spectral_block (v : I → D) (hv : ∑ i, star (v i)*v i = 1)
    (K : Finset D) (hK : ∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ 1) {η : ℝ}
    (T : BlockControl (Fintype.card I) η)
    {q : D} (hq : IsStarProjection q) (hq0 : q ≠ 0)
    (hcomp : ∀ i j, ∀ x ∈ insert 1 K, ∃ α : ℂ,
      ‖q * (star (v i) * x * v j) * q - α • q‖ < T.tolerance / 2) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, n ≤ Fintype.card I ∧ ∃ U : ProjectionRow (Fin n) q, ∃ c : Fin n → ℝ,
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ c i) ∧ (∀ i, c i ≤ 1) ∧ Monotone c ∧
      (∀ τ : Pureness.TracialState D,
        traceOneNorm τ ((∑ i, c i • U.atom i) - weightedAverage (fun _ => 1) v q) ≤
          η ^ 2 * (τ.functional q).re) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ e : Fin k ↪ Fin n, ∀ x ∈ K, ∃ H : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℂ,
        ‖(U.subrow e).sample q * x * (U.subrow e).sample q - (U.subrow e).matrix q H‖ < η)

name: OAI.CurrentMain.spectral_row_block_of_spectral_bound
statement:
theorem spectral_row_block_of_spectral_bound {q : D} (hq : IsStarProjection q)
    (f : D →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (a : I → D)
    (haq : ∀ i, a i * q = a i)
    (hcs : ∀ i, (scalarRowGram_posSemidef f a).isHermitian.eigenvalues i ≤ 1)
    {M σ δ : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hasum : ∑ i, ‖a i‖ ≤ M)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hgram : ∀ i j, ‖rowPair a 1 i j - scalarRowGram f a i j • q‖ ≤ δ)
    (K : Finset D)
    (htest : ∀ x ∈ K, ∃ H : Matrix I I ℂ,
      ∀ i j, ‖rowPair a x i j - H i j • q‖ ≤ δ)
    (hKn : ∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((Real.sqrt σ)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
      ((Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 2 * δ)) ≤ 1 / 2) :
    let c := (scalarRowGram_posSemidef f a).isHermitian.eigenvalues
    let E := 2 * (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 3 * (Real.sqrt σ)⁻¹ ^ 3 * M *
      ((Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 2 * δ)
    ∃ U : ProjectionRow {i : I // σ ≤ c i} q,
      (∀ τ : Pureness.TracialState D,
        traceOneNorm τ ((∑ i : {i : I // σ ≤ c i}, c i • U.atom i) -
          ∑ i, a i * star (a i)) ≤
          ((Fintype.card I : ℝ) * ((M + 1) * E + (σ + (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 2 * δ))) *
            (τ.functional q).re) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ K, ∃ H : Matrix {i : I // σ ≤ c i} {i : I // σ ≤ c i} ℂ,
        ∀ i j, ‖rowPair U.entry x i j - H i j • q‖ ≤
          E * (1 + (Real.sqrt σ)⁻¹ * M) + (Real.sqrt σ)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
            ((Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 2 * δ))

name: OAI.CurrentMain.weighted_family_of_kraus_average
statement:
theorem weighted_family_of_kraus_average {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (hRR : RealRankZero D) (v : I → D) (hv : ∑ i, star (v i)*v i = 1)
    (K : Finset (unitary D)) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη1 : η < 1)
    {r : D} (hr : IsStarProjection r)
    (hcentral : ∀ P : ProjectionPartition r, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ τ : Pureness.TracialState D,
      ∑ s, traceOneNorm τ (weightedAverage (fun _ : I => (1 : ℝ)) v (P.piece s) -
        (x : D) * weightedAverage (fun _ : I => (1 : ℝ)) v (P.piece s) * star (x : D)) ≤ η^2) :
    ∃ F : WeightedBlockFamily r,
      (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ K, ∃ H : Matrix (Fin (F.columns j)) (Fin (F.columns j)) ℂ,
        ‖F.range j * (x : D) * F.range j - (F.row j).matrix (F.base j) H‖ < η) ∧
      (∀ τ : Pureness.TracialState D,
        traceOneNorm τ (F.weightedSum - weightedAverage (fun _ : I => (1 : ℝ)) v r) ≤ η ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ K, ∀ τ : Pureness.TracialState D,
        ∑ j, F.weight j * traceTwoNorm τ ((x : D) * F.range j - F.range j * (x : D)) ^ 2 ≤
          6 * η)

name: OAI.CurrentMain.global_partition_bound_corner
statement:
lemma global_partition_bound_corner {N : Type} [Fintype N]
    (v : N → D) (x : unitary D) {r : D} (hr : IsStarProjection r)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (h : ∀ (J : Type) [Fintype J] (q : J → D),
      (∀ j, IsStarProjection (q j)) → (∑ j, q j = 1) →
      ∀ τ : TracialState D,
      (∑ j, traceOneNorm τ (weightedAverage (fun _ : N => (1 : ℝ)) v (q j) -
        (x : D)*weightedAverage (fun _ : N => (1 : ℝ)) v (q j)*star (x : D)))^2 < δ^2)
    (P : ProjectionPartition r) (τ : TracialState D) :
    (∑ j, traceOneNorm τ (weightedAverage (fun _ : N => (1 : ℝ)) v (P.piece j) -
      (x : D)*weightedAverage (fun _ : N => (1 : ℝ)) v (P.piece j)*star (x : D))) ≤ δ

name: OAI.CurrentMain.BistochasticTest.relative_unitary_tests
statement:
lemma relative_unitary_tests [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A]
    (V : BistochasticTest A) (ι : A →⋆ₐ[ℂ] D) :
    ∃ L : Finset (unitary A), ∀ (J : Type) [Fintype J] (y : J → D)
      (τ : TracialState D) (B : ℝ), 0 ≤ B →
      (∀ u ∈ L, ∑ j, traceTwoNorm τ (ι (u : A)*y j-y j*ι (u : A))^2 ≤ B) →
      ∑ j, (V.map ι).energy τ (y j) ≤ (4*V.size)*B

name: OAI.CurrentMain.BistochasticTest.unitary_tests

    ∃ L : Finset (unitary D), ∀ (J : Type) [Fintype J] (y : J → D)

      (∀ u ∈ L, ∑ j, traceTwoNorm τ ((u : D)*y j-y j*(u : D))^2 ≤ B) →

name: OAI.CurrentMain.SampledPackingRound.precise_sampled_energy_sum
statement:
lemma precise_sampled_energy_sum
    (H : ∀ a, PackingStepBounds (F.range a.1) (R.occupied a) (R.sampled a) (R.inserted a)
      (η*F.weight a.1/2) σ δ K) (τ : TracialState D) (x : unitary D) (hx : x ∈ K) :
    (∑ a, traceTwoNorm τ ((x : D)*R.sampled a-R.sampled a*(x : D))^2) ≤
      η*(∑ j, F.weight j*traceTwoNorm τ ((x : D)*F.range j-F.range j*(x : D))^2)+
        6*σ*(R.sampledMass τ+R.targetMass τ)+10*R.totalError

name: OAI.CurrentMain.exists_precise_packing_round
statement:
lemma exists_precise_packing_round (hRR : RealRankZero D)
    (hsmall : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ g : D, IsStarProjection g ∧ IsFull g ∧
      (⨆ τ : TracialState D, (τ.functional g).re) < δ)
    {z₀ r : D} (hz₀ : IsStarProjection z₀) (F : WeightedBlockFamily r)
    (K : Finset (unitary D)) {η σ δ : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη1 : η < 1)
    (hση : σ ≤ η) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (happrox : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ K, ∃ H : Matrix (Fin (F.columns j)) (Fin (F.columns j)) ℂ,
      ‖F.range j*(x : D)*F.range j-(F.row j).matrix (F.base j) H‖ < σ) :
    ∃ R : SampledPackingRound F z₀ K η δ, ∀ a,
      PackingStepBounds (F.range a.1) (R.occupied a) (R.sampled a) (R.inserted a)
        (η*F.weight a.1/2) σ δ K

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.inwardOne_isTreeTest
statement:
lemma inwardOne_isTreeTest {r : Bool} {k : QuadraticKind} {h g : Node → ℝ}
    (hh : IsTreeTest r k h) (hg : IsTreeTest r k g) {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D)
    (hroot : [] ∈ D) (hsupp : ∀ s, s ∉ D → h s = 0)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.inward_pairing_identity
statement:
lemma inward_pairing_identity {r : Bool} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) {h g : Node → ℝ}
    (hsupp : ∀ s, s ∉ D → h s = 0) (x y : TreeCoordinate r →₀ ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ s, x s ≠ 0 → s.val ∈ D) (hy : ∀ s, s.val ∈ D → y s = 0)
    (a θ t : ℝ) :
    treePairing (a • h + θ • inwardCoeffsOne D h g) (x + t • y) +
      treePairing (a • h + θ • inwardCoeffsTwo D h g) (x - t • y) =
      2 * a * treePairing h x + t * θ * treePairing g y

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.paired_finite_inequality
statement:
theorem paired_finite_inequality {r : Bool} {k : QuadraticKind} {D : Set Node}
    (hD : Initial D) (hroot : [] ∈ D)
    (x y : TreeCoordinate r →₀ ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ s, x s ≠ 0 → s.val ∈ D) (hy : ∀ s, s.val ∈ D → y s = 0)
    {a θ t : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1/2)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hsquare : a^2 + θ^2 ≤ 1) :
    a * testNorm (treeTestFamily r k) x + (t * θ / 2) * testNorm (treeTestFamily r k) y ≤
      (testNorm (treeTestFamily r k) (x + t • y) + testNorm (treeTestFamily r k) (x - t • y)) / 2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.paired_finite_test_bound
statement:
theorem paired_finite_test_bound {r : Bool} {k : QuadraticKind} {D : Set Node}
    (hD : Initial D) (hroot : [] ∈ D)
    (x y : TreeCoordinate r →₀ ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ s, x s ≠ 0 → s.val ∈ D) (hy : ∀ s, s.val ∈ D → y s = 0)
    {a θ t : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1/2)
    (hsquare : a^2 + θ^2 ≤ 1)
    (f g : treeTestFamily r k) :
    a * finitePairing f.val x + (t * θ / 2) * finitePairing g.val y ≤
      (testNorm (treeTestFamily r k) (x + t • y) + testNorm (treeTestFamily r k) (x - t • y)) / 2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.averagedModulus_lower_bound
statement:
lemma averagedModulus_lower_bound {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {t b : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ x : E, ‖x‖ = 1 → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ F : ClosedFiniteCodim E,
      ∀ y : E, y ∈ F.space → 1 ≤ ‖y‖ →
        b - ε ≤ (‖x + t • y‖ + ‖x - t • y‖) / 2 - 1) :
    (b : EReal) ≤ averagedModulus E t

    (‖z + t • y‖ + ‖z - t • y‖) / 2 ≤

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.optimal_pair_parameters

      a + t * θ / 2 = Real.sqrt (1 + t^2/4)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.bounded_tree_modulus_eq_zero
statement:
theorem bounded_tree_modulus_eq_zero
    (p : (h : ℕ) → Tree h → E) {m M c : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hmM : m ≤ M) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hbound : ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : Tree h, m ≤ ‖p h s‖ ∧ ‖p h s‖ ≤ M)
    (hweak : ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → ∀ (s : Tree h) (hs : s.val.length < h),
      WeaklyNull (fun n => p h (child s hs n) - p h s))
    (hinc : ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → ∀ (s : Tree h) (hs : s.val.length < h) (n : ℕ),
      c ≤ ‖p h (child s hs n) - p h s‖) :
    oneSidedModulus E (c / (2 * M)) = 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.bounded_tree_renorming_obstruction
statement:
theorem bounded_tree_renorming_obstruction
    {Y : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace ℝ Y]
    (p : (h : ℕ) → Tree h → E) {m M c α β : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hmM : m ≤ M) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hbound : ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : Tree h, m ≤ ‖p h s‖ ∧ ‖p h s‖ ≤ M)
    (hweak : ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → ∀ (s : Tree h) (hs : s.val.length < h),
      WeaklyNull (fun n => p h (child s hs n) - p h s))
    (hinc : ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → ∀ (s : Tree h) (hs : s.val.length < h) (n : ℕ),
      c ≤ ‖p h (child s hs n) - p h s‖)
    (e : E ≃L[ℝ] Y) (hα : 0 < α) (hαβ : α ≤ β)
    (he : ∀ x : E, α * ‖x‖ ≤ ‖e x‖ ∧ ‖e x‖ ≤ β * ‖x‖) :
    oneSidedModulus Y (α * c / (2 * β * M)) = 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.hilbert_upper_eval_sq_sum
statement:
lemma hilbert_upper_eval_sq_sum {I : Type*} (v : I → E)
    (hv : ∀ (A : Finset I) (a : I → ℝ),
      ‖∑ n ∈ A, a n • v n‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ A, (a n)^2))
    (φ : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (A : Finset I) :
    ∑ n ∈ A, φ (v n)^2 ≤ ‖φ‖^2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.norm_bound_extends_to_rays

    {t γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hsphere : ∀ y : E, y ∈ F → ‖y‖ = 1 → 1 + γ ≤ ‖x + t • y‖)
    (y : E) (hy : y ∈ F) (hy1 : 1 ≤ ‖y‖) :
    1 + γ ≤ ‖x + t • y‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.oneSidedModulus_nonneg
statement: lemma oneSidedModulus_nonneg (t : ℝ) : (0 : EReal) ≤ oneSidedModulus E t

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.oneSided_growth
statement:
lemma oneSided_growth {t γ c : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hδ : (γ : EReal) < oneSidedModulus E t) (p : E) (hp : 0 < ‖p‖)
    (htp : t * ‖p‖ ≤ c/2) (d : ℕ → E) (hd : WeaklyNull d)
    (hdn : ∀ n, c ≤ ‖d n‖) :
    ∃ n, ‖p‖ + γ * ‖p‖ / 2 ≤ ‖p + d n‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.oneSided_sphere_tail
statement:
lemma oneSided_sphere_tail {t γ : ℝ} (hγ : (γ : EReal) < oneSidedModulus E t)
    (x : E) (hx : ‖x‖ = 1) :
    ∃ F : ClosedFiniteCodim E, ∀ y : E, y ∈ F.space → ‖y‖ = 1 →
      1 + γ ≤ ‖x + t • y‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.oneSided_wide_tail
statement:
lemma oneSided_wide_tail {t γ : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hδ : (γ : EReal) < oneSidedModulus E t) (p : E) (hp : 0 < ‖p‖) :
    ∃ F : ClosedFiniteCodim E, ∀ w : E, w ∈ F.space → t * ‖p‖ ≤ ‖w‖ →
      (1 + γ) * ‖p‖ ≤ ‖p + w‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.weaklyNull_of_hilbert_upper

lemma weaklyNull_of_hilbert_upper (v : ℕ → E)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.childNode_injective

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.finitePairing_nodeArray
statement:
lemma finitePairing_nodeArray (r : Bool) (f : TreeCoordinate r → ℝ) (s : Node) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.finitePairing_pathArray
statement:
lemma finitePairing_pathArray (r : Bool) (f : TreeCoordinate r → ℝ) (s : Node) :
    finitePairing f (pathArray r s) = potential (liftCoefficients r f) s

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.pathArray_apply
statement:
lemma pathArray_apply (r : Bool) (s : Node) (i : TreeCoordinate r) :
    pathArray r s i = if i.val <+: s then 1 else 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.pathArray_child
statement:
lemma pathArray_child (r : Bool) (s : Node) (n : ℕ) :
    pathArray r (s ++ [n]) = pathArray r s + nodeArray r (s ++ [n])

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.sibling_quadraticGroup
statement:
lemma sibling_quadraticGroup (k : QuadraticKind) (s : Node) (A : Finset ℕ) :
    QuadraticGroup k (A.image (fun n => s ++ [n]))

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.sibling_sq_sum_le
OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.testNorm_pathArray
statement:
lemma testNorm_pathArray (r : Bool) (k : QuadraticKind) (s : Node)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.testNorm_pathArray_le
statement:
lemma testNorm_pathArray_le (r : Bool) (k : QuadraticKind) (s : Node) :
    testNorm (treeTestFamily r k) (pathArray r s) ≤ 1

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.averaged_tail_bound_pullback
statement:
lemma averaged_tail_bound_pullback (e : E →L[ℝ] Y) (he : ∀ x, ‖e x‖ = ‖x‖)
    {t b : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ x : Y, ‖x‖ = 1 → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ F : ClosedFiniteCodim Y,
      ∀ y : Y, y ∈ F.space → 1 ≤ ‖y‖ →
        b - ε ≤ (‖x + t • y‖ + ‖x - t • y‖)/2 - 1) :
    (b : EReal) ≤ averagedModulus E t

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.continuousEquiv_bounds
statement:
lemma continuousEquiv_bounds (e : E ≃L[ℝ] Y) :
    ∃ α β : ℝ, 0 < α ∧ α ≤ β ∧ ∀ x, α * ‖x‖ ≤ ‖e x‖ ∧ ‖e x‖ ≤ β * ‖x‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.finitePairing_embDomain
statement:
lemma finitePairing_embDomain (ι : J ↪ I) (f : I → ℝ) (x : J →₀ ℝ) :
    finitePairing f (Finsupp.embDomain ι x) = finitePairing (f ∘ ι) x

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.mem_pullbackFiniteCodim
statement:
lemma mem_pullbackFiniteCodim (e : E →L[ℝ] Y) (F : ClosedFiniteCodim Y) (x : E) :
    x ∈ (pullbackFiniteCodim e F).space ↔ e x ∈ F.space

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.testNorm_restricted
statement:
lemma testNorm_restricted (K : TestFamily I) (ι : J ↪ I) (x : J →₀ ℝ) :
    testNorm (restrictedTestFamily K ι) x = testNorm K (Finsupp.embDomain ι x)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.FreeRoot.distinct_bound_le_common
statement:
lemma distinct_bound_le_common (t : ℝ) :
    (Real.sqrt (1+t^2/576)-1)/4 ≤ Real.sqrt (1+t^2/4)-1

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.FreeRoot.includeEdge_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma includeEdge_apply (s : TreeCoordinate false) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.FreeRoot.includeEdge_child
statement:
@[simp] lemma includeEdge_child (s : Node) (n : ℕ) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.FreeRoot.isFreePotential_iff
statement:
lemma isFreePotential_iff (b : Node → ℝ) :
    IsFreePotential b ↔ IsTreeTest true .sibling (increments b)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.FreeRoot.mem_freeTestFamily_iff
statement:
theorem mem_freeTestFamily_iff (f : TreeCoordinate false → ℝ) :
    f ∈ freeTestFamily.carrier ↔ ∃ b : Node → ℝ, IsFreePotential b ∧
      ∀ s : TreeCoordinate false, f s = b s.val - b s.val.dropLast

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.FreeRoot.rootless_restricted_potential
statement:
lemma rootless_restricted_potential (g : treeTestFamily true .sibling) (s : Node) :
    potential (liftCoefficients false (g.val ∘ includeEdge)) s =
      potential (liftCoefficients true g.val) s - liftCoefficients true g.val []

lemma coordinate_le_quadraticBlockCost {n : ℕ} (x : TreeHilbert n) (s : Tree n) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.dot_two_le_sqrt
statement:
lemma dot_two_le_sqrt (a b c d : ℝ) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.norm_QuadraticBlock

OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.pairCost_add_le

lemma pairCost_add_le (h k : H) (μ ν : M) :

lemma pairCost_eq_norm {H M : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H]

lemma pairCost_smul (a : ℝ) (h : H) (μ : M) :

statement: lemma pathBound_nonneg {n : ℕ} (f : TreeHilbert n) : 0 ≤ pathBound f

lemma quadraticBlockCost_abs_eval_scaled {n : ℕ} (f x : TreeHilbert n) :

lemma quadraticBlockCost_single_bounds {n : ℕ} (s : Tree n) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticCost_bddBelow

lemma quadraticCost_bddBelow (B : M →L[ℝ] H) (x : H) :

statement:
lemma quadraticCost_le (B : M →L[ℝ] H) (x : H) (μ : M) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticCost_le_norm
statement: lemma quadraticCost_le_norm (B : M →L[ℝ] H) (x : H) : quadraticCost B x ≤ ‖x‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticCost_nonneg
statement: lemma quadraticCost_nonneg (B : M →L[ℝ] H) (x : H) : 0 ≤ quadraticCost B x

statement:
lemma quadraticCost_representation_le (B : M →L[ℝ] H) (h : H) (μ : M) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticCost_smul_le

lemma quadraticCost_smul_le (B : M →L[ℝ] H) (a : ℝ) (x : H) :

lemma quadraticCost_synthesis_le (B : M →L[ℝ] H) (μ : M) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticPolar_nonneg

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticPolar_single

lemma quadraticPolar_single {n : ℕ} (s : Tree n) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticPolar_sq
statement:
lemma quadraticPolar_sq {n : ℕ} (f : TreeHilbert n) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.bounded_tree_modulus_eq_zero_le
statement:
theorem bounded_tree_modulus_eq_zero_le
    (p : (h : ℕ) → Tree h → E) {m M c t : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hmM : m ≤ M) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hbound : ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : Tree h, m ≤ ‖p h s‖ ∧ ‖p h s‖ ≤ M)
    (hweak : ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → ∀ (s : Tree h) (hs : s.val.length < h),
      WeaklyNull (fun n => p h (child s hs n) - p h s))
    (hinc : ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → ∀ (s : Tree h) (hs : s.val.length < h) (n : ℕ),
      c ≤ ‖p h (child s hs n) - p h s‖)
    (ht : 0 < t) (htM : t*M ≤ c) :
    oneSidedModulus E t = 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.prefix_child_iff

lemma prefix_child_iff (r s : List ℕ) (j : ℕ) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.raiseTree_child

lemma raiseTree_child {h : ℕ} (s : Tree h) (hs : s.val.length < h) (j : ℕ) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.single_sequence_weaklyNull

lemma single_sequence_weaklyNull {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I] (v : ℕ → I) (hv : Function.Injective v) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.subspace_radial_adjustment
statement:
lemma subspace_radial_adjustment (F : Submodule ℝ E) {d w : E} (hw : w ∈ F)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrd : r ≤ ‖d‖) (he : ‖d-w‖ < r) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.disk_sup_bound
statement:
lemma disk_sup_bound {A B C : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hC : 0 ≤ C)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.dominatedHilbert_norm_le
statement:
lemma dominatedHilbert_norm_le {n : ℕ} (f : TreeHilbert n) (g : Tree n → ℝ)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.ellipse_sup_bound
statement:
lemma ellipse_sup_bound {A B C : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hC : 0 ≤ C)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.extendCoeff_apply

@[simp] lemma extendCoeff_apply {n : ℕ} (f : TreeHilbert n) (s : Tree n) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.extendCoeff_head_support
statement:

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.extendCoeff_potential_bound
statement:
lemma extendCoeff_potential_bound {n : ℕ} (f : TreeHilbert n) (s : Node) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_apply

    head D f s = if s.val ∈ D then f s else 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_eq_iff

lemma head_eq_iff {n : ℕ} (D : Set Node) (f : TreeHilbert n) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_extendCoeff

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_idem

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_inner

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_linearCost_le

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_linearPolar_le

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_norm_le
statement: lemma head_norm_le {n : ℕ} (D : Set Node) (f : TreeHilbert n) : ‖head D f‖ ≤ ‖f‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_orthogonal

lemma head_orthogonal {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} {h r : TreeHilbert n}

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_pathBound_le
statement:
lemma head_pathBound_le {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (f : TreeHilbert n) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_quadraticCost_le

lemma head_quadraticCost_le {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (x : TreeHilbert n) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_quadraticPolar_le

lemma head_quadraticPolar_le {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (f : TreeHilbert n) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.inwardOne_head

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.inwardOne_norm

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.inwardOne_piece

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.inwardOne_potential
statement:
lemma inwardOne_potential {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (h g : TreeHilbert n)
    (hh : head D h = h) (s : Tree n) :
    pathPotential (inwardOne hD h g hh) s =
      TreeCalculus.inwardPotentialOne D (extendCoeff h) (extendCoeff g) s.val

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.inwardTwo_head
statement:
lemma inwardTwo_head {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (h g : TreeHilbert n)
    (hh : head D h = h) : head D (inwardTwo hD h g hh) = 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.inwardTwo_norm
statement:
lemma inwardTwo_norm {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (h g : TreeHilbert n)
    (hh : head D h = h) : ‖inwardTwo hD h g hh‖ ≤ ‖g‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.inwardTwo_piece
statement:
lemma inwardTwo_piece {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (h g : TreeHilbert n)
    (hh : head D h = h) : InwardPiece D h g (inwardTwo hD h g hh)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.inwardTwo_potential
statement:
lemma inwardTwo_potential {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (h g : TreeHilbert n)
    (hh : head D h = h) (s : Tree n) :
    pathPotential (inwardTwo hD h g hh) s =
      TreeCalculus.inwardPotentialTwo D (extendCoeff h) (extendCoeff g) s.val

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.inward_difference
statement:
lemma inward_difference {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (h g : TreeHilbert n)
    (hh : head D h = h) : inwardOne hD h g hh - inwardTwo hD h g hh = g-head D g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.linearBlockCost_norming
statement:
lemma linearBlockCost_norming (n : ℕ) (x : TreeHilbert n) :
    ∃ f : TreeHilbert n, linearPolar n f ≤ 1 ∧ inner ℝ f x = linearBlockCost n x

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.linear_midpoint_tail
statement:
theorem linear_midpoint_tail {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (x y : TreeHilbert n)
    (hx : head D x = x) :
    Real.sqrt ((linearBlockCost n x)^2+(linearBlockCost n (y-head D y))^2/16) ≤
      (linearBlockCost n (x+y)+linearBlockCost n (x-y))/2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.linear_paired
statement:
theorem linear_paired {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (x y : TreeHilbert n)
    (hx : head D x = x) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a^2+4*b^2 ≤ 1) :
    a*linearBlockCost n x+(b/2)*linearBlockCost n (y-head D y) ≤
      (linearBlockCost n (x+y)+linearBlockCost n (x-y))/2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.linear_paired_unit
statement:
theorem linear_paired_unit {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (x y : TreeHilbert n)
    (hx : head D x = x) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hb1 : b ≤ 1/2) (hab : a^2+b^2 ≤ 1) :
    a*linearBlockCost n x+(b/2)*linearBlockCost n (y-head D y) ≤
      (linearBlockCost n (x+y)+linearBlockCost n (x-y))/2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.pathPotential_child
statement:
lemma pathPotential_child {n : ℕ} (f : TreeHilbert n) (s : Tree n)
    (hs : s.val.length < n) (j : ℕ) :
    pathPotential f (child s hs j) = pathPotential f s + f (child s hs j)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.pathPotential_root
statement: lemma pathPotential_root {n : ℕ} (f : TreeHilbert n) : pathPotential f (root n) = f (root n)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.potential_congr_on_prefix
statement:
lemma potential_congr_on_prefix (f g : Node → ℝ) (s : Node)
    (h : ∀ r, r <+: s → f r = g r) : potential f s = potential g s

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.potential_extendCoeff
statement:
lemma potential_extendCoeff {n : ℕ} (f : TreeHilbert n) (s : Tree n) :
    potential (extendCoeff f) s.val = pathPotential f s

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.quadratic_eval_le
statement:
lemma quadratic_eval_le {n : ℕ} {f : TreeHilbert n} (hf : quadraticPolar n f ≤ 1)
    (x : TreeHilbert n) : inner ℝ f x ≤ quadraticBlockCost n x

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.quadratic_midpoint_tail
statement:
theorem quadratic_midpoint_tail {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (x y : TreeHilbert n)
    (hx : head D x = x) :
    Real.sqrt ((quadraticBlockCost n x)^2+(quadraticBlockCost n (y-head D y))^2/16) ≤
      (quadraticBlockCost n (x+y)+quadraticBlockCost n (x-y))/2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.quadratic_paired
statement:
theorem quadratic_paired {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (x y : TreeHilbert n)
    (hx : head D x = x) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a^2+4*b^2 ≤ 1) :
    a*quadraticBlockCost n x+(b/2)*quadraticBlockCost n (y-head D y) ≤
      (quadraticBlockCost n (x+y)+quadraticBlockCost n (x-y))/2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.lp_hasSum_sq
statement:
lemma lp_hasSum_sq {I : Type*} {E : I → Type*} [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)]
    [∀ i, NormedSpace ℝ (E i)] (x : HilbertSum E) :
    HasSum (fun i => ‖x i‖^2) (‖x‖^2)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.lp_midpoint_sq
statement:
lemma lp_midpoint_sq (x z u v : HilbertSum E)
    (h : ∀ i, ‖x i‖^2+‖z i‖^2/16 ≤ ((‖u i‖+‖v i‖)/2)^2) :
    ‖x‖^2+‖z‖^2/16 ≤ ((‖u‖+‖v‖)/2)^2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.average_add
statement:
lemma average_add (k : ℕ) (f g : List Bool → ℝ) :
    average k (fun w => f w+g w) = average k f+average k g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.average_congr
statement:
lemma average_congr {k : ℕ} {f g : List Bool → ℝ} (h : ∀ w, w.length = k → f w = g w) :
    average k f = average k g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.average_const
statement: lemma average_const (k : ℕ) (c : ℝ) : average k (fun _ => c) = c

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.average_mono
statement:
lemma average_mono {k : ℕ} {f g : List Bool → ℝ} (h : ∀ w, w.length = k → f w ≤ g w) :
    average k f ≤ average k g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.average_mul
statement:
lemma average_mul (k : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (f : List Bool → ℝ) :
    average k (fun w => c*f w) = c*average k f

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.average_nonneg
statement:
lemma average_nonneg {k : ℕ} {f : List Bool → ℝ} (h : ∀ w, w.length = k → 0 ≤ f w) :
    0 ≤ average k f

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.average_sub
statement:
lemma average_sub (k : ℕ) (f g : List Bool → ℝ) :
    average k (fun w => f w-g w) = average k f-average k g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.average_succ
statement:
lemma average_succ (k : ℕ) (f : List Bool → ℝ) :
    average (k+1) f = average k (fun w => (f (false::w)+f (true::w))/2)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.average_zero
statement: lemma average_zero (f : List Bool → ℝ) : average 0 f = f []

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.endpoints
statement:
lemma endpoints {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    {m : ℕ} {W : List Bool → E} (hW : IsMartingale m W) (w : List Bool) (hw : w.length < m) :
    W w+(1/2 : ℝ) • (W (false::w)-W (true::w)) = W (false::w) ∧
    W w-(1/2 : ℝ) • (W (false::w)-W (true::w)) = W (true::w)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.mem_histories
statement: lemma mem_histories {k : ℕ} {w : List Bool} : w ∈ histories k ↔ w.length = k

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.telescope
statement:
lemma telescope {m : ℕ} {v e : List Bool → ℝ} (hv : ∀ w, 0 ≤ v w)
    (he : ∀ w, w.length < m → (e (false::w)+e (true::w))/2 ≤
      16*((v (false::w)+v (true::w))/2-v w)) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, average (i+1) e) ≤ 16*average m v

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.FiniteOuterHead.hull_contains
statement: lemma hull_contains (S : Finset ForestNode) {s : ForestNode} (hs : s ∈ S) : s ∈ hull S

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.FiniteOuterHead.hull_initial
OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.FiniteOuterHead.mem_ancestors_same
statement:
lemma mem_ancestors_same (n : ℕ) (s r : Tree (n+1)) :
    (⟨n,r⟩ : ForestNode) ∈ ancestors ⟨n,s⟩ ↔ r.val <+: s.val

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.FiniteOuterHead.ofFinset_contains
statement:
lemma ofFinset_contains (S : Finset ForestNode) {s : ForestNode} (hs : s ∈ S) :
    s.2.val ∈ (ofFinset S).nodes s.1

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.InwardPiece.error_bound
OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.InwardPiece.linear_le_two
OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_nested
statement:
lemma head_nested {n : ℕ} {A D : Set Node} (hAD : A ⊆ D) (x : TreeHilbert n) :
    head A (head D x) = head A x

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.linear_leakage_step
statement:
theorem linear_leakage_step {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D)
    (x y : TreeHilbert n) :
    ((linearBlockCost n ((x+y)-head D (x+y)))^2+
      (linearBlockCost n ((x-y)-head D (x-y)))^2)/2 ≤
      50*(linearBlockCost n (x-head D x))^2+
      32*(((linearBlockCost n (x+y))^2+(linearBlockCost n (x-y))^2)/2-
        (linearBlockCost n (head D x))^2)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.linear_paired_leak
statement:
theorem linear_paired_leak {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D)
    (x y : TreeHilbert n) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a^2+4*b^2 ≤ 1) :
    a*linearBlockCost n (head D x)+(b/2)*linearBlockCost n (y-head D y) ≤
      (linearBlockCost n (x+y)+linearBlockCost n (x-y))/2 +
        2*b*linearBlockCost n (x-head D x)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.leakage_energy_scalar
statement:
lemma leakage_energy_scalar {r l q c d u v : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hl : 0 ≤ l) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hup : u ≤ l+q) (hvp : v ≤ l+q)
    (h : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → a^2+4*b^2 ≤ 1 →
      a*r+(b/2)*q ≤ (c+d)/2+2*b*l) :
    (u^2+v^2)/2 ≤ 50*l^2+32*((c^2+d^2)/2-r^2)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.coeff_bound
statement: lemma coeff_bound (A : Atom) {S : Segment} (hS : S ∈ A.family) : |A.coeff S| ≤ 1

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.coordinate_profile
statement:
@[simp] lemma coordinate_profile (v : Node) :
    (coordinate v).profile = fun s => if s=v then 1 else 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.defect
statement:
lemma defect (A : Atom) {g : Node → ℝ} (hg : IsUnitTest g) :
    0 ≤ 1-A.pairing g ∧
    (∑ S ∈ A.family, (A.coeff S-S.eval g)^2) ≤ 2*(1-A.pairing g) ∧
    1-(∑ S ∈ A.family, (S.eval g)^2) ≤ 2*(1-A.pairing g)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.neg_profile
statement: @[simp] lemma neg_profile (A : Atom) : A.neg.profile = -A.profile

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.pairing_bound
statement: lemma pairing_bound (A : Atom) {g : Node → ℝ} (hg : IsUnitTest g) : |A.pairing g| ≤ 1

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.pairing_sq_le
statement: lemma pairing_sq_le (A : Atom) {g : Node → ℝ} (hg : IsUnitTest g) : (A.pairing g)^2 ≤ 1

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.profile_at
statement:
lemma profile_at (A : Atom) {S : Segment} (hS : S ∈ A.family) {v : Node}
    (hv : v ∈ S.nodes) : A.profile v = A.coeff S

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.profile_bound
statement: lemma profile_bound (A : Atom) (v : Node) : |A.profile v| ≤ 1

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.profile_missing
statement:
lemma profile_missing (A : Atom) {v : Node} (hv : ∀ S ∈ A.family, v ∉ S.nodes) :
    A.profile v = 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.zero_profile
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_profile : zero.profile = 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Prefix.antisymm
statement: lemma Prefix.antisymm {s t : Node} (h : Prefix s t) (h' : Prefix t s) : s = t

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Prefix.trans
statement: lemma Prefix.trans {s t u : Node} (h : Prefix s t) (h' : Prefix t u) : Prefix s u

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Segment.eval_add
statement: @[simp] lemma eval_add (S : Segment) (f g : Node → ℝ) : S.eval (f+g) = S.eval f+S.eval g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Segment.eval_coordinate
statement:
lemma eval_coordinate (S : Segment) (v : Node) :
    S.eval (fun s => if s=v then (1:ℝ) else 0) = if v ∈ S.nodes then 1 else 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Segment.eval_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma eval_neg (S : Segment) (g : Node → ℝ) : S.eval (-g) = -S.eval g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Segment.eval_singleton
statement: @[simp] lemma eval_singleton (s : Node) (g : Node → ℝ) : (singleton s).eval g = g s

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Segment.eval_smul
statement: @[simp] lemma eval_smul (S : Segment) (c : ℝ) (g : Node → ℝ) : S.eval (c • g) = c*S.eval g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Segment.eval_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma eval_zero (S : Segment) : S.eval 0 = 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Segment.finish_mem
statement: @[simp] lemma finish_mem (S : Segment) : S.finish ∈ S.nodes

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Segment.mem_nodes
statement: lemma mem_nodes (S : Segment) (s : Node) : s ∈ S.nodes ↔ Prefix S.start s ∧ Prefix s S.finish

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Segment.singleton_nodes
statement: @[simp] lemma singleton_nodes (s : Node) : (singleton s).nodes = {s}

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Segment.start_mem
statement: @[simp] lemma start_mem (S : Segment) : S.start ∈ S.nodes

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.incomparable_disjoint
statement:
lemma incomparable_disjoint {F : Finset Segment} (hF : Incomparable F)
    {S T : Segment} (hS : S ∈ F) (hT : T ∈ F) (hne : S ≠ T) :
    Disjoint S.nodes T.nodes

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.incomparable_nodes
statement:
lemma incomparable_nodes {F : Finset Segment} (hF : Incomparable F)
    {S T : Segment} (hS : S ∈ F) (hT : T ∈ F) (hne : S ≠ T)
    {s t : Node} (hs : s ∈ S.nodes) (ht : t ∈ T.nodes) :
    ¬Prefix s t ∧ ¬Prefix t s

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.mem_ancestors
statement: lemma mem_ancestors (v s : Node) : s ∈ ancestors v ↔ Prefix s v

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.prefix_chain
statement:
lemma prefix_chain {s t u : Node} (h : Prefix s u) (h' : Prefix t u) :
    Prefix s t ∨ Prefix t s

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.prefix_refl
statement: lemma prefix_refl (s : Node) : Prefix s s

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.unit_coordinate
statement: lemma unit_coordinate {g : Node → ℝ} (hg : IsUnitTest g) (s : Node) : |g s| ≤ 1

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.unit_coordinate_test
statement: lemma unit_coordinate_test (v : Node) : IsUnitTest (fun s => if s=v then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.unit_neg
statement: lemma unit_neg {g : Node → ℝ} (hg : IsUnitTest g) : IsUnitTest (-g)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.unit_segment
statement: lemma unit_segment {g : Node → ℝ} (hg : IsUnitTest g) (S : Segment) : |S.eval g| ≤ 1

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.unit_zero
statement: lemma unit_zero : IsUnitTest 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.coordinate_vector
statement: @[simp] lemma coordinate_vector (v : Node) : (coordinate v).vector = Finsupp.single v 1

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.finitePairing_vector
statement:
lemma finitePairing_vector (A : Atom) (g : Node → ℝ) :
    finitePairing g A.vector = A.pairing g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.neg_vector
statement: @[simp] lemma neg_vector (A : Atom) : A.neg.vector = -A.vector

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.oneSegment_vector
statement: @[simp] lemma oneSegment_vector (S : Segment) : (oneSegment S).vector = segmentVector S

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.pairing_smul
statement:
lemma Atom.pairing_smul (A : Atom) (c : ℝ) (g : Node → ℝ) :
    A.pairing (c • g) = c*A.pairing g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.vector_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma vector_apply (A : Atom) (v : Node) : A.vector v = A.profile v

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.zero_vector
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_vector : zero.vector = 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.finitePairing_profile
statement:
lemma finitePairing_profile (A : Atom) (g : Node →₀ ℝ) :
    finitePairing A.profile g = A.pairing g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.finitePairing_segmentVector
statement:
lemma finitePairing_segmentVector (S : Segment) (g : Node → ℝ) :
    finitePairing g (segmentVector S) = S.eval g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.predual_test_bound
statement:
lemma predual_test_bound (g : Node →₀ ℝ) (F : Finset Segment) (hF : Incomparable F) :
    Real.sqrt (∑ S ∈ F, (S.eval g)^2) ≤ testNorm atomTests g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.predual_unit_iff
statement: lemma predual_unit_iff (g : Node →₀ ℝ) : testNorm atomTests g ≤ 1 ↔ IsUnitTest g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.segmentVector_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma segmentVector_apply (S : Segment) (v : Node) :
    segmentVector S v = if v ∈ S.nodes then 1 else 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.unit_iff_pairing_atoms
statement:
lemma unit_iff_pairing_atoms (g : Node → ℝ) :
    IsUnitTest g ↔ ∀ A : Atom, |A.pairing g| ≤ 1

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Segment.eval_to_exit
OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Segment.head_restriction
statement:
lemma Segment.head_restriction (S : Segment) {C : Set Node} (hC : Initial C)
    (hn : (S.nodes.filter (fun v => v ∈ C)).Nonempty) :
    ∃ R : Segment, R.start=S.start ∧ R.finish ∈ S.nodes ∧
      R.nodes=S.nodes.filter (fun v => v ∈ C)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Segment.shorten_at_exit
OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Segment.shorten_before
statement:
lemma Segment.shorten_before (S : Segment) {t : Node}
    (hst : Prefix S.start t) (htf : Prefix t S.finish) (hne : S.start ≠ t) :
    ∃ R : Segment, R.start=S.start ∧ ∀ g : Node → ℝ,
      R.eval g=S.eval g-(Segment.mk t S.finish htf).eval g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Segment.tail_exit
statement:
lemma Segment.tail_exit (S : Segment) {C : Set Node} (hC : Initial C)
    (hs : S.start ∈ C) (hn : (S.nodes.filter (fun v => v ∉ C)).Nonempty) :
    ∃ R : Segment, R.finish=S.finish ∧ R.start ∈ S.nodes ∧
      R.nodes=S.nodes.filter (fun v => v ∉ C) ∧ IsExit C R.start

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Segment.tail_restriction
statement:
lemma Segment.tail_restriction (S : Segment) {C : Set Node} (hC : Initial C)
    (hn : (S.nodes.filter (fun v => v ∉ C)).Nonempty) :
    ∃ R : Segment, R.finish=S.finish ∧ R.start ∈ S.nodes ∧
      R.nodes=S.nodes.filter (fun v => v ∉ C)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.exits_incomparable
statement:
lemma exits_incomparable {C : Set Node} {q r : Node} (hq : IsExit C q)
    (hr : IsExit C r) (hne : q ≠ r) : ¬Prefix q r ∧ ¬Prefix r q

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.incomparable_image
statement:
lemma incomparable_image {F : Finset Segment} (hF : Incomparable F)
    (R : Segment → Segment) (hR : ∀ S ∈ F, (R S).start ∈ S.nodes) :
    Incomparable (F.image R) ∧ Set.InjOn R (F : Set Segment)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.initial_before
statement: lemma initial_before (t : Node) : Initial {v | ¬Prefix t v}

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.initial_complement
statement:
lemma initial_complement {C : Set Node} (hC : Initial C) {s t : Node}
    (hs : s ∉ C) (hst : Prefix s t) : t ∉ C

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.oppositeProduct_eq
statement:
lemma oppositeProduct_eq (a b : ℝ) :
    oppositeProduct a b = if a*b < 0 then |a*b| else 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.oppositeProduct_nonneg
statement: lemma oppositeProduct_nonneg (a b : ℝ) : 0 ≤ oppositeProduct a b

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.prefix_equal_length
statement:
lemma prefix_equal_length {s t : Node} (h : Prefix s t)
    (hlen : s.2.val.length=t.2.val.length) : s=t

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.prefix_of_length_le
statement:
lemma prefix_of_length_le {s t u : Node} (hs : Prefix s u) (ht : Prefix t u)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.shortening_loss

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.unsigned_energy_bound
statement:
lemma unsigned_energy_bound (p : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hp1 : ∑ i, p i=1)
    (r : I → Q → ℝ) (d : I → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i j, (∑ q, oppositeProduct (r i q) (r j q)) ≤ d i+d j) :
    (∑ q, (∑ i, p i*|r i q|)^2) ≤
      (∑ q, (∑ i, p i*r i q)^2)+4*(∑ i, p i*d i)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.unsigned_energy_identity
statement:
lemma unsigned_energy_identity (p : I → ℝ) (r : I → Q → ℝ) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.weighted_sqrt_bound

lemma weighted_sqrt_bound (p : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hp1 : ∑ i, p i=1)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.cancellation
statement:
theorem cancellation {C : Set Node} (hC : Initial C) {g : Node → ℝ}
    (hg : IsUnitTest g) (hsupp : ∀ v ∉ C, g v=0) (A B : Atom) (Q : Finset Node)
    (hQ : ∀ q ∈ Q, IsExit C q) :
    (∑ q ∈ Q, oppositeProduct (A.exitCoeff g q) (B.exitCoeff g q)) ≤
      (1-A.pairing g)+(1-B.pairing g)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.early_cancellation
statement:
lemma early_cancellation {C : Set Node} (hC : Initial C) {g : Node → ℝ}
    (hg : IsUnitTest g) (hsupp : ∀ v ∉ C, g v=0) (A B : Atom) (Q : Finset Node)
    (hQ : ∀ q ∈ Q, IsExit C q)
    (hop : ∀ q ∈ Q, A.exitCoeff g q*B.exitCoeff g q < 0)
    (hearly : ∀ q ∈ Q, Prefix (A.original q).start (B.original q).start ∧
      (A.original q).start ≠ (B.original q).start) :
    2*(∑ q ∈ Q, |A.exitCoeff g q*B.exitCoeff g q|) ≤
      1-(∑ S ∈ A.family, (S.eval g)^2)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.exitCoeff_eq

lemma finitePairing_filter (C : Set Node) [DecidablePred (fun v => v ∈ C)] (g : Node → ℝ) (z : Node →₀ ℝ) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.shortening_injective
statement:
lemma shortening_injective {Q : Type*} (qset : Finset Q)
    {g : Node → ℝ} (hg : IsUnitTest g) {F : Finset Segment} (hF : Incomparable F)
    (D : Q → Segment) (b : Q → ℝ)
    (hD : ∀ q ∈ qset, D q ∈ F) (hinj : Set.InjOn D (qset : Set Q))
    (hsign : ∀ q ∈ qset, (D q).eval g*b q ≤ 0)
    (hshort : ∀ q ∈ qset, ∃ R : Segment, R.start=(D q).start ∧
      R.eval g=(D q).eval g-b q) :
    2*(∑ q ∈ qset, |(D q).eval g*b q|) ≤ 1-(∑ S ∈ F, (S.eval g)^2)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.norm_weighted_signed_sum

name: OAI.Dixmier.DayDixmier.mean_const

name: OAI.Dixmier.DayDixmier.mean_norm_le
statement:
lemma mean_norm_le (m : (G →ᵇ ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)
    (h1 : m (BoundedContinuousFunction.const G 1) = 1)
    (hp : ∀ f : G →ᵇ ℂ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ (f x).re ∧ (f x).im = 0) →

    (f : G →ᵇ ℂ) (C : ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, (f x).im = 0)

name: OAI.Dixmier.DayDixmier.averagedForm_bound
statement:
lemma averagedForm_bound (m : (G →ᵇ ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)
    (h1 : m (BoundedContinuousFunction.const G 1) = 1)
    (hp : ∀ f : G →ᵇ ℂ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ (f x).re ∧ (f x).im = 0) →
      0 ≤ (m f).re ∧ (m f).im = 0) (x y : H) :

name: OAI.Dixmier.DayDixmier.averagedForm_lower
statement:
lemma averagedForm_lower (m : (G →ᵇ ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)
    (h1 : m (BoundedContinuousFunction.const G 1) = 1)
    (hp : ∀ f : G →ᵇ ℂ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ (f x).re ∧ (f x).im = 0) →
      0 ≤ (m f).re ∧ (m f).im = 0) (x : H) :

name: OAI.Dixmier.DayDixmier.averagedForm_nonneg
statement:
lemma averagedForm_nonneg (m : (G →ᵇ ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)
    (hp : ∀ f : G →ᵇ ℂ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ (f x).re ∧ (f x).im = 0) →

name: OAI.Dixmier.DayDixmier.coefficient_add_left
statement:
lemma coefficient_add_left (x y z : H) :

name: OAI.Dixmier.DayDixmier.coefficient_add_right
statement:
lemma coefficient_add_right (x y z : H) :

name: OAI.Dixmier.DayDixmier.coefficient_apply

name: OAI.Dixmier.DayDixmier.coefficient_norm_le
statement:
lemma coefficient_norm_le (x y : H) :

lemma coefficient_smul_left (c : ℂ) (x y : H) :

name: OAI.Dixmier.DayDixmier.coefficient_smul_right
statement:
lemma coefficient_smul_right (c : ℂ) (x y : H) :

name: OAI.Dixmier.DayDixmier.coefficient_translate
statement:
lemma coefficient_translate (h : G) (x y : H) :

name: OAI.Dixmier.columnDifference_card_le
statement:
theorem columnDifference_card_le (a : G → I → Bool) (s : I → G) (r : ℕ)
    (hc : ∀ y, (columnZeros a s y).card ≤ r) (g y : G) :
    (columnDifference a s g y).card ≤ min (2 * r) (Fintype.card I)

name: OAI.Dixmier.columnDifference_subset
statement:
theorem columnDifference_subset (a : G → I → Bool) (s : I → G) (g y : G) :
    columnDifference a s g y ⊆ columnZeros a s y ∪ columnZeros a s (g⁻¹ * y)

name: OAI.Dixmier.difference_mask_ne_zero

theorem difference_mask_ne_zero (b c : Bool) :
    boolComplex b - boolComplex c ≠ 0 ↔ b ≠ c

name: OAI.Dixmier.difference_mask_norm
statement: theorem difference_mask_norm (b c : Bool) : ‖boolComplex b - boolComplex c‖ ≤ 1

name: OAI.Dixmier.rowDifference_card_le
statement:
theorem rowDifference_card_le (a : G → I → Bool) (r : ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ x, (rowOnes a x).card ≤ r) (g x : G) :

name: OAI.Dixmier.rowDifference_subset
statement:
theorem rowDifference_subset (a : G → I → Bool) (g x : G) :
    rowDifference a g x ⊆ rowOnes a x ∪ rowOnes a (g⁻¹ * x)

name: OAI.Dixmier.assigned_col_card_le
OAI.Dixmier.assigned_row_card_le
OAI.Dixmier.endpointSlots_biUnion
statement:
theorem endpointSlots_biUnion (row : E → V) (col : E → W) (r : ℕ)
    (F : Finset E) :
    F.biUnion (endpointSlots row col r) =
      ((F.image row) ×ˢ (univ : Finset (Fin r))).disjSum ((F.image col) ×ˢ univ)

name: OAI.Dixmier.exists_endpoint_assignment
statement:
theorem exists_endpoint_assignment (row : E → V) (col : E → W) (r : ℕ)
    (hdensity : ∀ F : Finset E, F.card ≤ r * ((F.image row).card + (F.image col).card)) :
    ∃ f : E → (V × Fin r) ⊕ (W × Fin r), Function.Injective f ∧
      ∀ e, f e ∈ endpointSlots row col r e

name: OAI.Dixmier.exists_sparse_mask
statement:
theorem exists_sparse_mask {G I : Type*} [Group G] [Fintype I] (s : I → G) (r : ℕ)
    (hdensity : ∀ F : Finset (G × I), F.card ≤
      r * ((F.image Prod.fst).card + (F.image (fun e => e.1 * s e.2)).card)) :
    ∃ a : G → I → Bool, (∀ x, (rowOnes a x).card ≤ r) ∧
      ∀ y, (columnZeros a s y).card ≤ r

name: OAI.Dixmier.edges_subset_endpoint_rectangle
statement:
theorem edges_subset_endpoint_rectangle (s : I → G) (F : Finset (G × I)) :
    F ⊆ rectangleEdges s (F.image Prod.fst) (F.image fun e => e.1 * s e.2)

name: OAI.Dixmier.endpoint_density_of_rectangle_bound
statement:
theorem endpoint_density_of_rectangle_bound (s : I → G) {q : ℝ} {r : ℕ}
    (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hqr : q ≤ r)
    (hrect : ∀ U V : Finset G, ((rectangleEdges s U V).card : ℝ) ≤
      q * Real.sqrt ((U.card : ℝ) * V.card))
    (F : Finset (G × I)) :
    F.card ≤ r * ((F.image Prod.fst).card + (F.image fun e => e.1 * s e.2).card)

name: OAI.Dixmier.sqrt_mul_le_half_add
statement:
theorem sqrt_mul_le_half_add {u v : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :

name: OAI.Dixmier.l2_norm_sq

@[simp] theorem reindexL2_apply (e : G ≃ G) (ξ : ScalarL2 G) (x : G) :

name: OAI.Dixmier.reindexL2_norm
statement: theorem reindexL2_norm (e : G ≃ G) (ξ : ScalarL2 G) : ‖reindexL2 e ξ‖ = ‖ξ‖

name: OAI.Dixmier.pairwise_sq_le_sum
OAI.Dixmier.sum_pairwise_sq
statement:
theorem sum_pairwise_sq (S : Finset I) (v : I → H) :
    ∑ i ∈ S, ∑ j ∈ S, ‖v i - v j‖ ^ 2 =
      2 * (S.card : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ S, ‖v i‖ ^ 2) - 2 * ‖∑ i ∈ S, v i‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.Dixmier.coboundary_cocycle
statement:
theorem coboundary_cocycle (U : G →* R) (T : R) (g h : G) :
    coboundary U T (g * h) = coboundary U T g + conjugate U g (coboundary U T h)

name: OAI.Dixmier.coboundary_one
statement: @[simp] theorem coboundary_one (U : G →* R) (T : R) : coboundary U T 1 = 0

name: OAI.Dixmier.conjugate_eq_self_iff_commute
statement:
theorem conjugate_eq_self_iff_commute (U : G →* R) (g : G) (T : R) :

name: OAI.Dixmier.conjugate_mul
statement:
theorem conjugate_mul (U : G →* R) (g h : G) (T : R) :
    conjugate U (g * h) T = conjugate U g (conjugate U h T)

name: OAI.Dixmier.conjugate_one
statement: @[simp] theorem conjugate_one (U : G →* R) (T : R) : conjugate U 1 T = T

name: OAI.Dixmier.conjugate_sub
statement:
theorem conjugate_sub (U : G →* R) (g : G) (A B : R) :
    conjugate U g (A - B) = conjugate U g A - conjugate U g B

name: OAI.Dixmier.equal_coboundaries_iff_commute_sub
statement:
theorem equal_coboundaries_iff_commute_sub (U : G →* R) (T B : R) (g : G) :
    coboundary U T g = coboundary U B g ↔ Commute (U g) (T - B)

name: OAI.Dixmier.triangular_cocycle_mul
statement:
theorem triangular_cocycle_mul (U : G →* R) (D : G → R)
    (hD : ∀ g h, D (g * h) = D g + conjugate U g (D h))
    (g h : G) (x : R × R) :
    triangular (U g) (D g) (triangular (U h) (D h) x) =
      triangular (U (g * h)) (D (g * h)) x

name: OAI.Dixmier.amenable_of_approximate_means
statement:
theorem amenable_of_approximate_means
    (h : ∀ (S : Finset G) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
      ∃ m : (G →ᵇ ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ,
        ‖m‖ ≤ 1 ∧ m (BoundedContinuousFunction.const G (1 : ℂ)) = 1 ∧
        (∀ b : G →ᵇ ℂ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ (b x).re ∧ (b x).im = 0) →
          0 ≤ (m b).re ∧ (m b).im = 0) ∧
        ∀ g ∈ S, ∀ b : G →ᵇ ℂ, ‖m (leftTranslate g b) - m b‖ ≤ ε * ‖b‖) :
    Amenable G

name: OAI.Dixmier.coefficient_norm_sq_eq_trace
statement:
theorem coefficient_norm_sq_eq_trace (W : EuclideanSpace ℂ (K × K)) :
    ‖W‖^2 = (Matrix.trace (Matrix.conjTranspose (coefficientMatrix W) * coefficientMatrix W)).re

name: OAI.Dixmier.kernelCoefficients_offsupport
statement:
theorem kernelCoefficients_offsupport (v : I → EuclideanSpace ℂ K) (s : I → G)

name: OAI.Dixmier.kernel_energy_ge_card

name: OAI.Dixmier.rankOneCoefficients_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rankOneCoefficients_apply (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ K) (a b : K) :

name: OAI.Dixmier.rankOne_inner
statement:
theorem rankOne_inner (v w : EuclideanSpace ℂ K) :
    inner ℂ (rankOneCoefficients v) (rankOneCoefficients w) =

name: OAI.Dixmier.rankOne_inner_re
statement:
theorem rankOne_inner_re (v w : EuclideanSpace ℂ K) :
    (inner ℂ (rankOneCoefficients v) (rankOneCoefficients w)).re = ‖inner ℂ v w‖^2

name: OAI.Dixmier.rankOne_norm_sq
statement:
theorem rankOne_norm_sq (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ K) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) :
    ‖rankOneCoefficients v‖^2 = 1

name: OAI.Dixmier.rankOne_sum_energy
statement:
theorem rankOne_sum_energy (v : I → EuclideanSpace ℂ K) (hv : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ = 1)

name: OAI.Dixmier.FiniteSynthesis.analysis_sq_le
OAI.Dixmier.FiniteSynthesis.synthesis_adjoint_apply
statement:

name: OAI.Dixmier.FiniteSynthesis.synthesis_apply

OAI.Dixmier.FiniteSigns.sign_mgf
statement:
theorem sign_mgf (a : J → ℝ) :

name: OAI.Dixmier.FiniteSigns.value_neg
statement: theorem value_neg (a : J → ℝ) (σ : J → Bool) : value (fun j => -a j) σ = -value a σ

name: OAI.Dixmier.FiniteSigns.value_smul
statement:
theorem value_smul (a : J → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (σ : J → Bool) :

name: OAI.Dixmier.SphereNet.exists_quarter_net
statement:
theorem exists_quarter_net : ∃ s : Finset E,
    (∀ x ∈ s, ‖x‖ = 1) ∧ s.card ≤ 9 ^ finrank ℝ E ∧
      ∀ x : E, ‖x‖ = 1 → ∃ y ∈ s, ‖x-y‖ ≤ (1/4 : ℝ)

name: OAI.Dixmier.SphereNet.quarter_separated_card
statement:
theorem quarter_separated_card (s : Finset E) (hs : ∀ c ∈ s, ‖c‖ ≤ 1)
    (h : ∀ c ∈ s, ∀ d ∈ s, c ≠ d → (1/4 : ℝ) ≤ ‖c-d‖) : s.card ≤ 9 ^ finrank ℝ E

name: OAI.Dixmier.SphereNet.operator_norm_le_ten
statement:
theorem operator_norm_le_ten (M : E →L[ℝ] F) (s : Finset E) (t : Finset F)
    (_hs : ∀ x ∈ s, ‖x‖ = 1) (ht : ∀ y ∈ t, ‖y‖ = 1)
    (hsnet : ∀ x : E, ‖x‖ = 1 → ∃ x₀ ∈ s, ‖x-x₀‖ ≤ (1/4 : ℝ))
    (htnet : ∀ y : F, ‖y‖ = 1 → ∃ y₀ ∈ t, ‖y-y₀‖ ≤ (1/4 : ℝ))
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ t, |inner ℝ (M x) y| ≤ 5) : ‖M‖ ≤ 10

name: OAI.Dixmier.SignMatrix.bilinear_test
statement:
theorem bilinear_test (σ : K × I → Bool) (e : J ↪ I) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ K) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ J) :
    inner ℝ (synthesis σ e z) w = FiniteSigns.value (testCoefficients e w z) σ

name: OAI.Dixmier.SignMatrix.extend_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem extend_apply (e : J ↪ I) (z : J → ℝ) (j : J) : extend e z (e j) = z j

name: OAI.Dixmier.SignMatrix.extend_off
statement: theorem extend_off (e : J ↪ I) (z : J → ℝ) (i : I) (hi : ¬ ∃ j, e j = i) : extend e z i = 0

name: OAI.Dixmier.SignMatrix.sign_sq
statement: theorem sign_sq (b : Bool) : (FiniteSigns.sign b)^2 = 1

name: OAI.Dixmier.SignMatrix.sum_extend_sq
statement: theorem sum_extend_sq (e : J ↪ I) (z : J → ℝ) : ∑ i, (extend e z i)^2 = ∑ j, (z j)^2

name: OAI.Dixmier.SignMatrix.sum_on_embedding
statement:
theorem sum_on_embedding {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R] (e : J ↪ I) (f : I → R)

name: OAI.Dixmier.SignMatrix.synthesis_apply
statement:

name: OAI.Dixmier.SignMatrix.testCoefficients_sq
statement:
theorem testCoefficients_sq [Nonempty K] (e : J ↪ I) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ K) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ J)
    (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) :
    ∑ ai, (testCoefficients e w z ai)^2 = 1 / (Fintype.card K : ℝ)

name: OAI.Dixmier.SignMatrix.vector_apply
statement:

name: OAI.Dixmier.SignMatrix.vector_norm
statement: theorem vector_norm [Nonempty K] (σ : K × I → Bool) (i : I) : ‖vector σ i‖ = 1

name: OAI.Dixmier.ComplexFrames.norm_sq_split

name: OAI.Dixmier.ComplexFrames.ofReal_norm

theorem faceMap_succ (X : GlobularSet.{u}) (m : ℕ) (side : Bool) :

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.faceMap_target
statement:

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.weakEquivalence_of_exactBoundaryTest
statement:

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.weakEquivalence_of_partialPath_data
statement:
theorem weakEquivalence_of_partialPath_data {C : GlobularTheory.{v}}
    (hC : C.IsCoherator) {X Y : C.Model} (hX : X.IsCellular)
    (n : ℕ) (a : disk C n ⟶ X) (i : X ⟶ Y) (b : disk C (n+1) ⟶ Y)
    (sq : IsPushout a (J C n) i b)
    (PX PY : C.Model) (pX₀ pX₁ : PX ⟶ X) (pY₀ pY₁ : PY ⟶ Y)
    (Pi : PX ⟶ PY) (nat₀ : Pi ≫ pY₀ = pX₀ ≫ i) (nat₁ : Pi ≫ pY₁ = pX₁ ≫ i)
    (hpX₀ : GlobularSet.LiftsBoundaries (underlyingMap pX₀))
    (hpX₁ : GlobularSet.LiftsBoundaries (underlyingMap pX₁))
    (hpY₀ : GlobularSet.LiftsBoundaries (underlyingMap pY₀))
    (hpY₁ : GlobularSet.LiftsBoundaries (underlyingMap pY₁))
    (joint : ∀ (t : disk C n ⟶ PY) (u₀ u₁ : disk C (n+1) ⟶ Y),
      t ≫ pY₀ = J C n ≫ u₀ → t ≫ pY₁ = J C n ≫ u₁ →
      ∃ l : disk C (n+1) ⟶ PY,
        J C n ≫ l = t ∧ l ≫ pY₀ = u₀ ∧ l ≫ pY₁ = u₁) :
    WeakEquivalence hC i

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.lift_operation
statement:
theorem lift_operation {X Y : GlobularSet.{v}} (η : X.Hom Y)
    {A B : Type v} (f : A → B) (n : ℕ)
    (s t : A → X.Cell n) (s' t' : B → Y.Cell n)
    (hs : ∀ a, η.app n (s a) = s' (f a))
    (ht : ∀ a, η.app n (t a) = t' (f a))
    (hp : ∀ b, Y.Parallel n (s' b) (t' b))
    (z : A → X.Cell (n+1)) (hzs : ∀ a, X.source n (z a) = s a)
    (hzt : ∀ a, X.target n (z a) = t a)
    (h : Function.Bijective f ∨ Function.Bijective (Y.boundary (n+1))) :
    ∃ z' : B → Y.Cell (n+1),
      (∀ b, Y.source n (z' b) = s' b) ∧
      (∀ b, Y.target n (z' b) = t' b) ∧
      (∀ a, η.app (n+1) (z a) = z' (f a))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.liftedRealization_pushout
statement:
theorem liftedRealization_pushout (S : Shape) (b h : ℕ) (hl : b < S.1) (hr : b < h) :
    IsPushout (liftedRealization.{v}.map (S.seam hl))
      (liftedRealization.{v}.map (face hr false))
      (liftedRealization.{v}.map (S.inl b h hl hr))
      (liftedRealization.{v}.map (S.inr b h hl hr))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.realization_pushout

      (realization.map (S.inl b h hl hr)) (realization.map (S.inr b h hl hr))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularPresheaf.tupleCellEquiv_face
statement:
theorem tupleCellEquiv_face (X : GlobularPresheaf.{v}) {m n : ℕ} (h : m < n)

statement:

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.cutoffLow_face
statement:
theorem cutoffLow_face (X : GlobularSet.{u}) {q n : ℕ} (h : n+1 ≤ q)
    (side : Bool) (x : (X.cutoff q).Cell (n+1)) :
    X.cutoffLow (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ n) h) (X.cutoffFace q n side x) =
      (if side then X.target n else X.source n) (X.cutoffLow h x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.cutoffLow_parallel
statement:
theorem cutoffLow_parallel (X : GlobularSet.{u}) {q n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ q)
    (x y : (X.cutoff q).Cell n) :
    (X.cutoff q).Parallel n x y ↔ X.Parallel n (X.cutoffLow h x) (X.cutoffLow h y)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.cutoffUnitCell_face
statement:
theorem cutoffUnitCell_face (X : GlobularSet.{u}) (q n : ℕ) (side : Bool)
    (x : X.Cell (n+1)) :
    X.cutoffUnitCell q n ((if side then X.target n else X.source n) x) =
      X.cutoffFace q n side (X.cutoffUnitCell q (n+1) x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.cutoffUnitCell_high
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cutoffUnitCell_high (X : GlobularSet.{u}) {q n : ℕ} (h : q < n) (x : X.Cell n) :
    X.cutoffHigh h (X.cutoffUnitCell q n x) =
      ⟨(X.faceMap h false x, X.faceMap h true x), X.faceMap_parallel h x⟩

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.cutoffUnitCell_low
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cutoffUnitCell_low (X : GlobularSet.{u}) {q n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ q) (x : X.Cell n) :
    X.cutoffLow h (X.cutoffUnitCell q n x) = x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.cutoff_high_face
statement:
theorem cutoff_high_face (X : GlobularSet.{u}) {q n : ℕ} (h : q < n)
    (side : Bool) (x : (X.cutoff q).Cell (n+1)) :
    X.cutoffHigh h (X.cutoffFace q n side x) =
      X.cutoffHigh (Nat.lt_trans h (Nat.lt_succ_self n)) x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.cutoff_seam_face
statement:
theorem cutoff_seam_face (X : GlobularSet.{u}) (q : ℕ) (side : Bool)
    (x : (X.cutoff q).Cell (q+1)) :
    X.cutoffLow (q := q) le_rfl (X.cutoffFace q q side x) =
      (if side then (X.cutoffHigh (Nat.lt_succ_self q) x).1.2
        else (X.cutoffHigh (Nat.lt_succ_self q) x).1.1)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.Hom.boundary_bijective_iff
statement:

@[simp] theorem inverseCell_source {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (n : ℕ) (a : X.underlying.Cell (n+1)) :
    X.underlying.source n (X.inverseCell hC n a) = X.underlying.target n a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.inverseCell_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem inverseCell_target {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (n : ℕ) (a : X.underlying.Cell (n+1)) :
    X.underlying.target n (X.inverseCell hC n a) = X.underlying.source n a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.map_eval
statement:
theorem map_eval {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} {X Y : C.Model} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {S T : Shape} (a : C.Hom S T) (t : X.presheaf.obj (op (⟨T⟩ : C.Obj))) :
    f.app (op (⟨S⟩ : C.Obj)) (X.eval a t) =
      Y.eval a (f.app (op (⟨T⟩ : C.Obj)) t)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.map_inverseCell
statement:
theorem map_inverseCell {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} {X Y : C.Model} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hC : C.IsCoherator) (n : ℕ) (a : X.underlying.Cell (n+1)) :
    (underlyingMap f).app (n+1) (X.inverseCell hC n a) =
      Y.inverseCell hC n ((underlyingMap f).app (n+1) a)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.sumTuple_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem sumTuple_left {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model)
    (S : Shape) (b h : ℕ) (hl : b < S.1) (hr : b < h)
    (a : X.presheaf.obj (op (⟨S⟩ : C.Obj))) (d : X.underlying.Cell h)
    (w : X.eval (C.base (S.seam hl)) a = X.eval (C.base (Shape.face hr false)) d) :
    X.eval (C.base (S.inl b h hl hr)) (X.sumTuple S b h hl hr a d w) = a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.sumTuple_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem sumTuple_right {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model)
    (S : Shape) (b h : ℕ) (hl : b < S.1) (hr : b < h)
    (a : X.presheaf.obj (op (⟨S⟩ : C.Obj))) (d : X.underlying.Cell h)
    (w : X.eval (C.base (S.seam hl)) a = X.eval (C.base (Shape.face hr false)) d) :
    X.eval (C.base (S.inr b h hl hr)) (X.sumTuple S b h hl hr a d w) = d

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.composition_source
statement:
theorem composition_source (C : GlobularTheory.{v}) (hC : C.IsCoherator) (n : ℕ) :
    C.comp (C.base (Shape.source n)) (C.composition hC n) =
      C.base (Shape.source n ≫ compositionLeft n)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.composition_target
statement:
theorem composition_target (C : GlobularTheory.{v}) (hC : C.IsCoherator) (n : ℕ) :
    C.comp (C.base (Shape.target n)) (C.composition hC n) =
      C.base (Shape.target n ≫ compositionRight n)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.inverse_source
statement:
theorem inverse_source (C : GlobularTheory.{v}) (hC : C.IsCoherator) (n : ℕ) :
    C.comp (C.base (Shape.source n)) (C.inverse hC n) = C.base (Shape.target n)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.inverse_target
statement:
theorem inverse_target (C : GlobularTheory.{v}) (hC : C.IsCoherator) (n : ℕ) :
    C.comp (C.base (Shape.target n)) (C.inverse hC n) = C.base (Shape.source n)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.HasFillers.joined
statement:
theorem HasFillers.joined {X : GlobularSet.{u}} (hX : X.HasFillers)
    {n : ℕ} {a b : X.Cell n} (hp : X.Parallel n a b) : X.Joined n a b

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.HasFillers.retract
statement:
theorem HasFillers.retract {X Y : GlobularSet.{u}} (hY : Y.HasFillers)
    (i : Hom X Y) (r : Hom Y X) (hir : i.comp r = Hom.id X) : X.HasFillers

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.Hom.boundaryMap_id
statement:
theorem Hom.boundaryMap_id (X : GlobularSet.{u}) (n : ℕ) (b : X.Boundary n) :
    (Hom.id X).boundaryMap n b = b

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.hasFillers_of_endpoint_factorization
statement:
theorem hasFillers_of_endpoint_factorization {X Y P : GlobularSet.{u}}
    (hX : X.HasFillers) (i : Hom X Y) (r : Hom Y X) (h : Hom Y P)
    (p₀ p₁ : Hom P Y) (hh₀ : h.comp p₀ = Hom.id Y)
    (hh₁ : h.comp p₁ = r.comp i) (hp₁ : LiftsBoundaries p₁) : Y.HasFillers

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.liftsBoundary_of_contractible
statement:
theorem liftsBoundary_of_contractible {X Y : GlobularSet.{u}} (f : Hom X Y)
    (hX : X.HasFillers) (hY : Y.HasFillers) (n : ℕ) (hf : LiftsSource f n)
    (b : X.Boundary n) (y : Y.Cell n) (hy : Y.boundary n y = f.boundaryMap n b) :
    ∃ x : X.Cell n, X.boundary n x = b ∧ f.app n x = y

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.compCell_assoc
statement:
theorem compCell_assoc {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (n : ℕ) (a b c : X.underlying.Cell (n+1))
    (hab : X.underlying.target n a = X.underlying.source n b)
    (hbc : X.underlying.target n b = X.underlying.source n c) :
    X.underlying.Joined (n+1)
      (X.compCell hC n (X.compCell hC n a b hab) c (by rw [compCell_target, hbc]))
      (X.compCell hC n a (X.compCell hC n b c hbc) (by rw [compCell_source, hab]))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.compCell_inverse_left
statement:
theorem compCell_inverse_left {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (n : ℕ) (a : X.underlying.Cell (n+1)) :
    X.underlying.Joined (n+1)
      (X.compCell hC n (X.inverseCell hC n a) a (X.inverseCell_target hC n a))
      (X.unitCell hC n (X.underlying.target n a))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.compCell_inverse_right
statement:
theorem compCell_inverse_right {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (n : ℕ) (a : X.underlying.Cell (n+1)) :
    X.underlying.Joined (n+1)
      (X.compCell hC n a (X.inverseCell hC n a) (X.inverseCell_source hC n a).symm)
      (X.unitCell hC n (X.underlying.source n a))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.compCell_left_unit
statement:
theorem compCell_left_unit {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (n : ℕ) (a : X.underlying.Cell (n+1)) :
    X.underlying.Joined (n+1)
      (X.compCell hC n (X.unitCell hC n (X.underlying.source n a)) a
        (X.unitCell_target hC n _)) a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.compCell_right_unit
statement:
theorem compCell_right_unit {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (n : ℕ) (a : X.underlying.Cell (n+1)) :
    X.underlying.Joined (n+1)
      (X.compCell hC n a (X.unitCell hC n (X.underlying.target n a))
        (X.unitCell_source hC n _).symm) a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.joined_of_parallel_expressions
statement:
theorem joined_of_parallel_expressions {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model)
    (hC : C.IsCoherator) (S : Shape) (n : ℕ)
    (a b : (freeShape C S).underlying.Cell n)
    (hp : (freeShape C S).underlying.Parallel n a b)
    (t : X.presheaf.obj (op (⟨S⟩ : C.Obj))) :
    X.underlying.Joined n (X.eval a t) (X.eval b t)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.map_compCell
statement:
theorem map_compCell {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} {X Y : C.Model} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hC : C.IsCoherator) (n : ℕ) (a b : X.underlying.Cell (n+1))
    (hab : X.underlying.target n a = X.underlying.source n b) :
    (underlyingMap f).app (n+1) (X.compCell hC n a b hab) =
      Y.compCell hC n ((underlyingMap f).app (n+1) a) ((underlyingMap f).app (n+1) b)
        (by rw [← (underlyingMap f).target_app, ← (underlyingMap f).source_app, hab])

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.map_compositionTuple
statement:
theorem map_compositionTuple {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} {X Y : C.Model} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (n : ℕ) (a b : X.underlying.Cell (n+1))
    (hab : X.underlying.target n a = X.underlying.source n b) :
    f.app (op (⟨compositionShape n⟩ : C.Obj)) (X.compositionTuple n a b hab) =
      Y.compositionTuple n ((underlyingMap f).app (n+1) a) ((underlyingMap f).app (n+1) b)
        (by rw [← (underlyingMap f).target_app, ← (underlyingMap f).source_app, hab])

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.sumTuple_ext
statement:
theorem sumTuple_ext {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model)
    (S : Shape) (b h : ℕ) (hl : b < S.1) (hr : b < h)
    {x y : X.presheaf.obj (op (⟨S.attach b h hl hr⟩ : C.Obj))}
    (h₀ : X.eval (C.base (S.inl b h hl hr)) x = X.eval (C.base (S.inl b h hl hr)) y)
    (h₁ : X.eval (C.base (S.inr b h hl hr)) x = X.eval (C.base (S.inr b h hl hr)) y) : x = y

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.tripleTuple_first
statement:
@[simp] theorem tripleTuple_first {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (n : ℕ)
    (a b c : X.underlying.Cell (n+1))
    (hab : X.underlying.target n a = X.underlying.source n b)
    (hbc : X.underlying.target n b = X.underlying.source n c) :
    X.eval (C.base (tripleFirst n)) (X.tripleTuple n a b c hab hbc) = a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.tripleTuple_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem tripleTuple_last {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (n : ℕ)
    (a b c : X.underlying.Cell (n+1))
    (hab : X.underlying.target n a = X.underlying.source n b)
    (hbc : X.underlying.target n b = X.underlying.source n c) :
    X.eval (C.base (tripleLast n)) (X.tripleTuple n a b c hab hbc) = c

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.tripleTuple_middle
statement:
@[simp] theorem tripleTuple_middle {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (n : ℕ)
    (a b c : X.underlying.Cell (n+1))
    (hab : X.underlying.target n a = X.underlying.source n b)
    (hbc : X.underlying.target n b = X.underlying.source n c) :
    X.eval (C.base (tripleMiddle n)) (X.tripleTuple n a b c hab hbc) = b

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.tupleMap_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem tupleMap_app {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (S : Shape)
    (t : X.presheaf.obj (op (⟨S⟩ : C.Obj))) (n : ℕ)
    (a : C.Hom (Shape.globe n) S) :
    (underlyingMap (X.tupleMap S t)).app n a = X.eval a t

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.tupleMap_topCell
statement:
@[simp] theorem tupleMap_topCell {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (n : ℕ)
    (a : X.underlying.Cell n) :
    (underlyingMap (X.tupleMap (Shape.globe n) a)).app n (topCell C n) = a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.triple_first_middle
statement:
theorem triple_first_middle (n : ℕ) :
    Shape.target n ≫ tripleFirst n = Shape.source n ≫ tripleMiddle n

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.triple_middle_last
statement:
theorem triple_middle_last (n : ℕ) :
    Shape.target n ≫ tripleMiddle n = Shape.source n ≫ tripleLast n

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.attach_seam
statement:
theorem attach_seam (S : Shape) (b h : ℕ) (hl : b < S.1) (hr : b < h)

    (S.attach b h hl hr).seam hk = face hk true ≫ S.inr b h hl hr

OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.compCell_congr_left
statement:
theorem compCell_congr_left {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (n : ℕ) (a₀ a₁ b : X.underlying.Cell (n+1))
    (hab₀ : X.underlying.target n a₀ = X.underlying.source n b)
    (hab₁ : X.underlying.target n a₁ = X.underlying.source n b)
    (ha : X.underlying.Joined (n+1) a₀ a₁) :
    X.underlying.Joined (n+1) (X.compCell hC n a₀ b hab₀) (X.compCell hC n a₁ b hab₁)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.compCell_congr_right
statement:
theorem compCell_congr_right {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (n : ℕ) (a b₀ b₁ : X.underlying.Cell (n+1))
    (hab₀ : X.underlying.target n a = X.underlying.source n b₀)
    (hab₁ : X.underlying.target n a = X.underlying.source n b₁)
    (hb : X.underlying.Joined (n+1) b₀ b₁) :
    X.underlying.Joined (n+1) (X.compCell hC n a b₀ hab₀) (X.compCell hC n a b₁ hab₁)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.hasLiftingProperty_I_iff
statement:
theorem hasLiftingProperty_I_iff {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} {X Y : C.Model}
    (n : ℕ) (p : X ⟶ Y) :
    HasLiftingProperty (I C n) p ↔
      ∀ (b : X.underlying.Boundary n) (y : Y.underlying.Cell n),
        Y.underlying.boundary n y = (underlyingMap p).boundaryMap n b →
        ∃ x : X.underlying.Cell n,
          X.underlying.boundary n x = b ∧ (underlyingMap p).app n x = y

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.hasLiftingProperty_J_iff
statement:
theorem hasLiftingProperty_J_iff {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} {X Y : C.Model}
    (n : ℕ) (p : X ⟶ Y) :
    HasLiftingProperty (J C n) p ↔
      ∀ (x : X.underlying.Cell n) (y : Y.underlying.Cell (n+1)),
        Y.underlying.source n y = (underlyingMap p).app n x →
        ∃ z : X.underlying.Cell (n+1),
          X.underlying.source n z = x ∧ (underlyingMap p).app (n+1) z = y

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.liftsBoundaries_iff
statement:
theorem liftsBoundaries_iff {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} {X Y : C.Model} (p : X ⟶ Y) :
    GlobularSet.LiftsBoundaries (underlyingMap p) ↔ ∀ n, HasLiftingProperty (I C n) p

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.face_two_source
statement:
theorem face_two_source (n : ℕ) (side : Bool) :

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.lift_of_top_joined
statement:
theorem lift_of_top_joined {A X Y : GlobularSet.{v}} {p : Hom X Y}
    (n : ℕ) (hp : LiftsSource p (n+1)) (f : Hom A Y) (a : Hom A X)
    (hA : ∀ k, n+1 < k → IsEmpty (A.Cell k))
    (ha : ∀ k, k ≤ n → ∀ x, p.app k (a.app k x) = f.app k x)
    (htop : ∀ x, Y.Joined (n+1) (p.app (n+1) (a.app (n+1) x)) (f.app (n+1) x)) :
    ∃ g : Hom A X, g.comp p = f

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.free_hasFillers_of_top_homotopy
statement:
theorem free_hasFillers_of_top_homotopy {C : GlobularTheory.{v}}
    (hC : C.IsCoherator) (q n : ℕ) (H : ExpansionContraction hC q (n+1))
    (S : GlobularPresheaf.{v})
    (hS : ∀ k, n+1 < k → IsEmpty (S.underlying.Cell k))
    (L : CutoffModels C q) (hL : Cofibrant hC q L)
    (hLF : L.obj.underlying.HasFillers)
    (f : (cutoffFreeGlobular hC q).obj S ⟶ L)
    (g : L ⟶ (cutoffFreeGlobular hC q).obj S)
    (hlo : ∀ k, k ≤ n → ∀ x,
      (underlyingMap (f ≫ g).hom).app k
        (GlobularPresheaf.underlyingMap ((cutoffGlobularAdjunction hC q).unit.app S) |>.app k x) =
      (GlobularPresheaf.underlyingMap ((cutoffGlobularAdjunction hC q).unit.app S)).app k x)
    (htop : ∀ x, ((cutoffFreeGlobular hC q).obj S).obj.underlying.Joined (n+1)
      ((underlyingMap (f ≫ g).hom).app (n+1)
        ((GlobularPresheaf.underlyingMap ((cutoffGlobularAdjunction hC q).unit.app S)).app (n+1) x))
      ((GlobularPresheaf.underlyingMap ((cutoffGlobularAdjunction hC q).unit.app S)).app (n+1) x)) :
    ((cutoffFreeGlobular hC q).obj S).obj.underlying.HasFillers

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.shapeGlobularEquiv_natural
statement:
theorem shapeGlobularEquiv_natural {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (S : Shape) {X Y : C.Model}
    (a : freeShape C S ⟶ X) (b : X ⟶ Y) :
    shapeGlobularEquiv S Y (a ≫ b) =
      shapeGlobularEquiv S X a ≫ (forgetGlobular C).map b

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularPresheaf.relative_lift
statement:
theorem relative_lift {A B X Y : GlobularPresheaf.{v}}
    (i : A ⟶ B) (a : A ⟶ X) (p : X ⟶ Y) (b : B ⟶ Y) (r : ℕ)
    (hi : ∀ k, Function.Injective ((underlyingMap i).app k))
    (hlo : ∀ k, k < r → Function.Surjective ((underlyingMap i).app k))
    (hp : ∀ k, r ≤ k → GlobularSet.LiftsBoundary (underlyingMap p) k)
    (sq : a ≫ p = i ≫ b) : ∃ l : B ⟶ X, i ≫ l = a ∧ l ≫ p = b

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.ExactBoundaryTest.of_retract_factor
statement:
theorem ExactBoundaryTest.of_retract_factor {X Y : GlobularSet.{u}}
    (i : Hom X Y) (r : Hom Y X) (u : Hom X Y) (hir : i.comp r = Hom.id X)
    (hv : ExactBoundaryTest (r.comp u)) (units : ∀ k x, Y.Joined k x x) :
    ExactBoundaryTest i

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.RelativeLiftStage.exists_cell
statement:
theorem exists_cell (r k : ℕ)
    (hi : Function.Injective (i.app k))
    (hlo : k < r → Function.Surjective (i.app k))
    (hp : r ≤ k → LiftsBoundary p k)
    (sq : a.comp p = i.comp b)
    (bd : B.Cell k → X.Boundary k)
    (hbd : ∀ x, X.boundary k (a.app k x) = bd (i.app k x))
    (hbp : ∀ y, Y.boundary k (b.app k y) = p.boundaryMap k (bd y)) :
    ∃ z : B.Cell k → X.Cell k,
      (∀ y, X.boundary k (z y) = bd y) ∧
      (∀ y, p.app k (z y) = b.app k y) ∧
      (∀ x, z (i.app k x) = a.app k x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.RelativeLiftStage.succ_old
statement:
theorem succ_old (r : ℕ)
    (hi : ∀ k, Function.Injective (i.app k))
    (hlo : ∀ k, k < r → Function.Surjective (i.app k))
    (hp : ∀ k, r ≤ k → LiftsBoundary p k) (sq : a.comp p = i.comp b)
    {n : ℕ} (s : RelativeLiftStage i a p b n) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) (x : B.Cell k) :
    (s.succ r hi hlo hp sq).app k (by omega) x = s.app k hk x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.relative_lift
statement:
theorem relative_lift {A B X Y : GlobularSet.{v}} (i : Hom A B) (a : Hom A X)
    (p : Hom X Y) (b : Hom B Y) (r : ℕ)
    (hi : ∀ k, Function.Injective (i.app k))
    (hlo : ∀ k, k < r → Function.Surjective (i.app k))
    (hp : ∀ k, r ≤ k → LiftsBoundary p k) (sq : a.comp p = i.comp b) :
    ∃ l : Hom B X, i.comp l = a ∧ l.comp p = b

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoff_hasFillers_iff
statement:
theorem cutoff_hasFillers_iff {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) (X : CutoffModels C q) :
    X.obj.underlying.HasFillers ↔ ∀ n (f : cutoffBoundary hC q n ⟶ X),
      ∃ g : cutoffDisk hC q n ⟶ X, cutoffI hC q n ≫ g = f

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoff_hasLimits
