    {i : A} {j : B} {k : C} (ha : a.link (.inl i) (.inr j))
    (hb : b.link (.inl j) (.inr k)) : (compose a b).link (.inl i) (.inr k)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.defect_le_support
statement:
lemma defect_le_support (a : Pairing (A ⊕ A)) :
    Fintype.card A - rank a ≤ (support a).card

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.eq_identity
statement:
lemma eq_identity (a : Pairing (A ⊕ A))
    (h : ∀ i, a.link (.inl i) (.inr i)) : a = identity A

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.eq_of_link_imp
statement:
lemma eq_of_link_imp (a b : Pairing P)
    (h : ∀ x y, a.link x y → b.link x y) : a = b

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.flip_flip
statement: lemma flip_flip (a : Pairing (A ⊕ B)) : flip (flip a) = a

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.flip_link
statement:
@[simp] lemma flip_link (a : Pairing (A ⊕ B)) (x y : B ⊕ A) :
    (flip a).link x y ↔ a.link (Sum.swap x) (Sum.swap y)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.idempotent_full_rank
statement:
lemma idempotent_full_rank (e : Pairing (A ⊕ A)) (he : compose e e = e)
    (hr : rank e = Fintype.card A) : e = identity A

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.identity_link
statement:
@[simp] lemma identity_link (x y : A ⊕ A) :
    (identity A).link x y ↔ Sum.swap x = y

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.left_cap_not_lefts
statement:
lemma left_cap_not_lefts (a : Pairing (A ⊕ B)) {i j : A}
    (h : a.link (.inl i) (.inl j)) : i ∉ lefts a

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.lefts_compose_subset
statement:
lemma lefts_compose_subset (a : Pairing (A ⊕ B)) (b : Pairing (B ⊕ C)) :
    lefts (compose a b) ⊆ lefts a

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.mem_lefts
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_lefts (a : Pairing (A ⊕ B)) (i : A) :
    i ∈ lefts a ↔ ∃ j, a.link (.inl i) (.inr j)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.mem_rights
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_rights (a : Pairing (A ⊕ B)) (j : B) :
    j ∈ rights a ↔ ∃ i, a.link (.inl i) (.inr j)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.mem_support
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_support (a : Pairing (A ⊕ A)) (i : A) :
    i ∈ support a ↔ ¬ a.link (.inl i) (.inr i)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.rank_compose_le_left
statement:
lemma rank_compose_le_left (a : Pairing (A ⊕ B)) (b : Pairing (B ⊕ C)) :
    rank (compose a b) ≤ rank a

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.rank_compose_le_right
statement:
lemma rank_compose_le_right (a : Pairing (A ⊕ B)) (b : Pairing (B ⊕ C)) :
    rank (compose a b) ≤ rank b

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.rank_eq_rights
statement: lemma rank_eq_rights (a : Pairing (A ⊕ B)) : rank a = (rights a).card

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.rank_le_card
statement: lemma rank_le_card (a : Pairing (A ⊕ B)) : rank a ≤ Fintype.card A

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.right_cap_not_rights
statement:
lemma right_cap_not_rights (a : Pairing (A ⊕ B)) {i j : B}
    (h : a.link (.inr i) (.inr j)) : i ∉ rights a

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.rights_compose_subset
statement:
lemma rights_compose_subset (a : Pairing (A ⊕ B)) (b : Pairing (B ⊕ C)) :
    rights (compose a b) ⊆ rights b

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.splitLeft_inverse
statement:
lemma splitLeft_inverse (e : Pairing (A ⊕ A)) :
    compose (flip (splitLeft e)) (splitLeft e) = identity {i // i ∈ lefts e}

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.splitLeft_splitRight
statement:
lemma splitLeft_splitRight (e : Pairing (A ⊕ A)) :
    compose (splitLeft e) (splitRight e) = e

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.splitRight_inverse
statement:
lemma splitRight_inverse (e : Pairing (A ⊕ A)) :
    compose (splitRight e) (flip (splitRight e)) = identity {i // i ∈ lefts e}

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.splitRight_splitLeft
statement:
lemma splitRight_splitLeft (e : Pairing (A ⊕ A)) (he : compose e e = e) :
    compose (splitRight e) (splitLeft e) = identity {i // i ∈ lefts e}

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.support_compose_subset
statement:
lemma support_compose_subset (a b : Pairing (A ⊕ A)) :
    support (compose a b) ⊆ support a ∪ support b

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.support_idempotent_bound
statement:
lemma support_idempotent_bound (e : Pairing (A ⊕ A)) (he : compose e e = e) :
    (support e).card ≤ 2 * (Fintype.card A - rank e)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.support_idempotent_subset
statement:
lemma support_idempotent_subset (e : Pairing (A ⊕ A)) (he : compose e e = e) :
    support e ⊆ (Finset.univ \ lefts e) ∪ (Finset.univ \ rights e)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FiniteWiring.color_eq_of_reachable_from
statement:
lemma color_eq_of_reachable_from (color : V → C) (s : V)
    (hc : ∀ x y, G.Reachable s x → G.Adj x y → color x = color y)
    {y : V} (h : G.Reachable s y) : color s = color y

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.card_reduced
statement: lemma card_reduced (e : Pairing (A ⊕ A)) : Fintype.card {i // i ∈ lefts e} = rank e

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.common_support
statement:
lemma common_support (v : Pairing (A ⊕ B)) (u : Pairing (B ⊕ A))
    (huv : compose v u = identity A) (J : Finset B) :
    ∃ K : Finset A, K.card ≤ J.card ∧ ∀ a : Pairing (B ⊕ B), support a ⊆ J →
      support (compose (compose v a) u) ⊆ K

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.left_reachable_eq
OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.marked_card_le
statement:
lemma marked_card_le (v : Pairing (A ⊕ B)) (u : Pairing (B ⊕ A))
    (huv : compose v u = identity A) (J : Finset B) : (marked v u J).card ≤ J.card

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.mem_marked
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_marked (v : Pairing (A ⊕ B)) (u : Pairing (B ⊕ A)) (J : Finset B) (x : A) :
    x ∈ marked v u J ↔ ∃ i ∈ J,
      (glueGraph v u).Reachable (outer (.inl x)) (.inl (.inr i))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.support_sandwich_subset_marked
statement:
lemma support_sandwich_subset_marked (v : Pairing (A ⊕ B)) (u : Pairing (B ⊕ A))
    (huv : compose v u = identity A) (J : Finset B) (a : Pairing (B ⊕ B))
    (ha : support a ⊆ J) : support (compose (compose v a) u) ⊆ marked v u J

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.exists_idempotent_lift
statement:
lemma exists_idempotent_lift {M N : Type*} [Monoid M] [Monoid N] [Finite M]
    (f : M →* N) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (q : N) (hq : q * q = q) :
    ∃ e : M, e * e = e ∧ f e = q

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.exists_idempotent_power
statement:
lemma exists_idempotent_power {M : Type*} [Monoid M] [Finite M] (a : M) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ a ^ n * a ^ n = a ^ n

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.isUnit_of_injective_map_finite
statement:
lemma isUnit_of_injective_map_finite {M N : Type*} [Monoid M] [Monoid N] [Finite M]
    (f : M →* N) (hf : Function.Injective f) (a : M) (ha : IsUnit (f a)) : IsUnit a

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.DMachine.toMachine_accepts
statement:
lemma DMachine.toMachine_accepts {Alpha : Type} {s : ℕ} (M : DMachine Alpha s)
    (positive : Bool) (w : List Alpha) : M.toMachine.Accepts positive w ↔ M.Accepts positive w

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Machine.positiveCopy_accepts
statement:
lemma positiveCopy_accepts (w : List Alpha) :
    M.positiveCopy.Accepts false w ↔ M.Accepts true w

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Machine.positiveCopy_reach
statement:
lemma positiveCopy_reach (w : List Alpha) (c c' : Config (Q := Q) w) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (M.positiveCopy.Step w) (c.1, some c.2) (c'.1, some c'.2) ↔
      Relation.ReflTransGen (M.Step w) c c'

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Machine.positiveCopy_step
statement:
lemma positiveCopy_step (w : List Alpha) (i : Fin (w.length + 2)) (q : Option Q)
    (c' : Config (Q := Option Q) w) :
    M.positiveCopy.Step w (i, q) c' ↔
      ∃ r, c'.2 = some r ∧ M.Step w (i, q.getD M.initial) (c'.1, r)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Machine.sinkCopy_accepts
statement:
lemma sinkCopy_accepts (w : List Alpha) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (M.sinkCopy.Step w) (⟨0, by omega⟩, some M.initial) (terminal w) ↔
      M.Accepts false w

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Machine.sinkCopy_reach_iff
statement:
lemma sinkCopy_reach_iff (w : List Alpha) (c : Config (Q := Q) w) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (M.sinkCopy.Step w) (c.1, some c.2) (terminal w) ↔
      ∃ a, Relation.ReflTransGen (M.Step w) c a ∧ a.2 ∈ M.accepting

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Machine.sinkCopy_step_old
statement:
lemma sinkCopy_step_old (w : List Alpha) (c : Config (Q := Q) w)
    (c' : Config (Q := Option Q) w) :
    M.sinkCopy.Step w (c.1, some c.2) c' ↔
      (c.2 ∈ M.accepting ∧ c' = (c.1, none)) ∨
      (c.2 ∉ M.accepting ∧ ∃ r, c'.2 = some r ∧ M.Step w c (c'.1, r))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Machine.sinkCopy_sweep
statement:
lemma sinkCopy_sweep (w : List Alpha) (i : Fin (w.length + 2)) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (M.sinkCopy.Step w) (i, none) (terminal w)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Machine.sinkCopy_terminal
statement:
lemma sinkCopy_terminal (w : List Alpha) :
    M.sinkCopy.transition (terminal (Q := Q) w).2 (scanned w (terminal (Q := Q) w).1) = none

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.scanned_eq_left_iff
statement:
lemma scanned_eq_left_iff {Alpha : Type} (w : List Alpha) (i : Fin (w.length + 2)) :
    scanned w i = .left ↔ i.val = 0

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.scanned_eq_right_iff
statement:
lemma scanned_eq_right_iff {Alpha : Type} (w : List Alpha) (i : Fin (w.length + 2)) :
    scanned w i = .right ↔ i.val = w.length + 1

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.Rotation.basin_sameCycle
statement:
lemma basin_sameCycle [Finite E] {t : V} (ht : ∀ e, G.src e ≠ t) (d d' r : E × Bool)
    (hd : G.Reach (G.vertex d) t) (hd' : G.Reach (G.vertex d') t)
    (hr : G.vertex r = t) : R.tour.SameCycle d d'

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.Rotation.color_eq_of_sameCycle
statement:
lemma color_eq_of_sameCycle {D C : Type*} [Finite D] (τ : Equiv.Perm D)
    (color : D → C) (hc : ∀ d, color (τ d) = color d)
    {d d' : D} (h : τ.SameCycle d d') : color d = color d'

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.Rotation.edge_sameCycle
statement:
lemma edge_sameCycle [Finite E] {t : V} (ht : ∀ e, G.src e ≠ t) (e : E)
    (h : G.Reach (G.src e) t) : R.tour.SameCycle (e, false) (e, true)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.Rotation.flip_sameCycle
statement:
lemma flip_sameCycle [Finite E] {t : V} (ht : ∀ e, G.src e ≠ t) (d : E × Bool)
    (hd : G.Reach (G.vertex d) t) : R.tour.SameCycle d (G.flip d)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.Rotation.perm_sameCycle
statement:
lemma perm_sameCycle [Finite E] {t : V} (ht : ∀ e, G.src e ≠ t) (d : E × Bool)
    (hd : G.Reach (G.vertex d) t) : R.tour.SameCycle d (R.perm d)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.Rotation.reach_sameCycle
statement:
lemma reach_sameCycle [Finite E] {t : V} (ht : ∀ e, G.src e ≠ t) (d d' : E × Bool)
    (h : G.Reach (G.vertex d) (G.vertex d')) (ht' : G.Reach (G.vertex d') t) :
    R.tour.SameCycle d d'

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.Rotation.tour_flip
statement: @[simp] lemma tour_flip (d : E × Bool) : R.tour (G.flip d) = R.perm d

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.Rotation.tour_vertex
statement: lemma tour_vertex (d : E × Bool) : G.vertex (R.tour d) = G.vertex (G.flip d)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.Rotation.vertex_pow
statement: lemma vertex_pow (n : ℕ) (d : E × Bool) : G.vertex ((R.perm ^ n) d) = G.vertex d

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.Rotation.vertex_sameCycle
statement:
lemma vertex_sameCycle [Finite E] {t : V} (ht : ∀ e, G.src e ≠ t) (d d' : E × Bool)
    (hd : G.Reach (G.vertex d) t) (he : G.vertex d = G.vertex d') :
    R.tour.SameCycle d d'

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.deterministic
statement: lemma deterministic {v w z : V} (h : G.Step v w) (h' : G.Step v z) : w = z

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.edge_cut
statement:
lemma edge_cut {e f : E} (hne : f ≠ e) :
    G.Reach (G.src f) (G.src e) ↔ G.Reach (G.dst f) (G.src e)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.edge_not_return
statement:
lemma edge_not_return {t : V} (ht : ∀ e, G.src e ≠ t) (e : E)
    (h : G.Reach (G.src e) t) : ¬ G.Reach (G.dst e) (G.src e)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.flip_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma flip_apply (d : E × Bool) : G.flip d = (d.1, !d.2)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.reach_of_terminal
statement: lemma reach_of_terminal {t v : V} (ht : ∀ e, G.src e ≠ t) (h : G.Reach t v) : t = v

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.successor_reaches
statement:
lemma successor_reaches {t v w : V} (ht : ∀ e, G.src e ≠ t)
    (hv : G.Reach v t) (hvw : G.Step v w) : G.Reach w t

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.vertex_false
statement: @[simp] lemma vertex_false (e : E) : G.vertex (e, false) = G.src e

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.vertex_true
statement: @[simp] lemma vertex_true (e : E) : G.vertex (e, true) = G.dst e

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.permutation_single_entrance
statement:
lemma permutation_single_entrance {D : Type*} [Finite D] (τ : Equiv.Perm D)
    (U : Set D) (a b : D) (ha : a ∈ U) (ha' : τ a ∉ U)
    (hin : ∀ d, d ∉ U → τ d ∈ U → d = b) : τ.SameCycle a b

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.sameCycle_permCongr
statement:
lemma sameCycle_permCongr {D D' : Type*} (e : D ≃ D') (τ : Equiv.Perm D)
    {d d' : D} (h : τ.SameCycle d d') : (e.permCongrHom τ).SameCycle (e d) (e d')

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.decorate_injective
statement: lemma decorate_injective (w : List Alpha) : Function.Injective (decorate M w)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.edgeInc_incEdge
statement: lemma edgeInc_incEdge (n : ℕ) (d : WholeInc Q n) : edgeInc Q n (incEdge Q n d) = d

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.edgeKey_injective
statement: lemma edgeKey_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (edgeKey Q n)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.graphOrder_apply
statement:
lemma graphOrder_apply [Fintype Q] (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (d : Edge Q w.length × Bool) :
    edgeInc Q w.length ((graphOrder M finish w).perm d) =
      (wholeOrder M finish w).perm (edgeInc Q w.length d)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.graph_reach_state
statement:
lemma graph_reach_state (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (c c' : Machine.Config (Q := Q) w) :
    (graph M finish w).Reach (stateVertex w c) (stateVertex w c') ↔
      Relation.ReflTransGen (M.Step w) c c'

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.graph_step_from_state
statement:
lemma graph_step_from_state (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (c : Machine.Config (Q := Q) w)
    (v : Vertex Q w.length) :
    (graph M finish w).Step (stateVertex w c) v ↔
      ∃ c', v = stateVertex w c' ∧ M.Step w c c'

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.graph_terminal
statement:
lemma graph_terminal (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (t : Machine.Config (Q := Q) w)
    (ht : M.transition t.2 (scanned w t.1) = none) :
    ∀ e, (graph M finish w).src e ≠ stateVertex w t

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.graph_vertex
statement:
lemma graph_vertex (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (d : Edge Q w.length × Bool) :
    (graph M finish w).vertex d = wholeVertex M finish w (edgeInc Q w.length d)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.incEdge_edgeInc
statement: lemma incEdge_edgeInc (n : ℕ) (d : Edge Q n × Bool) : incEdge Q n (edgeInc Q n d) = d

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.outward_internal
statement:
lemma outward_internal (w : List Alpha) (j : Fin (w.length + 1)) :
    outward (scanned w j.castSucc) true = false ∧ outward (scanned w j.succ) false = false

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.scanned_outCell
statement:
lemma scanned_outCell (w : List Alpha) (s : Bool) :
    scanned w (outCell w.length s) = if s then .right else .left

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.sourceAttach_eq_state
statement:
lemma sourceAttach_eq_state (b : Symbol Alpha) (k : Key Q) (p : Q) :
    sourceAttach M b k = .inl p ↔ k.2.1 = p ∧ M.transition p b = some (k.2.2,k.1)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.sourceAttach_injective
statement: lemma sourceAttach_injective (b : Symbol Alpha) : Function.Injective (sourceAttach M b)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.sourceInc_injective
statement: lemma sourceInc_injective : Function.Injective (sourceInc Q)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.stateVertex_injective
statement: lemma stateVertex_injective (w : List Alpha) : Function.Injective (stateVertex (Q := Q) w)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.test_destination
statement:
lemma test_destination (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (s : Bool) :
    (graph M finish w).dst (.inr (.inr (s,testSlot M finish))) =
      stateVertex w (outCell w.length s,if s then finish else M.initial)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.test_step
statement:
lemma test_step (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (s : Bool) :
    (graph M finish w).Step (.inr (s,testSlot M finish))
      (stateVertex w (outCell w.length s,if s then finish else M.initial))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.wholePerm_pow
statement:
lemma wholePerm_pow (w : List Alpha) (r : Symbol Alpha → Equiv.Perm (Incidence Q))
    (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (w.length + 2)) (j : Incidence Q) :
    (wholePerm w r ^ n) (.inl (i,j)) = .inl (i,(r (scanned w i) ^ n) j)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.ColorData.tour_invariant
statement:
lemma tour_invariant (hl : Flat (C.boundary 0)) (hr : Flat (C.boundary (w.length+2)))
    (d : Edge Q w.length × Bool) :
    C.wholeTip (edgeInc Q w.length ((graphOrder M finish w).tour d)) true =
      C.wholeTip (edgeInc Q w.length d) true

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.ColorData.wholeTip_join
statement:
lemma wholeTip_join (hl : Flat (C.boundary 0)) (hr : Flat (C.boundary (w.length+2)))
    (x : WholeInc Q w.length) :
    C.wholeTip x false = C.wholeTip ((wholeOrder M finish w).perm x) true

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.ColorData.wholeTip_lane
statement:
lemma wholeTip_lane (d : Edge Q w.length × Bool) :
    C.wholeTip (edgeInc Q w.length d) true =
      C.wholeTip (edgeInc Q w.length ((graph M finish w).flip d)) false

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.boundaryColor_left
statement:
lemma boundaryColor_left (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (c : Vertex Q w.length → Bool)
    (hc : ∀ e, c ((graph M finish w).src e) = c ((graph M finish w).dst e))
    (i : Fin (w.length+2)) (slot : Slot Q) (lane : Bool) :
    boundaryColor M finish w c i.val (slot,lane) =
      c (wholeVertex M finish w (.inl (i,.inl (false,slot))))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.boundaryColor_right
statement:
lemma boundaryColor_right (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (c : Vertex Q w.length → Bool)
    (i : Fin (w.length+2)) (slot : Slot Q) (lane : Bool) :
    boundaryColor M finish w c (i.val+1) (slot,lane) =
      c (wholeVertex M finish w (.inl (i,.inl (true,slot))))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.boundaryColor_test
statement:
lemma boundaryColor_test (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (c : Vertex Q w.length → Bool)
    (hc : ∀ e, c ((graph M finish w).src e) = c ((graph M finish w).dst e)) (s lane : Bool) :
    boundaryColor M finish w c (if s then w.length+2 else 0) (testSlot M finish,lane) =
      c (stateVertex w (outCell w.length s,if s then finish else M.initial))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.diagram_recognizes_reach
statement:
lemma diagram_recognizes_reach (finish : Q) (ht : M.transition finish .right = none)
    (w : List Alpha) :
    (¬ ∃ l r, (fullDiagram M finish w).Compatible (Sum.elim l r) ∧ Separated M finish l r) ↔
      Relation.ReflTransGen (M.Step w) (outCell w.length false,M.initial)
        (outCell w.length true,finish)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.fullDiagram_compatible
statement:
lemma fullDiagram_compatible (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (l r : Port Q → Bool) :
    (fullDiagram M finish w).Compatible (Sum.elim l r) ↔
      ∃ C : ColorData M finish w, C.boundary 0 = l ∧ C.boundary (w.length+2) = r

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.reach_excludes_separation
statement:
lemma reach_excludes_separation (finish : Q) (ht : M.transition finish .right = none)
    (w : List Alpha)
    (hp : Relation.ReflTransGen (M.Step w) (outCell w.length false,M.initial)
      (outCell w.length true,finish))
    (C : ColorData M finish w) : ¬ Separated M finish (C.boundary 0) (C.boundary (w.length+2))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.separation_of_not_reach
statement:
lemma separation_of_not_reach (finish : Q) (ht : M.transition finish .right = none)
    (w : List Alpha)
    (hp : ¬ Relation.ReflTransGen (M.Step w) (outCell w.length false,M.initial)
      (outCell w.length true,finish)) :
    ∃ C : ColorData M finish w, Separated M finish (C.boundary 0) (C.boundary (w.length+2))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.vertex_color_adjacent
statement:
lemma vertex_color_adjacent (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (c : Vertex Q w.length → Bool)
    (hc : ∀ e, c ((graph M finish w).src e) = c ((graph M finish w).dst e))
    (i : Fin (w.length+1)) (slot : Slot Q) :
    c (wholeVertex M finish w (.inl (i.castSucc,.inl (true,slot)))) =
      c (wholeVertex M finish w (.inl (i.succ,.inl (false,slot))))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.vertex_color_flip
statement:
lemma vertex_color_flip (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (c : Vertex Q w.length → Bool)
    (hc : ∀ e, c ((graph M finish w).src e) = c ((graph M finish w).dst e))
    (d : Edge Q w.length × Bool) :
    c (wholeVertex M finish w (edgeInc Q w.length d)) =
      c (wholeVertex M finish w (edgeInc Q w.length ((graph M finish w).flip d)))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.NMachineOn.relabel_accepts
statement:
lemma relabel_accepts {n : ℕ} (e : Q ≃ Fin n) (positive : Bool) (w : List Alpha) :
    (M.relabel e).Accepts positive w ↔ M.Accepts positive w

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.NMachineOn.relabel_noLeft
statement:
lemma relabel_noLeft {n : ℕ} (e : Q ≃ Fin n)
    (hm : ∀ q b q', (q',.left) ∉ M.transition q b) : (M.relabel e).NoLeft

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.PathNFA.accepts_iff
statement:
lemma accepts_iff (positive : Bool) (w : List (BRel H)) :
    machine.Accepts positive w ↔ BRel.live w

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.PathNFA.good_step
statement:
lemma good_step (w : List (BRel H)) (c c' : NMachineOn.Config (Q := State H) w)
    (hg : Good w c) (hs : machine.Step w c c') : Good w c'

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.PathNFA.product_path
statement:
lemma product_path (w : List (BRel H)) (a b : H) :
    w.prod.holds a b ↔ ∃ p : ℕ → H, p 0 = a ∧ p w.length = b ∧
      ∀ i (hi : i < w.length), w[i].holds (p i) (p (i+1))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.PathNFA.rules_noLeft
statement:
lemma rules_noLeft (q : State H) (b : Symbol (BRel H)) (q' : State H) :
    (q',.left) ∉ rules q b

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.PathNFA.scanned_letter_cell
statement:
lemma scanned_letter_cell (w : List (BRel H)) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < w.length) :
    scanned w ⟨i+1,by omega⟩ = .letter w[i]

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.PathNFA.scanned_letter_data
statement:
lemma scanned_letter_data (w : List (BRel H)) (i : Fin (w.length+2)) (R : BRel H)
    (hs : scanned w i = .letter R) : ∃ hi : i.val-1 < w.length, w[i.val-1] = R

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.small_nfa
statement:
theorem small_nfa (h : ℕ) :
    ∃ N : NMachine (Alphabet h) (h+3), N.NoLeft ∧
      ∀ positive : Bool, N.Recognizes positive (OWL h)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.BRel.addEdge_holds
statement:
@[simp] lemma addEdge_holds (x y u v : H) :
    (addEdge x y).holds u v ↔ u = v ∨ u = x ∧ v = y

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.BRel.addEdge_idem
statement: lemma addEdge_idem (x y : H) : addEdge x y * addEdge x y = addEdge x y

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.BRel.addEdge_ne_one
statement: lemma addEdge_ne_one {x y : H} (hxy : x ≠ y) : addEdge x y ≠ 1

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.BRel.exists_perm_pair
statement:
lemma exists_perm_pair [Finite H] {x y u v : H} (hxy : x ≠ y) (huv : u ≠ v) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm H, σ x = u ∧ σ y = v

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.BRel.mul_restrictedId
statement:
lemma mul_restrictedId (F : Set H) (a : BRel H) (x y : H) :
    (a * restrictedId F).holds x y ↔ a.holds x y ∧ y ∈ F

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.BRel.permGraph_holds
statement:
@[simp] lemma permGraph_holds (σ : Equiv.Perm H) (x y : H) :
    (permGraph σ).holds x y ↔ σ x = y

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.BRel.restrictedId_holds
statement:
@[simp] lemma restrictedId_holds (F : Set H) (x y : H) :
    (restrictedId F).holds x y ↔ x = y ∧ x ∈ F

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.BRel.restrictedId_idem
statement: lemma restrictedId_idem (F : Set H) : restrictedId F * restrictedId F = restrictedId F

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.BRel.restrictedId_mul
statement:
lemma restrictedId_mul (F : Set H) (a : BRel H) (x y : H) :
    (restrictedId F * a).holds x y ↔ x ∈ F ∧ a.holds x y

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.BRel.restricted_sandwich
statement:
lemma restricted_sandwich {P N : BRel H} (F : Set H)
    (hF : restrictedId F * P * restrictedId F = restrictedId F)
    (hPN : P * N = N) (hNP : N * P = N) :
    let Q := P * restrictedId F * P
    restrictedId F * (Q * N * Q) * restrictedId F = restrictedId F * N * restrictedId F

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.BRel.sandwich_holds_on
statement:
lemma sandwich_holds_on {P N : BRel H} (F : Set H)
    (hF : restrictedId F * P * restrictedId F = restrictedId F)
    (hPN : P * N = N) (hNP : N * P = N) (x y : F) :
    ((P * restrictedId F * P) * N * (P * restrictedId F * P)).holds x.val y.val ↔
      N.holds x.val y.val

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.HasUnitLifts.comp_equiv
statement:
lemma HasUnitLifts.comp_equiv {M N P : Type*} [Monoid M] [Monoid N] [Monoid P]
    {f : M →* N} (hf : HasUnitLifts f) (e : N ≃* P) : HasUnitLifts (e.toMonoidHom.comp f)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.RectangleFrame.generator_image
OAI.OneWayLiveness.RectangleFrame.rel_absorb
statement:
lemma rel_absorb {E D : Set (I × J)} (h : E ⊆ D) :
    F.rel E * F.rel D = F.rel D ∧ F.rel D * F.rel E = F.rel D

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.RectangleFrame.rel_empty
statement: lemma rel_empty : F.rel ∅ = F.base

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.RectangleFrame.rel_holds
statement:
@[simp] lemma rel_holds (E : Set (I × J)) (x y : H) :
    (F.rel E).holds x y ↔ (x = y ∧ x ≠ F.hub) ∨ ∃ p ∈ E, x = F.left p.1 ∧ y = F.right p.2

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.RectangleFrame.rel_idem
statement: lemma rel_idem (E : Set (I × J)) : F.rel E * F.rel E = F.rel E

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.RectangleFrame.rel_mul
statement: lemma rel_mul (E D : Set (I × J)) : F.rel E * F.rel D = F.rel (E ∪ D)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.RectangleFrame.restricted_new
statement:
lemma restricted_new (E : Set (I × J)) (K : Set H)
    (hK : ∀ x ∈ K, x ≠ F.hub)
    (hE : ∀ p ∈ E, F.left p.1 ∉ K ∨ F.right p.2 ∉ K)
    (i : I) (j : J) (hi : F.left i ∈ K) (hj : F.right j ∈ K) :
    let u : K := ⟨F.left i,hi⟩
    let v : K := ⟨F.right j,hj⟩
    ∀ x y : K, (F.rel (insert (i,j) E)).holds x.val y.val ↔ (BRel.addEdge u v).holds x y

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.RectangleFrame.restricted_old
statement:
lemma restricted_old (E : Set (I × J)) (K : Set H)
    (hK : ∀ x ∈ K, x ≠ F.hub)
    (hE : ∀ p ∈ E, F.left p.1 ∉ K ∨ F.right p.2 ∉ K) :
    BRel.restrictedId K * F.rel E * BRel.restrictedId K = BRel.restrictedId K

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.unit_image_inv
statement:
lemma unit_image_inv {M N : Type*} [Monoid M] [Monoid N] (f : M →* N)
    (u : Mˣ) (v : Nˣ) (h : f (↑u) = (↑v)) : f (↑u⁻¹) = (↑v⁻¹)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.RectangleFrame.deleted_card
statement:
lemma deleted_card (i : I) (j : J) :
    (F.deleted i j).card = (Fintype.card I - 1) + (Fintype.card J - 1) + 1

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.RectangleFrame.exists_frame
statement: lemma exists_frame [Fintype H] (h : 33 ≤ Fintype.card H) : Nonempty (RectangleFrame H (Fin 16) (Fin 16))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.RectangleFrame.left_mem_retained
statement:
@[simp] lemma left_mem_retained (i k : I) (j : J) :
    F.left k ∈ F.retained i j ↔ k = i

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.RectangleFrame.old_avoids_retained
statement:
lemma old_avoids_retained {E : Set (I × J)} {i : I} {j : J} (h : (i,j) ∉ E) :
    ∀ p ∈ E, F.left p.1 ∉ F.retained i j ∨ F.right p.2 ∉ F.retained i j

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.RectangleFrame.retained_card
statement:
lemma retained_card [Fintype H] (i : I) (j : J) :
    Fintype.card (F.retained i j) = Fintype.card H -
      ((Fintype.card I - 1) + (Fintype.card J - 1) + 1)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.RectangleFrame.retained_ne_hub
statement: lemma retained_ne_hub (i : I) (j : J) (x : H) (hx : x ∈ F.retained i j) : x ≠ F.hub

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.RectangleFrame.right_mem_retained
statement:
@[simp] lemma right_mem_retained (i : I) (j k : J) :
    F.right k ∈ F.retained i j ↔ k = j

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.rankLoss_all
statement: theorem rankLoss_all (h : ℕ) : RankLossAt h

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.rankLoss_recurrence
statement: lemma rankLoss_recurrence {h : ℕ} (hh : 33 ≤ h) : rankLoss h = 2 * rankLoss (h - 31)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.BRel.context_separates
statement:
lemma context_separates (u v : List (BRel H))
    (h : ∀ x y : List (BRel H), live (x ++ u ++ y) ↔ live (x ++ v ++ y)) : u.prod = v.prod

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.BRel.singleton_context
statement:
lemma singleton_context (a : BRel H) (i j : H) :
    (∃ x y, (restrictedId {i} * a * restrictedId {j}).holds x y) ↔ a.holds i j

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Machine.liveness_rank_bound
statement:
lemma liveness_rank_bound (hM : ∀ w, M.Accepts false w ↔ BRel.live w)
    (x y : H) (hxy : x ≠ y) : rankLoss (Fintype.card H) ≤ 4 * (Fintype.card Q + 1)^2

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.deterministic_lower_bound
statement:
theorem deterministic_lower_bound (h : ℕ) (hh : 2 ≤ h) (positive : Bool) (s : ℕ)
    (D : DMachine (Alphabet h) s) (hD : D.Recognizes positive (OWL h)) :
    2 ^ ((h - 2) / 31) ≤ 4 * (s + if positive then 2 else 1)^2

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.scanned_list
statement:
lemma scanned_list {Alpha : Type} (w : List Alpha) :
    List.ofFn (scanned w) = Symbol.left :: (w.map Symbol.letter ++ [Symbol.right])

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.main_theorem
statement:
theorem main_theorem (h : ℕ) (hh : 2 ≤ h) :
    (∃ N : NMachine (Alphabet h) (h + 3), N.NoLeft ∧
      ∀ positive : Bool, N.Recognizes positive (OWL h)) ∧
    (∀ (positive : Bool) (s : ℕ) (D : DMachine (Alphabet h) s),
      D.Recognizes positive (OWL h) →
      2 ^ ((h - 2) / 31) ≤ 4 * (s + if positive then 2 else 1) ^ 2)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.no_polynomial_simulation
statement: theorem no_polynomial_simulation (positive : Bool) : ¬ PolynomialSimulation positive

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.average_tv_sq_le_average_divergence
statement:
lemma average_tv_sq_le_average_divergence {a : J → ℝ} (ha : IsProb a)
    {p q : J → I → ℝ} (hp : ∀ j, IsProb (p j)) (hq : ∀ j, IsProb (q j))
    (hs : ∀ j, 0 < a j → ∀ i, 0 < p j i → 0 < q j i) :
    (∑ j, a j * tv (p j) (q j)) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, a j * divergence (p j) (q j)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.divergence_eq_sum
statement:
lemma divergence_eq_sum {p q : I → ℝ} (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < p i → 0 < q i) :
    divergence p q = ∑ i, (p i * Real.log (p i) - p i * Real.log (q i))

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.divergence_nonneg
statement:
lemma divergence_nonneg {p q : I → ℝ} (hp : IsProb p) (hq : IsProb q)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < p i → 0 < q i) : 0 ≤ divergence p q

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.entropy_eq_sum
statement:
lemma entropy_eq_sum {w p : I → ℝ} (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) :
    entropy w p = ∑ i, (p i * Real.log (w i) - p i * Real.log (p i))

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.entropy_ge_neg_log_of_density
statement:
lemma entropy_ge_neg_log_of_density {w p : I → ℝ} (_hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i)
    (hp : IsProb p) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hden : ∀ i, p i ≤ b * w i) :
    -Real.log b ≤ entropy w p

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.entropy_mix_gap
statement:
lemma entropy_mix_gap {w : I → ℝ} (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i)
    {a : J → ℝ} {p : J → I → ℝ} (ha : IsProb a) (hp : ∀ j, IsProb (p j)) :
    entropy w (fun i ↦ ∑ j, a j * p j i) - ∑ j, a j * entropy w (p j) =
      ∑ j, a j * divergence (p j) (fun i ↦ ∑ k, a k * p k i)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.entropy_sum_on
statement:
lemma entropy_sum_on {w p : I → ℝ} (D : Finset I)
    (hs : ∀ i, i ∉ D → p i = 0) : entropy w p = ∑ i ∈ D, p i * Real.log (w i / p i)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.entropy_supported_concentration
statement:
lemma entropy_supported_concentration (D s : Finset I) (hsD : s ⊆ D) {w p : I → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ D, 0 < w i) (hp : IsProb p) (hs : ∀ i, i ∉ D → p i = 0)
    {m M : ℝ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hwsmall : ∑ i ∈ s, w i ≤ m) (hwall : ∑ i ∈ D, w i ≤ M) :
    entropy w p ≤ Real.log 2 + Real.log m + (1 - ∑ i ∈ s, p i) * Real.log M

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.entropy_supported_le_log
statement:
lemma entropy_supported_le_log (D : Finset I) {w p : I → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ D, 0 < w i) (hp : IsProb p)
    (hs : ∀ i, i ∉ D → p i = 0) {m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hwm : ∑ i ∈ D, w i ≤ m) :
    entropy w p ≤ Real.log m

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.entropy_tail
statement:
lemma entropy_tail {p w : I → ℝ} (hp : IsProb p) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i)
    {x a : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hd : ∀ i, p i ≤ x * w i) :
    (a + Real.log x) * (∑ i, if p i < w i * Real.exp (-a) then p i else 0) ≤
      entropy w p + Real.log x

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.entropy_tail_term
statement:
lemma entropy_tail_term {p w x a : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hw : 0 < w)
    (hx : 0 < x) (hd : p ≤ x * w) :
    (a + Real.log x) * (if p < w * Real.exp (-a) then p else 0) ≤
      p * (Real.log (w / p) + Real.log x)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.hellinger_le_divergence
statement:
lemma hellinger_le_divergence {p q : I → ℝ} (hp : IsProb p) (hq : IsProb q)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < p i → 0 < q i) :
    (∑ i, (Real.sqrt (p i) - Real.sqrt (q i)) ^ 2) ≤ divergence p q

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.mix_isProb
statement:
lemma mix_isProb {a : J → ℝ} {p : J → I → ℝ} (ha : IsProb a)
    (hp : ∀ j, IsProb (p j)) : IsProb (fun i ↦ ∑ j, a j * p j i)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.mix_support
statement:
lemma mix_support {a : J → ℝ} {p : J → I → ℝ} (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ a j)
    (hp : ∀ j i, 0 ≤ p j i) {j : J} (hj : 0 < a j) {i : I} (hi : 0 < p j i) :
    0 < ∑ k, a k * p k i

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.mul_log_div
statement:
lemma mul_log_div {p w : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hw : 0 < w) :
    p * Real.log (w / p) = p * Real.log w - p * Real.log p

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.partial_entropy_le
statement:
lemma partial_entropy_le (s : Finset I) {w p : I → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < w i) (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i)
    {m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hwm : ∑ i ∈ s, w i ≤ m) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, p i * Real.log (w i / p i)) ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, p i) * Real.log (m / (∑ i ∈ s, p i))

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.prob_sum_on
statement:
lemma prob_sum_on {p : I → ℝ} (hp : IsProb p) (D : Finset I)
    (hs : ∀ i, i ∉ D → p i = 0) : ∑ i ∈ D, p i = 1

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.relTerm_nonneg
statement:
lemma relTerm_nonneg {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hs : 0 < p → 0 < q) : 0 ≤ p * Real.log (p / q) - p + q

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.sqrt_sub_sq_le_relTerm
statement:
lemma sqrt_sub_sq_le_relTerm {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hs : 0 < p → 0 < q) :
    (Real.sqrt p - Real.sqrt q) ^ 2 ≤ p * Real.log (p / q) - p + q

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.tv_comm
statement: lemma tv_comm (p q : I → ℝ) : tv p q = tv q p

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.tv_nonneg
statement: lemma tv_nonneg (p q : I → ℝ) : 0 ≤ tv p q

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.tv_sq_le_hellinger
statement:
lemma tv_sq_le_hellinger {p q : I → ℝ} (hp : IsProb p) (hq : IsProb q) :
    tv p q ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, (Real.sqrt (p i) - Real.sqrt (q i)) ^ 2

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.tv_triangle
statement: lemma tv_triangle (p q r : I → ℝ) : tv p r ≤ tv p q + tv q r

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.weighted_sq_le
statement:
lemma weighted_sq_le {a f : I → ℝ} (ha : IsProb a) :
    (∑ i, a i * f i) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, a i * (f i) ^ 2

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.ceil_bounds
statement:
lemma ceil_bounds {x : ℝ} (hx : 32 ≤ x) :
    0 < ⌈x⌉₊ ∧ x ≤ (⌈x⌉₊ : ℝ) ∧ (⌈x⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ 2 * x

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.exists_iteration_threshold
statement:
lemma exists_iteration_threshold (a : ℝ) :
    ∃ X : ℝ, 32 ≤ X ∧ a * lossRatio X ≤ 1/4

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.exp_neg_le_inv_pow_seven
statement:
lemma exp_neg_le_inv_pow_seven {x : ℝ} (hx : 32 ≤ x) :
    Real.exp (-x) ≤ 1 / x ^ 7

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.growth_factor_le
statement:
lemma growth_factor_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 32 ≤ x) :
    1 + Real.exp x / threshold x ≤ Real.exp (4 * x)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.inv_scale
statement:
lemma inv_scale {X : ℝ} (hX : 2 ≤ X) (n : ℕ) :
    1 / scale X n ≤ (1/2 : ℝ)^n * (1/X)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.leakage_factor
statement:
lemma leakage_factor {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    x ^ 2 * threshold x * Real.exp x = 1 / x ^ 4

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.log_bounds
statement: lemma log_bounds {x : ℝ} (hx : 32 ≤ x) : 1 ≤ Real.log x ∧ 7 * Real.log x ≤ x

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.lossRatio_nonneg
statement: lemma lossRatio_nonneg {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) : 0 ≤ lossRatio x

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.lossRatio_scale
statement:
lemma lossRatio_scale {X : ℝ} (hX : 16 ≤ X) (n : ℕ) :
    lossRatio (scale X n) ≤ (1/2 : ℝ)^n * lossRatio X

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.lossRatio_square
statement: lemma lossRatio_square {x : ℝ} (hx : 16 ≤ x) : lossRatio (x^2) ≤ (1/2) * lossRatio x

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.pow_six_le_exp
statement: lemma pow_six_le_exp {x : ℝ} (hx : 32 ≤ x) : x ^ 6 ≤ Real.exp x

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.recurrence_bound
statement:
lemma recurrence_bound {B q ε t m s : ℝ}
    (hB : 1 ≤ B) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1)
    (_hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε : ε ≤ q/4) (_ht : 0 ≤ t) (hm : 0 ≤ m)
    (hs : s ≤ q/2)
    (hstep : (1-ε)*t - s*m ≤ B*(2-2*q)*m) :
    t ≤ B*(2-q)*m

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.scale_ge
statement: lemma scale_ge {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 ≤ X) (n : ℕ) : X ≤ scale X n

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.scale_ge_add
statement: lemma scale_ge_add {X : ℝ} (hX : 2 ≤ X) (n : ℕ) : X + n ≤ scale X n

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.threshold_pos
statement: lemma threshold_pos {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : 0 < threshold x

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.commonMass_comm
statement:
lemma commonMass_comm (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (u v : V) :
    commonMass G w u v = commonMass G w v u

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.commonMass_eq_sum
statement:
lemma commonMass_eq_sum (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (u v : V) :
    commonMass G w u v = ∑ z ∈ neighbors G u, if G.Adj v z then w z else 0

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.commonMass_le_neighborMass
statement:
lemma commonMass_le_neighborMass (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.commonMass_nonneg
statement:
lemma commonMass_nonneg (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v) (u v : V) :

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.crossMass_all_left
statement:
lemma crossMass_all_left (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (A : Finset V) :

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.crossMass_all_right
statement:
lemma crossMass_all_right (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (A : Finset V) :

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.crossMass_factor
statement:
lemma crossMass_factor (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (A B : Finset V) :

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.crossMass_le_product

lemma crossMass_le_product (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v)

lemma crossMass_nonneg (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.crossMass_symm

lemma crossMass_symm (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (A B : Finset V) :

lemma edgeMass_nonneg (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v) :

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.edgeMass_spike
statement:
lemma edgeMass_spike [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (v : V) (t : ℝ) :

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.edgeMass_update
statement:
lemma edgeMass_update [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (v : V) (t : ℝ) :
    edgeMass G (Function.update w v t) = edgeMass G w + (t-w v)*neighborMass G w v

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.exists_optimizer
statement: lemma exists_optimizer (G : SimpleGraph V) : ∃ w : V → ℝ, IsOptimizer G w

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.optimizer_divergence
statement:
lemma optimizer_divergence {G : SimpleGraph V} {w : V → ℝ} (hw : IsOptimizer G w)
    (q : V → ℝ) (hq : ∀ v, 0 ≤ q v) :
    0 ≤ potential G w - potential G q ∧
      potential G w - potential G q =
        (∑ v, (q v * Real.log (q v / w v) - q v + w v)) + edgeMass G (q-w)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.optimizer_stationary
statement:
lemma optimizer_stationary {G : SimpleGraph V} {w : V → ℝ} (hw : IsOptimizer G w) (v : V) :
    0 < w v ∧ Real.log (1/w v) = neighborMass G w v ∧ w v ≤ 1

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.potential_clamp
statement:
lemma potential_clamp (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v) :
    potential G w ≤ potential G (fun v ↦ min (w v) 1)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.potential_update
statement:
lemma potential_update [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (v : V) (t : ℝ) :
    potential G (Function.update w v t) - potential G w =
      vertexPotential t - vertexPotential (w v) - (t-w v)*neighborMass G w v

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.update_eq_add_spike
statement:
lemma update_eq_add_spike [DecidableEq V] (w : V → ℝ) (v : V) (t : ℝ) :
    Function.update w v t = w + spike v (t-w v)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.expect_append
statement: lemma expect_append (L K : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) : expect (L++K) f = expect L f + expect K f

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.expect_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma expect_cons (p : ℝ) (a : α) (L : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) :

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.expect_const
statement: lemma expect_const (L : Law α) (a : ℝ) : expect L (fun _ ↦ a) = a * total L

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.expect_mono
statement:
lemma expect_mono {L : Law α} (hL : Positive L) {f g : α → ℝ}

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.expect_mul
statement:
lemma expect_mul (L : Law α) (a : ℝ) (f : α → ℝ) :

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.expect_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma expect_nil (f : α → ℝ) : expect [] f = 0

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.expect_singleton
statement: @[simp] lemma expect_singleton (p : ℝ) (a : α) (f : α → ℝ) : expect [(p,a)] f = p*f a

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.expect_sum
statement:
lemma expect_sum {I : Type*} (L : Law α) (s : Finset I) (f : I → α → ℝ) :
    expect L (fun a ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, f i a) = ∑ i ∈ s, expect L (f i)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.expect_transform
statement:
lemma expect_transform (p : ℝ) (f : α → β) (L : Law α) (g : β → ℝ) :

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.positive_append
statement: lemma positive_append {L K : Law α} (hL : Positive L) (hK : Positive K) : Positive (L++K)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.positive_transform

statement:
lemma total_transform (p : ℝ) (f : α → β) (L : Law α) :

OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.bounded_transform

lemma crossMass_restrict (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (A : Finset V) :

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.edgeMass_restrict
statement:
lemma edgeMass_restrict (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (A : Finset V) :

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.edgeMass_restrict_le
statement:
lemma edgeMass_restrict_le (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v)
    (A : Finset V) {t : ℝ} (hA : ∀ v ∈ A, mass w (A ∩ neighbors G v) ≤ t) :

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.edgeMass_smul
statement:
lemma edgeMass_smul (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    edgeMass G (fun v ↦ a*w v) = a^2 * edgeMass G w

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.expectedEdges_transform
statement:
lemma expectedEdges_transform (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (L : Law (V → ℝ)) (p k : ℝ) :
    expectedEdges G w (transform p (fun m v ↦ k*m v) L) = p*k^2*expectedEdges G w L

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.mean_transform
statement:
lemma mean_transform (L : Law (V → ℝ)) (p k : ℝ) (v : V) :
    expect (transform p (fun m v ↦ k*m v) L) (fun m ↦ m v) = p*k*expect L (fun m ↦ m v)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.normalize_subprob
statement:
lemma normalize_subprob (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) {L : Law (V → ℝ)}
    (hL : Positive L) (hsum : total L ≤ 1) {A : Finset V} {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hbL : BoundedOn L A b) :
    ∃ K : Law (V → ℝ), IsProb K ∧ BoundedOn K A b ∧
      (∀ v, expect K (fun m ↦ m v) = expect L (fun m ↦ m v)) ∧
      expectedEdges G w K = expectedEdges G w L

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.neighborhood_packing
statement:
lemma neighborhood_packing (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 < w v)
    (A : Finset V) {s η b B : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hη : 0 < η) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hB : 2 ≤ B) (hbig : 2/η*b ≤ B) (_hAs : mass w A ≤ s)
    (hlocal : ∀ (R : Finset V), R ⊆ A → ∀ v ∈ R,
      η*s < mass w (R ∩ neighbors G v) →
      ∃ L : Law (V → ℝ), IsProb L ∧ BoundedOn L (R ∩ neighbors G v) b ∧
        (∀ u, expect L (fun m ↦ m u) = if u ∈ R ∩ neighbors G v then 1 else 0) ∧
        expectedEdges G w L ≤ η * (mass w (R ∩ neighbors G v))^2) :
    ∃ L : Law (V → ℝ), Positive L ∧ total L ≤ 1/2+mass w A/(2*s) ∧
      BoundedOn L A B ∧
      (∀ u, expect L (fun m ↦ m u) = if u ∈ A then 1 else 0) ∧
      expectedEdges G w L ≤ 2*η*s*mass w A

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.multiplierBound_ge_one
statement:
lemma multiplierBound_ge_one (k : ℕ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    1 ≤ multiplierBound k ε

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.multiplierBound_pos
statement: lemma multiplierBound_pos (k : ℕ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : 0 < multiplierBound k ε

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.multiplierBound_step
statement:
lemma multiplierBound_step (k : ℕ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    multiplierBound (k+1) ε = (8/ε)*multiplierBound k (ε/4)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.sparse_multipliers_on
statement:
lemma sparse_multipliers_on (k : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ v, 0 < w v) (A : Finset V) (hfree : G.CliqueFreeOn (↑A) (k+2))
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hεhalf : ε ≤ 1/2) :
    ∃ L : Law (V → ℝ), IsProb L ∧ BoundedOn L A (multiplierBound k ε) ∧
      (∀ v, expect L (fun m ↦ m v) = if v ∈ A then 1 else 0) ∧
      expectedEdges G w L ≤ ε * (mass w A)^2

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.edgeForm_restrict
statement:
lemma edgeForm_restrict (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (S D : Finset V) :
    edgeForm G (restrict S w) (restrict D w) = crossMass G w S D

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.edgeForm_smul_left
statement:
lemma edgeForm_smul_left (G : SimpleGraph V) (a b : V → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    edgeForm G (fun v ↦ t*a v) b = t*edgeForm G a b

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.edgeForm_smul_right
statement:
lemma edgeForm_smul_right (G : SimpleGraph V) (a b : V → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    edgeForm G a (fun v ↦ t*b v) = t*edgeForm G a b

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.edgeMass_lin_sub
statement:
lemma edgeMass_lin_sub (G : SimpleGraph V) (a b : V → ℝ) (k : ℝ) :
    edgeMass G (fun v ↦ k*a v-b v) =
      k^2*edgeMass G a + edgeMass G b - k*edgeForm G a b

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.expected_edgeForm
statement:
lemma expected_edgeForm (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (L : Law (V → ℝ)) (S D : Finset V)
    (hmean : ∀ v, expect L (fun m ↦ m v) = if v ∈ S then 1 else 0) :
    expect L (fun m ↦ edgeForm G (fun v ↦ w v*m v) (restrict D w)) = crossMass G w S D

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.expected_weight
statement:
lemma expected_weight (w : V → ℝ) (L : Law (V → ℝ)) (S : Finset V)
    (hmean : ∀ v, expect L (fun m ↦ m v) = if v ∈ S then 1 else 0) :
    expect L (fun m ↦ ∑ v, w v*m v) = mass w S

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.variational_cross_lottery
statement:
lemma variational_cross_lottery (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : IsOptimizer G w)
    (S D : Finset V) (hSD : Disjoint S D) (L : Law (V → ℝ)) (hp : IsProb L)
    {b k ε : ℝ} (hk : 0 ≤ k) (hb : BoundedOn L S b)
    (hm : ∀ v, expect L (fun m ↦ m v) = if v ∈ S then 1 else 0)
    (he : expectedEdges G w L ≤ ε*(mass w S)^2) :
    k*crossMass G w S D ≤ k^2*ε*(mass w S)^2 + (mass w D)^2/2 + mass w D +
      k*Real.log (1+k*b)*mass w S

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.vertex_divergence_upper
statement:
lemma vertex_divergence_upper {w y L : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hL : y ≤ L) :
    (w*(1+y))*Real.log ((w*(1+y))/w) - w*(1+y) + w ≤ w*y*Real.log (1+L)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.cross_error_le
statement:
lemma cross_error_le {s t x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hslo : Real.exp (-x) ≤ s) (hsup : s ≤ Real.exp x) (htup : t ≤ Real.exp x) :
    s^2 + t^2/2 + t ≤ 3 * Real.exp (4*x) * x * s

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.log_multiplier_le
statement:
lemma log_multiplier_le (k : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    Real.log (1 + Real.exp (4*x) * multiplierBound k (Real.exp (-8*x))) ≤
      (5 + 10*(k:ℝ) + (k:ℝ)^2)*x

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.optimizer_cross_disjoint
statement:
lemma optimizer_cross_disjoint (k : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ}
    (hw : IsOptimizer G w) (S D : Finset V) (hSD : Disjoint S D)
    (hfree : G.CliqueFreeOn (↑S) (k+2)) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x)
    (hsup : mass w S ≤ Real.exp x) (htup : mass w D ≤ Real.exp x) :
    crossMass G w S D ≤ (4*((k:ℝ)+2)^2)*growth x (mass w S)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.optimizer_cross_disjoint_moderate
statement:
lemma optimizer_cross_disjoint_moderate (k : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ}
    (hw : IsOptimizer G w) (S D : Finset V) (hSD : Disjoint S D)
    (hfree : G.CliqueFreeOn (↑S) (k+2)) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x)
    (hslo : Real.exp (-x) ≤ mass w S) (hsup : mass w S ≤ Real.exp x)
    (htup : mass w D ≤ Real.exp x) :
    crossMass G w S D ≤ (8 + 10*(k:ℝ) + (k:ℝ)^2)*x*mass w S

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.bool_pair_count
statement:
lemma bool_pair_count (u v : V) (huv : u ≠ v) :
    (∑ f : V → Bool, if f u = false ∧ f v = true then (1:ℝ) else 0) =
      (Fintype.card (V → Bool) : ℝ)/4

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.bool_point_count
statement:
lemma bool_point_count (u : V) (b : Bool) :
    (∑ f : V → Bool, if f u = b then (1:ℝ) else 0) =
      (Fintype.card (V → Bool) : ℝ)/2

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.crossMass_colored
statement:
lemma crossMass_colored (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (S D : Finset V) (f : V → Bool) :
    crossMass G w (S.filter fun u ↦ f u = false) (D.filter fun v ↦ f v = true) =
      ∑ u ∈ S, ∑ v ∈ D, (if f u = false ∧ f v = true then (1:ℝ) else 0) *
        (if G.Adj u v then w u*w v else 0)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.optimizer_cross_bound
OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.sum_colored_cross
statement:
lemma sum_colored_cross [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (S D : Finset V) :
    (∑ f : V → Bool, crossMass G w (S.filter fun u ↦ f u = false) (D.filter fun v ↦ f v = true)) =
      (Fintype.card (V → Bool) : ℝ)/4 * crossMass G w S D

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.card_neighbors
statement: lemma card_neighbors (G : SimpleGraph V) (v : V) : (neighbors G v).card = G.degree v

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.optimizer_edge_bound
statement:
lemma optimizer_edge_bound {G : SimpleGraph V} {w : V → ℝ} (hw : IsOptimizer G w)
    [Nonempty V] {Δ : ℝ} (hΔ : 3 ≤ Δ) (hdeg : ∀ v, (G.degree v : ℝ) ≤ Δ) :
    2 * edgeMass G w ≤ Real.log Δ * (∑ v, w v)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.optimizer_total_weight
statement:
lemma optimizer_total_weight {G : SimpleGraph V} {w : V → ℝ} (hw : IsOptimizer G w)
    [Nonempty V] {Δ : ℝ} (hΔ : 3 ≤ Δ) (hdeg : ∀ v, (G.degree v : ℝ) ≤ Δ) :
    (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / Δ ≤ ∑ v, w v

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.sum_log_le_log_sum
statement:
lemma sum_log_le_log_sum {p x : V → ℝ} (hp : ∀ v, 0 ≤ p v)
    (hs : ∑ v, p v = 1) (hx : ∀ v, 0 < x v) :
    (∑ v, p v * Real.log (x v)) ≤ Real.log (∑ v, p v * x v)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.sum_neighborMass
statement:
lemma sum_neighborMass (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) :
    (∑ v, neighborMass G w v) = ∑ v, (G.degree v : ℝ) * w v

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.edgeMass_closedNeighbors
statement:
lemma edgeMass_closedNeighbors (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (v : V) :
    edgeMass G (restrict (closedNeighbors G v) w) =
      w v * neighborMass G w v + triangleAt G w v / 2

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.mass_closedNeighbors
statement:
lemma mass_closedNeighbors (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (v : V) :
    mass w (closedNeighbors G v) = w v + neighborMass G w v

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.mem_closedNeighbors
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_closedNeighbors (G : SimpleGraph V) (u v : V) :
    u ∈ closedNeighbors G v ↔ u = v ∨ G.Adj v u

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.optimizer_deletion_cost
statement:
lemma optimizer_deletion_cost {G : SimpleGraph V} {w : V → ℝ}
    (hw : IsOptimizer G w) (A : Finset V) :
    potential G w - potential G (restrict Aᶜ w) =
      mass w A + edgeMass G (restrict A w)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.potential_induce
statement:
lemma potential_induce (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (A : Finset V) :
    potential (G.induce (A : Set V)) (fun v ↦ w v) = potential G (restrict A w)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteCoupling.bad_and
statement: lemma bad_and (p q : Prop) : bad (p ∧ q) ≤ bad p + bad q

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteCoupling.exists_positive_ge
statement:
lemma exists_positive_ge {q : I → ℝ} (hq : Law q) (f : I → ℝ) {L : ℝ}
    (hL : L ≤ ∑ i, q i * f i) : ∃ i, 0 < q i ∧ L ≤ f i

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteCoupling.exists_threshold_law
statement:
lemma exists_threshold_law (a : I → ℝ) (ha0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) (ha1 : ∀ i, a i ≤ 1) :
    ∃ q : Finset I → ℝ, Law q ∧
      (∀ i, (∑ A, if i ∈ A then q A else 0) = a i) ∧
      (∀ i j, (∑ A, if i ∈ A ∧ j ∈ A then q A else 0) = min (a i) (a j))

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteCoupling.expected_indicator_mix
statement:
lemma expected_indicator_mix (p : I → ℝ) (q : I → J → ℝ) (b : J → Prop) [DecidablePred b] :
    (∑ y, if b y then mix p q y else 0) =
      ∑ i, p i * ∑ y, if b y then q i y else 0

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteCoupling.expected_indicator_push
statement:
lemma expected_indicator_push {p : I → ℝ} (f : I → J) (b : J → Prop) [DecidablePred b] :
    (∑ y, if b y then push p f y else 0) = ∑ i, if b (f i) then p i else 0

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteCoupling.joint_of_trials
statement:
lemma joint_of_trials [Nonempty J] (p : I → J → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, Law (p i))
    (t : E → ℝ) (ht : ∀ e, 0 ≤ t e) (A : E → Finset I) (label : E → J)
    (hmarg : ∀ i y, (∑ e, if i ∈ A e ∧ label e = y then t e else 0) = p i y)
    (D : I → I → ℝ)
    (hpair : ∀ i j,
      (∑ e, if Xor (i ∈ A e) (j ∈ A e) then t e else 0) ≤
        D i j * (∑ e, if i ∈ A e ∨ j ∈ A e then t e else 0)) :
    ∃ q : (I → J) → ℝ, Law q ∧
      (∀ i y, (∑ f, if f i = y then q f else 0) = p i y) ∧
      (∀ i j, (∑ f, if f i ≠ f j then q f else 0) ≤ D i j)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteCoupling.law_dirac
statement: lemma law_dirac (j : J) : Law (fun y ↦ if y = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteCoupling.law_mix
statement:
lemma law_mix {p : I → ℝ} {q : I → J → ℝ} (hp : Law p) (hq : ∀ i, Law (q i)) :
    Law (mix p q)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteCoupling.law_push
statement: lemma law_push {p : I → ℝ} (hp : Law p) (f : I → J) : Law (push p f)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteCoupling.marginal_expectation
OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteCoupling.positive_output
statement:
lemma positive_output {p : I → J → ℝ} {q : (I → J) → ℝ} (hq : Law q)
    (hm : ∀ i y, (∑ f, if f i = y then q f else 0) = p i y)
    {f : I → J} (hf : 0 < q f) (i : I) : 0 < p i (f i)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteCoupling.prob_event_le_one
statement:
lemma prob_event_le_one {p : I → ℝ} (hp : Law p) (b : I → Prop) [DecidablePred b] :
    (∑ i, if b i then p i else 0) ≤ 1

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteCoupling.shared_rejection
statement:
lemma shared_rejection [Nonempty J] (p : I → J → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, Law (p i)) :
    ∃ q : (I → J) → ℝ, Law q ∧
      (∀ i y, (∑ f, if f i = y then q f else 0) = p i y) ∧
      (∀ i j, (∑ f, if f i ≠ f j then q f else 0) ≤
        2 * dist (p i) (p j) / (1 + dist (p i) (p j)))

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteCoupling.sharp_bound_le
statement: lemma sharp_bound_le (p q : I → ℝ) : 2 * dist p q / (1 + dist p q) ≤ 2 * dist p q

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteCoupling.sum_abs_eq
statement: lemma sum_abs_eq (a b : ℝ) : a + b - 2 * min a b = |a - b|

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteCoupling.sum_mix
statement:
lemma sum_mix (p : I → ℝ) (q : I → J → ℝ) (g : J → ℝ) :
    ∑ y, mix p q y * g y = ∑ i, p i * ∑ y, q i y * g y

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteCoupling.sum_push
statement:
lemma sum_push (p : I → ℝ) (f : I → J) (g : J → ℝ) :
    ∑ y, push p f y * g y = ∑ i, p i * g (f i)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.commute_lazy
statement: lemma commute_lazy (P : Kernel I) : Commute P (lazy P)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.entropy_increment
statement:
lemma entropy_increment {π w : I → ℝ} (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i)
    {Q K : Kernel I} (hQ : Stochastic Q) (hK : Stochastic K) (hs : Stationary π Q) :
    avgEntropy π w (Q * K) - avgEntropy π w K =
      ∑ i, π i * ∑ j, Q i j * divergence (K j) ((Q * K) i)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.entropy_increment_nonneg
statement:
lemma entropy_increment_nonneg {π w : I → ℝ} (hπ : IsProb π) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i)
    {Q K : Kernel I} (hQ : Stochastic Q) (hK : Stochastic K) (hs : Stationary π Q) :
    0 ≤ avgEntropy π w (Q * K) - avgEntropy π w K

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.entropy_increment_tv
statement:
lemma entropy_increment_tv {π w : I → ℝ} (hπ : IsProb π) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i)
    {Q K : Kernel I} (hQ : Stochastic Q) (hK : Stochastic K) (hs : Stationary π Q) :
    (∑ i, π i * ∑ j, Q i j * tv (K j) ((Q * K) i)) ^ 2 ≤
      avgEntropy π w (Q * K) - avgEntropy π w K

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.exists_smoothed_row_distance
statement:
lemma exists_smoothed_row_distance {π w : I → ℝ} (hπ : IsProb π) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i)
    {P : Kernel I} (hP : Stochastic P) (hs : Stationary π P)
    {R : ℕ} (hR : 0 < R) {D : ℝ}
    (hD : avgEntropy π w (smoothed P R) - avgEntropy π w (smoothed P 0) ≤ D) :
    ∃ j < R, (∑ i, π i * ∑ z, P i z * tv (smoothed P j i) (smoothed P j z)) ^ 2 ≤
      4 * D / R

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.lazy_eq
statement: lemma lazy_eq (P : Kernel I) : lazy P = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (1 + P)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.lazy_triangle_tv
statement:
lemma lazy_triangle_tv {π : I → ℝ} (hπ : IsProb π) {P K : Kernel I}
    (hP : Stochastic P) :
    (∑ i, π i * ∑ j, P i j * tv (K i) (K j)) ≤
      2 * (∑ i, π i * ∑ j, lazy P i j * tv (K j) ((lazy P * K) i))

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.leakage_mul_le
statement:
lemma leakage_mul_le {P Q : Kernel I} (hP : Stochastic P) (hQ : Stochastic Q)
    (i : I) (A B : Finset I) :
    rowMass (P * Q) i Bᶜ ≤ rowMass P i Aᶜ + ∑ y ∈ Bᶜ, ∑ z ∈ A, P i z * Q z y

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.pair_isProb
statement:
lemma pair_isProb {π : I → ℝ} (hπ : IsProb π) {Q : Kernel I} (hQ : Stochastic Q) :
    IsProb (fun a : I × I ↦ π a.1 * Q a.1 a.2)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.preserves_lazy
statement:
lemma preserves_lazy {label : I → J} {P : Kernel I} (hP : Preserves label P) :
    Preserves label (lazy P)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.preserves_mul
statement:
lemma preserves_mul {label : I → J} {P Q : Kernel I}
    (hP : Preserves label P) (hQ : Preserves label Q) : Preserves label (P * Q)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.preserves_one
statement: lemma preserves_one (label : I → J) : Preserves label (1 : Kernel I)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.preserves_pow
statement:
lemma preserves_pow {label : I → J} {P : Kernel I} (hP : Preserves label P) (n : ℕ) :
    Preserves label (P ^ n)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.preserves_smoothed
statement:
lemma preserves_smoothed {label : I → J} {P : Kernel I} (hP : Preserves label P) (n : ℕ) :
    Preserves label (smoothed P n)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.reversed_entropy_tail
statement:
lemma reversed_entropy_tail {μ w : I → ℝ} {K : Matrix I I ℝ}
    (hμ : IsProb μ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hK : Stochastic K)
    (hr : Reversible μ K) {x a : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hd : ∀ i j, K i j ≤ x * w j) :
    (a + Real.log x) *
        (∑ i, μ i * ∑ j, if K j i < w i * Real.exp (-a) then K i j else 0) ≤
      avgEntropy μ w K + Real.log x

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.reversible_lazy
statement:
lemma reversible_lazy {π : I → ℝ} {P : Kernel I} (hP : Reversible π P) :
    Reversible π (lazy P)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.reversible_mul
OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.reversible_one
statement: lemma reversible_one (π : I → ℝ) : Reversible π (1 : Kernel I)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.reversible_pow
statement:
lemma reversible_pow {π : I → ℝ} {P : Kernel I} (hP : Reversible π P) (n : ℕ) :

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.reversible_smoothed
statement:
lemma reversible_smoothed {π : I → ℝ} {P : Kernel I} (hP : Reversible π P) (j : ℕ) :
    Reversible π (smoothed P j)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.rowMass_compl
statement:
lemma rowMass_compl {K : Kernel I} (hK : Stochastic K) (i : I) (A : Finset I) :
    rowMass K i Aᶜ = 1 - rowMass K i A

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.rowMass_le_one
statement:
lemma rowMass_le_one {K : Kernel I} (hK : Stochastic K) (i : I) (A : Finset I) :
    rowMass K i A ≤ 1

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.rowMass_mul
statement:
lemma rowMass_mul (P Q : Kernel I) (i : I) (A : Finset I) :
    rowMass (P * Q) i A = ∑ j, P i j * rowMass Q j A

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.smoothed_density
statement:
lemma smoothed_density {P : Kernel I} (hP : Stochastic P) {b : I → ℝ}
    (hb : ∀ i j, P i j ≤ b j) (n : ℕ) : ∀ i j, smoothed P n i j ≤ b j

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.smoothed_entropy_mono
statement:
lemma smoothed_entropy_mono {π w : I → ℝ} (hπ : IsProb π) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i)
    {P : Kernel I} (hP : Stochastic P) (hs : Stationary π P) :
    Monotone (fun j ↦ avgEntropy π w (smoothed P j))

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.smoothed_row_distance_sq
statement:
lemma smoothed_row_distance_sq {π w : I → ℝ} (hπ : IsProb π) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i)
    {P : Kernel I} (hP : Stochastic P) (hs : Stationary π P) (j : ℕ) :
    (∑ i, π i * ∑ z, P i z * tv (smoothed P j i) (smoothed P j z)) ^ 2 ≤
      4 * (avgEntropy π w (smoothed P (j + 1)) - avgEntropy π w (smoothed P j))

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.smoothed_succ
statement:
lemma smoothed_succ (P : Kernel I) (j : ℕ) :
    smoothed P (j + 1) = lazy P * smoothed P j

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.smoothed_succ_right
statement:
lemma smoothed_succ_right (P : Kernel I) (j : ℕ) :
    smoothed P (j + 1) = smoothed P j * lazy P

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.smoothed_zero
statement: lemma smoothed_zero (P : Kernel I) : smoothed P 0 = P

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteKernel.stationary_average
statement:
lemma stationary_average {π : I → ℝ} {Q : Kernel I} (hQ : Stationary π Q) (f : I → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, π i * ∑ j, Q i j * f j) = ∑ j, π j * f j

statement:
lemma stationary_lazy {π : I → ℝ} {P : Kernel I} (hP : Stationary π P) :
    Stationary π (lazy P)

statement:

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.TriangleState.adj12
statement: @[simp] lemma adj12 (t : TriangleState G) : G.Adj t.first t.second

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.TriangleState.adj13
statement: @[simp] lemma adj13 (t : TriangleState G) : G.Adj t.first t.third

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.TriangleState.adj23
statement: @[simp] lemma adj23 (t : TriangleState G) : G.Adj t.second t.third

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.TriangleState.corner_sum
statement:
lemma corner_sum (w : V → ℝ) (f : EdgeState G → EdgeState G → ℝ) :
    (∑ t : TriangleState G, weight w t * f t.edge12 t.edge13) =
      ∑ e : EdgeState G, ∑ z : EdgeState G,
        if e.src = z.src ∧ G.Adj e.dst z.dst
          then w e.src * w e.dst * w z.dst * f e z else 0

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.TriangleState.marginal
statement:
lemma marginal (w : V → ℝ) (f : V → V → ℝ) :
    (∑ t : TriangleState G, weight w t * f t.first t.second) =
      ∑ e : EdgeState G, w e.src * w e.dst * commonMass G w e.src e.dst * f e.src e.dst

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.TriangleState.sum_edge_permutations
statement:
lemma sum_edge_permutations (w : V → ℝ) (g : EdgeState G → ℝ) :
    (∑ t, weight w t * g t.edge12.rev) = (∑ t, weight w t * g t.edge12) ∧
    (∑ t, weight w t * g t.edge13) = (∑ t, weight w t * g t.edge12) ∧
    (∑ t, weight w t * g t.edge13.rev) = (∑ t, weight w t * g t.edge12) ∧
    (∑ t, weight w t * g t.edge23) = (∑ t, weight w t * g t.edge12) ∧
    (∑ t, weight w t * g t.edge23.rev) = (∑ t, weight w t * g t.edge12)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.TriangleState.sum_eq
statement:
lemma sum_eq (f : V → V → V → ℝ) :
    (∑ t : TriangleState G, f t.first t.second t.third) =
      ∑ u, ∑ v ∈ neighbors G u, ∑ z ∈ neighbors G u,
        if G.Adj v z then f u v z else 0

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.TriangleState.sum_flip
statement:
lemma sum_flip (w : V → ℝ) (f : TriangleState G → ℝ) :
    (∑ t, weight w t * f (flip t)) = ∑ t, weight w t * f t

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.TriangleState.sum_rotate
statement:
lemma sum_rotate (w : V → ℝ) (f : TriangleState G → ℝ) :
    (∑ t, weight w t * f (rotate t)) = ∑ t, weight w t * f t

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.TriangleState.sum_swap
statement:
lemma sum_swap (w : V → ℝ) (f : TriangleState G → ℝ) :
    (∑ t, weight w t * f (swap t)) = ∑ t, weight w t * f t

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.TriangleState.sum_weight
statement: lemma sum_weight (w : V → ℝ) : (∑ t : TriangleState G, weight w t) = 6 * triangleMass G w

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.TriangleState.weight_flip
statement:
@[simp] lemma weight_flip (w : V → ℝ) (t : TriangleState G) :
    weight w (flip t) = weight w t

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.TriangleState.weight_pos
statement:
lemma weight_pos {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u) (t : TriangleState G) :
    0 < weight w t

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.TriangleState.weight_rotate
statement:
@[simp] lemma weight_rotate (w : V → ℝ) (t : TriangleState G) :

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.TriangleState.weight_swap
statement:
@[simp] lemma weight_swap (w : V → ℝ) (t : TriangleState G) :
