name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.EdgeProjection.crossBound
statement:
lemma crossBound (h : EdgeProjection H G π) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v)
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hc : CrossBound G w C) : CrossBound H (w ∘ π) C

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.EdgeProjection.crossMass_edge_sum
statement:
lemma crossMass_edge_sum (H : SimpleGraph U) (w : U → ℝ) (A B : Finset U) :
    crossMass H w A B =
      ∑ e : EdgeState H, if e.src ∈ A ∧ e.dst ∈ B then w e.src * w e.dst else 0

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.EdgeProjection.crossMass_le
statement:
lemma crossMass_le (h : EdgeProjection H G π) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v)
    (A B : Finset U) :
    crossMass H (w ∘ π) A B ≤ crossMass G w (A.image π) (B.image π)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.EdgeProjection.edgeMap_injective
statement: lemma edgeMap_injective (h : EdgeProjection H G π) : Function.Injective h.edgeMap

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.EdgeProjection.edgeMass_le
statement:
lemma edgeMass_le (h : EdgeProjection H G π) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v) :
    edgeMass H (w ∘ π) ≤ edgeMass G w

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.EdgeProjection.mass_image_le
statement:
lemma mass_image_le {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v) (A : Finset U) :
    mass w (A.image π) ≤ mass (w ∘ π) A

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.EdgeProjection.neighborMass_le
statement:
lemma neighborMass_le (h : EdgeProjection H G π) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v) (a : U) :
    neighborMass H (w ∘ π) a ≤ neighborMass G w (π a)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.EdgeProjection.neighbor_injective
statement:
lemma neighbor_injective (h : EdgeProjection H G π) (a : U) :
    Set.InjOn π (neighbors H a)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.EdgeProjection.neighborhood_image
statement:
lemma neighborhood_image (h : EdgeProjection H G π) (a : U) :
    (neighbors H a).image π ⊆ neighbors G (π a)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.sum_injective_le
statement:
lemma sum_injective_le {I : Type u} {J : Type v} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (f : I → J) (hf : Function.Injective f) (g : J → ℝ) (hg : ∀ j, 0 ≤ g j) :
    (∑ i, g (f i)) ≤ ∑ j, g j

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.edgeMass_eraseEdge
statement:
lemma edgeMass_eraseEdge {G : SimpleGraph V} (w : V → ℝ) {u v : V} (huv : G.Adj u v) :
    edgeMass (eraseEdge G u v) w = edgeMass G w - w u * w v

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.eraseEdge_le
statement: lemma eraseEdge_le (G : SimpleGraph V) (u v : V) : eraseEdge G u v ≤ G

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.peeling
statement:
lemma peeling (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 < w v)
    {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    ∃ H : SimpleGraph V, H ≤ G ∧
      (∀ u v, H.Adj u v → τ ≤ commonMass H w u v) ∧
      triangleMass G w - τ * edgeMass G w ≤ triangleMass H w

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.sum_removed_directed
statement:
lemma sum_removed_directed {G : SimpleGraph V} {u v : V} (huv : G.Adj u v)
    (f : V → V → ℝ) :
    (∑ e : EdgeState G, f e.src e.dst * bad ((eraseEdge G u v).Adj e.src e.dst)) =
      f u v + f v u

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.triangleMass_eraseEdge
statement:
lemma triangleMass_eraseEdge {G : SimpleGraph V} {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v)
    {u v : V} (huv : G.Adj u v) :
    triangleMass G w - w u * w v * commonMass G w u v ≤ triangleMass (eraseEdge G u v) w

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.triangle_deletion_bound
statement:
lemma triangle_deletion_bound {G H : SimpleGraph V} {w : V → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v) :
    6 * triangleMass G w ≤ 6 * triangleMass H w +
      3 * ∑ e : EdgeState G, w e.src * w e.dst * commonMass G w e.src e.dst * bad (H.Adj e.src e.dst)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.triangle_subgraph_surviving_le
statement:
lemma triangle_subgraph_surviving_le {G H : SimpleGraph V} {w : V → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v) :
    (∑ t : TriangleState G, if H.Adj t.first t.second ∧ H.Adj t.first t.third ∧ H.Adj t.second t.third
      then TriangleState.weight w t else 0) ≤ 6 * triangleMass H w

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.Splitting.neighborMass_le
statement:
lemma neighborMass_le (w : V → ℝ) (F : EdgeState G → EdgeState G)
    (hF : ∀ e, (F e).src = e.src) (good : EdgeState G → Prop)
    (K : EdgeState G → EdgeState G → ℝ) (hK0 : ∀ a e, 0 ≤ K a e)
    (hK1 : ∀ a, ∑ e, K a e = 1) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hadm : ∀ e, good e → w e.dst ≤ L * K (F e) e) (a : EdgeState G) :
    neighborMass (graph F hF good) (w ∘ EdgeState.src) a ≤ L

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.Splitting.projection
statement:
lemma projection (F : EdgeState G → EdgeState G)
    (hF : ∀ e, (F e).src = e.src) (good : EdgeState G → Prop) :
    EdgeProjection (graph F hF good) G EdgeState.src

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.Splitting.triangleMass_surviving_le
statement:
lemma triangleMass_surviving_le {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v)
    (F : EdgeState G → EdgeState G) (hF : ∀ e, (F e).src = e.src)
    (good : EdgeState G → Prop) :
    (∑ t : TriangleState G, if Survives F good t then TriangleState.weight w t else 0) ≤
      6 * triangleMass (graph F hF good) (w ∘ EdgeState.src)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.badSet_mass_bound
statement:
lemma badSet_mass_bound (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ u, 0 ≤ w u)
    {C Y : ℝ} (hCross : CrossBound G w C) (hY : 1 ≤ Y)
    (S : V → Finset V) (b : ℝ) (v : V)
    (hv : neighborMass G w v ≤ Real.exp Y) (hS : mass w (S v) ≤ Real.exp Y) :
    b * mass w (badSet G w S b v) ≤ C * growth Y (neighborMass G w v)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.badSet_subset
statement:
lemma badSet_subset (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (S : V → Finset V)
    (b : ℝ) (v : V) : badSet G w S b v ⊆ neighbors G v

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.conditional_bad_bound
statement:
lemma conditional_bad_bound (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ u, 0 ≤ w u)
    {C x k : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hk : 0 ≤ k)
    (hCross : CrossBound G w C) (v : V) (B : Finset V) (hB : B ⊆ neighbors G v)
    (hs : 1 / x ≤ neighborMass G w v) (hL : neighborMass G w v ≤ Real.exp x)
    (hh : neighborMass G w v / x ≤ triangleAt G w v)
    (hb : mass w B ≤ k * neighborMass G w v) :
    crossMass G w B (neighbors G v) ≤
      (2 * C * x ^ 2 * (k + x * Real.exp (-x))) * triangleAt G w v

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.enlarge_mass
statement:
lemma enlarge_mass (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v)
    {L t : ℝ} (hL : ∀ u, neighborMass G w u ≤ L) (ht : 0 < t) (A : Finset V) :
    mass w (enlarge G w t A) ≤ (1 + L / t) * mass w A

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.exceptionalConstant_nonneg
statement: lemma exceptionalConstant_nonneg {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) : 0 ≤ exceptionalConstant C

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.growth_le_of_lower
statement:
lemma growth_le_of_lower {x Y s : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hs : 1 / x ≤ s) :
    growth Y s ≤ s * (Y + Real.log x)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.not_mem_enlarge
statement:
lemma not_mem_enlarge (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (A : Finset V)
    {y : V} (hy : y ∉ enlarge G w t A) :
    y ∉ A ∧ mass w (A ∩ neighbors G y) < t

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.reach_bad_cross
statement:
lemma reach_bad_cross (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ u, 0 ≤ w u)
    {C x : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hCross : CrossBound G w C) (hx : 32 ≤ x)
    (hL : ∀ u, neighborMass G w u ≤ Real.exp x)
    (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 1 / x ≤ commonMass G w u v)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * x) (v : V) :
    crossMass G w (badSet G w (fun u ↦ reach G w (Numerical.threshold x) u n) (x ^ 8) v)
      (neighbors G v) ≤ (exceptionalConstant C / x ^ 4) * triangleAt G w v

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.reach_bad_mass
statement:
lemma reach_bad_mass (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ u, 0 ≤ w u)
    {C x : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hCross : CrossBound G w C) (hx : 32 ≤ x)
    (hL : ∀ u, neighborMass G w u ≤ Real.exp x)
    (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 1 / x ≤ commonMass G w u v)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * x) {v : V} (hv : (neighbors G v).Nonempty) :
    mass w (badSet G w (fun u ↦ reach G w (Numerical.threshold x) u n) (x ^ 8) v) ≤
      (21 * C / x ^ 6) * neighborMass G w v

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.reach_mass
statement:
lemma reach_mass (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v)
    {L t : ℝ} (hL0 : 0 ≤ L) (hL : ∀ u, neighborMass G w u ≤ L) (ht : 0 < t)
    (v : V) (n : ℕ) : mass w (reach G w t v n) ≤ (1 + L / t) ^ n * neighborMass G w v

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.reach_mass_exp
statement:
lemma reach_mass_exp (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 32 ≤ x) (hL : ∀ v, neighborMass G w v ≤ Real.exp x)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * x) (v : V) :
    mass w (reach G w (Numerical.threshold x) v n) ≤ Real.exp (20 * x ^ 2)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.subset_enlarge
statement:
lemma subset_enlarge (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (A : Finset V) :
    A ⊆ enlarge G w t A

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.entropy_bounds
statement:
lemma entropy_bounds [Nonempty (EdgeState G)] (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 1 / x ≤ commonMass G w u v)
    (hL : ∀ u, neighborMass G w u ≤ Real.exp x) (n : ℕ) (e : EdgeState G) :
    -Real.log x ≤ entropy (vertexWeight G w) (smoothed (transition G w) n e) ∧
      entropy (vertexWeight G w) (smoothed (transition G w) n e) ≤ x

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.fiber_mass
statement: lemma fiber_mass (u : V) : (∑ e ∈ fiber G u, vertexWeight G w e) = neighborMass G w u

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.law_isProb
statement:
lemma law_isProb [Nonempty (EdgeState G)] (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u)
    (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 0 < commonMass G w u v) : IsProb (law G w)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.mem_fiber
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_fiber (e : EdgeState G) (u : V) : e ∈ fiber G u ↔ e.src = u

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.normalizer_eq
statement: lemma normalizer_eq : normalizer G w = 6 * triangleMass G w

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.normalizer_pos
statement:
lemma normalizer_pos [Nonempty (EdgeState G)] (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u)
    (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 0 < commonMass G w u v) : 0 < normalizer G w

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.smoothed_density
statement:
lemma smoothed_density (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 1 / x ≤ commonMass G w u v) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ e f, smoothed (transition G w) n e f ≤ x * vertexWeight G w f

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.smoothed_fixed_src
statement:
lemma smoothed_fixed_src (n : ℕ) (e f : EdgeState G) (h : e.src ≠ f.src) :
    smoothed (transition G w) n e f = 0

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.smoothed_supported
statement:
lemma smoothed_supported (n : ℕ) (e f : EdgeState G) (h : f ∉ fiber G e.src) :
    smoothed (transition G w) n e f = 0

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.transition_density
statement:
lemma transition_density (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 1 / x ≤ commonMass G w u v) :
    ∀ e f, transition G w e f ≤ x * vertexWeight G w f

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.transition_fixed_src
statement:
lemma transition_fixed_src (e f : EdgeState G) (h : e.src ≠ f.src) :
    transition G w e f = 0

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.transition_reversible
statement:
lemma transition_reversible [Nonempty (EdgeState G)] (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u)
    (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 0 < commonMass G w u v) :
    Reversible (law G w) (transition G w)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.transition_stochastic
statement:
lemma transition_stochastic (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u)
    (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 0 < commonMass G w u v) : Stochastic (transition G w)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.averaged_entropy_bound
statement:
lemma averaged_entropy_bound [Nonempty (EdgeState G)] (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 1 / x ≤ commonMass G w u v)
    (hL : ∀ u, neighborMass G w u ≤ Real.exp x)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (n : ℕ) {b q : ℝ} (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (hbad : (∑ e : EdgeState G,
      if e.src ∈ badSet G w (fun v ↦ reach G w t v n) b e.dst then law G w e else 0) ≤ q) :
    avgEntropy (law G w) (vertexWeight G w) (smoothed (transition G w) n) ≤
      Real.log 2 + Real.log b + (n * (x ^ 2 * t * Real.exp x)) * x + q * x

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.avg_entropy_lower
statement:
lemma avg_entropy_lower [Nonempty (EdgeState G)] (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 1 / x ≤ commonMass G w u v)
    (hL : ∀ u, neighborMass G w u ≤ Real.exp x) (n : ℕ) :
    -Real.log x ≤ avgEntropy (law G w) (vertexWeight G w) (smoothed (transition G w) n)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.avg_entropy_upper
statement:
lemma avg_entropy_upper [Nonempty (EdgeState G)] (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u)
    {C x : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hCross : CrossBound G w C) (hx : 32 ≤ x)
    (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 1 / x ≤ commonMass G w u v)
    (hL : ∀ u, neighborMass G w u ≤ Real.exp x)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * x) :
    avgEntropy (law G w) (vertexWeight G w) (smoothed (transition G w) n) ≤
      entropyConstant C * Real.log x

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.entropy_good_row
statement:
lemma entropy_good_row (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 1 / x ≤ commonMass G w u v)
    (hL : ∀ u, neighborMass G w u ≤ Real.exp x)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (n : ℕ) (e : EdgeState G) {b : ℝ} (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (he : e.src ∉ badSet G w (fun v ↦ reach G w t v n) b e.dst) :
    entropy (vertexWeight G w) (smoothed (transition G w) n e) ≤
      Real.log 2 + Real.log b + (n * (x ^ 2 * t * Real.exp x)) * x

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.exists_smooth_index
statement:
lemma exists_smooth_index [Nonempty (EdgeState G)] (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u)
    {C x : ℝ} (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hCross : CrossBound G w C) (hx : 32 ≤ x)
    (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 1 / x ≤ commonMass G w u v)
    (hL : ∀ u, neighborMass G w u ≤ Real.exp x) :
    ∃ j < ⌈x⌉₊,
      avgEntropy (law G w) (vertexWeight G w) (smoothed (transition G w) j) ≤
        entropyConstant C * Real.log x ∧
      rowDistance (G := G) (w := w) j ≤ smoothingConstant C * Real.sqrt (Real.log x / x)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.incoming_good_le
statement:
lemma incoming_good_le (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 1 / x ≤ commonMass G w u v)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (n : ℕ) (e : EdgeState G) (A : Finset V) :
    (∑ y ∈ (liftSet (G := G) e.src (enlarge G w t A))ᶜ,
      ∑ z ∈ liftSet (G := G) e.src A,
        smoothed (transition G w) n e z * lazy (transition G w) z y) ≤
      x ^ 2 * t * neighborMass G w e.src

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.law_bad_le
statement:
lemma law_bad_le [Nonempty (EdgeState G)] (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u)
    (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 0 < commonMass G w u v)
    (B : V → Finset V) (hB : ∀ v, B v ⊆ neighbors G v) {q : ℝ}
    (hb : ∀ v, crossMass G w (B v) (neighbors G v) ≤ q * triangleAt G w v) :
    (∑ e : EdgeState G, if e.src ∈ B e.dst then law G w e else 0) ≤ q

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.law_bad_sum
statement:
lemma law_bad_sum (B : V → Finset V) (hB : ∀ v, B v ⊆ neighbors G v) :
    (∑ e : EdgeState G, if e.src ∈ B e.dst then law G w e else 0) =
      (∑ v, w v * crossMass G w (B v) (neighbors G v)) / normalizer G w

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.law_rev
statement: lemma law_rev (e : EdgeState G) : law G w e.rev = law G w e

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.lazy_neighbor_density
statement:
lemma lazy_neighbor_density (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 1 / x ≤ commonMass G w u v)
    (e f : EdgeState G) (h : e.dst ≠ f.dst) :
    lazy (transition G w) e f ≤ if G.Adj e.dst f.dst then x * w f.dst else 0

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.liftSet_adj_mass_le
statement:
lemma liftSet_adj_mass_le (hw : ∀ u, 0 ≤ w u) (u y : V) (A : Finset V) :
    (∑ z ∈ liftSet (G := G) u A, if G.Adj z.dst y then w z.dst else 0) ≤
      mass w (A ∩ neighbors G y)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.liftSet_subset_fiber
statement: lemma liftSet_subset_fiber (u : V) (A : Finset V) : liftSet (G := G) u A ⊆ fiber G u

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.mem_liftSet
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_liftSet (u : V) (A : Finset V) (e : EdgeState G) :
    e ∈ liftSet (G := G) u A ↔ e.src = u ∧ e.dst ∈ A

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.reach_leakage
statement:
lemma reach_leakage (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 1 / x ≤ commonMass G w u v)
    {L t : ℝ} (hL : ∀ u, neighborMass G w u ≤ L) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (n : ℕ) (e : EdgeState G) :
    rowMass (smoothed (transition G w) n) e
      (liftSet (G := G) e.src (reach G w t e.dst n))ᶜ ≤ n * (x ^ 2 * t * L)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.sum_liftSet
statement:
lemma sum_liftSet (u : V) (A : Finset V) (f : V → ℝ) :
    (∑ e ∈ liftSet (G := G) u A, f e.dst) = ∑ v ∈ A ∩ neighbors G u, f v

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.triangle_edge_sum
statement:
lemma triangle_edge_sum [Nonempty (EdgeState G)] (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u)
    (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 0 < commonMass G w u v) (f : EdgeState G → ℝ) :
    (∑ t : TriangleState G, TriangleState.weight w t * f t.edge12) =
      normalizer G w * ∑ e, law G w e * f e

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.LocalWalk.triangle_pair_sum
statement:
lemma triangle_pair_sum [Nonempty (EdgeState G)] (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u)
    (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 0 < commonMass G w u v)
    (f : EdgeState G → EdgeState G → ℝ) :
    (∑ t : TriangleState G, TriangleState.weight w t * f t.edge12 t.edge13) =
      normalizer G w * ∑ e, law G w e * ∑ z, transition G w e z * f e z

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.Splitting.bad_mass_le
statement:
lemma bad_mass_le {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v)
    (F : EdgeState G → EdgeState G) (good : EdgeState G → Prop) :
    (∑ t : TriangleState G, TriangleState.weight w t * bad (Survives F good t)) ≤
      3 * (∑ t, TriangleState.weight w t * bad (F t.edge12 = F t.edge13)) +
      6 * (∑ t, TriangleState.weight w t * bad (good t.edge12))

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.Splitting.bad_survives
statement:
lemma bad_survives (F : EdgeState G → EdgeState G) (good : EdgeState G → Prop)
    (t : TriangleState G) :
    bad (Survives F good t) ≤ bad (F t.edge12 = F t.edge13) +
      bad (F t.edge12.rev = F t.edge23) + bad (F t.edge13.rev = F t.edge23.rev) +
      bad (good t.edge12) + bad (good t.edge12.rev) + bad (good t.edge13) +
      bad (good t.edge13.rev) + bad (good t.edge23) + bad (good t.edge23.rev)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.Splitting.exists_graph
statement:
lemma exists_graph [Nonempty (EdgeState G)] {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u)
    (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 0 < commonMass G w u v)
    (K : Kernel (EdgeState G)) (hK : Stochastic K)
    (hblock : ∀ e z, e.src ≠ z.src → K e z = 0)
    {a D δ : ℝ}
    (hD : (∑ e, law G w e * ∑ z, transition G w e z * tv (K e) (K z)) ≤ D)
    (hδ : (∑ e, law G w e * ∑ y,
      if K y e < w e.dst * Real.exp (-a) then K e y else 0) ≤ δ) :
    ∃ H : SimpleGraph (EdgeState G), EdgeProjection H G EdgeState.src ∧
      (∀ z, neighborMass H (w ∘ EdgeState.src) z ≤ Real.exp a) ∧
      (1 - 6 * D - 6 * δ) * triangleMass G w ≤ triangleMass H (w ∘ EdgeState.src)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.Splitting.expected_loss_le
statement:
lemma expected_loss_le [Nonempty (EdgeState G)] {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u)
    (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 0 < commonMass G w u v)
    (K : Kernel (EdgeState G)) {q : (EdgeState G → EdgeState G) → ℝ}
    (hq : Law q) (hm : ∀ i y, (∑ F, if F i = y then q F else 0) = K i y)
    (hp : ∀ i j, (∑ F, if F i ≠ F j then q F else 0) ≤ 2 * tv (K i) (K j))
    (good : (EdgeState G → EdgeState G) → EdgeState G → Prop)
    (b : EdgeState G → EdgeState G → Prop)
    (hb : ∀ F e, good F e ↔ b e (F e)) :
    (∑ F, q F * ∑ t : TriangleState G, TriangleState.weight w t * bad (Survives F (good F) t)) ≤
      normalizer G w *
        (6 * (∑ e, law G w e * ∑ z, transition G w e z * tv (K e) (K z)) +
         6 * (∑ e, law G w e * ∑ y, K e y * bad (b e y)))

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.Splitting.surviving_mass_eq
statement:
lemma surviving_mass_eq {w : V → ℝ}
    (F : EdgeState G → EdgeState G) (good : EdgeState G → Prop) :
    (∑ t : TriangleState G, if Survives F good t then TriangleState.weight w t else 0) =
      6 * triangleMass G w - ∑ t : TriangleState G, TriangleState.weight w t * bad (Survives F good t)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.splitting_error_le
statement:
lemma splitting_error_le {C x : ℝ} (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hx : 32 ≤ x) :
    6 * (smoothingConstant C * Real.sqrt (Real.log x / x)) +
    6 * ((entropyConstant C + 1) * Real.log x / (Real.sqrt x + Real.log x)) ≤
    splittingConstant C * (Real.log x / Real.sqrt x)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.weighted_splitting
statement:
lemma weighted_splitting {G : SimpleGraph V} [Nonempty (EdgeState G)] {w : V → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u) {C x : ℝ} (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hCross : CrossBound G w C)
    (hx : 32 ≤ x) (hc : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → 1 / x ≤ commonMass G w u v)
    (hL : ∀ u, neighborMass G w u ≤ Real.exp x) :
    ∃ H : SimpleGraph (EdgeState G), EdgeProjection H G EdgeState.src ∧
      (∀ z, neighborMass H (w ∘ EdgeState.src) z ≤ Real.exp (Real.sqrt x)) ∧
      (1 - splittingConstant C * (Real.log x / Real.sqrt x)) * triangleMass G w ≤
        triangleMass H (w ∘ EdgeState.src)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.neighborhood_reduction
statement:
lemma neighborhood_reduction (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ u, 0 < w u)
    {C x : ℝ} (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hCross : CrossBound G w C) (hx : 32 ≤ x)
    (hε : splittingConstant C * Numerical.lossRatio x ≤ 1)
    (hL : ∀ u, neighborMass G w u ≤ Real.exp x) :
    ∃ (U : Type u) (_ : Fintype U) (J : SimpleGraph U) (π : U → V),
      EdgeProjection J G π ∧ (∀ a, neighborMass J (w ∘ π) a ≤ Real.exp (Real.sqrt x)) ∧
      (1-splittingConstant C * Numerical.lossRatio x) * triangleMass G w - edgeMass G w / x ≤
        triangleMass J (w ∘ π)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.triangle_bound_scale
statement:
lemma triangle_bound_scale {C X : ℝ} (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hX : 32 ≤ X)

    ∀ {V : Type u} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ),
      (∀ u, 0 < w u) → CrossBound G w C →
      (∀ u, neighborMass G w u ≤ Real.exp (Numerical.scale X n)) →
      triangleMass G w ≤ (1+Real.exp X/3) * (2-(1/2:ℝ)^n) * edgeMass G w

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.maximum_degree_potential_bound

lemma maximum_degree_potential_bound (k : ℕ) {B Δ : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hΔ : 3 ≤ Δ)
    (htri : ∀ {U : Type u} [Fintype U] (H : SimpleGraph U) (w : U → ℝ),
      IsOptimizer H w → H.CliqueFree (k+2) → triangleMass H w ≤ B * edgeMass H w)
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hf : G.CliqueFree (k+2)) (hdeg : ∀ v, (G.degree v : ℝ) ≤ Δ) :
    ∃ I : Finset V, G.IsIndepSet (I : Set V) ∧

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.maximum_degree_independence

lemma maximum_degree_independence (k : ℕ) {B Δ : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hΔ : 3 ≤ Δ)

theorem exists_small_weighted_hitting_set {I : Type cycleUniverse13} (A : Finset V) (hA : A.Nonempty)

    (((Finset.univ : Finset V).powerset).filter (fun S => S.card ≤ s)).card ≤
      (s+1) * Fintype.card V ^ s

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.card_witnessFamily_le
statement:
lemma card_witnessFamily_le (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (s : ℕ) (hr : 0 < Fintype.card V) :
    (witnessFamily P s).card ≤ (s+1) * Fintype.card V ^ s

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.cutColor_lt
statement: lemma cutColor_lt {V : Type cycleUniverse2} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] [_contextInstance2 : DecidableEq V] (e : V × V) : cutColor e < 2 * Fintype.card V

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.cutExpansionOn_of_witnesses
statement:
theorem cutExpansionOn_of_witnesses (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (W : Finset V) {p h τ M : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hh : 0 < h) (hτ0 : 0 < τ)
    (hτ : τ < p*h/4) (hM : 0 < M) (hMh : M ≤ h)
    (hmiss : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * exp (-p*M/4) < 1/2)
    (hε : 4*τ/(p*h) + 4*τ*M/h ≤ 1/2)
    (hperturb : τ + Fintype.card V * (4*τ/(p*h) + 4*τ*M/h) ≤ p^2*h/8)
    (hexp : CutExpansion P h)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, p*h/2 ≤ ((neighborsIn P v W).card : ℝ))
    (hwitness : ∀ S : Finset V, (S.card : ℝ) ≤ 4*Fintype.card V*M/h →
      let U := neighborhoodUnion P S
      p*h/8 ≤ min (U.card : ℝ) (Uᶜ.card : ℝ) →
      (p^2/4) * ((P.interedges U Uᶜ).card : ℝ) ≤
        ((P.interedges (U ∩ W) (W \ (U ∩ W))).card : ℝ)) :
    CutExpansionOn P W τ

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.cutExpansion_minDegree
statement:
lemma cutExpansion_minDegree (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    {h : ℝ} (hexp : CutExpansion P h) (hr : 2 ≤ Fintype.card V) (v : V) :
    h ≤ ((neighborsIn P v Finset.univ).card : ℝ)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.cut_card_lower_of_neighbors
statement:
lemma cut_card_lower_of_neighbors (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (A B Q : Finset V) (hQA : Q ⊆ A) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ v ∈ Q, c ≤ (neighborsIn P v B).card) :
    c * Q.card ≤ ((P.interedges A B).card : ℝ)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.cut_perturbation_card
statement:
lemma cut_perturbation_card (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (W A T : Finset V) (_hAW : A ⊆ W) (_hTW : T ⊆ W) :
    (P.interedges T (W \ T)).card ≤ (P.interedges A (W \ A)).card +
      Fintype.card V * (A ∆ T).card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.exists_approximating_witness
statement:
theorem exists_approximating_witness (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (W A : Finset V) (hAW : A ⊆ W) (ha : 0 < (A.card : ℝ))
    {p h τ M : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hh : 0 < h) (hτ0 : 0 < τ)
    (hτ : τ < p*h/4) (hM : 0 < M) (hMh : M ≤ h)
    (hmiss : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * exp (-p*M/4) < 1/2)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, p*h/2 ≤ ((neighborsIn P v W).card : ℝ))
    (hbad : ((P.interedges A (W \ A)).card : ℝ) < τ * A.card) :
    p*h/4 < (A.card : ℝ) ∧ ∃ S : Finset V, S ⊆ A ∧
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤ 4 * A.card * M / h ∧
      ((A ∆ (neighborhoodUnion P S ∩ W)).card : ℝ) ≤
        (4*τ/(p*h) + 4*τ*M/h) * A.card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.hitting_neighborhoodUnion
statement:
lemma hitting_neighborhoodUnion (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (good S A : Finset V) (hhit : ∀ v ∈ good, ¬Disjoint (neighborsIn P v A) S) :
    good ⊆ neighborhoodUnion P S

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.interedges_sym2_injective
statement:
lemma interedges_sym2_injective {V : Type cycleUniverse5} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] [_contextInstance2 : DecidableEq V] (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (A B : Finset V) (hAB : Disjoint A B) :
    Set.InjOn (fun e : V × V => s(e.1, e.2)) (P.interedges A B : Set (V × V))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.neighborhoodUnion_leakage
statement:
lemma neighborhoodUnion_leakage (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (S W A : Finset V) :
    (((neighborhoodUnion P S ∩ W) \ A).card : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ v ∈ S, ((neighborsIn P v (W \ A)).card : ℝ)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.neighborsIn_partition_card
statement:
lemma neighborsIn_partition_card {V : Type cycleUniverse4} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] [_contextInstance2 : DecidableEq V] (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (v : V) (A W : Finset V) (hAW : A ⊆ W) :
    (neighborsIn P v W).card = (neighborsIn P v A).card + (neighborsIn P v (W \ A)).card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.same_cutColor_blocks_disjoint
statement:
lemma same_cutColor_blocks_disjoint (A B : Finset V) (hAB : Disjoint A B)
    {e f : V × V} (he₁ : e.1 ∈ A) (he₂ : e.2 ∈ B)
    (hf₁ : f.1 ∈ A) (hf₂ : f.2 ∈ B) (hc : cutColor e = cutColor f) (hef : e ≠ f) :
    Disjoint ({e.1, e.2} : Finset V) {f.1, f.2}

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.sample_neighbors_lower_tail
statement:
lemma sample_neighbors_lower_tail (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (p : unitInterval) {h : ℝ} (hdeg : ∀ v, h ≤ ((neighborsIn P v Finset.univ).card : ℝ))
    (v : V) :
    (sampleMeasure V p).real {ω | ((neighborsIn P v (sampleVertices ω)).card : ℝ) < (p : ℝ)*h/2} ≤
      exp (-(p : ℝ)*h/8)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.sampled_bipartite_cut_lower_tail
statement:
theorem sampled_bipartite_cut_lower_tail (p : unitInterval)
    (hr : 0 < Fintype.card V) (A B : Finset V) (hAB : Disjoint A B)
    (E : Finset (V × V)) (hE : ∀ e ∈ E, e.1 ∈ A ∧ e.2 ∈ B) :
    (sampleMeasure V p).real {ω |
      ((E.filter (fun e => e.1 ∈ sampleVertices ω ∧ e.2 ∈ sampleVertices ω)).card : ℝ) <
        (p : ℝ) ^ 2 * E.card / 4} ≤
      2 * (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * exp (-(p : ℝ) ^ 2 * E.card / (32 * Fintype.card V))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.sampled_matching_lower_tail
statement:
lemma sampled_matching_lower_tail (p : unitInterval) (A B : Finset V) (hAB : Disjoint A B)
    (E : Finset (V × V)) (hE : ∀ e ∈ E, e.1 ∈ A ∧ e.2 ∈ B)
    (c : ℕ) (hc : ∀ e ∈ E, cutColor e = c) :
    (sampleMeasure V p).real {ω |
      ((E.filter (fun e => e.1 ∈ sampleVertices ω ∧ e.2 ∈ sampleVertices ω)).card : ℝ) ≤
        (p : ℝ) ^ 2 * E.card / 2} ≤ exp (-(p : ℝ) ^ 2 * E.card / 8)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.sampled_witness_cut_lower_tail
statement:
lemma sampled_witness_cut_lower_tail (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (p : unitInterval) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hexp : CutExpansion P h)
    (hr : 0 < Fintype.card V) (U : Finset V)
    (hU : (p : ℝ)*h/8 ≤ min (U.card : ℝ) (Uᶜ.card : ℝ)) :
    (sampleMeasure V p).real {ω |
      ((P.interedges (U ∩ sampleVertices ω) (sampleVertices ω \ (U ∩ sampleVertices ω))).card : ℝ) <
        (p : ℝ)^2/4 * (P.interedges U Uᶜ).card} ≤
      2 * (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * exp (-(p : ℝ)^3*h^2/(256*Fintype.card V))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.sdiff_card_le_add_symmDiff
statement:
lemma sdiff_card_le_add_symmDiff {V : Type cycleUniverse7} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] [_contextInstance2 : DecidableEq V] (W A T : Finset V) :
    (W \ A).card ≤ (W \ T).card + (A ∆ T).card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.sum_cutColor_class_card
statement:
lemma sum_cutColor_class_card (E : Finset (V × V)) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (2 * Fintype.card V), (E.filter (fun e => cutColor e = i)).card) =
      E.card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.vertex_sampling_failure_bound
statement:
theorem vertex_sampling_failure_bound (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (p : unitInterval) {h τ M : ℝ} (hp : 0 < (p : ℝ)) (hh : 0 < h) (hτ0 : 0 < τ)
    (hτ : τ < (p : ℝ)*h/4) (hM : 0 < M) (hMh : M ≤ h)
    (hr : 2 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hmiss : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * exp (-(p : ℝ)*M/4) < 1/2)
    (hε : 4*τ/((p : ℝ)*h) + 4*τ*M/h ≤ 1/2)
    (hperturb : τ + Fintype.card V * (4*τ/((p : ℝ)*h) + 4*τ*M/h) ≤ (p : ℝ)^2*h/8)
    (hexp : CutExpansion P h) :
    (sampleMeasure V p).real {ω | ¬SampleGood P (p : ℝ) h τ ω} ≤
      exp (-(p : ℝ)*Fintype.card V/3) +
      Fintype.card V * exp (-(p : ℝ)*h/8) +
      2*Fintype.card V * ((⌈4*Fintype.card V*M/h⌉₊+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (Fintype.card V : ℝ)^⌈4*Fintype.card V*M/h⌉₊ *
        exp (-(p : ℝ)^3*h^2/(256*Fintype.card V))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.eventually_log_le_small_power
statement: lemma eventually_log_le_small_power : ∀ᶠ D : ℝ in atTop, log D ≤ D^(1/10 : ℝ)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.eventually_monomial_lt
statement:
lemma eventually_monomial_lt (K c a b : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hab : a < b) :
    ∀ᶠ D : ℝ in atTop, K * D^a < c * D^b

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.eventually_samplingScaleReady
statement:
lemma eventually_samplingScaleReady (c p : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hp : 0 < p) :
    ∀ᶠ D : ℝ in atTop, ∀ r : ℕ,
      D^(9/10 : ℝ) ≤ r → (r : ℝ) ≤ D^(51/50 : ℝ) → SamplingScaleReady c p D r

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.labelIs_preserving
statement:
lemma labelIs_preserving (p : unitInterval) (hp : 3*(p : ℝ) ≤ 1) (i : Fin 3) :
    MeasurePreserving (labelIs i) (reservoirLabelPMF p hp).toMeasure
      (bernoulliMeasure true false p)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.ofReal_unitInterval
statement:
lemma ofReal_unitInterval (p : unitInterval) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (p : ℝ) = (unitInterval.toNNReal p : ENNReal)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.reservoirSample_preserving
statement:
lemma reservoirSample_preserving {V : Type cycleUniverse3} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] [_contextInstance2 : DecidableEq V] (p : unitInterval) (hp : 3*(p : ℝ) ≤ 1) (i : Fin 3) :
    MeasurePreserving (reservoirSample i) (reservoirMeasure V p hp) (sampleMeasure V p)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.reservoirSamples_disjoint
statement:
lemma reservoirSamples_disjoint {V : Type cycleUniverse4} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] [_contextInstance2 : DecidableEq V] (ω : V → Fin 4) (i j : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Disjoint (sampleVertices (reservoirSample i ω)) (sampleVertices (reservoirSample j ω))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.samplingScaleError_tendsto
statement:
lemma samplingScaleError_tendsto (c p : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hp : 0 < p) :
    Tendsto (samplingScaleError c p) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.tendsto_monomial_exp_neg_power
statement:
lemma tendsto_monomial_exp_neg_power (a b c : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) :
    Tendsto (fun D : ℝ => D^a * exp (-c * D^b)) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.three_reservoirs_uniform
statement:
theorem three_reservoirs_uniform (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (p : unitInterval)
    (hp : 0 < (p : ℝ)) (hp3 : 3*(p : ℝ) ≤ 1) :
    ∃ D₀ : ℝ, ∀ D : ℝ, D₀ ≤ D → ∀ (V : Type u) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
      (P : Fin 3 → SimpleGraph V) [∀ i, DecidableRel (P i).Adj],
      D^(9/10 : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card V : ℝ) →
      (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≤ D^(51/50 : ℝ) →
      (∀ i, CutExpansion (P i) (c*D^(9/10 : ℝ))) →
      ∃ W : Fin 3 → Finset V,
        (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (W i) (W j)) ∧
        (∀ i, ((W i).card : ℝ) ≤ 2*(p : ℝ)*Fintype.card V) ∧
        (∀ i v, (p : ℝ)*(c*D^(9/10 : ℝ))/2 ≤ ((neighborsIn (P i) v (W i)).card : ℝ)) ∧
        (∀ i, CutExpansionOn (P i) (W i) (D^(37/50 : ℝ)))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Sampling.vertex_sampling_uniform
statement:
theorem vertex_sampling_uniform (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (p : unitInterval)
    (hp : 0 < (p : ℝ)) (_hp1 : (p : ℝ) < 1) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ D₀ : ℝ, ∀ D : ℝ, D₀ ≤ D → ∀ (V : Type u) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
      (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj],
      D^(9/10 : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card V : ℝ) →
      (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≤ D^(51/50 : ℝ) →
      CutExpansion P (c*D^(9/10 : ℝ)) →
      (sampleMeasure V p).real {ω | ¬SampleGood P (p : ℝ) (c*D^(9/10 : ℝ))
        (D^(37/50 : ℝ)) ω} ≤ ε

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Splitting.bernoulli_sum_lower_tail
statement:
theorem bernoulli_sum_lower_tail {X : I → Ω → ℝ} (s : Finset I)
    (hm : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) (hi : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hX : ∀ i ω, X i ω = 0 ∨ X i ω = 1)
    (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = p) :
    μ.real {ω | (∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) ≤ p * s.card / 2} ≤ exp (-p * s.card / 8)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Splitting.bernoulli_sum_upper_tail
statement:
theorem bernoulli_sum_upper_tail {X : I → Ω → ℝ} (s : Finset I)
    (hm : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) (hi : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hX : ∀ i ω, X i ω = 0 ∨ X i ω = 1)
    (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = p) :
    μ.real {ω | 2 * p * s.card ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω} ≤ exp (-p * s.card / 3)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Splitting.boundary_sym2_injective
statement:
lemma boundary_sym2_injective (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (U : Finset V) :
    Set.InjOn (fun e : V × V => s(e.1, e.2)) (P.interedges U Uᶜ : Set (V × V))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Splitting.colorGraph_interedges
statement:
lemma colorGraph_interedges {V : Type cycleUniverse8} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] [_contextInstance2 : DecidableEq V] (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    {l : ℕ} (ω : Sym2 V → Fin l) (i : Fin l) (S T : Finset V) :
    (colorGraph P ω i).interedges S T =
      (P.interedges S T).filter (fun e => ω s(e.1,e.2) = i)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Splitting.colorIndicator_indep
statement:
lemma colorIndicator_indep {V : Type cycleUniverse6} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] [_contextInstance2 : DecidableEq V] {l : ℕ} [NeZero l] (i : Fin l) :
    iIndepFun (colorIndicator (V := V) i) (edgeColorMeasure V l)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Splitting.colorIndicator_integral
statement:
lemma colorIndicator_integral {V : Type cycleUniverse7} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] [_contextInstance2 : DecidableEq V] {l : ℕ} [NeZero l] (i : Fin l) (e : Sym2 V) :
    ∫ ω, colorIndicator i e ω ∂edgeColorMeasure V l = 1/(l : ℝ)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Splitting.color_cut_lower_tail
statement:
lemma color_cut_lower_tail (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    {l : ℕ} [NeZero l] (i : Fin l) (S : Finset V) {h : ℝ}
    (hexp : CutExpansion P h) (hS : S.card ≤ Sᶜ.card) :
    (edgeColorMeasure V l).real {ω |
      (((colorGraph P ω i).interedges S Sᶜ).card : ℝ) < h*S.card/(2*l)} ≤
        exp (-h*S.card/(8*l))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Splitting.color_cut_sum
statement:
lemma color_cut_sum (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    {l : ℕ} (ω : Sym2 V → Fin l) (i : Fin l) (S : Finset V) :
    (∑ e ∈ (P.interedges S Sᶜ).image (fun e => s(e.1,e.2)), colorIndicator i e ω) =
      (((colorGraph P ω i).interedges S Sᶜ).card : ℝ)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Splitting.cutExpansion_of_small_cuts
OAI.ErdosGallai.Splitting.edgeSplittingScaleError_tendsto
statement:
lemma edgeSplittingScaleError_tendsto (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (l : ℕ) (hl : 0 < l) :
    Tendsto (edgeSplittingScaleError c l) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Splitting.edge_splitting_failure_bound
statement:
theorem edge_splitting_failure_bound (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    {l : ℕ} [NeZero l] {h : ℝ} (hexp : CutExpansion P h) :
    (edgeColorMeasure V l).real {ω | ∃ i, ¬CutExpansion (colorGraph P ω i) (h/(2*l))} ≤
      l * (exp ((Fintype.card V : ℝ)*exp (-h/(8*l)))-1)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Splitting.edge_splitting_of_error_lt_one
statement:
theorem edge_splitting_of_error_lt_one (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    {l : ℕ} [NeZero l] {h : ℝ} (hexp : CutExpansion P h)
    (herror : (l : ℝ)*(exp ((Fintype.card V : ℝ)*exp (-h/(8*l)))-1) < 1) :
    ∃ ω : Sym2 V → Fin l,
      (∀ i, CutExpansion (colorGraph P ω i) (h/(2*l))) ∧
      (∀ x y, P.Adj x y ↔ ∃ i, (colorGraph P ω i).Adj x y) ∧
      (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (colorGraph P ω i).edgeSet (colorGraph P ω j).edgeSet)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Splitting.edge_splitting_uniform
statement:
theorem edge_splitting_uniform (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (l : ℕ) (hl : 0 < l) :
    ∃ D₀ : ℝ, ∀ D : ℝ, D₀ ≤ D → ∀ (V : Type u) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
      (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj] (h : ℝ),
      c*D^(9/10 : ℝ) ≤ h → D^(9/10 : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card V : ℝ) →
      (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≤ D^(51/50 : ℝ) → CutExpansion P h →
      ∃ ω : Sym2 V → Fin l,
        (∀ i, CutExpansion (colorGraph P ω i) (h/(2*l))) ∧
        (∀ x y, P.Adj x y ↔ ∃ i, (colorGraph P ω i).Adj x y) ∧
        (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (colorGraph P ω i).edgeSet (colorGraph P ω j).edgeSet)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Splitting.exp_half_bound
statement: lemma exp_half_bound : exp (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 5 / 3

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Splitting.exp_neg_half_bound
statement: lemma exp_neg_half_bound : exp (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤ 5 / 8

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Splitting.indicator_mem_Icc
statement:
lemma indicator_mem_Icc {Ω : Type cycleUniverse3} [_contextInstance1 : MeasurableSpace Ω] {X : Ω → ℝ} (hX : ∀ ω, X ω = 0 ∨ X ω = 1) (ω : Ω) :
    X ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Splitting.mgf_indicator
statement:
lemma mgf_indicator {X : Ω → ℝ} (hm : Measurable X)
    (hX : ∀ ω, X ω = 0 ∨ X ω = 1) (p t : ℝ) (hp : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = p) :
    mgf X μ t = 1 + p * (exp t - 1)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Splitting.mgf_indicator_sum_bound
statement:
lemma mgf_indicator_sum_bound {X : I → Ω → ℝ} (s : Finset I)
    (hm : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) (hi : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hX : ∀ i ω, X i ω = 0 ∨ X i ω = 1)
    (p t : ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = p) :
    mgf (∑ i ∈ s, X i) μ t ≤ exp ((s.card : ℝ) * p * (exp t - 1))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Splitting.sum_nonempty_subsets_power
statement:
lemma sum_nonempty_subsets_power (q : ℝ) :
    (∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset V)).erase ∅, q^S.card) =
      (1+q)^(Fintype.card V)-1

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Splitting.tendsto_monomial_exp_neg_power
statement:
lemma tendsto_monomial_exp_neg_power (a b c : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) :
    Tendsto (fun D : ℝ => D^a * exp (-c * D^b)) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Representatives.choose_with_mates
statement:
lemma choose_with_mates (A : Finset I) (mate : I → I)
    (hmate : Function.Involutive mate) (hfix : ∀ i, mate i ≠ i)
    (N : I → Finset V) (k : ℕ)
    (hroom : ∀ i ∈ A, A.card ≤ ((N i).card - 1) * k) :
    ∃ f : I → V, (∀ i ∈ A, f i ∈ N i) ∧
      (∀ i ∈ A, mate i ∈ A → f i ≠ f (mate i)) ∧
      (∀ v, (A.filter (fun i => f i = v)).card ≤ k)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Representatives.reservoir_representatives
statement:
theorem reservoir_representatives (S : Finset I) (N : I → Finset V)
    (r d : ℝ) (hr : (S.card : ℝ) ≤ r) (hd : 4 ≤ d)
    (hN : ∀ i ∈ S, d/2 ≤ ((N i).card : ℝ)) :
    ∃ f : I × Fin 2 → V,
      (∀ i ∈ S, ∀ t, f (i,t) ∈ N i) ∧
      (∀ i ∈ S, f (i,0) ≠ f (i,1)) ∧
      (∀ v, ((S ×ˢ Finset.univ).filter (fun i => f i = v)).card ≤ ⌈8*r/d⌉₊)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Representatives.two_distinct_representatives
statement:
theorem two_distinct_representatives (S : Finset I) (N : I → Finset V) (k : ℕ)
    (hroom : ∀ i ∈ S, 2*S.card ≤ ((N i).card-1)*k) :
    ∃ f : I × Fin 2 → V,
      (∀ i ∈ S, ∀ t, f (i,t) ∈ N i) ∧
      (∀ i ∈ S, f (i,0) ≠ f (i,1)) ∧
      (∀ v, ((S ×ˢ Finset.univ).filter (fun i => f i = v)).card ≤ k)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.reservoir_preparation
statement:
theorem reservoir_preparation (c η : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ D₀ : ℝ, ∀ D : ℝ, D₀ ≤ D → ∀ (V : Type u) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
      (G P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj], P ≤ G →
      D^(9/10 : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card V : ℝ) →
      (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≤ D^(51/50 : ℝ) →
      Splitting.CutExpansion P (c*D^(9/10 : ℝ)) →
      ∃ (ω : Sym2 V → Fin 3) (W : Fin 3 → Finset V) (f : Fin 3 → V × Fin 2 → V),
        (∀ i, Splitting.colorGraph P ω i ≤ G) ∧
        (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (Splitting.colorGraph P ω i).edgeSet
            (Splitting.colorGraph P ω j).edgeSet) ∧
        (∀ i, Splitting.CutExpansion (Splitting.colorGraph P ω i)
          (reservoirExpansionCoefficient c * D^(9/10 : ℝ))) ∧
        (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (W i) (W j)) ∧
        (∀ i, 2 ≤ (W i).card) ∧
        (∀ i, ((W i).card : ℝ) ≤ 2*reservoirProbability η*Fintype.card V) ∧
        (∀ i, (W i).card < Fintype.card V) ∧
        ((∑ i, (W i).card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ η * Fintype.card V ∧
        (∀ i, Sampling.CutExpansionOn (Splitting.colorGraph P ω i) (W i)
          (D^(37/50 : ℝ))) ∧
        (∀ i v, v ∉ W i → ∀ t, f i (v,t) ∈ W i ∧
          (Splitting.colorGraph P ω i).Adj v (f i (v,t))) ∧
        (∀ i v, v ∉ W i → f i (v,0) ≠ f i (v,1)) ∧
        (∀ i w, (((W i)ᶜ ×ˢ Finset.univ).filter (fun x => f i x = w)).card ≤
          ⌈8*(Fintype.card V : ℝ) /
            (reservoirProbability η * (reservoirExpansionCoefficient c * D^(9/10 : ℝ)))⌉₊)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.deleted_boundary_card_le_incidents

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.endpointLoad_insert
statement:
lemma endpointLoad_insert {V : Type} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] [_contextInstance2 : DecidableEq V] {I : Type} [_contextInstance4 : Fintype I] [_contextInstance5 : DecidableEq I] (A : Finset I) (i : I) (hi : i ∉ A) (x y : I → V) (v : V) :
    endpointLoad (insert i A) x y v = endpointLoad A x y v +
      (if v = x i ∨ v = y i then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.endpointLoad_mono
statement:
lemma endpointLoad_mono {V : Type} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] [_contextInstance2 : DecidableEq V] {I : Type} [_contextInstance4 : Fintype I] [_contextInstance5 : DecidableEq I] {A B : Finset I} (hAB : A ⊆ B) (x y : I → V) (v : V) :
    endpointLoad A x y v ≤ endpointLoad B x y v

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.endpointLoad_sum
statement:
lemma endpointLoad_sum {V : Type} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] [_contextInstance2 : DecidableEq V] {I : Type} [_contextInstance4 : Fintype I] [_contextInstance5 : DecidableEq I] (A : Finset I) (x y : I → V) (hxy : ∀ i ∈ A, x i ≠ y i) :
    ∑ v : V, endpointLoad A x y v = 2 * A.card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.exists_short_avoiding_path
statement:
lemma exists_short_avoiding_path (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (hexp : CutExpansion P h) (hr : 2 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (F : Finset (Sym2 V)) (W : Finset V) (s t : V) (hs : s ∉ W) (ht : t ∉ W)
    (hF : ∀ v, ((incidentEdges F v).card : ℝ) ≤ h / 4)
    (hW : (W.card : ℝ) ≤ h / 4) :
    ∃ q : (avoidGraph P F W).Walk s t, q.IsPath ∧
      q.length ≤ 2 * routingG (Fintype.card V) h

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.exists_short_path_with_avoidance
statement:
lemma exists_short_path_with_avoidance (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (hexp : CutExpansion P h) (hr : 2 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (F : Finset (Sym2 V)) (W : Finset V) (s t : V) (hs : s ∉ W) (ht : t ∉ W)
    (hF : ∀ v, ((incidentEdges F v).card : ℝ) ≤ h / 4)
    (hW : (W.card : ℝ) ≤ h / 4) :
    ∃ q : P.Walk s t, q.IsPath ∧ q.length ≤ routingLength (Fintype.card V) h ∧
      Disjoint q.edges.toFinset F ∧ Disjoint q.support.toFinset W

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.rootBallUnion_extract_root
statement:
theorem rootBallUnion_extract_root
    (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (hexp : CutExpansion P h)
    (hr : 0 < (Fintype.card V : ℝ))
    (F : Finset (Sym2 V)) (W : V → Finset V) (g N : ℕ)
    (hFglobal : (F.card : ℝ) ≤ h * (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 16)
    (hg : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 2 < (1 + h / (2 * (Fintype.card V : ℝ))) ^ g) :
    ∀ (A : Finset V) (t : ℕ),
      (∀ s ∈ A, s ∉ W s) →
      (∀ s ∈ A, ((W s).card : ℝ) ≤ h / 4) →
      A.card ≤ 2 ^ N →
      (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 2 < (rootBallUnion P F W A t).card →
      ∃ s ∈ A, (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 2 <
        (walkBall (avoidGraph P F (W s)) s (t + N * g)).card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.rootBallUnion_growth_block
statement:
theorem rootBallUnion_growth_block
    (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hexp : CutExpansion P h)
    (hr : 0 < (Fintype.card V : ℝ))
    (F : Finset (Sym2 V)) (W : V → Finset V) (A : Finset V) (t g : ℕ)
    (hroots : ∀ s ∈ A, s ∉ W s)
    (hW : ∀ s ∈ A, ((W s).card : ℝ) ≤ h / 4)
    (hpos : 1 ≤ (rootBallUnion P F W A t).card)
    (hF : (F.card : ℝ) ≤ h * (rootBallUnion P F W A t).card / 4)
    (hg : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 2 < (1 + h / (2 * (Fintype.card V : ℝ))) ^ g) :
    (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 2 < (rootBallUnion P F W A (t + g)).card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.rootBallUnion_growth_step
statement:
theorem rootBallUnion_growth_step
    (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (h : ℝ) (hexp : CutExpansion P h)
    (hr : 0 < (Fintype.card V : ℝ))
    (F : Finset (Sym2 V)) (W : V → Finset V) (A : Finset V) (t : ℕ)
    (hroots : ∀ s ∈ A, s ∉ W s)
    (hW : ∀ s ∈ A, ((W s).card : ℝ) ≤ h / 4)
    (hsmall : ((rootBallUnion P F W A t).card : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 2)
    (hF : (F.card : ℝ) ≤ h * (rootBallUnion P F W A t).card / 4) :
    (1 + h / (2 * (Fintype.card V : ℝ))) * (rootBallUnion P F W A t).card ≤
      ((rootBallUnion P F W A (t + 1)).card : ℝ)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.rootBallUnion_halve
statement:
lemma rootBallUnion_halve (P : SimpleGraph V) (F : Finset (Sym2 V))
    (W : V → Finset V) (A : Finset V) (t k : ℕ) (u : ℝ)
    (hcard : A.card ≤ 2 * k)
    (hlarge : 2 * u < (rootBallUnion P F W A t).card) :
    ∃ A' ⊆ A, A'.card ≤ k ∧ u < (rootBallUnion P F W A' t).card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.rootBallUnion_mono_time
statement:
lemma rootBallUnion_mono_time (P : SimpleGraph V) (F : Finset (Sym2 V))
    (W : V → Finset V) (A : Finset V) {t u : ℕ} (htu : t ≤ u) :
    rootBallUnion P F W A t ⊆ rootBallUnion P F W A u

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.root_mem_walkBall
statement:
lemma root_mem_walkBall (G : SimpleGraph V) (s : V) (t : ℕ) :

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.roots_subset_rootBallUnion
statement:
lemma roots_subset_rootBallUnion (P : SimpleGraph V) (F : Finset (Sym2 V))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.route_degree_update
statement:
lemma route_degree_update {P : SimpleGraph V} {s t : V} (q : P.Walk s t)
    (hp : q.IsPath) (F : Finset (Sym2 V)) (h : ℝ) (load : V → ℕ)
    (hdegree : ∀ v, ((incidentEdges F v).card : ℝ) ≤ h / 8 + 2 + load v)
    (havoid : Disjoint q.support.toFinset (saturated F h \ {s, t})) (v : V) :
    ((incidentEdges (F ∪ q.edges.toFinset) v).card : ℝ) ≤
      h / 8 + 2 + load v + (if v = s ∨ v = t then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.routing
statement:
theorem routing (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (hexp : CutExpansion P h) (hr : 2 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (x y : I → V) (hxy : ∀ i, x i ≠ y i) (team : I → T) (Z : I → Finset V)
    (k b z : ℝ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (hload : ∀ v, (endpointLoad Finset.univ x y v : ℝ) ≤ k)
    (hteam : ∀ i, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun j => team j = team i)).card : ℝ) ≤ b)
    (hZ : ∀ i, ((Z i).card : ℝ) ≤ z)
    (hbudget : 64 * ((routingLength (Fintype.card V) h : ℝ) ^ 2 * (k + b) + z) ≤ h) :
    ∃ q : ∀ i, P.Walk (x i) (y i),
      (∀ i, (q i).IsPath ∧ (q i).length ≤ routingLength (Fintype.card V) h ∧
        Disjoint (pathInterior (q i)) (Z i)) ∧
      (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (q i).edges.toFinset (q j).edges.toFinset) ∧
      (∀ i j, i ≠ j → team i = team j → Disjoint (pathInterior (q i)) (pathInterior (q j)))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.routingG_growth
statement:
lemma routingG_growth (r h : ℝ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hh : 0 < h) (hhr : h ≤ r) :
    r / 2 < (1 + h / (2 * r)) ^ routingG r h

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.routingLength_bounds
statement:
lemma routingLength_bounds (r h : ℝ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hh : 0 < h) :
    1 ≤ routingLength r h ∧ r ≤ (routingLength r h : ℝ) * h

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.routing_budget
statement:
lemma routing_budget (L k b z h r : ℝ) (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hh : 0 < h) (_hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hreach : r ≤ L * h) (hbudget : 64 * (L ^ 2 * (k + b) + z) ≤ h) :
    h / 8 + 2 + k ≤ h / 4 ∧ z + b * L ≤ h / 8 ∧ 64 * L * k * r ≤ h ^ 2

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.routing_large_root_ball
statement:
theorem routing_large_root_ball
    (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (hexp : CutExpansion P h) (hr : 2 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (F : Finset (Sym2 V)) (W : V → Finset V) (S : Finset V)
    (hne : S.Nonempty)
    (hroots : ∀ s ∈ S, s ∉ W s)
    (hW : ∀ s ∈ S, ((W s).card : ℝ) ≤ h / 4)
    (hFstart : (F.card : ℝ) ≤ h * S.card / 4)
    (hFglobal : (F.card : ℝ) ≤ h * (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 16) :
    ∃ s ∈ S, (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 2 <
      (walkBall (avoidGraph P F (W s)) s
        (routingG (Fintype.card V) h * (1 + routingDepth (Fintype.card V)))).card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.routing_union_growth_step
statement:
theorem routing_union_growth_step
    (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (h : ℝ) (hexp : CutExpansion P h)
    (hr : 0 < (Fintype.card V : ℝ))
    (F : Finset (Sym2 V)) (B Bnext : Finset V)
    (W : V → Finset V)
    (hmono : B ⊆ Bnext)
    (hsmall : (B.card : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 2)
    (hF : (F.card : ℝ) ≤ h * (B.card : ℝ) / 4)
    (hW : ∀ v ∈ B, ((W v).card : ℝ) ≤ h / 4)
    (hextend : ∀ v ∈ B, ∀ w ∉ B, P.Adj v w → s(v, w) ∉ F →
      w ∉ W v → w ∈ Bnext) :
    (1 + h / (2 * (Fintype.card V : ℝ))) * (B.card : ℝ) ≤
      (Bnext.card : ℝ)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.routing_union_growth_step_of_boundary
statement:
theorem routing_union_growth_step_of_boundary
    (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (h : ℝ) (hexp : CutExpansion P h)
    (hr : 0 < (Fintype.card V : ℝ))
    (F : Finset (Sym2 V)) (B Bnext : Finset V)
    (W : V → Finset V)
    (hmono : B ⊆ Bnext)
    (hsmall : (B.card : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 2)
    (hF : (((P.interedges B Bᶜ).filter (fun e => s(e.1, e.2) ∈ F)).card : ℝ) ≤
      h * (B.card : ℝ) / 4)
    (hW : ∀ v ∈ B, ((W v).card : ℝ) ≤ h / 4)
    (hextend : ∀ v ∈ B, ∀ w ∉ B, P.Adj v w → s(v, w) ∉ F →
      w ∉ W v → w ∈ Bnext) :
    (1 + h / (2 * (Fintype.card V : ℝ))) * (B.card : ℝ) ≤
      (Bnext.card : ℝ)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.saturated_card_le
statement:
lemma saturated_card_le (F : Finset (Sym2 V)) (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hF : 128 * (F.card : ℝ) ≤ h ^ 2) : (saturated F h).card ≤ h / 8

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.teamInterior_card_le
statement:
lemma teamInterior_card_le {V : Type} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] [_contextInstance2 : DecidableEq V] {I : Type} {T : Type} [_contextInstance5 : Fintype I] [_contextInstance6 : DecidableEq I] [_contextInstance7 : DecidableEq T] {P : SimpleGraph V} {x : I → V} {y : I → V} (A : Finset I) (q : ∀ j, P.Walk (x j) (y j))
    (team : I → T) (i : I) (L : ℕ) (b : ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ j ∈ A, (q j).length ≤ L)
    (hb : ((Finset.univ.filter (fun j => team j = team i)).card : ℝ) ≤ b) :
    ((teamInterior A q team i).card : ℝ) ≤ b * L

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.two_routingG_le_length
statement: lemma two_routingG_le_length (r h : ℝ) : 2 * routingG r h ≤ routingLength r h

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.usedEdges_card_le
statement:
lemma usedEdges_card_le {V : Type} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] [_contextInstance2 : DecidableEq V] {I : Type} [_contextInstance4 : Fintype I] [_contextInstance5 : DecidableEq I] {P : SimpleGraph V} {x : I → V} {y : I → V} (A : Finset I) (q : ∀ i, P.Walk (x i) (y i)) (L : ℕ)
    (hq : ∀ i ∈ A, (q i).length ≤ L) : (usedEdges A q).card ≤ L * A.card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.usedEdges_update_insert
statement:
lemma usedEdges_update_insert {V : Type} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] [_contextInstance2 : DecidableEq V] {I : Type} [_contextInstance4 : Fintype I] [_contextInstance5 : DecidableEq I] {P : SimpleGraph V} {x : I → V} {y : I → V} (A : Finset I) (i : I) (hi : i ∉ A)
    (q : ∀ j, P.Walk (x j) (y j)) (p : P.Walk (x i) (y i)) :
    usedEdges (insert i A) (Function.update q i p) = usedEdges A q ∪ p.edges.toFinset

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.walkBall_growth_of_incidents
statement:
lemma walkBall_growth_of_incidents (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (h : ℝ) (hexp : CutExpansion P h) (hr : 0 < (Fintype.card V : ℝ))
    (F : Finset (Sym2 V)) (W : Finset V) (s : V) (hs : s ∉ W)
    (hF : ∀ v, ((incidentEdges F v).card : ℝ) ≤ h / 4)
    (hW : (W.card : ℝ) ≤ h / 4) (t : ℕ)
    (hsmall : ((walkBall (avoidGraph P F W) s t).card : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 2) :
    (1 + h / (2 * (Fintype.card V : ℝ))) * (walkBall (avoidGraph P F W) s t).card ≤
      ((walkBall (avoidGraph P F W) s (t + 1)).card : ℝ)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.walkBall_large_of_incidents
statement:
lemma walkBall_large_of_incidents (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (hexp : CutExpansion P h) (hr : 2 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (F : Finset (Sym2 V)) (W : Finset V) (s : V) (hs : s ∉ W)
    (hF : ∀ v, ((incidentEdges F v).card : ℝ) ≤ h / 4)
    (hW : (W.card : ℝ) ≤ h / 4) :
    (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 2 <
      (walkBall (avoidGraph P F W) s (routingG (Fintype.card V) h)).card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.walkBall_mono

lemma walkBall_mono (G : SimpleGraph V) (s : V) {t u : ℕ} (htu : t ≤ u) :

statement:
lemma walkBall_step (G : SimpleGraph V) (s v w : V) (t : ℕ)

    {x y a b : I → V} (Q : ∀ i, G.Walk (x i) (y i))
    (P : ∀ i, G.Walk (a i) (b i))
    (hx : ∀ i, G.Adj (x i) (a i)) (hy : ∀ i, G.Adj (y i) (b i))
    (hQ : ∀ i, (Q i).IsPath) (hQpos : ∀ i, 0 < (Q i).length)
    (hP : ∀ i, (P i).IsPath)
    (hsep : ∀ i, (Q i).support.Disjoint (P i).support)
    (hQQ : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (Q i).edgeSet (Q j).edgeSet)
    (hPP : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (P i).edgeSet (P j).edgeSet)
    (hspoke : Function.Injective (fun z : I × Fin 2 =>
      if z.2 = 0 then s(x z.1,a z.1) else s(y z.1,b z.1)))
    (hQP : ∀ i j, Disjoint (Q i).edgeSet (P j).edgeSet)
    (hQS : ∀ i j, Disjoint (Q i).edgeSet {s(x j,a j),s(y j,b j)})
    (hPS : ∀ i j, Disjoint (P i).edgeSet {s(x j,a j),s(y j,b j)}) :
    let C := fun i => (Q i).append (reservoirReturn (P i) (hx i) (hy i))
    (∀ i, (C i).IsCycle) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (C i).edgeSet (C j).edgeSet) ∧
    (⋃ i, (C i).edgeSet) =
      (⋃ i, (Q i).edgeSet) ∪ (⋃ i, (P i).edgeSet) ∪
        (⋃ i, ({s(x i,a i),s(y i,b i)} : Set (Sym2 V)))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.reservoir_edge_ledger
statement:
lemma reservoir_edge_ledger {E : Type cycleUniverse18} {I : Type cycleUniverse19} (G O R : Set E)
    (A B S C : I → Set E)
    (hcover : (⋃ i, A i) ∪ O ∪ R = G)
    (hAO : Disjoint (⋃ i, A i) O) (hAR : Disjoint (⋃ i, A i) R)
    (hOR : Disjoint O R)
    (hB : (⋃ i, B i) ⊆ R) (hS : (⋃ i, S i) ⊆ O)
    (hC : (⋃ i, C i) = (⋃ i, A i) ∪ (⋃ i, B i) ∪ (⋃ i, S i)) :
    let unusedSpokes := O \ (⋃ i, S i)
    let remaining := R \ (⋃ i, B i)
    Disjoint (⋃ i, C i) unusedSpokes ∧
    Disjoint (⋃ i, C i) remaining ∧
    Disjoint unusedSpokes remaining ∧
    (⋃ i, C i) ∪ unusedSpokes ∪ remaining = G

          ∀ v ∈ (q i).support, v ∈ W) ∧
        Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (q i).edgeSet (q j).edgeSet) ∧
        (∀ i, ∃ t, a i = r (x i,t)) ∧ (∀ i, ∃ t, b i = r (y i,t)) ∧

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.reservoir_reservations
statement:
theorem reservoir_reservations {V : Type cycleUniverse19} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (P : Fin 3 → SimpleGraph V) (W : Fin 3 → Finset V)
    (r : Fin 3 → V × Fin 2 → V)
    (hPG : ∀ i, P i ≤ G)
    (hPP : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (P i).edgeSet (P j).edgeSet)
    (hr : ∀ i v, v ∉ W i → ∀ t, (P i).Adj v (r i (v,t))) :
    let R := fun i => reservoirInternal (P i) (W i)
    let O := fun i => (reservoirSpokes (W i) (r i) : Set (Sym2 V))
    (∀ i, R i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ O i ⊆ G.edgeSet) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (R i ∪ O i) (R j ∪ O j)) ∧
    (∀ i, Disjoint (R i) (O i)) ∧
    Disjoint (⋃ i, R i) (⋃ i, O i) ∧
    (∑ i, (reservoirSpokes (W i) (r i)).card) ≤ 6 * Fintype.card V

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.residual_induce_exact
statement:
theorem residual_induce_exact {V : Type cycleUniverse41} {B : Type cycleUniverse42} {I : Type cycleUniverse43} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (R : B → Set (Sym2 V)) (C : I → Set (Sym2 V)) (b : B) (W : Set V)
    (hR : R b ⊆ G.edgeSet) (hinside : ∀ e ∈ R b, ∀ v ∈ e, v ∈ W) :
    Sym2.map Subtype.val '' ((residualInternalGraph G R C b).induce W).edgeSet =
      R b \ completedEdges C

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.residue_edge_ledger
statement:
theorem residue_edge_ledger {V : Type cycleUniverse35} {B : Type cycleUniverse36} {I : Type cycleUniverse37} [Fintype V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (R : B → Set (Sym2 V)) (S : Set (Sym2 V))
    (C : I → Set (Sym2 V))
    (hR : ∀ b, R b ⊆ G.edgeSet) (hS : S ⊆ G.edgeSet)
    (hRR : Pairwise fun b c => Disjoint (R b) (R c))
    (hRS : ∀ b, Disjoint (R b) S)
    (hC : ∀ i, C i ⊆ G.edgeSet)
    (_hCC : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (C i) (C j))
    (hcover : G.edgeSet \ ((⋃ b, R b) ∪ S) ⊆ completedEdges C) :
    (∀ b, (residualInternalGraph G R C b).edgeSet = R b \ completedEdges C) ∧
    Pairwise (fun b c => Disjoint (residualInternalGraph G R C b).edgeSet
      (residualInternalGraph G R C c).edgeSet) ∧
    (∀ b i, Disjoint (residualInternalGraph G R C b).edgeSet (C i)) ∧
    (∀ b, Disjoint (residualInternalGraph G R C b).edgeSet (↑(unusedSpokes S C) : Set _)) ∧
    (∀ i, Disjoint (C i) (↑(unusedSpokes S C) : Set _)) ∧
    (completedEdges C ∪ (↑(unusedSpokes S C) : Set _) ∪
      (⋃ b, (residualInternalGraph G R C b).edgeSet)) = G.edgeSet

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.residue_part_count
statement:
theorem residue_part_count {V : Type cycleUniverse38} {I : Type cycleUniverse39} [Fintype V] [Fintype I]
    (S : Finset (Sym2 V)) (C : I → Set (Sym2 V))
    (hI : Fintype.card I ≤ 3 * Fintype.card V)
    (hS : S.card ≤ 6 * Fintype.card V) :
    Fintype.card I + (unusedSpokes (↑S) C).card ≤ 9 * Fintype.card V

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.sigma_three_card_le
statement:
lemma sigma_three_card_le {V : Type} [Fintype V]
    (I : Fin 3 → Type) [∀ b, Fintype (I b)]
    (hI : ∀ b, Fintype.card (I b) ≤ Fintype.card V) :
    Fintype.card (Sigma I) ≤ 3 * Fintype.card V

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.three_reservoir_remainder
statement:
theorem three_reservoir_remainder {V : Type cycleUniverse53} {I : Type cycleUniverse54} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype I]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (P : Fin 3 → SimpleGraph V)
    (W : Fin 3 → Finset V) (r : Fin 3 → V × Fin 2 → V)
    (hPG : ∀ b, P b ≤ G)
    (hPP : Pairwise fun b d => Disjoint (P b).edgeSet (P d).edgeSet)
    (hr : ∀ b v, v ∉ W b → ∀ t, (P b).Adj v (r b (v,t)))
    (C : I → Set (Sym2 V)) (hC : ∀ i, C i ⊆ G.edgeSet)
    (hCC : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (C i) (C j))
    (hI : Fintype.card I ≤ 3 * Fintype.card V)
    (hcover : G.edgeSet \ ((⋃ b, reservoirInternal (P b) (W b)) ∪
      (allReservoirSpokes W r : Set _)) ⊆ completedEdges C) :
    let R := fun b => reservoirInternal (P b) (W b)
    let H := residualInternalGraph G R C
    let S := unusedSpokes (↑(allReservoirSpokes W r)) C
    (∀ b, (H b).support ⊆ (W b : Set V)) ∧
    (∀ b, Sym2.map Subtype.val '' ((H b).induce (W b : Set V)).edgeSet = (H b).edgeSet) ∧
    (∀ b, (H b).edgeSet = R b \ completedEdges C) ∧
    Pairwise (fun b d => Disjoint (H b).edgeSet (H d).edgeSet) ∧
    (∀ b i, Disjoint (H b).edgeSet (C i)) ∧
    (∀ b, Disjoint (H b).edgeSet (S : Set _)) ∧
    (∀ i, Disjoint (C i) (S : Set _)) ∧
    (completedEdges C ∪ (S : Set _) ∪ (⋃ b, (H b).edgeSet)) = G.edgeSet ∧
    Fintype.card I + S.card ≤ 9 * Fintype.card V

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.uniform_reservoir_completion
statement:
theorem uniform_reservoir_completion (c p : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hp : 0 < p) :
    ∃ D₀ : ℝ, 1 < D₀ ∧ ∀ D ≥ D₀,
      ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V],
      ∀ (G P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj], P ≤ G →
      ∀ W : Finset V, CutExpansionOn P W (D^(37/50:ℝ)) → 2 ≤ W.card →
      (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≤ D^(51/50:ℝ) →
      ∀ (I : Type) [Fintype I] (x y : I → V) (Q : ∀ i, G.Walk (x i) (y i)),
      (∀ i, (Q i).IsPath) → (∀ i, 0 < (Q i).length) →
      (∀ i v, v ∈ (Q i).support → v ∉ W) →
      Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (Q i).edgeSet (Q j).edgeSet) →
      (∀ v, endpointLoad univ x y v ≤ 2) →
      ∀ r : V × Fin 2 → V,
      (∀ v, v ∉ W → ∀ t, r (v,t) ∈ W ∧ P.Adj v (r (v,t))) →
      (∀ v, v ∉ W → r (v,0) ≠ r (v,1)) →
      (∀ v, ((Wᶜ ×ˢ univ).filter (fun z => r z = v)).card ≤
        ⌈8*(Fintype.card V:ℝ)/(p*(c*D^(9/10:ℝ)))⌉₊) →
      ∃ (a b : I → V) (q : ∀ i, G.Walk (a i) (b i))
        (C : ∀ i, G.Walk (x i) (x i)),
        (∀ i, (C i).IsCycle) ∧
        Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (C i).edgeSet (C j).edgeSet) ∧
        (∀ i, (C i).edgeSet = (Q i).edgeSet ∪ (q i).edgeSet ∪
          {s(x i,a i),s(y i,b i)}) ∧
        (∀ i, (q i).edgeSet ⊆ P.edgeSet ∧ ∀ v ∈ (q i).support, v ∈ W) ∧
        Function.Injective (fun z : I × Fin 2 =>
          if z.2 = 0 then s(x z.1,a z.1) else s(y z.1,b z.1)) ∧
        (∀ i, ∃ t, a i = r (x i,t)) ∧ (∀ i, ∃ t, b i = r (y i,t))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.uniform_three_reservoir_completion
statement:
theorem uniform_three_reservoir_completion (c p : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hp : 0 < p) :
    ∃ D₀ : ℝ, 1 < D₀ ∧ ∀ D ≥ D₀,
      ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V],
      ∀ (G : SimpleGraph V) (P K : Fin 3 → SimpleGraph V)
        [∀ b, DecidableRel (P b).Adj],
      (∀ b, P b ≤ G) →
      Pairwise (fun b d => Disjoint (P b).edgeSet (P d).edgeSet) →
      ∀ (W : Fin 3 → Finset V) (r : Fin 3 → V × Fin 2 → V),
      (∀ b, CutExpansionOn (P b) (W b) (D^(37/50:ℝ))) →
      (∀ b, 2 ≤ (W b).card) → (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≤ D^(51/50:ℝ) →
      (∀ b v, v ∉ W b → ∀ t, r b (v,t) ∈ W b ∧ (P b).Adj v (r b (v,t))) →
      (∀ b v, v ∉ W b → r b (v,0) ≠ r b (v,1)) →
      (∀ b v, (((W b)ᶜ ×ˢ univ).filter (fun z => r b z = v)).card ≤
        ⌈8*(Fintype.card V:ℝ)/(p*(c*D^(9/10:ℝ)))⌉₊) →
      let T := fun b => reservoirInternal (P b) (W b) ∪
        (reservoirSpokes (W b) (r b) : Set (Sym2 V))
      Pairwise (fun b d => Disjoint (K b).edgeSet (K d).edgeSet) →
      (∀ b d, Disjoint (K b).edgeSet (T d)) →
      ∀ (I : Fin 3 → Type) [∀ b, Fintype (I b)]
        (x y : ∀ b, I b → V) (Q : ∀ b i, G.Walk (x b i) (y b i)),
      (∀ b i, (Q b i).IsPath) → (∀ b i, 0 < (Q b i).length) →
      (∀ b i v, v ∈ (Q b i).support → v ∉ W b) →
      (∀ b, Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (Q b i).edgeSet (Q b j).edgeSet) →
      (∀ b, (⋃ i, (Q b i).edgeSet) = (K b).edgeSet) →
      (∀ b v, endpointLoad univ (x b) (y b) v ≤ 2) →
      ∃ C : ∀ b i, G.Walk (x b i) (x b i),
        (∀ b i, (C b i).IsCycle) ∧
        Pairwise (fun s t : Sigma I =>
          Disjoint (C s.1 s.2).edgeSet (C t.1 t.2).edgeSet) ∧
        (∀ b i, (C b i).edgeSet ⊆ (K b).edgeSet ∪ T b) ∧
        (⋃ b, (K b).edgeSet) ⊆ (⋃ s : Sigma I, (C s.1 s.2).edgeSet) ∧
        Fintype.card (Sigma I) ≤ 3 * Fintype.card V

    (K : I → Centered G x) (S : Set V)
    (hS : ∀ v ∈ S, G.Adj x v)
    (hold : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (K i).piece.walk.edgeSet (K j).piece.walk.edgeSet)
    (hfresh : Disjoint {e | ∃ v ∈ S, e = s(x,v)} (⋃ i, (K i).piece.walk.edgeSet))
    (selected : Set (Σ i, (K i).Port))
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (fun z : Σ i, (K i).Port => (K z.1).endpoint z.2) selected)
    (hcov : ∀ v, G.Adj x v → ∃ z ∈ selected, (K z.1).endpoint z.2 = v) :
    ∃ Q : I → Piece G,
      (Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (Q i).walk.edgeSet (Q j).walk.edgeSet) ∧
      (⋃ i, (Q i).walk.edgeSet) =
        (⋃ i, (K i).piece.walk.edgeSet) ∪ {e | ∃ v ∈ S, e = s(x,v)}

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Lovasz.rewire_partition
statement:
theorem rewire_partition {E : Type cycleUniverse19} {I : Type cycleUniverse20} (old remove add : I → Set E) (fresh : Set E)
    (hsub : ∀ i, remove i ⊆ old i)
    (hold : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (old i) (old j))
    (hadd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (add i) (add j))
    (hfresh : Disjoint fresh (⋃ i, old i))
    (hbalance : (⋃ i, add i) = (⋃ i, remove i) ∪ fresh) :
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint ((old i \ remove i) ∪ add i)
      ((old j \ remove j) ∪ add j)) ∧
    (⋃ i, ((old i \ remove i) ∪ add i)) = (⋃ i, old i) ∪ fresh

theorem delete_vertex_boundary_edges {V : Type cycleUniverse25} [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b v : V} (p : G.Walk a b) (hv : v ∈ p.support) :
    (0 < (p.takeUntil v hv).dropLast.length →
      s((p.takeUntil v hv).penultimate, v) ∈ p.edgeSet) ∧
    (0 < (p.dropUntil v hv).tail.length →
      s(v, (p.dropUntil v hv).snd) ∈ p.edgeSet)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.delete_vertex_from_path
statement:
theorem delete_vertex_from_path {V : Type cycleUniverse24} [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {a b v : V} (p : G.Walk a b) (hp : p.IsPath) (hv : v ∈ p.support) :
    let q := (p.takeUntil v hv).dropLast
    let r := (p.dropUntil v hv).tail
    q.IsPath ∧ r.IsPath ∧ Disjoint q.edgeSet r.edgeSet ∧
    q.edgeSet ∪ r.edgeSet = {e | e ∈ p.edgeSet ∧ v ∉ e} ∧
    (0 < q.length → v ∉ q.support) ∧
    (0 < r.length → v ∉ r.support) ∧
    (0 < q.length → G.Adj (p.takeUntil v hv).penultimate v) ∧
    (0 < r.length → G.Adj v (p.dropUntil v hv).snd)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.delete_vertex_new_endpoint_load
statement:
theorem delete_vertex_new_endpoint_load {V : Type cycleUniverse27} {I : Type cycleUniverse28} [DecidableEq V] [Fintype I]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b : I → V} {v : V}
    (p : ∀ i, G.Walk (a i) (b i)) (hp : ∀ i, (p i).IsPath)
    (hv : ∀ i, v ∈ (p i).support)
    (hd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (p i).edgeSet (p j).edgeSet) (x : V) :
    let live := fun z : I × Bool => if z.2 then
      0 < ((p z.1).takeUntil v (hv z.1)).dropLast.length else
      0 < ((p z.1).dropUntil v (hv z.1)).tail.length
    let newEnd := fun z : I × Bool => if z.2 then
      ((p z.1).takeUntil v (hv z.1)).penultimate else
      ((p z.1).dropUntil v (hv z.1)).snd
    (Finset.univ.filter fun z => live z ∧ newEnd z = x).card ≤ 1

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.Lovasz.rewire_partition

theorem rewire_partition {E : Type cycleUniverse19} {I : Type cycleUniverse20} (old remove add : I → Set E) (fresh : Set E)
    (hsub : ∀ i, remove i ⊆ old i)
    (hold : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (old i) (old j))
    (hadd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (add i) (add j))
    (hfresh : Disjoint fresh (⋃ i, old i))
    (hbalance : (⋃ i, add i) = (⋃ i, remove i) ∪ fresh) :
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint ((old i \ remove i) ∪ add i)
      ((old j \ remove j) ∪ add j)) ∧
    (⋃ i, ((old i \ remove i) ∪ add i)) = (⋃ i, old i) ∪ fresh

    (hd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (P i).walk.edgeSet (P j).walk.edgeSet)
    (hc : (⋃ i, (P i).walk.edgeSet) = (subdivision G x y).edgeSet)
    (hp : ∀ i, (P i).start ≠ (P i).finish ∧ (P i).start ≠ none ∧ (P i).finish ≠ none) :
    ∃ Q : I → Piece G,

statement:
theorem delete_vertex_boundary_edges {V : Type cycleUniverse25} [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b v : V} (p : G.Walk a b) (hv : v ∈ p.support) :
    (0 < (p.takeUntil v hv).dropLast.length →
      s((p.takeUntil v hv).penultimate, v) ∈ p.edgeSet) ∧
    (0 < (p.dropUntil v hv).tail.length →
      s(v, (p.dropUntil v hv).snd) ∈ p.edgeSet)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.delete_vertex_from_path
statement:
theorem delete_vertex_from_path {V : Type cycleUniverse24} [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {a b v : V} (p : G.Walk a b) (hp : p.IsPath) (hv : v ∈ p.support) :
    let q := (p.takeUntil v hv).dropLast
    let r := (p.dropUntil v hv).tail
    q.IsPath ∧ r.IsPath ∧ Disjoint q.edgeSet r.edgeSet ∧
    q.edgeSet ∪ r.edgeSet = {e | e ∈ p.edgeSet ∧ v ∉ e} ∧
    (0 < q.length → v ∉ q.support) ∧
    (0 < r.length → v ∉ r.support) ∧
    (0 < q.length → G.Adj (p.takeUntil v hv).penultimate v) ∧
    (0 < r.length → G.Adj v (p.dropUntil v hv).snd)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.delete_vertex_new_endpoint_load
statement:
theorem delete_vertex_new_endpoint_load {V : Type cycleUniverse27} {I : Type cycleUniverse28} [DecidableEq V] [Fintype I]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b : I → V} {v : V}
    (p : ∀ i, G.Walk (a i) (b i)) (hp : ∀ i, (p i).IsPath)
    (hv : ∀ i, v ∈ (p i).support)
    (hd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (p i).edgeSet (p j).edgeSet) (x : V) :
    let live := fun z : I × Bool => if z.2 then
      0 < ((p z.1).takeUntil v (hv z.1)).dropLast.length else
      0 < ((p z.1).dropUntil v (hv z.1)).tail.length
    let newEnd := fun z : I × Bool => if z.2 then
      ((p z.1).takeUntil v (hv z.1)).penultimate else
      ((p z.1).dropUntil v (hv z.1)).snd
    (Finset.univ.filter fun z => live z ∧ newEnd z = x).card ≤ 1

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.finiteAverage_mono

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.finiteAverage_mul_const

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.finiteAverage_or_le

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.finiteAverage_pi_eval

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.four_endpoint_collision

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.paired_event_local

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.paired_two_bound

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.pairing_patterns_cross
statement:
lemma pairing_patterns_cross {I : Type cycleUniverse37} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    {V : I → Type cycleUniverse63} [∀ i, Fintype (V i)] (i j : I) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (a c : V i) (hac : a ≠ c) (b d : V j) (hbd : b ≠ d) :
    finiteAverage (fun p : ∀ k, PairingSpace (V k) =>

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.pairing_patterns_cross_bound

lemma pairing_patterns_cross_bound {I : Type cycleUniverse38} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

    (a c : V i) (hac : a ≠ c) (b d : V j) (hbd : b ≠ d) :
    finiteAverage (fun p : ∀ k, PairingSpace (V k) =>
      if paired (p i) a c ∧ paired (p j) b d then 1 else 0) ≤

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.cross_collision_average

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.distinct_edge_cases

lemma distinct_edge_cases (G : SimpleGraph V) {e f : Sym2 V}
    (he : e ∈ G.edgeFinset) (hf : f ∈ G.edgeFinset) (hef : e ≠ f) :
    (∃ v u w, v ≠ u ∧ v ≠ w ∧ u ≠ w ∧ e = s(v,u) ∧ f = s(v,w)) ∨
    (∃ u v x y, u ≠ v ∧ x ≠ y ∧ u ≠ x ∧ u ≠ y ∧ v ≠ x ∧ v ≠ y ∧
      e = s(u,v) ∧ f = s(x,y))

lemma familyPaired_local {V : Type cycleUniverse26} {I : Type cycleUniverse27} [_contextInstance2 : Fintype V] [_contextInstance3 : Fintype I] (X : I → Finset V) (hd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (X i) (X j)) (p : ∀ i, PairingSpace (X i)) (i : I)

    (h : familyPaired X p u v) : familyPaired X p v u

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.finiteAverage_filter_card
statement:
lemma finiteAverage_filter_card {Ω : Type cycleUniverse30} {A : Type cycleUniverse31} [Fintype Ω]
    (s : Finset A) (P : Ω → A → Prop) :
    finiteAverage (fun ω => ((s.filter (P ω)).card : ℝ)) =
      ∑ a ∈ s, finiteAverage (fun ω => if P ω a then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.incidence_bound

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.internalGraph_degree
statement:
lemma internalGraph_degree (X : Finset V) (v : V) :
    (internalGraph G X).degree v = if v ∈ X then neighborsIn G X v else 0

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.internalGraph_degree_sum
statement:
lemma internalGraph_degree_sum (X : Finset V) :

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.internal_collision_average
statement:
lemma internal_collision_average (i : I) (hm : 4 ≤ (X i).card)
    (u v x y : X i) (huv : u ≠ v) (hux : u ≠ x) (huy : u ≠ y)
    (hvx : v ≠ x) (hvy : v ≠ y) (hxy : x ≠ y) :

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.internal_edge_bound
statement:
lemma internal_edge_bound (X : Finset V) (a : ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ x ∈ X, (G.degree x : ℝ) ≤ a) :

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.mem_collisionPairs
statement:
lemma mem_collisionPairs {α : Type cycleUniverse8} {β : Type cycleUniverse9} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (f : α → β) (s : Finset α) (p : Finset α) :
    p ∈ CollisionPairs f s ↔ p ⊆ s ∧ p.card = 2 ∧ (p.image f).card = 1

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.mem_internalGraph

lemma mem_internalGraph {G : SimpleGraph V} {S : Finset V} {u v : V} :
    s(u,v) ∈ (internalGraph G S).edgeFinset ↔ G.Adj u v ∧ u ∈ S ∧ v ∈ S

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.neighborsIn_eq_sum

lemma neighborsIn_eq_sum {V : Type cycleUniverse2} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (X : Finset V) (v : V) :
    neighborsIn G X v = ∑ x ∈ X, if G.Adj v x then 1 else 0

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.neighborsIn_le_degree
statement:
lemma neighborsIn_le_degree (X : Finset V) (v : V) :
    neighborsIn G X v ≤ G.degree v

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.pair_mem_collisionPairs
statement:
lemma pair_mem_collisionPairs {α : Type cycleUniverse12} {β : Type cycleUniverse13} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (f : α → β) (s : Finset α)
    {a b : α} (ha : a ∈ s) (hb : b ∈ s) (hne : a ≠ b) (heq : f a = f b) :
    {a,b} ∈ CollisionPairs f s

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.prune_bad_images
statement:
theorem prune_bad_images {α : Type cycleUniverse16} {β : Type cycleUniverse17} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (f : α → β) (s : Finset α) (bad : β → Prop) [DecidablePred bad] :
    ∃ t ⊆ s, (∀ x ∈ t, ¬ bad (f x)) ∧ Set.InjOn f (t : Set α) ∧
      t.image f = (s.filter (fun x => ¬bad (f x))).image f ∧
      s.card-t.card ≤ (s.filter (fun x => bad (f x))).card +
        (CollisionPairs f (s.filter (fun x => ¬bad (f x)))).card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.prune_collisions
statement:
theorem prune_collisions {α : Type cycleUniverse14} {β : Type cycleUniverse15} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (f : α → β) (s : Finset α) :
    ∃ t ⊆ s, Set.InjOn f (t : Set α) ∧ t.image f = s.image f ∧
      s.card - t.card ≤ (CollisionPairs f s).card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.simple_quotient_representatives
statement:
theorem simple_quotient_representatives {V : Type cycleUniverse20} {W : Type cycleUniverse21} [Fintype V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (projMap : V → W) :
    ∃ (retained : Finset (Sym2 V)) (Q : SimpleGraph W),
      retained ⊆ G.edgeFinset ∧
      (G.edgeFinset \ retained).card ≤ quotientDefect G projMap ∧
      Q.edgeSet = ((retained.image (Sym2.map projMap) : Finset (Sym2 W)) : Set (Sym2 W)) ∧
      (∀ e ∈ Q.edgeSet, ∃! f, f ∈ retained ∧ Sym2.map projMap f = e)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.sum_incidence_to_set
statement:
lemma sum_incidence_to_set (X : Finset V) :
    ∑ v, neighborsIn G X v = ∑ x ∈ X, G.degree x

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.vertexPairEvent_average
statement:
lemma vertexPairEvent_average (i : I) (s : Finset V)
    (hs : s ⊆ X i) (hc : s.card = 2) (hm : 2 ≤ (X i).card) :
    finiteAverage (fun p : ∀ j, PairingSpace (X j) =>
      if vertexPairEvent X p s then 1 else 0) ≤ 1 / ((X i).card-1:ℝ)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.vertexPairEvent_pair
statement:
lemma vertexPairEvent_pair (p : ∀ i, PairingSpace (X i)) (u v : V) (huv : u ≠ v) :

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.wedgeErrors_average
statement:
lemma wedgeErrors_average (G : SimpleGraph V) (i : I) (v : V)
    (hm : 2 ≤ (X i).card) :
    finiteAverage (fun p : ∀ j, PairingSpace (X j) => ((wedgeErrors X G p i v).card : ℝ)) ≤
      ((neighborsIn G (X i) v).choose 2 : ℝ) / ((X i).card-1:ℝ)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.wedge_count_bound
statement:
lemma wedge_count_bound (X : Finset V) (a : ℝ) (ha : 1 ≤ a)
    (hdegree : ∀ x ∈ X, (G.degree x : ℝ) ≤ a)
    (hneighbor : ∀ v, (neighborsIn G X v : ℝ) ≤ a) :
    ((∑ v, (neighborsIn G X v).choose 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      a*(a-1)*X.card/2

OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.all_collisions_covered
statement:
lemma all_collisions_covered (G : SimpleGraph V) (p : ∀ i, PairingSpace (X i)) :
    CollisionPairs (Sym2.map (familyProject X hd p)) G.edgeFinset ⊆

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.all_loops_covered

    G.edgeFinset.filter (fun e => (Sym2.map (familyProject X hd p) e).IsDiag) ⊆

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.alternating_endpoint_mem
statement:
lemma alternating_endpoint_mem {V : Type cycleUniverse22} {G : SimpleGraph V} (X H : Set V)
    (hbi : ∀ {u v}, G.Adj u v → (u ∈ X ∧ v ∈ H) ∨ (u ∈ H ∧ v ∈ X))
    {a b : V} (p : G.Walk a b) (hp : 0 < p.length) :
    (a ∈ X ∨ a ∈ H) ∧ (b ∈ X ∨ b ∈ H)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.alternating_penultimate_mem
statement:
lemma alternating_penultimate_mem {V : Type cycleUniverse24} {G : SimpleGraph V} (X H : Set V)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.alternating_snd_mem

lemma alternating_snd_mem {V : Type cycleUniverse23} {G : SimpleGraph V} (X H : Set V)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.bipartite_path_length
statement:
lemma bipartite_path_length {V : Type cycleUniverse26} {G : SimpleGraph V} (X H : Set V)
