name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.choose_two_real_bound
statement: lemma choose_two_real_bound (n : ℕ) : (n.choose 2 : ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ)^2/2

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.close_trimmed_path
statement:
theorem close_trimmed_path {V : Type cycleUniverse29} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b : V}
    (p : G.Walk a b) (q : G.Walk b a) (hp : p.IsPath) (hq : q.IsPath)
    (hlen : 2 ≤ p.length)
    (havoid : ∀ v ∈ q.support, v ≠ a → v ≠ b → v ∉ p.support) :
    (p.append q).IsCycle ∧ (p.append q).edgeSet = p.edgeSet ∪ q.edgeSet

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.crossGraph_card
statement:
lemma crossGraph_card (G : SimpleGraph V) (S T : Finset V) (hst : Disjoint S T) :
    (crossGraph G S T).edgeFinset.card = betweenCount G S T

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.cross_error_numeric
statement:
lemma cross_error_numeric (m n : ℝ) (e : ℕ) (hm : 8 ≤ m) (hn : 8 ≤ n) :
    (e.choose 2 : ℝ)*(1/((m-1)*(n-1))) ≤ (32/49)*((e:ℝ)^2/(m*n))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.cross_errors_average
statement:
lemma cross_errors_average (G : SimpleGraph V) (i : I) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hm : ∀ i, 8 ≤ (X i).card)
    (hdegree : ∀ i x, x ∈ X i → (G.degree x : ℝ) ≤ a) :
    finiteAverage (fun p : ∀ k, PairingSpace (X k) =>
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, ((pairErrors X hd (crossGraph G (X i) (X j)) p).card : ℝ)) ≤
      (32/49)*a^2

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.cross_pairErrors_average
statement:
lemma cross_pairErrors_average (G : SimpleGraph V) (i j : I) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hi : 2 ≤ (X i).card) (hj : 2 ≤ (X j).card) :
    finiteAverage (fun p : ∀ k, PairingSpace (X k) =>
      ((pairErrors X hd (crossGraph G (X i) (X j)) p).card : ℝ)) ≤
      ((betweenCount G (X i) (X j)).choose 2 : ℝ) *
        (1 / (((X i).card-1:ℝ)*((X j).card-1:ℝ)))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.cross_pair_orientation
statement:
lemma cross_pair_orientation {V : Type cycleUniverse3} {I : Type cycleUniverse4} [_contextInstance2 : Fintype V] [_contextInstance3 : Fintype I] (X : I → Finset V) (G : SimpleGraph V) (i j : I)
    (q : Finset (Sym2 V)) (hq : q ⊆ (crossGraph G (X i) (X j)).edgeFinset)
    (hdis : DisjointEdgePair q) :
    ∃ (u x : X i) (v y : X j), u ≠ x ∧ v ≠ y ∧ q = {s((u:V),(v:V)),s((x:V),(y:V))}

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.edgePairEvent_pair
statement:
lemma edgePairEvent_pair (p : ∀ i, PairingSpace (X i)) (e f : Sym2 V) :

      Sym2.map (familyProject X hd p) e = Sym2.map (familyProject X hd p) f

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.endpoint_path_count_on
statement:
lemma endpoint_path_count_on {V : Type cycleUniverse30} {I : Type cycleUniverse31} [Fintype V] [Fintype I]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} (P : I → PositiveSimplePath G) (S : Finset V)
    (hends : ∀ i, (P i).start ∈ S ∧ (P i).finish ∈ S)
    (hload : ∀ v, (univ.filter (fun i => (P i).start = v ∨ (P i).finish = v)).card ≤ 2) :

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.first_error_numeric
statement:
lemma first_error_numeric (m a e : ℝ) (hm : 8 ≤ m) (he : 2*e ≤ a*m) :
    e/(m-1) + (a*(a-1)*m/2)/(m-1) ≤ (4/7)*a^2

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.first_errors_average
statement:
lemma first_errors_average (G : SimpleGraph V) (i : I) (a : ℝ) (ha : 1 ≤ a)
    (hm : 8 ≤ (X i).card)
    (hdegree : ∀ x ∈ X i, (G.degree x : ℝ) ≤ a)
    (hneighbor : ∀ v, (neighborsIn G (X i) v : ℝ) ≤ a) :
    finiteAverage (fun p : ∀ j, PairingSpace (X j) =>
      ((loopErrors X hd G p i).card : ℝ) + ∑ v, ((wedgeErrors X G p i v).card:ℝ)) ≤
      (4/7)*a^2

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.fold_ratio_one

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.fold_ratio_three

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.folded_order_saving
statement:
lemma folded_order_saving {V : Type cycleUniverse33} {I : Type cycleUniverse34} [Fintype V] [Fintype I]
    (X : I → Finset V) (hd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (X i) (X j))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.folding_average_bound
statement:
theorem folding_average_bound (G : SimpleGraph V) (X : I → Finset V)
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (X i) (X j))) (a : ℝ) (ha : 1 ≤ a)
    (hm : ∀ i, 8 ≤ (X i).card) (hma : ∀ i, a^2 ≤ (X i).card)
    (hdegree : ∀ i x, x ∈ X i → (G.degree x : ℝ) ≤ a)
    (hneighbor : ∀ i v, (neighborsIn G (X i) v : ℝ) ≤ a) :
    finiteAverage (fun p : ∀ i, PairingSpace (X i) =>
      (foldErrorBudget X hd G p : ℝ)) ≤ 2 * ∑ i, ((X i).card : ℝ)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.heavyDesignated_le

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.heavyDesignated_pairwise
statement:
theorem heavyDesignated_pairwise {V : Type cycleUniverse15} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) {I : Type cycleUniverse16} [_contextInstance4 : Fintype I] (X : I → Finset V) (a : ℝ)
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (X i) (X j)))
    (hdegree : ∀ i v, v ∈ X i → (G.degree v : ℝ) ≤ a) :

      (heavyDesignated G X a j).edgeSet)

lemma heavyNeighbors_card_le (X : Finset V) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.internal_error_numeric
statement:
lemma internal_error_numeric (m a : ℝ) (e : ℕ) (hm : 8 ≤ m) (ha : 0 ≤ a)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.internal_errors_average
statement:
lemma internal_errors_average (G : SimpleGraph V) (i : I) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)

    finiteAverage (fun p : ∀ j, PairingSpace (X j) =>

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.internal_pairErrors_average
statement:
lemma internal_pairErrors_average (G : SimpleGraph V) (i : I) (hm : 4 ≤ (X i).card) :
    finiteAverage (fun p : ∀ j, PairingSpace (X j) =>
      ((pairErrors X hd (internalGraph G (X i)) p).card : ℝ)) ≤

statement:
lemma loopErrors_average (G : SimpleGraph V) (i : I) (hm : 2 ≤ (X i).card) :

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.mem_crossGraph
statement:
lemma mem_crossGraph {G : SimpleGraph V} {S T : Finset V} {u v : V} :
    s(u,v) ∈ (crossGraph G S T).edgeFinset ↔
      G.Adj u v ∧ ((u ∈ S ∧ v ∈ T) ∨ (u ∈ T ∧ v ∈ S))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.mem_heavyNeighbors
statement:
lemma mem_heavyNeighbors (X : Finset V) (a : ℝ) (v : V) :
    v ∈ heavyNeighbors G X a ↔ a < (neighborsIn G X v : ℝ)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.mem_pairErrors
statement:
lemma mem_pairErrors (H : SimpleGraph V) (p : ∀ i, PairingSpace (X i))
    (q : Finset (Sym2 V)) :
    q ∈ pairErrors X hd H p ↔ q ⊆ H.edgeFinset ∧ q.card = 2 ∧
      DisjointEdgePair q ∧ edgePairEvent X hd p q

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.pair_folding
statement:
theorem pair_folding (G : SimpleGraph V) (X : I → Finset V)
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (X i) (X j))) (a : ℝ) (ha : 1 ≤ a)
    (hm : ∀ i, 8 ≤ (X i).card) (hma : ∀ i, a^2 ≤ (X i).card)
    (hdegree : ∀ i x, x ∈ X i → (G.degree x : ℝ) ≤ a)
    (hneighbor : ∀ i v, (neighborsIn G (X i) v : ℝ) ≤ a) :
    ∃ (p : ∀ i, PairingSpace (X i)) (retained : Finset (Sym2 V))
      (Q : SimpleGraph (FamilyQuotient X p)),
      retained ⊆ G.edgeFinset ∧
      (G.edgeFinset \ retained).card ≤ 2 * ∑ i, (X i).card ∧
      Q.edgeSet = ((retained.image (Sym2.map (familyProject X hd p)) :
         Finset (Sym2 (FamilyQuotient X p))) : Set (Sym2 (FamilyQuotient X p))) ∧
      (∀ e ∈ Q.edgeSet, ∃! f, f ∈ retained ∧ Sym2.map (familyProject X hd p) f = e) ∧
      Fintype.card (FamilyQuotient X p) = Fintype.card V - ∑ i, (X i).card / 2

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.path_edgeFinset_card
statement:
lemma path_edgeFinset_card {V : Type cycleUniverse27} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {a b : V} (p : G.Walk a b) (hp : p.IsPath) : p.edges.toFinset.card = p.length

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.quotientDefect_le_budget
statement:
lemma quotientDefect_le_budget (G : SimpleGraph V) (p : ∀ i, PairingSpace (X i)) :
    quotientDefect G (familyProject X hd p) ≤ foldErrorBudget X hd G p

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.trimHeavyGraph_degree
statement:
theorem trimHeavyGraph_degree (a : ℝ) (v : V) :
    (trimHeavyGraph G X a).degree v ≤ G.degree v

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.trimHeavyGraph_le
statement: lemma trimHeavyGraph_le {V : Type cycleUniverse17} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) {I : Type cycleUniverse18} [_contextInstance4 : Fintype I] (X : I → Finset V) (a : ℝ) : trimHeavyGraph G X a ≤ G

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.trimHeavyGraph_ledger
statement:
theorem trimHeavyGraph_ledger (a : ℝ) :
    (trimHeavyGraph G X a).edgeSet ∪
      (⋃ i, (heavyDesignated G X a i).edgeSet) = G.edgeSet ∧
    Disjoint (trimHeavyGraph G X a).edgeSet
      (⋃ i, (heavyDesignated G X a i).edgeSet)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.trimHeavyGraph_neighbors
statement:
theorem trimHeavyGraph_neighbors {V : Type cycleUniverse19} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) {I : Type cycleUniverse20} [_contextInstance4 : Fintype I] (X : I → Finset V) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (i : I) (v : V) :
    (neighborsIn (trimHeavyGraph G X a) (X i) v : ℝ) ≤ a

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.trim_bipartite_path
statement:
theorem trim_bipartite_path {V : Type cycleUniverse25} {G : SimpleGraph V} (X H : Set V)
    (hd : Disjoint X H)
    (hbi : ∀ {u v}, G.Adj u v → (u ∈ X ∧ v ∈ H) ∨ (u ∈ H ∧ v ∈ X))
    {a b : V} (p : G.Walk a b) (hs : p.IsPath) (hp : 0 < p.length) :
    ∃ q : TrimmedPath G,
      q.walk.edgeSet ⊆ p.edgeSet ∧ p.length ≤ q.walk.length + 2 ∧
      (0 < q.walk.length → q.start ∈ X ∧ q.finish ∈ X)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.trim_bipartite_path_ledger
statement:
theorem trim_bipartite_path_ledger {V : Type cycleUniverse28} {G : SimpleGraph V} (X H : Set V)
    (hd : Disjoint X H)
    (hbi : ∀ {u v}, G.Adj u v → (u ∈ X ∧ v ∈ H) ∨ (u ∈ H ∧ v ∈ X))
    {a b : V} (p : G.Walk a b) (hs : p.IsPath) (hp : 0 < p.length) :
    ∃ (q : TrimmedPath G) (discarded : Finset (Sym2 V)),
      discarded.card ≤ 2 ∧ Disjoint (discarded : Set (Sym2 V)) q.walk.edgeSet ∧
      (discarded : Set (Sym2 V)) ∪ q.walk.edgeSet = p.edgeSet ∧
      (0 < q.walk.length → q.start ∈ X ∧ q.finish ∈ X ∧ 2 ≤ q.walk.length)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.two_paired_edges_placement
statement:
lemma two_paired_edges_placement (G : SimpleGraph V) (p : ∀ i, PairingSpace (X i))
    {u v x y : V} (he : G.Adj u v) (hf : G.Adj x y)
    (hux : familyPaired X p u x) (hvy : familyPaired X p v y) :
    (∃ i, {s(u,v),s(x,y)} ⊆ (internalGraph G (X i)).edgeFinset) ∨
    (∃ i j, i ≠ j ∧ {s(u,v),s(x,y)} ⊆ (crossGraph G (X i) (X j)).edgeFinset)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.CutExpansion.le_order
statement:
lemma CutExpansion.le_order (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (h : ℝ) (hexp : CutExpansion P h) (hr : 2 ≤ Fintype.card V) :
    h ≤ (Fintype.card V : ℝ)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.PreparedBatch.quotient_supported
statement:
lemma PreparedBatch.quotient_supported {V I : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype I]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {X : I → Finset V} {hd}
    (b : PreparedBatch G X hd) (W : Finset V)
    (hW : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, G.Adj x y → x ∈ W ∧ y ∈ W) :
    ∀ ⦃x y⦄, b.quotient.Adj x y →
      x ∈ W.image (familyProject X hd b.pairing) ∧
      y ∈ W.image (familyProject X hd b.pairing)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.avoidGraph_le
statement:
lemma avoidGraph_le {V : Type} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] [_contextInstance2 : DecidableEq V] (P : SimpleGraph V) (F : Finset (Sym2 V)) (W : Finset V) :
    avoidGraph P F W ≤ P

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.ball_avoids
statement:
lemma ball_avoids (P : SimpleGraph V) (F : Finset (Sym2 V)) (W : Finset V)
    (s : V) (hs : s ∉ W) (t : ℕ) : Disjoint (walkBall (avoidGraph P F W) s t) W

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.boundary_sym2_injective
statement:
lemma boundary_sym2_injective (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (U : Finset V) :
    Set.InjOn (fun e : V × V => s(e.1, e.2)) (P.interedges U Uᶜ : Set (V × V))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.deleted_boundary_card_le
statement:
lemma deleted_boundary_card_le (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (U : Finset V) (F : Finset (Sym2 V)) :
    ((P.interedges U Uᶜ).filter (fun e => s(e.1, e.2) ∈ F)).card ≤ F.card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.deleted_boundary_card_le_incidents
statement:
lemma deleted_boundary_card_le_incidents (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (B : Finset V) (F : Finset (Sym2 V)) :
    ((P.interedges B Bᶜ).filter (fun e => s(e.1, e.2) ∈ F)).card ≤
      ∑ v ∈ B, (incidentEdges F v).card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.endpointLoad_insert
statement:
lemma endpointLoad_insert {V : Type} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] [_contextInstance2 : DecidableEq V] {I : Type} [_contextInstance4 : Fintype I] [_contextInstance5 : DecidableEq I] (A : Finset I) (i : I) (hi : i ∉ A) (x y : I → V) (v : V) :
    endpointLoad (insert i A) x y v = endpointLoad A x y v +
      (if v = x i ∨ v = y i then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.endpointLoad_mono
statement:
lemma endpointLoad_mono {V : Type} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] [_contextInstance2 : DecidableEq V] {I : Type} [_contextInstance4 : Fintype I] [_contextInstance5 : DecidableEq I] {A B : Finset I} (hAB : A ⊆ B) (x y : I → V) (v : V) :
    endpointLoad A x y v ≤ endpointLoad B x y v

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.endpointLoad_sum
statement:
lemma endpointLoad_sum {V : Type} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] [_contextInstance2 : DecidableEq V] {I : Type} [_contextInstance4 : Fintype I] [_contextInstance5 : DecidableEq I] (A : Finset I) (x y : I → V) (hxy : ∀ i ∈ A, x i ≠ y i) :
    ∑ v : V, endpointLoad A x y v = 2 * A.card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.exists_short_avoiding_path
statement:
lemma exists_short_avoiding_path (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (hexp : CutExpansion P h) (hr : 2 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (F : Finset (Sym2 V)) (W : Finset V) (s t : V) (hs : s ∉ W) (ht : t ∉ W)
    (hF : ∀ v, ((incidentEdges F v).card : ℝ) ≤ h / 4)
    (hW : (W.card : ℝ) ≤ h / 4) :
    ∃ q : (avoidGraph P F W).Walk s t, q.IsPath ∧
      q.length ≤ 2 * routingG (Fintype.card V) h

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.exists_short_path_with_avoidance
statement:
lemma exists_short_path_with_avoidance (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (hexp : CutExpansion P h) (hr : 2 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (F : Finset (Sym2 V)) (W : Finset V) (s t : V) (hs : s ∉ W) (ht : t ∉ W)
    (hF : ∀ v, ((incidentEdges F v).card : ℝ) ≤ h / 4)
    (hW : (W.card : ℝ) ≤ h / 4) :
    ∃ q : P.Walk s t, q.IsPath ∧ q.length ≤ routingLength (Fintype.card V) h ∧
      Disjoint q.edges.toFinset F ∧ Disjoint q.support.toFinset W

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.family_quotient_image_order
statement:
lemma family_quotient_image_order {V I : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype I]
    (X : I → Finset V) (hd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (X i) (X j))
    (p : ∀ i, PairingSpace (X i)) (W : Finset V) (hX : ∀ i, X i ⊆ W) :
    (W.image (familyProject X hd p)).card + ∑ i, (X i).card / 2 = W.card

statement:
lemma incidentEdges_sum_le (F : Finset (Sym2 V)) :

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.incidentEdges_union

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.rootBallUnion_extract_root
statement:
theorem rootBallUnion_extract_root
    (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (hexp : CutExpansion P h)
    (hr : 0 < (Fintype.card V : ℝ))
    (F : Finset (Sym2 V)) (W : V → Finset V) (g N : ℕ)
    (hFglobal : (F.card : ℝ) ≤ h * (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 16)
    (hg : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 2 < (1 + h / (2 * (Fintype.card V : ℝ))) ^ g) :
    ∀ (A : Finset V) (t : ℕ),
      (∀ s ∈ A, s ∉ W s) →
      (∀ s ∈ A, ((W s).card : ℝ) ≤ h / 4) →
      A.card ≤ 2 ^ N →
      (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 2 < (rootBallUnion P F W A t).card →
      ∃ s ∈ A, (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 2 <
        (walkBall (avoidGraph P F (W s)) s (t + N * g)).card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.rootBallUnion_growth_block

theorem rootBallUnion_growth_block

    (hroots : ∀ s ∈ A, s ∉ W s)
    (hW : ∀ s ∈ A, ((W s).card : ℝ) ≤ h / 4)
    (hpos : 1 ≤ (rootBallUnion P F W A t).card)
    (hF : (F.card : ℝ) ≤ h * (rootBallUnion P F W A t).card / 4)
    (hg : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 2 < (1 + h / (2 * (Fintype.card V : ℝ))) ^ g) :
    (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 2 < (rootBallUnion P F W A (t + g)).card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.rootBallUnion_growth_step

theorem rootBallUnion_growth_step
    (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]

    (F : Finset (Sym2 V)) (W : V → Finset V) (A : Finset V) (t : ℕ)
    (hroots : ∀ s ∈ A, s ∉ W s)
    (hW : ∀ s ∈ A, ((W s).card : ℝ) ≤ h / 4)
    (hsmall : ((rootBallUnion P F W A t).card : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 2)
    (hF : (F.card : ℝ) ≤ h * (rootBallUnion P F W A t).card / 4) :
    (1 + h / (2 * (Fintype.card V : ℝ))) * (rootBallUnion P F W A t).card ≤

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.routing
statement:
theorem routing (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (hexp : CutExpansion P h) (hr : 2 ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (x y : I → V) (hxy : ∀ i, x i ≠ y i) (team : I → T) (Z : I → Finset V)
    (k b z : ℝ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (hload : ∀ v, (endpointLoad Finset.univ x y v : ℝ) ≤ k)
    (hteam : ∀ i, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun j => team j = team i)).card : ℝ) ≤ b)
    (hZ : ∀ i, ((Z i).card : ℝ) ≤ z)
    (hbudget : 64 * ((routingLength (Fintype.card V) h : ℝ) ^ 2 * (k + b) + z) ≤ h) :
    ∃ q : ∀ i, P.Walk (x i) (y i),
      (∀ i, (q i).IsPath ∧ (q i).length ≤ routingLength (Fintype.card V) h ∧
        Disjoint (pathInterior (q i)) (Z i)) ∧
      (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (q i).edges.toFinset (q j).edges.toFinset) ∧
      (∀ i j, i ≠ j → team i = team j → Disjoint (pathInterior (q i)) (pathInterior (q j)))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.routing_budget
statement:
lemma routing_budget (L k b z h r : ℝ) (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hh : 0 < h) (_hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hreach : r ≤ L * h) (hbudget : 64 * (L ^ 2 * (k + b) + z) ≤ h) :
    h / 8 + 2 + k ≤ h / 4 ∧ z + b * L ≤ h / 8 ∧ 64 * L * k * r ≤ h ^ 2

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.routing_large_root_ball

statement:
theorem routing_union_growth_step
    (P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj]

    (F : Finset (Sym2 V)) (B Bnext : Finset V)

    (hmono : B ⊆ Bnext)

    {a : W} (p : Q.Walk a a) (hp : p.IsCycle) (v₀ : V) :
    ∃ s t : W → V,
      (∀ d ∈ p.darts, t d.fst = (R d).fst ∧ s d.snd = (R d).snd) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ p.dropLast.support, projMap (s z) = z ∧ projMap (t z) = z)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.complete_batch_cycle
statement:
theorem complete_batch_cycle {W : Type cycleUniverse19} {Ridx : Type cycleUniverse20} {Q : SimpleGraph W}
    (projMap : V → W) (R : Q.Dart → G.Dart)
    (_hprojMap : ∀ d, projMap (R d).fst = d.fst ∧ projMap (R d).snd = d.snd)
    {a : W} (p : Q.Walk a a) (hp : p.IsCycle)
    (s t : W → V)
    (hports : ∀ d ∈ p.darts, t d.fst = (R d).fst ∧ s d.snd = (R d).snd)
    (hproj : ∀ z ∈ p.dropLast.support, projMap (s z) = z ∧ projMap (t z) = z)
    (q : ∀ z, G.Walk (s z) (t z))
    (hq : ∀ z ∈ p.dropLast.support, (q z).IsPath)
    (U : Ridx → Set V) (hU : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (U i) (U j)))
    (router : {z // z ∈ p.dropLast.support} → Ridx)
    (hroute : ∀ z : {z // z ∈ p.dropLast.support},
      visitInterior s t q z ⊆ U (router z))
    (hteam : ∀ z w : {z // z ∈ p.dropLast.support}, z ≠ w →
      router z = router w → Disjoint (visitInterior s t q z) (visitInterior s t q w))
    (havoid : ∀ z ∈ p.dropLast.support, Disjoint (visitInterior s t q z)
      {v | ∃ d ∈ p.darts, v = (R d).fst ∨ v = (R d).snd}) :
    ∃ (v : V) (c : G.Walk v v), c.IsCycle ∧
      c.edgeSet = {e | ∃ d ∈ p.darts, e = (R d).edge} ∪
        (⋃ z ∈ p.dropLast.support, (q z).edgeSet)

    (hf : ∀ p ∈ q.visits, ∀ r ∈ q.visits, Disjoint p.interior r.ends)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.team_routing_on_set
statement:
theorem team_routing_on_set {I T : Type} [Fintype I]
    (G P : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel P.Adj] (hPG : P ≤ G)
    (W : Finset V) (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hexp : CutExpansionOn P W h) (hr : 2 ≤ W.card)
    (x y : I → V) (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ W) (hy : ∀ i, y i ∈ W)
    (hxy : ∀ i, x i ≠ y i) (team : I → T) (Z : I → Finset V)
    (k b z : ℝ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (hload : ∀ v, (endpointLoad univ x y v : ℝ) ≤ k)
    (hteam : ∀ i, ((univ.filter (fun j => team j = team i)).card : ℝ) ≤ b)
    (hZ : ∀ i, ((Z i).card : ℝ) ≤ z)
    (hbudget : 64 * ((routingLength W.card h : ℝ)^2 * (k+b) + z) ≤ h) :
    ∃ q : ∀ i, G.Walk (x i) (y i),
      (∀ i, (q i).IsPath ∧ (q i).length ≤ routingLength W.card h ∧
        (∀ v ∈ (q i).support, v ∈ W) ∧ (q i).edgeSet ⊆ P.edgeSet ∧
        Disjoint (pathInterior (q i)) (Z i)) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (q i).edgeSet (q j).edgeSet) ∧
      (∀ i j, i ≠ j → team i = team j →
        Disjoint (pathInterior (q i)) (pathInterior (q j)))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.uniform_batch_routing
statement:
theorem uniform_batch_routing :
    ∃ D₀ : ℝ, 1 < D₀ ∧ ∀ D ≥ D₀,
      ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A],
      ∀ (G P : SimpleGraph A) [DecidableRel P.Adj], P ≤ G →
      ∀ W : Finset A, CutExpansionOn P W (D^(9/10:ℝ)/4) →
      D^(9/10:ℝ) ≤ (W.card : ℝ) → (W.card : ℝ) ≤ D^(51/50:ℝ) →
      ∀ (I T : Type) [Fintype I] (x y : I → A),
      (∀ i, x i ∈ W) → (∀ i, y i ∈ W) → (∀ i, x i ≠ y i) →
      ∀ (team : I → T) (Z : I → Finset A),
      (∀ v, (endpointLoad univ x y v : ℝ) ≤ D^(1/100:ℝ)) →
      (∀ i, ((univ.filter (fun j => team j = team i)).card : ℝ) ≤ D^(3/10:ℝ)) →
      (∀ i, ((Z i).card : ℝ) ≤ 2*D^(3/10:ℝ)) →
      ∃ q : ∀ i, G.Walk (x i) (y i),
        (∀ i, (q i).IsPath ∧ (q i).length ≤ routingLength W.card (D^(9/10:ℝ)/4) ∧
          (∀ v ∈ (q i).support, v ∈ W) ∧ (q i).edgeSet ⊆ P.edgeSet ∧
          Disjoint (pathInterior (q i)) (Z i)) ∧
        Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (q i).edgeSet (q j).edgeSet) ∧
        (∀ i j, i ≠ j → team i = team j →
          Disjoint (pathInterior (q i)) (pathInterior (q j)))

theorem uniform_multi_batch_routing :
    ∃ D₀ : ℝ, 1 < D₀ ∧ ∀ D ≥ D₀,
      ∀ (V R I T : Type) [Fintype V] [Fintype R] [Fintype I],
      ∀ (G : SimpleGraph V) (P : R → SimpleGraph V) (U : R → Finset V),
      (∀ r, P r ≤ G) → Pairwise (fun r s => Disjoint (P r).edgeSet (P s).edgeSet) →
      Pairwise (fun r s => Disjoint (U r) (U s)) →
      (∀ r, CutExpansionOn (P r) (U r) (D^(9/10:ℝ)/4)) →
      (∀ r, D^(9/10:ℝ) ≤ ((U r).card:ℝ) ∧ ((U r).card:ℝ) ≤ D^(51/50:ℝ)) →
      ∀ (owner : I → R) (x y : I → V),
      (∀ i, x i ∈ U (owner i) ∧ y i ∈ U (owner i) ∧ x i ≠ y i) →
      ∀ (team : I → T) (Z : I → Finset V),
      (∀ v, (endpointLoad univ x y v:ℝ) ≤ D^(1/100:ℝ)) →
      (∀ i, ((univ.filter (fun j => team j = team i)).card:ℝ) ≤ D^(3/10:ℝ)) →
      (∀ i, ((Z i).card:ℝ) ≤ 2*D^(3/10:ℝ)) →
      ∃ q : ∀ i, G.Walk (x i) (y i),
        (∀ i, (q i).IsPath ∧ (∀ v ∈ (q i).support, v ∈ U (owner i)) ∧
          (q i).edgeSet ⊆ (P (owner i)).edgeSet ∧ Disjoint (pathInterior (q i)) (Z i)) ∧
        Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (q i).edgeSet (q j).edgeSet) ∧
        (∀ i j, i ≠ j → team i = team j → Disjoint (pathInterior (q i)) (pathInterior (q j)))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.uniform_resolve_templates
statement:
theorem uniform_resolve_templates :
    ∃ D₀ : ℝ, 1 < D₀ ∧ ∀ D ≥ D₀,
      ∀ (V R B : Type) [Fintype V] [Fintype R] [Fintype B],
      ∀ (G F : SimpleGraph V) (P : R → SimpleGraph V) (U : R → Finset V),
      F ≤ G → (∀ r, P r ≤ G) →
      Pairwise (fun r s => Disjoint (P r).edgeSet (P s).edgeSet) →
      Pairwise (fun r s => Disjoint (U r) (U s)) →
      (∀ r, Disjoint F.edgeSet (P r).edgeSet) →
      (∀ r, CutExpansionOn (P r) (U r) (D^(9/10:ℝ)/4)) →
      (∀ r, D^(9/10:ℝ) ≤ ((U r).card:ℝ) ∧ ((U r).card:ℝ) ≤ D^(51/50:ℝ)) →
      ∀ (b : B → RoutingTemplate G),
      (∀ j, (b j).edges ⊆ F.edgeSet) →
      Pairwise (fun j k => Disjoint (b j).edges (b k).edges) →
      ∀ owner : (j : B) → (b j).Arity → R,
      (∀ j i, (b j).x i ∈ U (owner j i) ∧ (b j).y i ∈ U (owner j i)) →
      (∀ j i, (F.degree ((b j).x i):ℝ) ≤ D^(1/100:ℝ) ∧
        (F.degree ((b j).y i):ℝ) ≤ D^(1/100:ℝ)) →
      (∀ j, (Fintype.card (b j).Arity:ℝ) ≤ D^(3/10:ℝ)) →
      (∀ j, ((b j).vertices.card:ℝ) ≤ 2*D^(3/10:ℝ)) →
      ∃ (parts : B → Set (Sym2 V)) (used : Set (Sym2 V)),
        (∀ j, CycleOrSingleEdge G (parts j)) ∧
        Pairwise (fun j k => Disjoint (parts j) (parts k)) ∧
        used ⊆ ⋃ r, (P r).edgeSet ∧ Disjoint F.edgeSet used ∧
        (⋃ j, parts j) = (⋃ j, (b j).edges) ∪ used

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.BatchTemplateFamily.subset
OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.cycle_template_of_representatives
statement:
theorem cycle_template_of_representatives {V W : Type} [Fintype W]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {Q : SimpleGraph W} (projMap : V → W)
    (S : Set (Sym2 V)) (hSG : S ⊆ G.edgeSet)
    (hrep : ∀ e ∈ Q.edgeSet, ∃! f, f ∈ S ∧ Sym2.map projMap f = e)
    {a : W} (p : Q.Walk a a) (hp : p.IsCycle) :
    ∃ b : RoutingTemplate G,
      b.edges = {e | e ∈ S ∧ Sym2.map projMap e ∈ p.edgeSet} ∧
      Fintype.card b.Arity ≤ Fintype.card W ∧
      b.vertices.card ≤ 2*Fintype.card W ∧
      ∀ i, projMap (b.x i) = projMap (b.y i)

    {a : W} (p : Q.Walk a a) (hp : p.IsCycle)
    (M : ℕ) (hM : p.dropLast.support.toFinset.card ≤ M) :
    ∃ b : RoutingTemplate G,
      b.edges = {e | e ∈ S ∧ Sym2.map projMap e ∈ p.edgeSet} ∧
      Fintype.card b.Arity ≤ M ∧
      b.vertices.card ≤ 2*M ∧
      ∀ i, projMap (b.x i) = projMap (b.y i)

    (hrep : ∀ e ∈ Q.edgeSet, ∃! f, f ∈ S ∧ Sym2.map projMap f = e)
    {k : ℕ} (hQ : EdgeDecomposition Q k) :
    ∃ b : Fin k → RoutingTemplate G,

      (∀ i, Fintype.card (b i).Arity ≤ Fintype.card W ∧

      (∀ i, Fintype.card (b i).Arity ≤ A.card ∧

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.uniform_batch_resolution
statement:
theorem uniform_batch_resolution :
    ∃ D₀ : ℝ, 1 < D₀ ∧ ∀ D ≥ D₀,
      ∀ (V R B : Type) [Fintype V] [Fintype R] [Fintype B],
      ∀ (G F : SimpleGraph V) (P : R → SimpleGraph V) (U : R → Finset V),
      F ≤ G → (∀ r, P r ≤ G) →
      Pairwise (fun r s => Disjoint (P r).edgeSet (P s).edgeSet) →
      Pairwise (fun r s => Disjoint (U r) (U s)) →
      (∀ r, Disjoint F.edgeSet (P r).edgeSet) →
      (∀ r, CutExpansionOn (P r) (U r) (D^(9/10:ℝ)/4)) →
      (∀ r, D^(9/10:ℝ) ≤ ((U r).card:ℝ) ∧ ((U r).card:ℝ) ≤ D^(51/50:ℝ)) →
      ∀ (J : B → SimpleGraph V) (W : B → Finset V),
      (∀ b, J b ≤ F) → Pairwise (fun b c => Disjoint (J b).edgeSet (J c).edgeSet) →
      (⋃ b, (J b).edgeSet) = F.edgeSet →
      (∀ b, ∀ ⦃x y⦄, (J b).Adj x y → x ∈ W b ∧ y ∈ W b) →
      (∀ b, ((W b).card:ℝ) ≤ D^(3/10:ℝ)) →
      ∀ (I : B → Type) [∀ b, Fintype (I b)] (X : ∀ b, I b → Finset V)
        (hXd : ∀ b, Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (X b i) (X b j)),
      (∀ b i, X b i ⊆ W b) →
      ∀ rX : ∀ b, I b → R,
      (∀ b i, X b i ⊆ U (rX b i)) →
      (∀ b i v, v ∈ X b i → (F.degree v:ℝ) ≤ D^(1/100:ℝ)) →
      ∀ (prep : ∀ b, PreparedBatch (J b) (X b) (hXd b)) (k : B → ℕ),
      (∀ b, EdgeDecomposition (prep b).quotient (k b)) →
      ∃ (K : Type) (_ : Fintype K) (parts : K → Set (Sym2 V)) (used : Set (Sym2 V)),
        Fintype.card K ≤ (∑ b, k b) + 8 * ∑ b, ∑ i, (X b i).card ∧
        (∀ j, CycleOrSingleEdge G (parts j)) ∧
        Pairwise (fun j l => Disjoint (parts j) (parts l)) ∧
        used ⊆ ⋃ r, (P r).edgeSet ∧ Disjoint F.edgeSet used ∧
        (⋃ j, parts j) = F.edgeSet ∪ used

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Batch.prepared_quotient_cost
statement:
lemma prepared_quotient_cost {V I : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype I]
    (J : SimpleGraph V) (X : I → Finset V) (hd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (X i) (X j))
    (p : PreparedBatch J X hd) (W : Finset V)
    (hW : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, J.Adj x y → x ∈ W ∧ y ∈ W)
    (hX : ∀ i, X i ⊆ W) (n : ℕ) (M t : ℝ) (_ht : 0 ≤ t) (hn : W.card < n) (hM : (W.card:ℝ) ≤ M)
    (ih : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] (H : SimpleGraph A), Fintype.card A < n → (Fintype.card A:ℝ) ≤ M →
      (decompositionCost H:ℝ) ≤ t * Fintype.card A) :
    ∃ k, EdgeDecomposition p.quotient k ∧

OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.box_recursion
statement:
theorem box_recursion (G : SimpleGraph V) (A : Finset V) (T : ℝ)
    (hT : 4 ≤ T) (hA : A.Nonempty) (hG : SupportedOn G A)
    (hsplit : ∀ B ⊆ A, ∀ H : SimpleGraph V, H ≤ G → SupportedOn H B → T < (B.card : ℝ) →
      ∃ U ⊆ B, U.Nonempty ∧ 2*U.card ≤ B.card ∧
        ((externalOn H U).card : ℝ) < (1/32:ℝ)*U.card/(logb 2 B.card)^2) :
    ∃ L : List (AssignedPiece V),
      (∀ P ∈ L, P.vertices ⊆ A ∧ P.vertices.Nonempty ∧ (P.vertices.card : ℝ) ≤ T) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ A, ∃ P ∈ L, x ∈ P.vertices) ∧
      GraphPartition G (L.map AssignedPiece.graph) ∧
      (L.map (fun P => (P.vertices.card : ℝ)*splitPotential T P.vertices.card)).sum ≤
        (A.card : ℝ)*splitPotential T A.card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.connector_exists

    (X Z J : Finset V) (hX : X.Nonempty) (hZ : Z.Nonempty)
    (hXJ : Disjoint X J) (hZJ : Disjoint Z J)
    (hconnX : ∀ x ∈ X, ∀ y ∈ X, (avoidGraph G J).Reachable x y)
    (_hconnZ : ∀ x ∈ Z, ∀ y ∈ Z, (avoidGraph G J).Reachable x y)
    (hmX : m ≤ (X.card : ℝ)) (hmZ : m ≤ (Z.card : ℝ))
    (hJ : (J.card : ℝ) < α*m) :
    ∃ x ∈ X, ∃ z ∈ Z, (avoidGraph G J).Reachable x z

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.cycle_across_middle

theorem cycle_across_middle (G : SimpleGraph V) (X J Z : List V)
    (hnd : (X ++ J ++ Z).Nodup) (hC : (X ++ J ++ Z).IsChain G.Adj)
    (hj : 1 ≤ J.length)
    (hc : ∃ x ∈ X, ∃ z ∈ Z, ∃ q : G.Walk x z,
      q.IsPath ∧ ∀ w ∈ q.support, w ∉ J ∧ (w ∈ X → w = x) ∧ (w ∈ Z → w = z)) :
    ∃ a : V, ∃ c : G.Walk a a, c.IsCycle ∧ J.length + 2 ≤ c.length

    ((U ∪ externalOn G U).card : ℝ) ≤ 3*A.card/4 ∧
    (A\U).card < A.card ∧

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.cut_extraction
statement:
theorem cut_extraction (G : SimpleGraph V) (A : Finset V)
    (hG : SupportedOn G A) (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) :
    ∃ (R : List (AssignedPiece V)) (H : SimpleGraph V),
      (∀ P ∈ R, P.vertices ⊆ A ∧ 2 ≤ P.vertices.card ∧
        CutExpansionOn P.graph P.vertices σ) ∧
      R.Pairwise (fun P Q => Disjoint P.vertices Q.vertices) ∧
      GraphPartition G (H :: R.map AssignedPiece.graph) ∧
      SupportedOn H A ∧
      (edgeCount H : ℝ) ≤ σ * A.card * A.card.log2

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.cut_split_properties
statement:
lemma cut_split_properties {V : Type cycleUniverse5} [_contextInstance1 : Fintype V] [_contextInstance2 : DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (A U : Finset V)
    (hG : SupportedOn G A) (_hU : U ⊆ A) :
    (∀ x y, G.Adj x y ↔ (crossingGraph G U (A\U)).Adj x y ∨
        (restrictGraph G U).Adj x y ∨ (restrictGraph G (A\U)).Adj x y) ∧
    Disjoint (crossingGraph G U (A\U)) (restrictGraph G U) ∧
    Disjoint (crossingGraph G U (A\U)) (restrictGraph G (A\U)) ∧
    Disjoint (restrictGraph G U) (restrictGraph G (A\U))

OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.remove_long_cycles
statement:
theorem remove_long_cycles (G : SimpleGraph V) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    ∃ (H : SimpleGraph V) (L : List (SimpleGraph V)),
      H ≤ G ∧ NoLongCycle H ℓ ∧
      (∀ K ∈ L, IsCycleGraph K ∧ ℓ ≤ (edgeCount K : ℝ)) ∧
      GraphPartition G (H::L) ∧
      (L.length : ℝ)*ℓ + edgeCount H ≤ edgeCount G

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.scale_boxes
statement:
theorem scale_boxes : ∃ Dsp : ℝ, ∀ D ≥ Dsp,
    ∀ (V : Type u) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
      (G : SimpleGraph V) (A : Finset V), A.Nonempty → SupportedOn G A →
      2*(edgeCount G : ℝ)/A.card ≤ D →
    ∃ (C : List (SimpleGraph V)) (L : List (AssignedPiece V)),
      (∀ K ∈ C, IsCycleGraph K ∧ D^(101/100:ℝ) ≤ (edgeCount K : ℝ)) ∧
      (C.length : ℝ) ≤ A.card/(2*D^(1/100:ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ P ∈ L, P.vertices ⊆ A ∧ P.vertices.Nonempty ∧ (P.vertices.card : ℝ) ≤ D^(51/50:ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ A, ∃ P ∈ L, x ∈ P.vertices) ∧
      GraphPartition G (C++L.map AssignedPiece.graph) ∧
      (L.map (fun P => (P.vertices.card : ℝ))).sum ≤ (1+2/logb 2 D)*A.card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.scale_cut_extraction
statement:
theorem scale_cut_extraction : ∃ Dcut : ℝ, ∀ D ≥ Dcut,
    ∀ (V : Type u) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
      (G : SimpleGraph V) (A : Finset V), A.Nonempty → SupportedOn G A →
      (A.card : ℝ) ≤ D^(51/50:ℝ) →
    ∃ (R : List (AssignedPiece V)) (H : SimpleGraph V),
      (∀ P ∈ R, P.vertices ⊆ A ∧ D^(9/10:ℝ) ≤ P.vertices.card ∧
        (P.vertices.card:ℝ) ≤ D^(51/50:ℝ) ∧ CutExpansionOn P.graph P.vertices (D^(9/10:ℝ))) ∧
      R.Pairwise (fun P Q => Disjoint P.vertices Q.vertices) ∧
      GraphPartition G (H :: R.map AssignedPiece.graph) ∧ SupportedOn H A ∧
      2*(edgeCount H : ℝ)/A.card ≤ D^(19/20:ℝ)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.sparse_neighborhood_from_cycle_exclusion
statement:
lemma sparse_neighborhood_from_cycle_exclusion (G : SimpleGraph V) (A : Finset V)
    (hG : SupportedOn G A) (ℓ : ℝ) (hNL : NoLongCycle G ℓ)
    (hα : 0 < (1/32:ℝ)/(logb 2 A.card)^2)
    (hα1 : (1/32:ℝ)/(logb 2 A.card)^2 ≤ 1)
    (hq : 1 ≤ ((1/32:ℝ)/(logb 2 A.card)^2)^2*A.card/100)
    (hmargin : ℓ < ((1/32:ℝ)/(logb 2 A.card)^2)^2*A.card/100) :
    ∃ U ⊆ A, U.Nonempty ∧ 2*U.card ≤ A.card ∧
      ((externalOn G U).card : ℝ) < (1/32:ℝ)*U.card/(logb 2 A.card)^2

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.advance_bounded

lemma advance_bounded (s : SplitSystem V) (n Dstar : ℝ) (hn : 0 ≤ n)
    (hs : ∀ l P, Dstar ≤ inductionScale n l → P.vertices.Nonempty →
      2*(edgeCount P.graph:ℝ)/P.vertices.card ≤ inductionScale n l →
      (s l P).Bounded (inductionScale n l))
    (j k : ℕ) (L : List (AssignedPiece V))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.scale_split
statement:
theorem scale_split : ∃ Dsp : ℝ, ∀ D ≥ Dsp,
    ∀ (V : Type u) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
      (G : SimpleGraph V) (A : Finset V), A.Nonempty → SupportedOn G A →
      2*(edgeCount G : ℝ)/A.card ≤ D →
    ∃ (C : List (SimpleGraph V)) (L : List (AssignedPiece V))
      (R : AssignedPiece V → List (AssignedPiece V))
      (H : AssignedPiece V → SimpleGraph V),
      (∀ K ∈ C, IsCycleGraph K ∧ D^(101/100:ℝ) ≤ (edgeCount K : ℝ)) ∧
      (C.length : ℝ) ≤ A.card/(2*D^(1/100:ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ P ∈ L, P.vertices ⊆ A ∧ P.vertices.Nonempty ∧
        (P.vertices.card : ℝ) ≤ D^(51/50:ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ A, ∃ P ∈ L, x ∈ P.vertices) ∧
      (L.map (fun P => (P.vertices.card : ℝ))).sum ≤ (1+2/logb 2 D)*A.card ∧
      (∀ P ∈ L,
        (∀ Q ∈ R P, Q.vertices ⊆ P.vertices ∧
          D^(9/10:ℝ) ≤ Q.vertices.card ∧
          (Q.vertices.card:ℝ) ≤ D^(51/50:ℝ) ∧
          CutExpansionOn Q.graph Q.vertices (D^(9/10:ℝ))) ∧
        (R P).Pairwise (fun Q T => Disjoint Q.vertices T.vertices) ∧
        GraphPartition P.graph (H P :: (R P).map AssignedPiece.graph) ∧
        SupportedOn (H P) P.vertices ∧
        2*(edgeCount (H P) : ℝ)/P.vertices.card ≤ D^(19/20:ℝ)) ∧
      GraphPartition G (C ++ L.flatMap (fun P => H P :: (R P).map AssignedPiece.graph))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.scale_splitter

      ∀ D ≥ Dsp, ∀ P, P.vertices.Nonempty →
        2*(edgeCount P.graph:ℝ)/P.vertices.card ≤ D → (split D P).Bounded D

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.decompositionCost_adjoin
statement:
lemma decompositionCost_adjoin {V I J : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (parts : I → Set (Sym2 V))
    (hp : ∀ i, CycleOrSingleEdge G (parts i))
    (hd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (parts i) (parts j))
    (W : J → Type) [∀ j, Fintype (W j)] (H : ∀ j, SimpleGraph (W j))
    (f : ∀ j, H j →g G) (hf : ∀ j, Function.Injective (f j))
    (hHH : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (Sym2.map (f i) '' (H i).edgeSet)
      (Sym2.map (f j) '' (H j).edgeSet))
    (hHP : ∀ j i, Disjoint (Sym2.map (f j) '' (H j).edgeSet) (parts i))
    (hu : (⋃ i, parts i) ∪ (⋃ j, Sym2.map (f j) '' (H j).edgeSet) = G.edgeSet) :
    decompositionCost G ≤ Fintype.card I + ∑ j, decompositionCost (H j)

    (hd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (parts i) (parts j))
    (H : J → SimpleGraph V) (hHG : ∀ j, H j ≤ G)
    (hHH : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (H i).edgeSet (H j).edgeSet)
    (hHP : ∀ j i, Disjoint (H j).edgeSet (parts i))

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Indexing.active_occurrences
statement:
theorem active_occurrences {V : Type cycleUniverse8} {I : Type cycleUniverse9} {J : Type cycleUniverse10} [DecidableEq V]
    [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (Y good : Finset V) (W : I → Finset V) (R : J → Finset V)
    (_hW : ∀ i, W i ⊆ Y) (hRsub : ∀ j, R j ⊆ Y)
    (hcover : Y ⊆ Finset.univ.biUnion W)
    (hR : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (R i) (R j))
    (keep : I → J → Prop) [∀ i j, Decidable (keep i j)] :
    let active := ∑ i, ∑ j, if keep i j then (W i ∩ R j ∩ good).card else 0
    let skipped := ∑ i, ∑ j, if keep i j then 0 else (W i ∩ R j ∩ good).card
    (∑ j, (R j).card) ≤ active + skipped + (Y \ good).card ∧
    active + Y.card ≤ (∑ j, (R j).card) + ∑ i, (W i).card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Indexing.indexed_batch_construction
statement:
lemma indexed_batch_construction (w : I → ℕ) (A : Finset I) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ A, (w i : ℝ) ≤ B/2) :
    ∃ P : List (Finset I),
      P.Pairwise Disjoint ∧
      (∀ i, i ∈ A ↔ ∃ b ∈ P, i ∈ b) ∧
      (∀ b ∈ P, b.Nonempty ∧ batchWeight w b ≤ B) ∧
      (∀ b ∈ P.tail, B/2 < batchWeight w b) ∧
      (P.map (batchWeight w)).sum = batchWeight w A

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Indexing.indexed_batch_partition
statement:
theorem indexed_batch_partition (w : I → ℕ) (A : Finset I) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ A, (w i : ℝ) ≤ B/2) :
    ∃ P : List (Finset I),
      P.Pairwise Disjoint ∧
      (∀ i, i ∈ A ↔ ∃ b ∈ P, i ∈ b) ∧
      (∀ b ∈ P, b.Nonempty ∧ batchWeight w b ≤ B) ∧
      (P.map (batchWeight w)).sum = batchWeight w A ∧
      (P.length : ℝ) ≤ 1 + 2*batchWeight w A/B

    (F : SimpleGraph V) (Y : Finset V) (H : I → SimpleGraph V) (U : I → Finset V)
    (hHH : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (H i).edgeSet (H j).edgeSet)
    (hu : (⋃ i, (H i).edgeSet) = F.edgeSet)
    (hU : ∀ i, ∀ ⦃x y⦄, (H i).Adj x y → x ∈ U i ∧ y ∈ U i)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.box_cost_regroup
statement:
lemma box_cost_regroup {B R : AssignedPiece V} (A : List (AssignedPiece V))
    (hBR : GraphPartition B.graph (R.graph :: A.map AssignedPiece.graph))
    (s : SplitSystem V) (j k : ℕ) (c q : ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ P ∈ pastPieces s j k [R], (decompositionCost P.graph:ℝ) ≤ c*P.vertices.card)
    (hq : (decompositionCost (graphUnion ((advance s j k [R]).map AssignedPiece.graph ++
      A.map AssignedPiece.graph)):ℝ) ≤ q) :
    (decompositionCost B.graph:ℝ) ≤ (pastCycles s j k [R]).length +
      c*vertexMass (pastPieces s j k [R]) + q

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.selected_input_cost
statement:
lemma selected_input_cost (s : SplitSystem V) (j k) (P : AssignedPiece V) (c α β γ : ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ B ∈ (s j P).boxes, ∀ Q ∈ pastPieces s (j+1) k [(s j P).rest B],
      (decompositionCost Q.graph:ℝ) ≤ c*Q.vertices.card)
    (hq : ∀ B ∈ (s j P).boxes,
      (decompositionCost (graphUnion ((advance s (j+1) k [(s j P).rest B]).map AssignedPiece.graph ++
        ((s j P).pieces B).map AssignedPiece.graph)):ℝ) ≤
      c*vertexMass ((s j P).pieces B) + α*vertexMass (advance s (j+1) k [(s j P).rest B]) +
      β*vertexMass ((s j P).pieces B) + γ*B.vertices.card) :
    (decompositionCost P.graph:ℝ) ≤ ((pastCycles s j (k+1) [P]).length:ℝ) +
      c*vertexMass (pastPieces s j (k+1) [P]) + α*vertexMass (advance s j (k+1) [P]) +
      β*vertexMass (levelPieces s j [P]) + γ*vertexMass (nextLayer s j [P])

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.selected_prefix_cost

lemma selected_prefix_cost (s : SplitSystem V) (i k) (P : AssignedPiece V) (c α β γ : ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ Q ∈ pastPieces s 0 (i+(k+1)) [P], (decompositionCost Q.graph:ℝ) ≤ c*Q.vertices.card)
    (hq : ∀ Q ∈ advance s 0 i [P], ∀ B ∈ (s i Q).boxes,
      (decompositionCost (graphUnion ((advance s (i+1) k [(s i Q).rest B]).map AssignedPiece.graph ++
        ((s i Q).pieces B).map AssignedPiece.graph)):ℝ) ≤
      c*vertexMass ((s i Q).pieces B) + α*vertexMass (advance s (i+1) k [(s i Q).rest B]) +
      β*vertexMass ((s i Q).pieces B) + γ*B.vertices.card) :
    (decompositionCost P.graph:ℝ) ≤ ((pastCycles s 0 (i+(k+1)) [P]).length:ℝ) +
      c*vertexMass (pastPieces s 0 (i+(k+1)) [P]) + α*vertexMass (advance s 0 (i+(k+1)) [P]) +
      β*vertexMass (levelPieces s i (advance s 0 i [P])) + γ*vertexMass (advance s 0 (i+1) [P])

statement:
lemma disjoint_subset_mass {V A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq V]
    (U : A → Finset V) (Y : Finset V) (hd : Pairwise fun r s => Disjoint (U r) (U s))
    (hu : ∀ r, U r ⊆ Y) : (∑ r, ((U r).card:ℝ)) ≤ Y.card

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.Layers.gap_log
statement:
lemma Layers.gap_log (H : Layers P Dstar) (hn : 1 < (P.vertices.card:ℝ)) (i) :
    logb 2 (H.scale (i+200)) = scaleTheta^200 * logb 2 (H.scale i)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.assigned_union_edges
statement:
lemma assigned_union_edges (L : List (AssignedPiece V)) :
    (⋃ i : Fin L.length, (L.get i).graph.edgeSet) = (graphUnion (L.map AssignedPiece.graph)).edgeSet

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.box_coupled_partition
statement:
lemma box_coupled_partition {B R : AssignedPiece V} (A : List (AssignedPiece V))
    (hBR : GraphPartition B.graph (R.graph :: A.map AssignedPiece.graph))
    (s : SplitSystem V) (j k : ℕ) :
    GraphPartition (graphUnion ((advance s j k [R]).map AssignedPiece.graph ++ A.map AssignedPiece.graph))
      ((advance s j k [R]).map AssignedPiece.graph ++ A.map AssignedPiece.graph)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.pastPieces_mem
statement:
lemma pastPieces_mem (s : SplitSystem V) (j k : ℕ) (L : List (AssignedPiece V))
    {R : AssignedPiece V} (hR : R ∈ pastPieces s j k L) :
    ∃ l < k, R ∈ levelPieces s (j+l) (advance s j l L)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.main_gap_scalar
statement:
lemma main_gap_scalar (q n S M L Nt Ni C t w : ℝ)
    (hn : 0 ≤ n) (hS : 0 ≤ S) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hw : 0 < w)
    (hM : M ≤ mainP*S) (hL : L ≤ mainH*n/w)
    (hNt : Nt ≤ n+mainH*n/w) (hNilo : n ≤ Ni) (hNihi : Ni ≤ 2*n)
    (hq : q ≤ L+(9+C*mainEta)*M+(t+8)*Nt+(8-t/3)*S+((2/3)*t/w-8)*Ni) :
    q ≤ mainA₂*(S+n/w)+(C/100)*S+t*(n-S/3+mainA₁*n/w)

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.main_terminal_scalar
statement:
lemma main_terminal_scalar (q n M C Dstar : ℝ) (hn : 0 ≤ n) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hCbig : 4*(20+Dstar+18*mainP) ≤ C) (hM : M ≤ 2*mainP*n)
    (hq : q ≤ (20+Dstar)*n+(9+C*mainEta)*M) :
    q ≤ C*Batch.inductionPhi n*n

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.Layers.past_mass_eq_sequence
statement:
lemma Layers.past_mass_eq_sequence (H : Layers P Dstar) (k) (hk : k ≤ H.count) :
    vertexMass (pastPieces H.system 0 k [P]) = ∑ j ∈ range k, H.pieceSequence j

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.Layers.pieceSequence_nonneg
statement: lemma Layers.pieceSequence_nonneg (H : Layers P Dstar) (j) : 0 ≤ H.pieceSequence j

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.Layers.pieceSequence_zero
statement:
lemma Layers.pieceSequence_zero (H : Layers P Dstar) (j) (hj : H.count ≤ j) :
    H.pieceSequence j = 0

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.Scale.Layers.prefix_choice
statement:
lemma Layers.prefix_choice (H : Layers P Dstar) :
    vertexMass (pastPieces H.system 0 H.count [P]) = 0 ∨
    ∃ i < H.count, 0 < H.pieceMass i ∧
      ∀ k ≤ H.count, k ≤ i+201 →
        vertexMass (pastPieces H.system 0 k [P]) ≤ ErdosGallai.mainP*H.pieceMass i

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.main_cost_eq_batch
statement:
lemma main_cost_eq_batch {V : Type} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    decompositionCost G = Batch.decompositionCost G

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.main_cost_eq_scale
statement:
lemma main_cost_eq_scale {V : Type} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) :

name: OAI.ErdosGallai.main_edge_bound
statement:
lemma main_edge_bound {V : Type} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    2*(Scale.edgeCount G:ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card V:ℝ)^2

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covers.mono_cover
statement:
theorem Covers.mono_cover {G H A : Family α} (h : Covers G A) (hGH : G ⊆ H) :

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covers.mono_target
statement:
theorem Covers.mono_target {G A B : Family α} (h : Covers G A) (hBA : B ⊆ A) :

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covers.union
statement:
theorem Covers.union {G H A B : Family α} (hGA : Covers G A) (hHB : Covers H B) :

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem bernoulliMass_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.cost_biUnion_le
statement:
theorem cost_biUnion_le {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p)

    cost p (T.biUnion G) ≤ ∑ i ∈ T, cost p (G i)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.cost_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem cost_empty (p : ℝ) : cost p (∅ : Family α) = 0

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.cost_image_le
statement:
theorem cost_image_le {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.cost_mono
statement:
theorem cost_mono {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) {G H : Family α} (h : G ⊆ H) :

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.cost_nonneg
statement: theorem cost_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (G : Family α) : 0 ≤ cost p G

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.cost_singleton
statement:
@[simp] theorem cost_singleton (p : ℝ) (I : Finset α) :

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.cost_union_le
statement:
theorem cost_union_le {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (G H : Family α) :
    cost p (G ∪ H) ≤ cost p G + cost p H

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.covers_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem covers_empty (G : Family α) : Covers G ∅

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.covers_self
statement: theorem covers_self (A : Family α) : Covers A A

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.cubeSet_decide
statement:
@[simp] theorem cubeSet_decide (S : Finset α) :

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.familyIndicator_le_one
statement:
theorem familyIndicator_le_one (D : Family α) (x : α → Bool) :

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.familyIndicator_nonneg
statement:
theorem familyIndicator_nonneg (D : Family α) (x : α → Bool) :
    0 ≤ familyIndicator D x

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.familyIndicator_sq
statement:
theorem familyIndicator_sq (D : Family α) (x : α → Bool) :

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.familyMeasure_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem familyMeasure_empty (p : ℝ) :

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.familyMeasure_mono
statement:
theorem familyMeasure_mono {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.familyMeasure_nonneg
statement:
theorem familyMeasure_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (D : Family α) : 0 ≤ familyMeasure p D

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.mem_cubeSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_cubeSet {x : α → Bool} {a : α} :
    a ∈ cubeSet x ↔ x a = true

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.mem_unionTuple
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_unionTuple {k : ℕ} {f : Fin k → Finset α} {a : α} :
    a ∈ unionTuple f ↔ ∃ j, a ∈ f j

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.small_empty
statement: theorem small_empty (p : ℝ) : Small p (∅ : Family α)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.subset_unionTuple
statement:
theorem subset_unionTuple {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Finset α) (j : Fin k) :
    f j ⊆ unionTuple f

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.unionTuple_subset_iff
statement:
theorem unionTuple_subset_iff {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Finset α) (S : Finset α) :
    unionTuple f ⊆ S ↔ ∀ j, f j ⊆ S

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.expectation_add
statement:
theorem expectation_add (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f g : Ω → ℝ) :
    μ.expectation (fun ω => f ω + g ω) = μ.expectation f + μ.expectation g

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.expectation_const
statement:
@[simp] theorem expectation_const (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (c : ℝ) :
    μ.expectation (fun _ => c) = c

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.expectation_mono
statement:
theorem expectation_mono (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) {f g : Ω → ℝ} (hfg : ∀ ω, f ω ≤ g ω) :
    μ.expectation f ≤ μ.expectation g

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.expectation_nonneg
statement:
theorem expectation_nonneg (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) {f : Ω → ℝ} (hf : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω) :
    0 ≤ μ.expectation f

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.expectation_prod
statement:
theorem expectation_prod (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (ν : FiniteLaw Γ) (f : Ω × Γ → ℝ) :
    (μ.prod ν).expectation f = μ.expectation (fun ω => ν.expectation (fun γ => f (ω, γ)))

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.expectation_smul
statement:
theorem expectation_smul (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (c : ℝ) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    μ.expectation (fun ω => c * f ω) = c * μ.expectation f

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.expectation_sub
statement:
theorem expectation_sub (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f g : Ω → ℝ) :
    μ.expectation (fun ω => f ω - g ω) = μ.expectation f - μ.expectation g

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.expectation_sum
statement:
theorem expectation_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) :
    μ.expectation (fun ω => ∑ i, f i ω) = ∑ i, μ.expectation (f i)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.iid_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem iid_weight (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (n : ℕ) (ω : Fin n → Ω) :
    (iid μ n).weight ω = ∏ i, μ.weight (ω i)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.pi_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem pi_weight {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {A : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (A i)]
    (μ : ∀ i, FiniteLaw (A i)) (ω : ∀ i, A i) :
    (pi μ).weight ω = ∏ i, (μ i).weight (ω i)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_compl
statement:
theorem prob_compl (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : Ω → Prop) :
    μ.prob (fun ω => ¬ P ω) = 1 - μ.prob P

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_eq_expectation
statement:
theorem prob_eq_expectation (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : Ω → Prop) :
    μ.prob P = μ.expectation (fun ω => if P ω then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_false
statement: @[simp] theorem prob_false (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) : μ.prob (fun _ => False) = 0

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_ge_le_expectation_div
statement:
theorem prob_ge_le_expectation_div (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    μ.prob (fun ω => t ≤ f ω) ≤ μ.expectation f / t

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_le_expectation
statement:
theorem prob_le_expectation (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : Ω → Prop) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω) (hP : ∀ ω, P ω → 1 ≤ f ω) : μ.prob P ≤ μ.expectation f

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_le_one
statement: theorem prob_le_one (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : Ω → Prop) : μ.prob P ≤ 1

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_mono
statement:
theorem prob_mono (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) {P Q : Ω → Prop} (hPQ : ∀ ω, P ω → Q ω) :
    μ.prob P ≤ μ.prob Q

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_nonneg
statement: theorem prob_nonneg (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : Ω → Prop) : 0 ≤ μ.prob P

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_true
statement: @[simp] theorem prob_true (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) : μ.prob (fun _ => True) = 1

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_union_le
statement:
theorem prob_union_le (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P Q : Ω → Prop) :
    μ.prob (fun ω => P ω ∨ Q ω) ≤ μ.prob P + μ.prob Q

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prod_isPositive
statement:
theorem prod_isPositive (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (ν : FiniteLaw Γ)
    (hμ : μ.IsPositive) (hν : ν.IsPositive) : (μ.prod ν).IsPositive

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prod_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem prod_weight (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (ν : FiniteLaw Γ) (ω : Ω) (γ : Γ) :
    (μ.prod ν).weight (ω, γ) = μ.weight ω * ν.weight γ

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.uniform_isPositive
statement:
theorem uniform_isPositive (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω] :
    (uniform Ω).IsPositive

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.uniform_prob
statement:
theorem uniform_prob (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (P : Ω → Prop) :
    (uniform Ω).prob P = ((Finset.univ.filter P).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliExpectation_product
statement:
theorem bernoulliExpectation_product (p : ℝ) (f : α → Bool → ℝ) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => ∏ x, f x (decide (x ∈ W))) =
      ∏ x, (p * f x true + (1 - p) * f x false)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliLaw_expect_sum_mem
statement:
theorem bernoulliLaw_expect_sum_mem (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (f : α → ℝ) :
    (bernoulliLaw p hp0 hp1).expectation (fun W => ∑ x ∈ W, f x) = p * ∑ x, f x

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliLaw_expectation
statement:
@[simp] theorem bernoulliLaw_expectation (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (f : Finset α → ℝ) :
    (bernoulliLaw p hp0 hp1).expectation f = bernoulliExpectation p f

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliLaw_prob
statement:
@[simp] theorem bernoulliLaw_prob (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (P : Finset α → Prop) : (bernoulliLaw p hp0 hp1).prob P = bernoulliProbability p P

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliLaw_prob_disjoint
statement:
theorem bernoulliLaw_prob_disjoint (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (A : Finset α) :
    (bernoulliLaw p hp0 hp1).prob (fun W => Disjoint W A) = (1 - p) ^ A.card

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliLaw_prob_mem
statement:
theorem bernoulliLaw_prob_mem (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (a : α) :
    (bernoulliLaw p hp0 hp1).prob (fun s => a ∈ s) = p

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliLaw_prob_subset
statement:
theorem bernoulliLaw_prob_subset (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (A : Finset α) :
    (bernoulliLaw p hp0 hp1).prob (fun s => A ⊆ s) = p ^ A.card

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem bernoulliLaw_weight (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (W : Finset α) :
    (bernoulliLaw p hp0 hp1).weight W = bernoulliWeight p W

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliProbability_disjoint
statement:
theorem bernoulliProbability_disjoint (p : ℝ) (A : Finset α) :
    bernoulliProbability p (fun W => Disjoint W A) = (1 - p) ^ A.card

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliProbability_eq_expectation
statement:
theorem bernoulliProbability_eq_expectation (p : ℝ) (P : Finset α → Prop) :
    bernoulliProbability p P = bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => if P W then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliProbability_subset
statement:
theorem bernoulliProbability_subset (p : ℝ) (A : Finset α) :
    bernoulliProbability p (fun W => A ⊆ W) = p ^ A.card

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliWeight_eq_mass
statement:
theorem bernoulliWeight_eq_mass (p : ℝ) (s : Finset α) :
    bernoulliWeight p s = bernoulliMass p s

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem bernoulliWeight_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (W : Finset α) :
    0 ≤ bernoulliWeight p W

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliWeight_pos
statement:
theorem bernoulliWeight_pos {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (W : Finset α) :
    0 < bernoulliWeight p W

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliWeight_sum
statement: theorem bernoulliWeight_sum (p : ℝ) : ∑ W : Finset α, bernoulliWeight p W = 1

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bitLaw_prob_false
statement:
@[simp] theorem bitLaw_prob_false (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
    (bitLaw p hp0 hp1).prob (fun b => b = false) = 1 - p

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bitLaw_prob_true
statement:
@[simp] theorem bitLaw_prob_true (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
    (bitLaw p hp0 hp1).prob (fun b => b = true) = p

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bitLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem bitLaw_weight (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (b : Bool) :
    (bitLaw p hp0 hp1).weight b = bitWeight p b

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bitWeight_false
statement: @[simp] theorem bitWeight_false (p : ℝ) : bitWeight p false = 1 - p

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bitWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem bitWeight_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (b : Bool) :
    0 ≤ bitWeight p b

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bitWeight_true
statement: @[simp] theorem bitWeight_true (p : ℝ) : bitWeight p true = p

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.cubeExpectation_eq_bernoulliExpectation
statement:
theorem cubeExpectation_eq_bernoulliExpectation (p : ℝ) (f : (α → Bool) → ℝ) :
    cubeExpectation p f = bernoulliExpectation p (fun s => f (finsetBoolEquiv s))

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.cubeExpectation_familyIndicator
statement:
theorem cubeExpectation_familyIndicator (p : ℝ) (D : Family α) :
    cubeExpectation p (familyIndicator D) = familyMeasure p D

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.cubeExpectation_product
statement:
theorem cubeExpectation_product (p : ℝ) (f : α → Bool → ℝ) :
    cubeExpectation p (fun x => ∏ i, f i (x i)) =
      ∏ i, (p * f i true + (1 - p) * f i false)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.cubeSet_finsetBoolEquiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem cubeSet_finsetBoolEquiv (s : Finset α) :
    cubeSet (finsetBoolEquiv s) = s

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.cubeWeight_finsetBoolEquiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem cubeWeight_finsetBoolEquiv (p : ℝ) (s : Finset α) :
    cubeWeight p (finsetBoolEquiv s) = bernoulliWeight p s

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.cubeWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem cubeWeight_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (x : α → Bool) :
    0 ≤ cubeWeight p x

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.cubeWeight_sum
statement: theorem cubeWeight_sum (p : ℝ) : ∑ x : α → Bool, cubeWeight p x = 1

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.disjoint_indicator_product
statement:
theorem disjoint_indicator_product (A W : Finset α) :
    (if Disjoint W A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      ∏ x, (if x ∈ A then (if x ∈ W then (0 : ℝ) else 1) else 1)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.subset_indicator_product
statement:
theorem subset_indicator_product (A W : Finset α) :
    (if A ⊆ W then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      ∏ x, (if x ∈ A then (if x ∈ W then (1 : ℝ) else 0) else 1)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.sum_finset_product
statement:
theorem sum_finset_product (f : α → Bool → ℝ) :
    (∑ W : Finset α, ∏ x, f x (decide (x ∈ W))) =
      ∏ x, (f x true + f x false)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bin_card_cost_bound
statement:
theorem bin_card_cost_bound {n r h : ℕ} {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hw : (n : ℝ) * q ^ r * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (h + 1) ≤ 1) :
    (n : ℝ) * (q / (2 : ℝ) ^ 70) ^ r ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (h + 1)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bin_power_bound
statement:
theorem bin_power_bound {m h : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ 2 ^ (12 * h)) :
    (m : ℝ) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ h) ^ 16 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (4 * h)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.finite_bin_cost_lt_quarter
statement:
theorem finite_bin_cost_lt_quarter (B : Finset (ℕ × ℕ))
    (hB : ∀ b ∈ B, 1 ≤ b.1 ∧ 64 * b.1 ≤ b.2) :
    (∑ b ∈ B, 3 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ b.2) < 1 / 4

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.finite_bin_geometric_bound
statement:
theorem finite_bin_geometric_bound (B : Finset (ℕ × ℕ))
    (hB : ∀ b ∈ B, 1 ≤ b.1 ∧ 64 * b.1 ≤ b.2) {a : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha' : a ≤ 1 / 2) :
    (∑ b ∈ B, a ^ b.2) ≤ 4 * a ^ 64

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.finite_bin_power_lt_threshold
statement:
theorem finite_bin_power_lt_threshold (B : Finset (ℕ × ℕ))
    (hB : ∀ b ∈ B, 1 ≤ b.1 ∧ 64 * b.1 ≤ b.2) :
    (∑ b ∈ B, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (4 * b.2)) < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 32

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.outright_weight_le
statement:
theorem outright_weight_le {r : ℕ} {q w : ℝ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hw : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (64 * r) ≤ w) :
    (q / (2 : ℝ) ^ 70) ^ r ≤ (1 / 64 : ℝ) * q ^ r * w

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.binExponent_eq_of_bounds
OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.binExponent_lower
statement:
theorem binExponent_lower {w : ℝ} (hwpos : 0 < w) (hwle : w ≤ 1) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (binExponent w + 1) < w

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.binExponent_spec
statement:
theorem binExponent_spec {w : ℝ} (hwpos : 0 < w) (hwle : w ≤ 1) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (binExponent w + 1) < w ∧
      w ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ binExponent w

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.binExponent_upper
statement:
theorem binExponent_upper {w : ℝ} (hwpos : 0 < w) (hwle : w ≤ 1) :
    w ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ binExponent w

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.exists_dyadic_bin
statement:
theorem exists_dyadic_bin {w : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hwpos : 0 < w)
    (hwn : w < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) :
    ∃ h : ℕ, n ≤ h ∧ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (h + 1) < w ∧ w ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ h

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.le_binExponent_of_le_pow
statement:
theorem le_binExponent_of_le_pow {w : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hwpos : 0 < w)
    (hwn : w ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) : n ≤ binExponent w

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.le_binExponent_of_lt_pow
statement:
theorem le_binExponent_of_lt_pow {w : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hwpos : 0 < w)
    (hwn : w < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) : n ≤ binExponent w
